100.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫਤਹ ॥
100.e: The Lord is One and the Victory is of the True Guru.

100.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
100.e: The Lord is one and the Victory is of the Lord.

100.g: ਅਥ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਲਿਖ︀ਯਤੇ ॥
100.e: CHANDI CHARITRA IS NOW COMPOSED

100.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
100.e: NARAAJ STANZA

100.g: ਮਹਿਖ ਦਈਤ ਸੂਰਯੰ ॥
ਬਢਿਯੋ ਸੋ ਲੋਹ ਪੂਰਯੰ ॥
100.e: He conquered Indra, the king of gods

100.g: ਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਰਾਜ ਜੀਤਯੰ ॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਕ ਰਾਜ ਕੀਤਯੰ ॥੧॥
100.e: And ruled over the three worlds.1.

100.g: ਭਜੇ ਸੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਤਬੈ ॥
100.e: At that time the gods ran away

100.g: ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਬੈ ॥
100.e: And all of them gathered together.

100.g: ਮਹੇਸੁਰਾਚਲੰ ਬਸੇ ॥
100.e: They inhabited the Kailash mountain

100.g: ਬਿਸੇਖ ਚਿਤ ਮੋ ਤ੍ਰਸੇ ॥੨॥
100.e: With great fear in their mind.2.

100.g: ਜੁਗੇਸ ਭੇਸ ਧਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
100.e: They disguised themselves as great Yogis

100.g: ਭਜੇ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ਡਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
100.e: And throwing their weapons, they all ran away.

100.g: ਪੁਕਾਰ ਆਰਤੰ ਚਲੈ ॥
100.e: Crying in great distress they walked.

100.g: ਬਿਸੂਰ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਭਲੇ ॥੩॥
100.e: The fine heroes were in great agony.3.

100.g: ਬਰਖ ਕਿਤੇ ਤਹਾ ਰਹੇ ॥
100.e: They lived there for may years

100.g: ਸੁ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਮੋ ਸਹੇ ॥
100.e: And endured many sufferings on their bodies.

100.g: ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਿ ਧਿਆਇਯੰ ॥
100.e: They mediated on the mother of the universe

100.g: ਸੁ ਜੈਤ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਇਯੰ ॥੪॥
100.e: For conquering the demon Mahishasura.4.

100.g: ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਭਏ ॥
100.e: The gods wrere pleased

100.g: ਚਰੰਨ ਪੂਜਬੇ ਧਏ ॥
100.e: And sped to worship the feet of the goddess.

100.g: ਸਨੰਮੁਖਾਨ ਠਢੀਯੰ ॥
100.e: They stood before her

100.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਾਮ ਪਾਠ ਪਢੀਯੰ ॥੫॥
100.e: And recited her eulogy.5.

100.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
100.e: DOHRA,

100.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਚੰਡਿਕਾ; ਉਠੀ ਸੁ ਸੰਖ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
100.e: After killing Sumbh, Chnadika rose to blow her conch.,

100.g: ਤਬ ਧੁਨਿ ਘੰਟਾ ਕੀ ਕਰੀ; ਮਹਾ ਮੋਦ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨੨੨॥
100.e: Then she sounded the gong as a mark of Victory, with great delight in her mind.222.,

100.g: ਦੈਤ ਰਾਜ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਹਨਿਓ; ਦੇਵੀ ਇਹ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥
100.e: The goddess killed the king of demons in this way in an instant.,

100.g: ਅਸਟ ਕਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਗਹਿ; ਸੈਨਾ ਦਈ ਸੰਘਾਰ ॥੨੨੩॥
100.e: Holding her weapons in her eight hands, she destroyed the army of demons. 223.,

100.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
100.e: DOHRA

100.g: ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਤਿ ਸਇਆ ਕੋ ਕਰਿਓ; ਜਾ ਸਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
100.e: I have translated the book named Satsayya (a poem of seven hundred shalokas), which hath nothing equal to it.

100.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਮਿਤ ਕਵਿ ਨੇ ਕਹਿਓ; ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਚੰਡਿਕਾ, ਸੋਇ ॥੨੩੩॥
100.e: The purpose for which the poet hath comosed it, Chandi may grant him the same.233.

100.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਪੁਰਾਨੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਉਕਤਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਦੇਵ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਸਹਿਤ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਸਬਦ ਕਰਾ ਅਸਟਮੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੮॥
ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
100.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

100.g: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਏਵਡ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
100.e: I shall never forget You-You are such a Great Giver!

100.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
100.e: Please grant Your Grace, and imbue me with the love of devotional worship.

100.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ; ਏਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
100.e: If it pleases You, let me meditate on You day and night; please, grant me this gift! ||1||

100.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਅੰਧੀ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
100.e: Into this blind clay, You have infused awareness.

100.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ; ਭਲੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
100.e: Everything, everywhere which You have given is good.

100.g: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ; ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
100.e: Bliss, joyful celebrations, wondrous plays and entertainment-whatever pleases You, comes to pass. ||2||

100.g: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
100.e: Everything we receive is a gift from Him

100.g: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ; ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
100.e: -the thirty-six delicious foods to eat,

100.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਪਵਣਾ; ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
100.e: cozy beds, cooling breezes, peaceful joy and the experience of pleasure. ||3||

100.g: ਸਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਦੀਜੈ; ਜਿਤੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
100.e: Give me that state of mind, by which I may not forget You.

100.g: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
100.e: Give me that understanding, by which I may meditate on You.

100.g: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
100.e: I sing Your Glorious Praises with each and every breath. Nanak takes the Support of the Guru's Feet. ||4||12||19||

100.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
100.e: SWAYYA

100.g: ਦੇਹ ਸਿਵਾ, ਬਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੈ; ਸੁਭ ਕਰਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਟਰੋ ॥
100.e: O Goddess, grant me this that I may not hesitate from performing good actions.

100.g: ਨ ਡਰੋ ਅਰਿ ਸੋ, ਜਬ ਜਾਇ ਲਰੋ; ਨਿਸਚੈ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਜੀਤ ਕਰੋ ॥
100.e: I may not fear the enemy, when I go to fight and assuredly I may become victorious.

100.g: ਅਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਹੌ ਆਪਨੇ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਕੋ; ਇਹ ਲਾਲਚ ਹਉ, ਗੁਨ ਤਉ ਉਚਰੋ ॥
100.e: And I may give this instruction to my mind and have this tempotration that I may ever utter Thy Praises.

100.g: ਜਬ ਆਵ ਕੀ ਅਉਧ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਬਨੈ; ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਰਨ ਮੈ ਤਬ ਜੂਝ ਮਰੋ ॥੨੩੧॥
100.e: When the end of my life comes, then I may die fighting in the battlefield.231.

100.g: ਚੰਡਿ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਵਿਤਨ ਮੈ; ਬਰਨਿਓ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਰਸ ਰੁਦ੍ਰਮਈ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: I have narrated this Chandi Charitra in poetry, which is all full of Rudra Rasa (sentiment of ragge).

100.g: ਏਕ ਤੇ ਏਕ ਰਸਾਲ ਭਇਓ; ਨਖ ਤੇ ਸਿਖ ਲਉ ਉਪਮਾ ਸੁ ਨਈ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: The stanzas one and all, are beautifully composed, which contain new sillies from beginning to end.

100.g: ਕਉਤਕ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰੀ ਕਵਿ ਨੇ; ਸਤਿਸਯ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਇਹ ਪੂਰੀ ਭਈ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: The poet hath composed it for the pleasure of his mind, and the discourse of seven hundred sholokas is completed here.

100.g: ਜਾਹਿ ਨਮਿਤ ਪੜੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਹੈ ਨਰ; ਸੋ ਨਿਸਚੈ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਦਈ ਹੈ ॥੨੩੨॥
100.e: For whatever purpose a person ready it or listens to it, the hgoddess will assuredly grant him that.232.

100.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
100.e: SWAYYA

100.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਅਸੀਸ ਸਭੈ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਰਿ; ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਰਤੀ ਦੀਪ ਜਗਾਇਓ ॥
100.e: All the women of the gods bless the goddess and performing the aarti (the religious ceremony performed around the image of the deity) they have lighted the lamps.

100.g: ਫੂਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੁਅਛਤ ਦਛਨ; ਜਛਨ ਜੀਤ ਕੋ ਗੀਤ ਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
100.e: They offer flowers, fragrance and rice and the women of Yakshas sing songs of victory.

100.g: ਧੂਪ ਜਗਾਇ ਕੈ, ਸੰਖ ਬਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਸੀਸ ਨਿਵਾਇ ਕੈ, ਬੈਨ ਸੁਨਾਇਓ ॥
100.e: They burn the incence and blow the conch and supplicate bowing their heads.

100.g: ਹੇ ਜਗ ਮਾਇ, ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਇ; ਤੈ ਸੁੰਭ ਕੋ ਘਾਇ, ਬਡੋ ਜਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨੨੮॥
100.e: “O Universal mother, ever Giver of the comfort, by killing Sumbh, Thou hast earned a great approhbation.”228.

100.g: ਸਕ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਾਜ ਦੈ ਚੰਡ ਸੁ; ਮੋਦ ਮਹਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਈ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: Giving all the royal paraphernalia to Indra, Chandi is very much pleased in her mind.

100.g: ਸੂਰ ਸਸੀ ਨਭਿ ਥਾਪ ਕੈ ਤੇਜੁ ਦੇ; ਆਪ ਤਹਾ ਤੇ ਸੁ ਲੋਪ ਭਈ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: Sabilising the sun and moon in the sky and making them glorious, she herself hath disappeared.

100.g: ਬੀਚ ਅਕਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਬਢਿਓ; ਤਿਹ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨ ਗਈ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: The light of sun and moon hath increased in the sky, the powt hath not forgotten its comparison from his mind.

100.g: ਧੂਰਿ ਕੈ ਪੂਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੁਤੋ ਰਵਿ; ਮਾਨਹੁ ਚੰਡਿਕਾ ਓਪ ਦਈ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੯॥
100.e: It seemed that the sun had become filthy with dust and the goddess Chandi hath given him the splendour.229.

100.g: ਰੇਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
100.e: I applied the dust of the feet of the Saints to my face.

100.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ; ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥
100.e: My evil-mindedness disappeared, along with my misfortune and false-mindedness.

100.g: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ. ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
100.e: I sit in the true home of my self; I sing His Glorious Praises. O Nanak, my falsehood has vanished! ||4||11||18||

100.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
100.e: SWAYYA,

100.g: ਚੰਡਿ ਕੇ ਕੋਪ ਨ ਓਪ ਰਹੀ; ਰਨ ਮੈ ਅਸਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਭਈ ਸਮੁਹਾਈ ॥
100.e: When Chnadi appeared with her sword in the battlefield. None of the demons could withstand her ire.,

100.g: ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਦਏ; ਤਬ ਭੂਪ ਬਿਨਾ, ਕਰੈ ਕਉਨ ਲਰਾਈ ॥
100.e: She killed and destroyed all, who can then wage a war without the king?,

100.g: ਕਾਪ ਉਠੇ ਅਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਹੀਏ ਧਰਿ; ਛਾਡਿ ਦਈ ਸਭ ਪਉਰਖਤਾਈ ॥
100.e: The enemies trembled with fear in their hearts, they abandoned the pride of their heroism.,

100.g: ਦੈਤ ਚਲੈ ਤਜਿ ਖੇਤ ਇਉ, ਜੈਸੇ; ਬਡੇ ਗੁਨ ਲੋਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਤ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥੨੨੪॥
100.e: Then the demons leaving the battlefield, ran away like the good qualities from the avarice.224.,

100.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਸੁੰਭ ਬਧਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਪਤਮੋ ਧਿਆਯ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੰ ॥੭॥
100.e: End of the Seventh Chapter entitled ‘Slaying of Sumbh’ in CHANDI CHARITRA of Markandeya Purana.7.,

100.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
100.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

100.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀਆ ॥
100.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is eternally pure.

100.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ; ਦੂਖ ਬਿਡਾਰਨ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
100.e: The Lord is the Giver of Peace and the Dispeller of sorrow.

100.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਿ. ਸਗਲੇ ਦੇਖੇ; ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਸਭ ਤੇ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
100.e: I have seen and tasted all other flavors, but to my mind, the Subtle Essence of the Lord is the sweetest of all. ||1||

100.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
100.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

100.g: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ; ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
100.e: To praise You is to follow Your Command and Your Will.

100.g: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
100.e: That which pleases You is spiritual wisdom and meditation.

100.g: ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ. ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ; ਭਾਣੈ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
100.e: That which pleases God is chanting and meditation; to be in harmony with His Will is perfect spiritual wisdom. ||1||

100.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
100.e: He alone sings Your Ambrosial Naam,

100.g: ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
100.e: Who is pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master.

100.g: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ. ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ; ਸੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
100.e: You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You. The minds of the Saints are attuned to You, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

100.g: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
100.e: You cherish and nurture the Saints.

100.g: ਸੰਤ ਖੇਲਹਿ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
100.e: The Saints play with You, O Sustainer of the World.

100.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
100.e: Your Saints are very dear to You. You are the breath of life of the Saints. ||3||

100.g: ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੇ ॥
100.e: My mind is a sacrifice to those Saints who know You,

100.g: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੇ ॥
100.e: and are pleasing to Your Mind.

100.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
100.e: In their company I have found a lasting peace. Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||13||20||

100.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
100.e: KAVIT

100.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੇ ਸੁ ਦੇਵਨ, ਬਡਾਈ ਕਰੀ ਕਾਲਿਕਾ ਕੀ; ਏਹੋ, ਜਗ ਮਾਤ, ਤੈ ਤੋ ਕਟਿਓ ਬਡੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: All the gods gathered and sang this Eulogy in praise of the goddess: “O Universal mother, Thou hast effaced a very great sin

100.g: ਦੈਤਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਰ, ਰਾਜ ਦੀਨੋ ਤੈ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ; ਬਡੋ ਜਸੁ ਲੀਨੇ ਜਗਿ, ਤੇਰੋ ਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: “Thou hast bestowed on Indra the kingdom of heaven by killing the demons, Thou hast earned great repulations and Thy glory hath spread in the world.

100.g: ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਅਸੀਸ, ਦਿਜ ਰਾਜ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ; ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ਪੜਿਓ ਹੈ, ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਉਚ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਜਾਪ ਹੈ ॥
100.e: “All the sages, spiritual as well as royal bless Thee again and again, they have revited there the mantra called ‘Brahm-Kavach’ (the spiritual coat of mail).”

100.g: ਐਸੇ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰ ਰਹਿਓ, ਚੰਡਿਕਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨ ਲੋਕਿ; ਜੈਸੇ ਧਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ, ਗੰਗਾ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਆਪੁ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੭॥
100.e: The praise of Chandika pervades thus in all the three worlds like the merging of the pure water of the ganges in the current of the ocean.227.

100.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
100.e: KAVIT

100.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਮਧੁ ਕੈਟ ਮਦ ਮਥਨ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰੈ; ਮਾਨ, ਮਰਦਨ ਕਰਨ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਬਰ ਬੰਡਕਾ ॥
100.e: She who is the destroyer of the pride of Madhu nad Kaitabh and then the ego of Mahishasura nad who is very active in granting the boon.

100.g: ਧੂਮ੍ਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਧਰਨਧਰਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਧਾਨੀ ਕਰਨ; ਚੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਮੁੰਡ ਕੇ, ਮੁੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡਕਾ ॥
100.e: She who dashed the tumultuous Dhumar Lochan against the earth and sliced the heads of Chand and Mund.

100.g: ਰਕਤ ਬੀਰਜ ਹਰਨ, ਰਕਤ ਭਛਨ ਕਰਨ; ਦਰਨ ਅਨਸੁੰਭ ਰਨਿ, ਰਾਰ ਰਿਸ ਮੰਡਕਾ ॥
100.e: She who is the killer of Raktavija and drinker of his blood, masher of the enemies and beginner of the war with Nisumbh with great ire in the battlefield.

100.g: ਸੰਭ ਬਲੁ ਧਾਰ, ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕਰਵਾਰ ਕਰਿ; ਸਕਲ ਖਲੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਦਲੁ ਜੈਤ ਜੈ ਚੰਡਿਕਾ ॥੨੩੦॥
100.e: She who is the destroyer of the powerful Sumbh with sword in her hand and is the conqueror of all the forces of foolish demons, HAIL, HAIL To THAT CHANDI.230.

100.g: ਖੈਚ ਕੈ ਮੂੰਡ ਦਈ ਕਰਵਾਰ ਕੀ; ਏਕ ਕੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਬ ਦੋਊ ॥
100.e: The goddess pulled out her sword and struck it on the neck of Sumbh, cutting his body into two parts.,

100.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਦੁ ਟੂਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਰਿਓ; ਤਨ ਜਿਉ ਕਲਵਤ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਚੀਰਤ ਕੋਊ ॥੨੨੧॥
100.e: The body of Sumbh cut into two fell in such a way on the earth as the same had been ripped by the saw.221.,

100.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
100.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

100.g: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ; ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
100.e: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am Your fish.

100.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ; ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤਿਖਹਾਰੇ ॥
100.e: Your Name is the drop of water, and I am a thirsty rainbird.

100.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
100.e: You are my hope, and You are my thirst. My mind is absorbed in You. ||1||

100.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ; ਪੀ ਖੀਰੁ. ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥
100.e: Just as the baby is satisfied by drinking milk,

100.g: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ; ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
100.e: and the poor person is pleased by seeing wealth,

100.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ. ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਠੰਢਾ; ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ. ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
100.e: and the thirsty person is refreshed by drinking cool water, so is this mind drenched with delight in the Lord. ||2||

100.g: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ; ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
100.e: Just as the darkness is lit up by the lamp,

100.g: ਭਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ; ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
100.e: and the hopes of the wife are fulfilled by thinking about her husband,

100.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ, ਜਿਉ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ, ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
100.e: and people are filled with bliss upon meeting their beloved, so is my mind imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

100.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
100.e: The Saints have set me upon the Lord's Path.

100.g: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਝਾਇਆ ॥
100.e: By the Grace of the Holy Saint, I have been attuned to the Lord.

100.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਰਾ. ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
100.e: The Lord is mine, and I am the slave of the Lord. O Nanak, the Guru has blessed me with the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||14||21||

100.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
100.e: SWAYYA.,

100.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਗਇਓ ਮਘਵਾ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਡਰ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਸਭੈ ਭੈ ਭੀਤੇ ॥
100.e: With whose fear Indra had fied from heaven and Brahma and other gods, had been filled with fear.,

100.g: ਤੇਈ ਵੈ ਦੈਤ ਪਰਾਇ ਗਏ; ਰਨਿ ਹਾਰ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਭਏ ਬਲੁ ਰੀਤੇ ॥
100.e: The same demons, seeing defeat in the battlefield, being devoid of their power had run away.,

100.g: ਜੰਬੁਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਝ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਏ; ਬਨ ਬਾਸ ਗਏ ਜੁਗ ਜਾਮਨ ਬੀਤੇ ॥
100.e: The jackals and vultures, having been dejected, have returned to the forest, even the two watches of the day have not elapsed.

100.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਜਗ ਮਾਇ; ਸੁ ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਬਡੇ ਅਰਿ ਜੀਤੇ ॥੨੨੫॥
100.e: The mother of the world (goddess), ever the protector of saints, hath conquered the great enemies Sumbh and Nisumbh.225.

100.g: ਦੇਵ ਸਭੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਇਕ ਠਉਰ; ਸੁ ਅਛਤ ਕੁੰਕਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
100.e: All the gods gathering at one place and taking rice, saffron and sandalwood.

100.g: ਤਛਨ ਲਛਨ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਦਛਨ; ਟੀਕਾ ਸੁ ਚੰਡਿ ਕੇ ਭਾਲ ਮੈ ਦੀਨੋ ॥
100.e: Lakhs of gods, circumambulating the goddess immeditately applied the frontal mark (of victory) on her forehead.

100.g: ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੋ ਉਪਜ︀ਯੋ ਤਹ ਭਾਵ ਇਹੈ ਕਵਿ ਨੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਲਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
100.e: The glory of that event hath been imagined by the poet in his mind like this:

100.g: ਮਾਨਹੁ ਚੰਦ ਕੈ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੈ; ਸੁਭ ਮੰਗਲ ਆਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਹਿ ਕੀਨੋ ॥੨੨੬॥
100.e: It seemed that in the sphere of the moon, the period of “propitious rejoicings” hath penetrated. 226.

101.e: TOTAK STANZA

101.g: ਤਬ ਦਾਨਵ ਰੋਸ ਭਰੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ॥
101.e: All the demons were filled with anger,

101.g: ਜਗ ਮਾਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਣ ਲਗੈ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
101.e: When the were pierced by the arrows of the Mother of the worls.
Those brave warriors caught hold of their weapons with pleasure,
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
All the shafts shot by the demons with their hands,
Were intercepted by the goddess to protect herself.

101.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਢਾਲ ਢਾਹੇ ਕਿਤੇ ਪਾਸ ਪੇਲੇ ॥
101.e: Many were thrown on the ground with her shield and many were entrapped within the baited trap.

101.g: ਭਰੇ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੋਹੂ ਜਨੋ ਫਾਗ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੧੩॥
101.e: The clothes saturated with blood created an illusion of Holi.13.

101.g: ਦ੍ਰੁਗਾ ਹੂੰ ਕੀਯੰ ਖੇਤ ਧੁੰਕੇ ਨਗਾਰੇ ॥
101.e: The trumpets sounded and Durga began to wage war.
She had pattas, axes and baits in her hands
She caught of pellet bow, mace and pellets.

101.g: ਹਠੀ ਮਾਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ॥੧੪॥
101.e: The persistent warriors were shouting “Kill, Kill”.14.
The goddess held eight weapons in her eitht hands,
And hit them on the heads of chief demons.
The demon-king rored like a lion in the battlefield,

101.g: ਕਰੇ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡੰ ਸੁ ਜੋਧਾ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥੧੫॥
101.e: And chopped into bits, many great warriors.15.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

101.g: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
101.e: My Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the nine treasures, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, wealth and prosperity.
He is the Deep and Profound Treasure of Life.

101.g: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ; ਜੋ. ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
101.e: Hundreds of thousands, even millions of pleasures and delights are enjoyed by one who falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are sanctified,
and all family and friends are saved.

101.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.e: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Inaccessible and Unfathomable True Lord. ||2||
The One, the Guru, who is sought by all-only a few,
By great good fortune, receive His Darshan.

101.g: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਥਾਨਾ; ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ. ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
101.e: His Place is lofty, infinite and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me that palace. ||3||
Your Ambrosial Name is deep and profound.
That person is liberated, in whose heart You dwell.

101.g: ਗੁਰਿ. ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੇ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
101.e: The Guru cuts away all his bonds; O Servant Nanak, he is absorbed in the poise of intuitive peace. ||4||16||23||
Whoever drinks this in, is satisfied.

101.g: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
101.e: Whoever obtains the Sublime Essence of the Naam becomes immortal.

101.g: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ. ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.e: The Treasure of the Naam is obtained by one whose mind is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

101.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
101.e: One who obtains the Sublime Essence of the Lord is satisfied and fulfilled.

101.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਡੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
101.e: One who obtains this Flavor of the Lord does not waver.

101.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
101.e: One who has this destiny written on his forehead obtains the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

101.g: ਹਰਿ. ਇਕਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਆਇਆ; ਵਰਸਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
101.e: The Lord has come into the hands of the One, the Guru, who has blessed so many with good fortune.
Attached to Him, a great many have been liberated.

101.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਵਿਰਲੀ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
101.e: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam; says Nanak, those who see the Lord are very rare. ||4||15||22||
RASAAVAL STANZA
Then the gods ran towards the goddess
With bowed heads.
The flowers were showered
And all the saints (hods) were pleased.6.
The goddess was worshipped
With the recitation of Vesdas manifested by Brahma.
When they fell at the feet of the goddess
All their sufferings ended.7.
They made their supplication,
And pleased the goddess
Who wore all her weapons,
And mounted the lion.8.
The songs resounded without interruption
The sounds was heard by the demon-king,
Who made preparations for the war.9.
The demon-king marched forward
And appointed four generals
One was Chamar, the second was Chichhur,
Both brave and persistent.10.
The third was the brave biralachh,
They were all mighty warriors and most tenacious.
They were great archers
And marched forward like dark clouds.11.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Through and through, the Lord is intermingled with His servant.
God, the Giver of Peace, cherishes His servant.

101.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
101.e: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the grain for the servant of my Lord and Master. ||1||
God has cut the noose from around my neck; He has placed me in His Service.

101.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ; ਸੇਵਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
101.e: The Lord and Master's Command is pleasing to the mind of His servant.

101.g: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ. ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.e: He does that which pleases his Lord and Master. Inwardly and outwardly, the servant knows his Lord. ||2||

101.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
101.e: You are the All-knowing Lord and Master; You know all ways and means.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

101.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
101.e: By God's Grace, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.
By God's Kindness, I sing the songs of joy.

101.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ. ਸਗਲ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
101.e: While standing and sitting, while sleeping and while awake, meditate on the Lord, all your life. ||1||

101.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ ॥
101.e: The Holy Saint has given me the Medicine of the Naam.
My sins have been cut out, and I have become pure.

101.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ; ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.e: I am filled with bliss, and all my pains have been taken away. All my suffering has been dispelled. ||2||

101.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ; ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
101.e: One who has my Beloved on his side,
Is liberated from the world-ocean.

101.g: ਸਤਿ ਕਰੇ. ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ; ਸੋ. ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
101.e: One who recognizes the Guru practices Truth; why should he be afraid? ||3||
Since I found the Company of the Holy and met the Guru,
The demon of pride has departed.

101.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ. ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
101.e: With each and every breath, Nanak sings the Lord's Praises. The True Guru has covered my sins. ||4||17||24||
DOHRA

101.g: ਬਾਣਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਰਾਛਸਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ; ਛਾਡਤ ਭਏ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
101.e: The arrows showered by all the demons together in great numbers,

101.g: ਫੂਲਮਾਲ ਹੁਐ ਮਾਤ ਉਰਿ; ਸੋਭੇ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ॥੧੨॥
101.e: Became a garland the neck of the goddess (the universal mother), bedecking it.12.

102.e: And began to shoot arrows like the rain-drops.16.

102.g: ਜਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਕੈ ਸਿਆਮ ਘਟਾ ਘੁਮਡੀ ॥
102.e: Like the roaring and advancing dark clouds,
The forces of the demon-king marched forward.

102.g: ਜਗ ਮਾਤ, ਬਿਰੂਥਨਿ ਮੋ ਧਸਿ ਕੈ ॥
102.e: The Mother of the world, penetrating into the armies of the enemy,

102.g: ਧਨੁ ਸਾਇਕ ਹਾਥ ਗਹਿਯੋ ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ॥੧੭॥
102.e: She caught hold of the bow and arrows smilingly.17.
She overthrew in the battlefield the herds of elephants,
And chopped into halves some of them.
On the heads of some of them she struck such a mighty blow,
That the bodies were pierced from the heads to the foot-palm.

102.g: ਤਨ ਝਝਰ ਹੁਐ ਰਣ ਭੂਮਿ ਗਿਰੇ ॥
102.e: The decayed bodies fell in the battlefield

102.g: ਇਕ ਭਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਫਿਰ ਕੈ ਨ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
102.e: Some ran away and did not return

102.g: ਇਕਿ ਹਾਥ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਲੈ ਆਨਿ ਬਹੇ ॥
102.e: Some have caught hold of weapons and entered the battlefield

102.g: ਲਰਿ ਕੈ ਮਰਿ ਕੈ ਗਿਰਿ ਖੇਤਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧੯॥
102.e: And after fighting have died and fallen in the field.19.
CHAUPAI
The enemies who came before the goddess, they were all killed by her.
When all the army was thus effaced, then the egoistic demon-king was filled with rage.26.
Then the goddess Durga herself waged the war, and picked up and killed the warriors wearing armour.
The flame of ire manifested itself from her forehead, which appeared in the form of goddess kalka.27.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
You are the tree; Your branches have blossomed forth.
From the very small and subtle, You have become huge and manifest.

102.g: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ. ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ; ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
102.e: You are the Ocean of Water, and You are the foam and the bubbles on its surface. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||1||
You are the thread, and You are also the beads.
You are the knot, and You are the primary bead of the maalaa.

102.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
102.e: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, there is God. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||2||
You transcend all qualities, and You possess the supreme qualities. You are the Giver of peace.
You are detached in Nirvaanaa, and You are the Enjoyer, imbued with love.

102.g: ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਤਬ, ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.e: You Yourself know Your Own Ways; You dwell upon Yourself. ||3||
You are the Master, and then again, You are the servant.
O God, You Yourself are the Manifest and the Unmanifest.

102.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ. ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੮॥
102.e: Slave Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises forever. Please, just for a moment, bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||21||28||
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
Then the hero named Biralachh was filled with ire.

102.g: ਸਜੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਹੰ ਚਲੋ ਜੁਧ ਧਾਮੰ ॥
102.e: He bedecked himself with weapons and walked towards the battlefield.

102.g: ਸਿਰੰ ਸਿੰਘ ਕੇ ਆਨਿ ਘਾਯੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰ ॥
102.e: He struck his weapon on the head of the lion and wounded him,

102.g: ਬਲੀ ਸਿੰਘ ਸੋ ਹਾਥ ਸੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
102.e: But the brave lion killed him with his hands.22.
When Biralachh was killed, Pinagachh ran forward
Going in front of Durga, he uttered some inronical words.

102.g: ਕਰੀ ਅਭ੍ਰਿ ਜ︀ਯੋ ਗਰਜ ਕੈ ਬਾਣ ਬਰਖੰ ॥
102.e: Roaring like a cloud, he showered a volley of arrows

102.g: ਮਹਾ ਸੂਰ ਬੀਰੰ ਭਰੇ ਜੁਧ ਹਰਖੰ ॥੨੩॥
102.e: That great hero was filled with pleasure in the battlefield.23.
Then the goddess caught hold of her bow and arrows.

102.g: ਹਨਿਯੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਕੇ ਘਾਇ ਸੀਸੰ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥
102.e: She wounded the tyrant on his head with her shaft

102.g: ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਝੂਮਿ ਭੂਮੰ ਗਏ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਛੁਟੰ ॥
102.e: Who swayed, fell down of the goround and breathed his last.

102.g: ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰ ਕੋ ਸਾਤਵੌ ਸ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਟੁਟੰ ॥੨੪॥
102.e: It seemed that the seventh peak of Sumeru mountain had fallen down.24.
When the warriors like Pingachh fell in the field,
Other warriors holding their weapons marched forward.
Then the goddess in great ire shot many arrows,

102.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਜੁਧ ਮਧੰ ਗਿਰਾਏ ॥੨੫॥
102.e: Which laid to rest many warriors in the battlefield.25.

102.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ॥
102.e: The servant of the Lord and Master enjoys the Love and Affection of the Lord.

102.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ. ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ; ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.e: That which belongs to the Lord and Master, belongs to His servant. The servant becomes distinguished in association with his Lord and Master. ||3||
He, whom the Lord and Master dresses in the robes of honor,
Is not called to answer for his account any longer.

102.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ. ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ; ਸੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰਾ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
102.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant. He is the pearl of the deep and unfathomable Ocean of God. ||4||18||25||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
I am a sacrifice to those who have heard of You.
I am a sacrifice to those whose tongues speak of You.

102.g: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ. ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
102.e: Again and again, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on You with mind and body. ||1||

102.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੀ; ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
102.e: I wash the feet of those who walk upon Your Path.
With my eyes, I long to behold those kind people.

102.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ. ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਜਨ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
102.e: I offer my mind to those friends, who have met the Guru and found God. ||2||
Very fortunate are those who know You.
In the midst of all, they remain detached and balanced in Nirvaanaa.

102.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਉਨਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ; ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ. ਉਨਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and conquer all their evil passions. ||3||

102.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਆ; ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
102.e: My mind has entered their Sanctuary.
I have renounced my pride in my own strength, and the darkness of emotional attachment.

102.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
102.e: Please bless Nanak with the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable God. ||4||20||27||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

102.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
102.e: Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.
One who searches outside is deluded by doubt.

102.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
102.e: By Guru's Grace, one who has found the Lord within is happy, inwardly and outwardly. ||1||
Slowly, gently, drop by drop, the stream of nectar trickles down within.
The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.

102.g: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
102.e: It enjoys bliss and ecstasy day and night, and plays with the Lord forever and ever. ||2||
I have now been united with the Lord after having been separated and cut off from Him for so many lifetimes;
by the Grace of the Holy Saint, the dried-up branches have blossomed forth again in their greenery.

102.g: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ, ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.e: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; as Gurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||
As the waves of water merge again with the water,
so does my light merge again into the Light.

102.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਟੇ ਕਿਵਾੜਾ; ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ. ਜਉਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
102.e: Says Nanak, the veil of illusion has been cut away, and I shall not go out wandering any more. ||4||19||26||
NARAAJ STANZA
Then the demon-king gathered all the war-paraphernalis.
He drove his horse forward and wanted to kill the Mother (goddess).20.
Then the goddess Durga challenged him, taking up her bow and arrows
She wounded (one of) the generals named Chamar and threw him down on the ground from his elephatnt.21

103.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

103.g: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
103.e: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.
Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.

103.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ. ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ; ਆਏ ਤੇ. ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.e: Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||

103.g: ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ; ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
103.e: Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved and accepted.

103.g: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
103.e: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.

103.g: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ. ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿ. ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
103.e: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to that Congregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||
Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:
in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

103.g: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
103.e: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings and goings shall cease. ||3||

103.g: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ; ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
103.e: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:
please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

103.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
103.e: God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29||
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
The flames of fire come from her mouth and she herself came out from the forehead (of Durga).
She killed the great elephants and the warriors on horseback.28.
The arrows are being shot and the swords are glistening.
The daggers are being struck and it appears that the festival of Holi is being celebrated.29.
The weapons are being use unhesitatingly, which create clattering sounds.
The guns boom and produce roaring sounds. 30
The Mother (goddess) challenges and the wounds bust.
The youthful warriors fight and the horses dance.31
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.
His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

103.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ. ਧਿਆਇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.e: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

103.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ; ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
103.e: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home,
ROOAAL STANZA

103.g: ਧਾਈਯੋ ਅਸੁਰੇਾਂਦ੍ਰ ਤਹਿ; ਨਿਜ ਕੋਪ ਓਪ ਬਢਾਇ ॥
103.e: With increased anger, the demon-king sped forward.

103.g: ਸੰਗ ਲੈ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਸੈਨਾ; ਸੁਧ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਚਾਇ ॥
103.e: He had four kinds of forces with him, who cause the dance of sharp weapons.

103.g: ਦੇਬਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਲਗੈ ਗਿਰੈ ਰਣਿ; ਰੁਝਿ ਜੁਝਿ ਜੁਆਣ ॥
103.e: Whosoever was struck by the weapons of the goddess, those fighting warriors fell in the field.

103.g: ਪੀਲਰਾਜ ਫਿਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਰਣ; ਸੁਛ ਛੁਛ ਕਿਕਾਣ ॥੩੨॥
103.e: Somewhere the elephants and somewhere horses are roaming without riders in the battlefield.32.

103.g: ਚੀਰ ਚਾਮਰ ਪੁੰਜ ਕੁੰਜਰ; ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
103.e: Somewhere clothes, turbans and fly-whisks are lying scattered and somewhere elephants, horses and chieftains are lying dead.

103.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਭੇ ਕਹੂੰ; ਸਰਦਾਰ ਸੁਆਰ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
103.e: Somewhere generals and warriors with weapons and aromuts are lying down.

103.g: ਤੇਗੁ ਤੀਰ ਤੁਫੰਗ ਤਬਰ; ਕੁਹੁਕ ਬਾਨ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
103.e: Somewhere the sonund of arrows, swords, guns, axes and special shafts is being heard.

103.g: ਬੇਧਿ ਬੇਧਿ ਗਿਰੈ ਬਰਛਿਨ; ਸੂਰ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥੩੩॥
103.e: Somewhere the heroes pierced by the daggers have fallen gracefully.33.

103.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਉਡੇ ਤਹਾ; ਫਿਕਰੰਤ ਸੁਆਨ ਸ੍ਰਿੰਗਾਲ ॥
103.e: Large-sized vultures are flying there, the dogs are barking and the jackals are howling.

103.g: ਮਤ ਦੰਤਿ ਸਪਛ ਪਬੈ; ਕੰਕ ਬੰਕ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
103.e: The intoxicated elephants look like the winged mountains and the crows, flying down to eat the flesh.

103.g: ਛੁਦ੍ਰ ਮੀਨ ਛੁਰੁਧ੍ਰਕਾ ਅਰੁ ਚਰਮ ਕਛਪ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
103.e: Thhe swords on the bodies of the demons appear like small fish and the shields look like tortoises.

103.g: ਨਕ੍ਰ ਬਕ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਬਰਮ ਸੋਭਿਤ; ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਨੀਰ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥੩੪॥
103.e: On their bodies, the steel-armour looks elegant and the blood is flowing down like flood.34.

103.g: ਨਵ ਸੂਰ ਨਵਕਾ ਸੇ ਰਥੀ; ਅਤਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਨੁ ਜਹਾਜ ॥
103.e: The new young warriors appear like boats and thhe charioteers look like shimps.

103.g: ਲਾਦਿ ਲਾਦਿ ਮਨੋ ਚਲੇ; ਧਨ ਧੀਰ ਬੀਰ ਸਲਾਜ ॥
103.e: All this appears as if the traders loading their commodities are coyly running out of the battlefield.

103.g: ਮੋਲੁ ਬੀਚ ਫਿਰੈ ਚੁਕਾਤ; ਦਲਾਲ ਖੇਤ ਖਤੰਗ ॥
103.e: The arrows of the battlefield are like the agents, who are busy in settling the account of the transaction.

103.g: ਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਫਵਜਨਿ; ਝਾਰਿ ਦਿਰਬ ਨਿਖੰਗ ॥੩੫॥
103.e: The armies are fastly moving in the field for settlement and emptying their treasure of quivers.35.

103.g: ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਗਿਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ; ਬਹੁਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਿਤ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ॥
103.e: Some where multi-coloured garments and chopped limbs are lying.

103.g: ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮ ਸੁਭੰ ਕਹੂੰ; ਰਣੰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਰੁ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ॥
103.e: Somewhere there are shields and armours and somewhere there only weapons.

103.g: ਮੁੰਡ ਤੁੰਡ ਧੁਜਾ ਪਤਾਕਾ; ਟੂਕ ਟਾਕ ਅਰੇਕ ॥
103.e: Somewhere there are heads, flags and ensigns scattered here and there.

103.g: ਜੂਝ ਜੂਝ ਪਰੇ ਸਬੈ ਅਰਿ; ਬਾਚਿਯੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕ ॥੩੬॥
103.e: In the battlefield all the enemies have fallen down while fighting and none has been left alive.36.

103.g: ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਮਹਿਖੇਸ ਦਾਨੋ; ਧਾਈਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਲ ॥
103.e: Then in great ire, the demon Mahishasura marched forward.

103.g: ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਭਾਰ ਸੂਰੋ; ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
103.e: He appeared in a frightful form and held up all his weapons and arms.

103.g: ਕਾਲ ਪਾਣਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਲੈ ਤਿਹ; ਮਾਰਿਯੋ ਤਤਕਾਲ ॥
103.e: The goddess Kalka took her sword in her hand and killed him instantly.

103.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਿਲੀ; ਤਜ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਰੰਧ੍ਰਿ ਉਤਾਲ ॥੩੭॥
103.e: His soul left Brahmrandhir (life-channel of Dasam Dyar) and merged in Divine Light.37.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ; ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
103.e: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
103.e: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ. ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ; ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.e: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||
By Your Grace, I recognize You.

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ; ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
103.e: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.

103.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
103.e: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||
You have created all beings and creatures.

103.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
103.e: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.

103.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ. ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
103.e: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||
Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.

103.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
103.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.

103.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ. ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
103.e: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.

103.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
103.e: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

103.g: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.e: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled and soothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||
Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,
when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

103.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ, ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
103.e: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; no place is left empty. ||2||
The Creator has showered His Kindness;
He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

103.g: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
103.e: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||
The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.
The Doer of all did this in an instant.

103.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
103.e: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind. ||4||23||30||
DOHRA

103.g: ਲੋਪ ਚੰਡਿਕਾ ਜੂ ਭਈ; ਦੈ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ॥
103.e: The goddess Chandi disappeared after bestowing kingdom on the gods.

103.g: ਬਹੁਰ ਸੁੰਭ ਨੈਸੁੰਭ ਦੁਐ; ਦੈਤ ਬੜੇ ਸਿਰਤਾਜ ॥੫॥੪੩॥
103.e: Then after some time, both the demons kings came to power.5.43.
CHAUPAI

103.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਚੜੇ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਦਲ ॥
103.e: Both Sumbh and Nisumbh marched with their forces.

103.g: ਅਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ॥
103.e: They conquered many enemies in water and on land.
They seized the kingdom of Indra, the king of gods.
Sheshanaga sent his head-jewel as a gift.6.44.
DOHRA

103.g: ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ ਕਹ ਮਾਰ ਕਰਿ; ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਤ ਭੀ ਜਗ ਮਾਇ ॥
103.e: After killing Mahishasura, the Mother of the world was greatly pleased.

103.g: ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਮਹਿਖੇ ਬਲੈ; ਦੇਤ ਜਗਤ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੮॥
103.e: And from that day the whole world gives the sacrifice of the animals for the attainment of peace.38.

103.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ ਬਧਹ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੰਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧॥
103.e: Here ends the First Chapter entitled ‘Killing of Mahishasura’ of Chandi Charitra in BACHITTAR NATAK.1.
Here begins the description of the war with Dhumar Nain :
KULAK STANZA
Then the goddess roared and there was continuous intonation.
All were delighted and felt comfortable.1.39.
The trumpents sounded and all the gods shouted.
They eulogise the godess and shower flowers on her. 2.40.
They worshipped the goddess in various ways and sang her poraises.
They have touhed her feet and all their sorrows have ended.3.41.
They sang the songs of victory and showered flowers.
They bowed their heads and obtained great comfort.4.42.

104.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
With elevated tail and full of rage the lion ran forward.

104.g: ਇਤੇ ਸੰਖ ਲੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਬਜਾਯੋ ॥
104.e: There the goddess holding the conch in her hand, blew it.
Its sound reverberated in all the fourteen regions.

104.g: ਚਮਕਿਯੋ ਮੁਖੰ ਜੁਧ ਕੇ ਮਧਿ ਨੂਰੰ ॥੧੭॥੫੫॥
104.e: The face of the goddess was filled with brightness in the battlefield.17.55.

104.g: ਤਬੈ ਧੂਮ੍ਰ ਨੈਣੰ ਮਚਿਯੋ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
104.e: Then Dhumar Nain, the weapon-wielder, was greatly excited.

104.g: ਲਏ ਸੰਗ ਜੋਧਾ ਬਡੇ ਬੀਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
104.e: He took many brave warriors with him.
To the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

104.g: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.e: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

104.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ; ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
104.e: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.
The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

104.g: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ. ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.e: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||
I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss,
Joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

104.g: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ; ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
104.e: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||
RASAAVAL STANZA
Listening to the talk of the gods, the queen (goddess) munted the lion.
She had worn all her auspicious weapons and she is the one who effaces all the sins.11.49.
The goddess commanded that highly inebriating trumpets besounded.
Then the conches created great noise, which was heard. In all the four directions.12.50.
The demons marched forward and brought great forces.
Their faces and eyes were red like blood and they shouted prickig words.13.51.
Four types of forces rushed and shouted from their mouths: “Kill, Kill”.
They took up in their hands the arrows, daggers and swords.14.52.
They are all active in warfare and shoot arrows.
The weapons like swods and daggers glisten.15.53.
The great heroes rushed forward and many on them shot arrows.
They strike blows on the enemy with much swiftness like the watter-bird.16.54.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
By His Command, the rain begins to fall.
The Saints and friends have met to chant the Naam.

104.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
104.e: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||
God has produced everything in great abundance.
Granting His Grace, God has satisfied all.

104.g: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.e: Bless us with Your Gifts, O my Great Giver. All beings and creatures are satisfied. ||2||
True is the Master, and True is His Name.
By Guru's Grace, I meditate forever on Him.

104.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.e: The fear of birth and death has been dispelled; emotional attachment, sorrow and suffering have been erased. ||3||
With each and every breath, Nanak praises the Lord.
Meditating in remembrance on the Name, all bonds are cut away.

104.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਕਰੀ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
104.e: One's hopes are fulfilled in an instant, chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||27||34||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Come, dear friends, Saints and companions:
let us join together and sing the Glorious Praises of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

104.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ; ਸੋ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
104.e: Those who sing and hear these praises are liberated, so let us meditate on the One who created us. ||1||
The sins of countless incarnations depart,
and we receive the fruits of the mind's desires.

104.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਰਿਜਕੁ. ਸਭਸੁ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.e: So meditate on that Lord, our True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all. ||2||
Chanting the Naam, all pleasures are obtained.

104.g: ਸਭੁ ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
104.e: All fears are erased, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

104.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.e: One who serves the Lord swims across to the other side, and all his affairs are resolved. ||3||
I have come to Your Sanctuary;
if it pleases You, unite me with You.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Hearing of You, I live.
You are my Beloved, my Lord and Master, Utterly Great.

104.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ; ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
104.e: You alone know Your Ways; I grasp Your Support, Lord of the World. ||1||
Singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is rejuvenated.
Hearing Your Sermon, all filth is removed.

104.g: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ; ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate forever on the Merciful Lord. ||2||
I dwell on my God with each and every breath.

104.g: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
104.e: This understanding has been implanted within my mind, by Guru's Grace.

104.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.e: By Your Grace, the Divine Light has dawned. The Merciful Lord cherishes everyone. ||3||
True, True, True is that God.
Forever, forever and ever, He Himself is.

104.g: ਚਲਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੩॥
104.e: Your Playful Ways are revealed, O my Beloved. Beholding them, Nanak is enraptured. ||4||26||33||
They snatched the treasure of Kuber
And conquered the kings of various countries.
Wherever they sent their forces
They returned after conquering many countries.7.45.
NARAAJ STANZA
The gods ran in great fear and felt ashamed with particular self-abasment.
They had fitted poisonous shafts in their bows and in this way they went ot reside in the city of goddess.9.47.
Then the goddess was filled with great rage and marched towards the battlefield with her weapons and arms.
She drank the nectar in ther delight and roared wihile taking the sword in her hand.10.48.
DOHRA

104.g: ਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਤਿ ਭਏ; ਮਨ ਮੋ ਕੀਯੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
104.e: All the gods were filled with fear and thought in their mind

104.g: ਸਰਨ ਭਵਾਨੀ ਕੀ ਸਬੈ; ਭਾਜਿ ਪਰੇ ਨਿਰਧਾਰ ॥੮॥੪੬॥
104.e: Being helpless, they all ran to come under the refuge of the goddess.8.46.

105.e: DOHRA

105.g: ਭਜੀ ਬਿਰੂਥਨਿ ਦਾਨਵੀ; ਗਈ ਭੂਪ ਕੇ ਪਾਸ ॥
105.e: The demon forces ran towards their king.

105.g: ਧੂਮ੍ਰਨੈਣ ਕਾਲੀ ਹਨਿਯੋ; ਭਜੀਯੋ ਸੈਨ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
105.e: Intimating him that Kali had killed Dhumar Nain and the forces had fled in disappointment.26.64.

105.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਧੂਮ੍ਰਨੈਨ ਬਧਤ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨॥
105.e: Here ends the Second Chapter entitled ‘Killing of Dhumar Nain’, which forms part of Chandi Charitra of BACHITTAR NATAK.2.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The rain has fallen; I have found the Transcendent Lord God.
All beings and creatures dwell in peace.

105.g: ਗਇਆ ਕਲੇਸੁ. ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.e: Suffering has been dispelled, and true happiness has dawned, as we meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

105.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ; ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
105.e: The One, to whom we belong, cherishes and nurtures us.
The Supreme Lord God has become our Protector.

105.g: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.e: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer; my efforts have been rewarded. ||2||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
I cherish in my heart the Feet of my Lord and Master.
All my troubles and sufferings have run away.

105.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.e: The music of intuitive peace, poise and tranquility wells up within; I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
The bonds of love with the Lord are never broken.
The Lord is totally permeating and pervading inside and out.

105.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.e: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||
The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;
deep within my mind and body, peace and tranquility have come.

105.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
105.e: Your humble servants remain satisfied and fulfilled, and the True Guru blesses them with encouragement and comfort. ||3||

105.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ; ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
105.e: We are His, and from Him, we receive our rewards.
Showering His Mercy upon us, God has united us with Him.

105.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
105.e: Our comings and goings have ended, and through great good fortune, O Nanak, our hopes are fulfilled. ||4||31||38||

105.g: ਲਯੋ ਬੇੜਿ ਪਬੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਨਾਦ ਉਚੰ ॥
105.e: They besieged the mountain and began to shout at the top of their voice.
Which when heard could destroy the pregnancy of women.18.56.

105.g: ਸੁਣਿਯੋ ਨਾਦ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਦੇਵਿ ਕੋਪੰ ॥
105.e: When the goddess heard voice of the demon-chief, she was greatly enraged.

105.g: ਸਜੇ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮੰ ਧਰੇ ਸੀਸਿ ਟੋਪੰ ॥
105.e: She bedecked herself with shield and armour and wore the steel-helmet on her head.

105.g: ਭਈ ਸਿੰਘ ਸੁਆਰੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਨਾਦ ਉਚੰ ॥
105.e: She mounted the lion and shouted loudly.

105.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਦੀਹ ਦਾਨਵਾਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਨ ਮੁਚੰ ॥੧੯॥੫੭॥
105.e: Hearing her shouts, the pride of the demons was destroyed.19.57.

105.g: ਮਹਾ ਕੋਪਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਧਸੀ ਸੈਨ ਮਧੰ ॥
105.e: In great ire, the goddess penetrated into the demon-army.

105.g: ਕਰੇ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਤਹਾ ਅਧੁ ਅਧੰ ॥
105.e: She chopped into halves the great heroes.

105.g: ਜਿਸੈ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ਸੂਲ ਸੈਥੀ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
105.e: On whomsoever the goddess struck her blow with her trident and the destructive weapon (Saihathi)

105.g: ਤਿਨੇ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਾਣੰ ਨ ਬਾਣੰ ਸੰਭਾਰਿਯੋ ॥੨੦॥੫੮॥
105.e: He could not hold again his bow and arrows in his hands.20.58.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Where the Naam, the Name of God the Beloved is chanted
those barren places become mansions of gold.

105.g: ਜਿਥੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ; ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.e: Where the Naam, the Name of my Lord of the Universe is not chanted-those towns are like the barren wilderness. ||1||
One who meditates as he eats dry bread,
sees the Blessed Lord inwardly and outwardly.

105.g: ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ. ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ; ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.e: Know this well, that one who eats and eats while practicing evil, is like a field of poisonous plants. ||2||
One who does not feel love for the Saints,
misbehaves in the company of the wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics;

105.g: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
105.e: he wastes this human body, so difficult to obtain. In his ignorance, he tears up his own roots. ||3||
I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek,
Ocean of Peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.

105.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮ ਅਸਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
105.e: Shower Your Mercy upon Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; please, preserve my honor. ||4||30||37||
Now the battle with Chand and Mund is described:
DOHRA

105.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕਰ; ਧਵਲਾ ਚਲੀ ਅਵਾਸ ॥
105.e: In this way, killing the demons, the goddess Durga went to her abode.

105.g: ਜੋ ਯਹ ਕਥਾ ਪੜੈ ਸੁਨੈ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤਾਸ ॥੧॥੬੫॥
105.e: He who read or listens to this discourse, he will attain in his house wealth and miraculous powers.1.65.
CHAUPAI
When it was learnt that Dhumar Nain had been killed,
The demon-king then called Chand and Mund.
They were sent after bestowing many honours on them.

105.g: ਹੈ ਗੈ ਪਤਿ ਦੀਏ ਰਥ ਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੬੬॥
105.e: And also many gifts like horses, elephants and chariots.2.66.
Those who had earlier seen the goddess
They were sent towards kailash mountain (as spies).

105.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਤਨਿਕ ਭਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
105.e: When the goddess heard some rumour about them
She then promptly came down with her weapons and armour.3.67.

105.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
105.e: Shower Your Mercy upon me, God; let me be committed to devotional worship. Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of Truth. ||4||28||35||
RASAAVAL STANZA
Whosover was shot with the arrow, he was killed instantly.
Wherever the lion rushed forward, he destroyed the army.21.59.
All those who were killed, they were thrown into caves.
The enemies who confronted coul not return alive.22.60.
Those who were active in the battlefield, they were all decimated.
Those who caught hold of weapons, they were all killed.23.61.
Then the mother Kali flared up like the flaming fire.
To whomsoever she struck, he departed for heaven.24.62.
The whole army was destroyed within a very short time.
Dhumar Nain was killed and the gods heard about it in heaven.25.63.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth, has become Merciful;
the rain is falling everywhere.

105.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.e: He is Merciful to the meek, always Kind and Gentle; the Creator has brought cooling relief. ||1||
He cherishes all His beings and creatures,
as the mother cares for her children.

105.g: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਆਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.e: The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of Peace, the Lord and Master gives sustenance to all. ||2||
The Merciful Lord is totally pervading and permeating the water and the land.
I am forever devoted, a sacrifice to Him.

105.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ; ਜਿ. ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
105.e: Night and day, I always meditate on Him; in an instant, He saves all. ||3||
God Himself protects all;
He drives out all sorrow and suffering.

105.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
105.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are rejuvenated. O Nanak, God has bestowed His Glance of Grace. ||4||29||36||

106.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
106.e: He is the Giver of all souls.

106.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
106.e: By Guru's Grace, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.

106.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਸਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਣੇ; ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.e: The beings in the water, on the land and in the sky are all satisfied; I wash the Feet of the Holy. ||3||

106.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
106.e: He is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind.

106.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
106.e: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

106.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਿ; ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
106.e: O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this Gift; I am imbued with the Love of the Delightful Lord. ||4||32||39||

106.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
106.e: ROOAAL STANZA

106.g: ਸਾਜਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਤਹਾ; ਰਣਿ ਰਾਛਸੇਾਂਦ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
106.e: Decorating their forces many demon-generals marched towards the battlefield.

106.g: ਅਰਧ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤੇਕ; ਜਟਾ ਧਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਰੇਕ ॥
106.e: Many warriors are with half-shaven heads, many with fullshaven hads and many are with matted hair.

106.g: ਕੋਪਿ ਓਪੰ ਦੈ ਸਬੈ; ਕਰਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਚਾਇ ॥
106.e: All of them in great fury, are causing the dance of their weapons and armour.

106.g: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਨ; ਤਿਛ ਤੇਗ ਕੰਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੬੮॥
106.e: They are running and striking blows, causing their sharp swords to shake and glitter. 4.68

106.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਲਗੇ ਜਿਤੇ; ਸਬ ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲ ਹੁਐ ਗਏ ॥
106.e: All the blows of weapons and arms, which struck the goddess, they appeared as garlands of flowers around her neck.

106.g: ਕੋਪ ਓਪ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਅਤਿਭੁਤ; ਦਾਨਵੰ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਭਏ ॥
106.e: Seeing this all the demons were filled with anger and astonishment.

106.g: ਦਉਰ ਦਉਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਆਯੁਧ; ਫੇਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਹੀ ॥
106.e: Many of them, running ahead repeatedly strike blows with their weapons.

106.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਗਿਰੈ ਅਰੇਕ; ਸੁ ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰ ਪੁਕਾਰਹੀ ॥੫॥੬੯॥
106.e: And with shouts of “kill, kill”, they are fighting and falling down.5.69.

106.g: ਰੇਲਿ ਰੇਲਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਏਾਂਦ੍ਰਨ; ਪੇਲਿ ਪੇਲਿ ਗਜੇਾਂਦ੍ਰ ॥
106.e: The horse-rider generals are driving forward theh horses and the elephant-rider generals are goading their elephants.

106.g: ਝੇਲਿ ਝੇਲਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਆਯੁਧ; ਹੇਲਿ ਹੇਲਿ ਰਿਪੇਾਂਦ੍ਰ ॥
106.e: Facing unlimited weapons, the enemies’ generals, enduring the blows, are still making an assault.

106.g: ਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਫਵਜਨ; ਬਾਹਿ ਬਾਹਿ ਖਤੰਗ ॥
106.e: The armies crushing the warriors are marching forward and showering their arrows.

106.g: ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਗਿਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਰਣਿ; ਰੰਗ ਸੂਰ ਉਤੰਗ ॥੬॥੭੦॥
106.e: Many heroic fighters, becoming limbless, have fallen down in the battlefield.6.70.

106.g: ਝਾਰਿ ਝਾਰਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਸਰੋਤਮ; ਡਾਰਿ ਝਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ॥
106.e: Some where the shafts are falling like rain-showers and somewhere the swords are striking blows collectively.

106.g: ਸੈਲ ਸੇ ਰਣਿ ਪੁੰਜ ਕੁੰਜਰ; ਸੂਰ ਸੀਸ ਬਖਾਨ ॥
106.e: The elephants seen together are like stony rocks and the heads of the warriors appear like stones.

106.g: ਬਕ੍ਰ ਨਕ੍ਰ ਭੁਜਾ ਸੁ ਸੋਭਿਤ; ਚਕ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਰਥ ਚਕ੍ਰ ॥
106.e: The crooked arms appear like octopus and the chariot wheels are like tortoises.

106.g: ਕੇਸ ਪਾਸਿ ਸਿਬਾਲ ਸੋਹਤ; ਅਸਥ ਚੂਰ ਸਰਕ੍ਰ ॥੭॥੭੧॥
106.e: The hair seem like noose and scum and the crushed bones like sand.7.71.

106.g: ਸਜਿ ਸਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਥਿਆਰਨ; ਗਜਿ ਗਜਿ ਗਜੇਾਂਦ੍ਰ ॥
106.e: The warriors have bedecked themselves with weapons and the elephants are roaring wihil moving forward.

106.g: ਬਜਿ ਬਜਿ ਸਬਜ ਬਾਜਨ; ਭਜਿ ਭਜਿ ਹਏਾਂਦ੍ਰ ॥
106.e: The horse-riding warriors are speedily moving with the sounds of various types of musical instruments.

106.g: ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕੈ; ਹਥੀਆਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਭਾਰ ॥
106.e: Holding their weapons in their hands, the heroes are shouting “kill, kill”.

106.g: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਨਿਸਾਚ; ਬਾਇ ਸੰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੮॥੭੨॥
106.e: Blowing many conches, the demons are running in the battlefield.8.72.

106.g: ਸੰਖ ਗੋਯਮੰ ਗਜੀਯੰ; ਅਰੁ ਸਜੀਯੰ ਰਿਪੁਰਾਜ ॥
106.e: The conches and horns are being blown loudly and the generals of the enemy are ready for war.

106.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਕਿਤੇ; ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਬੀਰ ਨਿਲਾਜ ॥
106.e: Somewhere the cowards, forsaking their shame, are running away.

106.g: ਭੀਮ ਭੇਰੀ ਭੁੰਕੀਅੰ; ਅਰੁ ਧੁੰਕੀਅੰ ਸੁ ਨਿਸਾਣ ॥
106.e: The sound of large-sized drums is being heard and the flags are fluttering.

106.g: ਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਫਵਜਨ; ਬਾਹਿ ਬਾਹਿ ਗਦਾਣ ॥੯॥੭੩॥
106.e: The forces are roaming and striking their maces.9.73.

106.g: ਬੀਰ ਕੰਗਨੇ ਬੰਧਹੀ; ਅਰੁ ਅਛਰੈ ਸਿਰ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
106.e: The heavenly maids are bedecking themselves and offering ornaments to the warriors.

106.g: ਬੀਰ ਬੀਨਿ ਬਰੇ ਬਰੰਗਨ; ਡਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਫੁਲੇਲ ॥
106.e: Selecting their heroes, the heavenly ladies are being bound with them in wedlock by showrering the oil impregnated with the essence of flowers.

106.g: ਘਾਲਿ ਘਾਲਿ ਬਿਵਾਨ ਲੇਗੀ; ਫੇਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ॥
106.e: They have taken away the warriors with them in their vehicles.

106.g: ਕੂਦਿ ਕੂਦਿ ਪਰੇ ਤਹਾ ਤੇ; ਝਾਗਿ ਝਾਗਿ ਸੁ ਤੀਰ ॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
106.e: The heroes inebriated for fighting in thhe war, jump from the vehicles and being shot with arrows, fall down below.10.74

106.g: ਹਾਕਿ ਹਾਕਿ ਲਰੇ ਤਹਾ ਰਣਿ; ਰੀਝਿ ਰੀਝਿ ਭਟੇਾਂਦ੍ਰ ॥
106.e: Delightfully shouting in the battlefield, the heroic generals have waged war.

106.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਲਯੋ ਜਿਨੈ; ਕਈ ਬਾਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਉਪੇਾਂਦ੍ਰ ॥
106.e: Who had several times conquered the king and other chieftains of gods.

106.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਦਏ ਕਪਾਲੀ; ਬਾਟਿ ਬਾਟਿ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
106.e: Whom Durga (Kapali) chpped and threw in various directions.

106.g: ਡਾਟਿ ਡਾਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਲੰ; ਸੁਰ ਪਗੁ ਪਬ ਪਿਸਾਨ ॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
106.e: And with those who had ground the mountains with the strength of their hands and feet  11.75.

106.g: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੀਅੰ; ਰਿਪੁ ਰਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
106.e: The enemies speedily marching agead are killing countless horses.

106.g: ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਕੀ ਸਰਤਾ ਉਠੀ; ਰਣ ਮਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
106.e: And in the battlefield, the terrible stream of blood is flowing.

106.g: ਬਾਣ ਅਉਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸੈਹਥੀ; ਸੂਲ ਤਿਛੁ ਕੁਠਾਰ ॥
106.e: The weapons like bow and arrows, sword, trident and sharpo axe are being used.

106.g: ਚੰਡ ਮੁੰਡ ਹਣੇ ਦੋਊ; ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਕਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਵਾਰ ॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
106.e: The goddess Kali in great rage, struck down and killed both Chand and Mund.12.76.

106.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
106.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

106.g: ਝਿਮੀ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਗੰ ਸੁਰੋਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰ ॥
106.e: The sword which she has struck in ire

106.g: ਖਿਮੀ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਜਾਣ ਭਾਦੋ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥
106.e: It hath hlistened like lightning in the month of Bhadon.

106.g: ਉਦੇ ਨਦ ਨਾਦੰ ਕੜਕੇ ਕਮਾਣੰ ॥
106.e: The jingling sound of bows appears like the sound of flowing stream.

106.g: ਮਚਿਯੋ ਲੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਅਭੂਤੰ ਭਯਾਣੰ ॥੭॥੮੪॥
106.e: And the steel-weapons have been struck in great anger, which appear unique and frightening.7.84.

106.g: ਬਜੇ ਭੇਰਿ ਭੇਰੀ ਜੁਝਾਰੇ ਝਣੰਕੇ ॥
106.e: The sound of drums rises in the battle and the warriors glisten their weapons.

106.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
106.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

106.g: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
106.e: All happiness comes, when God is pleased.

106.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
106.e: The Feet of the Perfect Guru dwell in my mind.

106.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸੋ ਰਸੁ. ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
106.e: I am intuitively absorbed in the state of Samaadhi deep within. God alone knows this sweet pleasure. ||1||

106.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
106.e: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

106.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
106.e: Deep within each and every heart, He dwells near and close at hand.

106.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ. ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
106.e: He is always detached; He is the Giver of souls. How rare is that person who understands his own self. ||2||

106.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕੀ, ਏਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
106.e: This is the sign of union with God:

106.g: ਮਨਿ ਇਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
106.e: in the mind, the Command of the True Lord is recognized.

106.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਅਨਦੁ ਖਸਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.e: Intuitive peace and poise, contentment, enduring satisfaction and bliss come through the Pleasure of the Master's Will. ||3||

106.g: ਹਥੀ ਦਿਤੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
106.e: God, the Great Giver, has given me His Hand.

106.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰੋਗ; ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
106.e: He has erased all the sickness of birth and death.

106.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੨॥
106.e: O Nanak, those whom God has made His slaves, rejoice in the pleasure of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||35||42||

106.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
106.e: CHAUPAI

106.g: ਰਕਤਬੀਜ ਤਪ ਭੂਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਯੋ ॥
ਅਮਿਤ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇ ਤਹਾ ਪਠਾਯੋ ॥
106.e: Then the king called Rakat Beej and sent him after giving him enormous wealth.

106.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਈ ਬਿਰੂਥਨ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
ਹੈ ਗੈ ਰਥ ਪੈਦਲ ਚਤੁਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੭੯॥
106.e: He was also given various types of forces, which was fourfold: on horses, on elephants, on chariots and on foot.2.79.

106.g: ਰਕਤਬੀਜ ਦੈ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਨਗਾਰਾ ॥
ਦੇਵ ਲੋਗ ਲਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
106.e: Rakat Beej marched after sounding his trumpet, which was heard even in the habitation of gods.

106.g: ਕੰਪੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਗਗਨ ਥਹਰਾਨਾ ॥
ਦੇਵਨ ਜੁਤਿ ਦਿਵਰਾਜ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੮੦॥
106.e: The earth ttrembled and the sky vibrated, all the godds including the king were filled with fear.3.80.

106.g: ਧਵਲਾ ਗਿਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਬ ਤਟ ਆਇ ॥
ਦੁੰਦਭਿ ਢੋਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਬਜਾਏ ॥
106.e: When they came near the Kailash mountain, they sounded trumpets, drums and tabours.

106.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਨਾ ਕੁਲਾਹਲ ਕਾਨਾ ॥
ਉਤਰੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਨਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੮੧॥
106.e: When the gods heard the noises with their ears, the goddess Durga descended the mountain, taking many weapons and arms.4.81.

106.g: ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ਬਰਖੀਯੰ ਬਾਣੰ ॥
ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਅਰੁ ਗਿਰੇ ਕਿਕਾਣੰ ॥
106.e: The goddess showered arrows like incessant rain, which caused the horses and their riders fall down.

106.g: ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੁਭਟ ਸਿਰਦਾਰਾ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਕਰ ਕਟੈ ਬਿਰਛ ਸੰਗ ਆਰਾ ॥੫॥੮੨॥
106.e: Many warriors and their chieftainsfell, it seemed as if the trees had been sawed.5.82.

106.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਮੁਹੇ ਭਏ ॥
ਬਹੁਰ ਜੀਅਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੇ ਨਹੀ ਗਏ ॥
106.e: Those enemies ho came in front of her, they could not again return to their homes alive.

106.g: ਜਿਹ ਪਰ ਪਰਤ ਭਈ ਤਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
ਇਕਿ ਇਕਿ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਦੋ ਦੋ ਚਾਰਾ ॥੬॥੮੩॥
106.e: Those who were struck by the sword, they fell down in two halves or four quarters.6.83.

106.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
106.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

106.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
106.e: Mind and body are Yours; all wealth is Yours.

106.g: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
106.e: You are my God, my Lord and Master.

106.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ; ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
106.e: Body and soul and all riches are Yours. Yours is the Power, O Lord of the World. ||1||

106.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
106.e: Forever and ever, You are the Giver of Peace.

106.g: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ; ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
106.e: I bow down and fall at Your Feet.

106.g: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ. ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ; ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
106.e: I act as it pleases You, as You cause me to act, Kind and Compassionate Dear Lord. ||2||

106.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
106.e: O God, from You I receive; You are my decoration.

106.g: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
106.e: Whatever You give me, brings me happiness.

106.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖਹਿ. ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.e: Wherever You keep me, is heaven. You are the Cherisher of all. ||3||

106.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ, ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
106.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.

106.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
106.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

106.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ; ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
106.e: All my hopes and desires are fulfilled; I shall never again suffer sorrow. ||4||33||40||

106.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
106.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

106.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ; ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
106.e: The Supreme Lord God has unleashed the rain clouds.

106.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
106.e: Over the sea and over the land-over all the earth's surface, in all directions, He has brought the rain.

106.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ. ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ. ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
106.e: Peace has come, and the thirst of all has been quenched; there is joy and ecstasy everywhere. ||1||

106.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
106.e: He is the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of pain.

106.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ; ਕਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
106.e: He gives and forgives all beings.

106.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ; ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਨਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
106.e: He Himself nurtures and cherishes His Creation. I fall at His Feet and surrender to Him. ||2||

106.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ; ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
106.e: Seeking His Sanctuary, salvation is obtained.

106.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
106.e: With each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

106.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਭ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.e: Without Him, there is no other Lord and Master. All places belong to Him. ||3||

106.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
106.e: Yours is the Honor, God, and Yours is the Power.

106.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
106.e: You are the True Lord and Master, the Ocean of Excellence.

106.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
106.e: Servant Nanak utters this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ||4||34||41||

106.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
106.e: DOHRA

106.g: ਚੰਡ ਮੁੰਡ ਮਾਰੇ ਦੋਊ; ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
106.e: Kali in great rage, struck down both Chand and Mund and killed them.

106.g: ਅਉਰ ਜਿਤੀ ਸੈਨਾ ਹੁਤੀ; ਛਿਨ ਮੋ ਦਈ ਸੰਘਾਰ ॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
106.e: And all the army, that was there, was destroyed in and instant.13.77.

106.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਚੰਡ ਮੁੰਡ ਬਧਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਤਯੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤ ॥੩॥
106.e: Here ends the Third Chapter entitled ‘Killing of Chad and Mund’ of Chandi Charitra in BACHITTAR NATAK.3.

106.g: ਅਥ ਰਕਤ ਬੀਰਜ ਜੁਧ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
106.e: Now the war with Rakat Biraj is described:

106.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ॥
106.e: SORATHA

106.g: ਸੁਨੀ ਭੂਪ ਇਮ ਗਾਥ; ਚੰਡ ਮੁੰਡ ਕਾਲੀ ਹਨੇ ॥
106.e: The demons-king heard this news that Kali had killed Chand and Mund.

106.g: ਬੈਠ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਸੋ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਤ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਏ ॥੧॥੭੮॥
106.e: Then the brothers sat and decided in this manner: 1.78.

107.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The Life of the World, the Sustainer of the Earth, has showered His Mercy;

107.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਵਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
107.e: the Guru's Feet have come to dwell within my mind.

107.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ; ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.e: The Creator has made me His Own. He has destroyed the city of sorrow. ||1||
The True One abides within my mind and body;
no place seems difficult to me now.

107.g: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣ ਹੋਏ; ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.e: All the evil-doers and enemies have now become my friends. I long only for my Lord and Master. ||2||

107.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥
107.e: Whatever He does, He does all by Himself.
No one can know His Ways.

107.g: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ. ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
107.e: He Himself is the Helper and Support of His Saints. God has cast out my doubts and delusions. ||3||
His Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servants.
Twenty-four hours a day, they deal in the Name of the Lord.

107.g: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ. ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੩॥
107.e: In peace and pleasure, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, God is permeating everywhere. ||4||36||43||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Beautiful is the night, and beautiful is the day,
when one joins the Society of the Saints and chants the Ambrosial Naam.

107.g: ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਲ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ; ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.e: If you remember the Lord in meditation for a moment, even for an instant, then your life will become fruitful and prosperous. ||1||
Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.
Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is always with us.

107.g: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ. ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਦੇਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.e: Fear, dread and doubt have been dispelled by the Perfect Guru; now, I see God everywhere. ||2||
God is All-powerful, Vast, Lofty and Infinite.
The Naam is overflowing with the nine treasures.

107.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ; ਦੂਜਾ. ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
107.e: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, there is God. Nothing else even comes close to Him. ||3||
Take pity on me, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.
I am a beggar, begging for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

107.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ. ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੫॥
107.e: Servant Nanak begs for this gift: let me meditate on the Lord, forever and ever. ||4||38||45||

107.g: ਪਰੀ ਕੁਟ ਕੁਟੰ ਲਗੇ ਧੀਰ ਧਕੇ ॥
107.e: There is a great rush of blows and the men of endurance are experiencing shocks.
The vultures shriek and the clarionets are being played.
It appears that terrible tigers are roaring and roaming.8.85.
On the other side the demon warrior Rkat Beej was infuriated.

107.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਸੋ ਆਨਿ ਤੀਰੰ ॥
107.e: He shot his arrows very dexterously.

107.g: ਉਤੇ ਦਉਰ ਦੇਵੀ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਖਗ ਪਾਤੰ ॥
107.e: The goddess then speedily struck her sword.

107.g: ਗਰਿਯੋ ਮੂਰਛਾ ਹੁਐ ਭਯੋ ਜਾਨੁ ਘਾਤੰ ॥੯॥੮੬॥
107.e: Which cused the demon to fall senseless, it seemed that he has passed away.9.86.
When he came to senses, the mighty hero roared.

107.g: ਘਰੀ ਚਾਰ ਲਉ ਸਾਰ ਸੋ ਸਾਰ ਬਜਿਯੋ ॥
107.e: For four gharis, the steel clasged with steel.

107.g: ਲਗੇ ਬਾਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਣੰ ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਭੂਮਿ ਜੁਧੇ ॥
107.e: With the infliction of the arrow of the goddess, the blood of Rakat Beej began to fall on the ground.

107.g: ਉਠੇ ਬੀਰ ਤੇਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਨਾਦ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੰ ॥੧੦॥੮੭॥
107.e: With innumerable drops of blood arose innumerable Rakat Beejas, who began to shout with rage.10.87

107.g: ਉਠੇ ਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਤਿਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਕੂਟੇ ॥
107.e: All the warriors who arose, were destroyed by Kali.

107.g: ਪਰੇ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਾਤ ਟੂਟੇ ॥
107.e: Somewhere their shields, armour and wounded bodies are lying scattered

107.g: ਜਿਤੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਧੰ ਪਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
107.e: With all the drops of blood that fall on the ground.

107.g: ਜਗੇ ਸੂਰ ਤੇਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰੰ ॥੧੧॥੮੮॥
107.e: The same number of warriors arise shouting “kill, kill”. 11.88.

107.g: ਪਰੀ ਕੁਟ ਕੁਟੰ ਰੁਲੇ ਤਛ ਮੁਛੰ ॥
107.e: There were struck blows after blows and the warriors being chopped are rolling in dust.

107.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮੁੰਡ ਤੁੰਡੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੁਛੰ ॥
107.e: Their heads, faces and pieces of flesh are lying scattered.

107.g: ਭਯੋ ਚਾਰ ਸੈ ਕੋਸ ਲਉ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
107.e: For four hundred kos, the battlefield was occupied by warriors.
Most of whom are lying dead or senseless.12.89.
RASAAVAL STANZA
They have fixed firmly their banners and in excitement their rage is increasing.13.90.
The warriors filled with delight are showering their arrows.
All the four types of forces are moving forward and staying in their arens.14.91.
With the use of all the weapons, the stream of blood began to flow.
The most honoured warriors arose with bow and arrows in their hands.15.92.
They are raaring in great anger, and the clarionets and drums are being played.
Filled with great fury, the wielders of canopies are much excited.16.93.
There are shouts after shouts and the forces are running hither and thither.
With great ire, the steel is being used, and the inebriated warriors look glorious.17.94.
The warriors with chopped limbs have fallen and the red blood appears like flaming fire.
The jingling and the twanging sounds of weapons are being heard.18.95.
The weapons are being struck with clinking sound and both sides wan their victory.
Many are intoxicated with wine and in great fury, they appear highly inflamed.19.96.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

107.g: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
107.e: True is that temple, within which one meditates on the True Lord.

107.g: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
107.e: Blessed is that heart, within which the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung.

107.g: ਸਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ. ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.e: Beautiful is that land, where the Lord's humble servants dwell. I am a sacrifice to the True Name. ||1||
The extent of the True Lord's Greatness cannot be known.
His Creative Power and His Bounties cannot be described.

107.g: ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.e: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating on You. Their minds treasure the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||
The Praises of the True One are obtained by great good fortune.
By Guru's Grace, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

107.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ. ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
107.e: Those who are imbued with Your Love are pleasing to You. The True Name is their Banner and Insignia. ||3||
No one knows the limits of the True Lord.
In all places and interspaces, the True One is pervading.

107.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੪॥
107.e: O Nanak, meditate forever on the True One, the Searcher of hearts, the Knower of all. ||4||37||44||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
You are here, and You are hereafter.
All beings and creatures were created by You.

107.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ; ਮੈ ਧਰ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.e: Without You, there is no other, O Creator. You are my Support and my Protection. ||1||
The tongue lives by chanting and meditating on the Lord's Name.
The Supreme Lord God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

107.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਜਨਮੁ. ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.e: Those who serve the Lord find peace; they do not lose their lives in the gamble. ||2||

107.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
107.e: Your humble servant, who obtains the Medicine of the Naam,

108.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
People do whatever the Lord inspires them to do.
Wherever He keeps us is a good place.

108.g: ਸੋਈ ਸਿਆਣਾ. ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਗੈ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
108.e: That person is clever and honorable, unto whom the Hukam of the Lord's Command seems sweet. ||1||
Everything is strung upon the One String of the Lord.

108.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ; ਸੋ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
108.e: Those whom the Lord attaches, are attached to His Feet.

108.g: ਊਂਧ ਕਵਲੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
108.e: Those, whose inverted lotus of the crown chakra is illuminated, see the Immaculate Lord everywhere. ||2||
Only You Yourself know Your Glory.
You Yourself recognize Your Own Self.

108.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.e: I am a sacrifice to Your Saints, who have crushed their sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||
You have no hatred or vengeance; Your Saints are immaculate and pure.
Seeing them, all sins depart.

108.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵੈ; ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਧੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੪੯॥
108.e: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Naam. His stubborn doubt and fear have departed. ||4||42||49||
They are flushed with rage and are absorbed in waging war.
They offer arrows and are discussing archery.20.97.
The heroes are absorbed in heroic feats and are rainiong the shafts.
They are penetrating into the warrior-stronghold and do not turn away their eyes from it.21.98.
They are striking their weapons, facing the enemy and are pulling their bow-strings.
They are showering the arrows and striking the sharp steel-arms.22.99.
The stream of blood has become full and the houris are roaming in the sky.
The goddess Kali is roaring in the firmament and the female demon of the begging bowl is laughing.23.100.
Somewhere there are dead horses and somewhere the fallen mighty warriors.
Somewhere there are broken shields and somewhere the wounded elephants are roaming.24.101.
Somewhere the armour is penetrated and the inflicted skein is being seen.
Somewhere there are chopped elephants and somewhere the saddles of horses are seen cut down.25.102.
The brave warriors are engaged in inimical acts, all of them are fightning with their weapons.
Realising the presence of warriors in the battlefield, the ghosts and evil spirits are dancing.26.103.
The meat-eaters are dancing, those who roam in the sky, are laughing.
The crows are cawing and the elegant warriors are intoxicated.27.104.
The wears of canopies are full of fury and from their bows shoot their arrows.
They are desirous of their victory and thus are shooting their sharp shafts.28.105.
Ganas, Gandharvas, spies, minstrels and the Siddhas with miraculous powers.
All of them laugh and the warriors are inebriatedwith rage.29.106.
The vampires are belching and the egoist warriors are shouting.
The drums are creating loud sound and there are clanging noises.30.107.
The mighty warriors are roaring and the new instruments are being sounded.
The trumpets are resounding and the forces of Durga and the demons are fighting.31.108.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, my heart is filled with peace.
By His Grace, His devotees become famous and acclaimed.

108.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ; ਬਿਨਸੇ. ਆਲਸ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
108.e: Joining the Society of the Saints, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the disease of laziness has disappeared. ||1||

108.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
108.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the nine treasures are found in the Home of the Lord;
He comes to meet those who deserve it by their past actions.

108.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
108.e: The Perfect Transcendent Lord is spiritual wisdom and meditation. God is All-powerful to do all things. ||2||
In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the Many.

108.g: ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ. ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਡਿਠੇ. ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.e: Filth does not stick to the Giver, the Life of the World. Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the pain of separation departs. ||3||
Holding on to the hem of His Robe, the entire Universe is saved.
He Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

108.g: ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ. ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੪੮॥
108.e: The Boat of the Guru is found by His Grace; O Nanak, such blessed destiny is pre-ordained. ||4||41||48||
is rid of the illnesses of countless lifetimes and incarnations.

108.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਫਲ ਏਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.e: So sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night. This is the most fruitful occupation. ||3||
Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He has adorned His slave.
Deep within each and every heart, the Supreme Lord is humbly worshipped.

108.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ. ਹੋਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੪੬॥
108.e: Without the One, there is no other at all. O Baba Nanak, this is the most excellent wisdom. ||4||39||46||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord.
I sacrifice everything for Him.

108.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ; ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ. ਕੋਈ ਸਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
108.e: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. Do not forget Him, for even one breath. ||1||
He is a companion, a friend, and a beloved of mine,
who reflects upon the Lord's Name, in the Company of the Holy.

108.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ. ਤਰੀਜੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਕਟੀਐ. ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
108.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the world-ocean, and the noose of death shall be cut away. ||2||
The four cardinal blessings are obtained by serving the Lord.
The Elysian Tree, the source of all blessings, is meditation on the Unseen and Unknowable Lord.

108.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.e: The Guru has cut out the sinful mistakes of sexual desire and anger, and my hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||
That mortal who is blessed by perfect destiny meets the Lord,
The Sustainer of the Universe, in the Company of the Holy.

108.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੪੭॥
108.e: O Nanak, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the mind, one is approved and accepted, whether he is a house-holder or a renunciate. ||4||40||47||

109.e: Maajh, Third Mehl, First House:
By His Mercy, we meet the True Guru.
RASAAVAL STANZA
The demon-chief Rakat Beej became bloodless and his limbs became very weak.
Ultimatley he fell down on the ground wavering like the clound on he earth.44.121.
All the gods were pleased (to see this) and they showered the flowers.
Rakat Beej was killed and in this way the goddess saved the saints.45.122.

109.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਰਕਤ ਬੀਰਜ ਬਧਹ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਧਿਆਯ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੪॥
109.e: Thus the Fourth Chapter entitled “The Killing of Rakat Beej” of Chandi Charitra of BACHITTAR is completed.4.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
The mighty warriors Sumbh and Nisumbh began the invasion.

109.g: ਉਠੇ ਨਦ ਨਾਦੰ ਸੁ ਧਉਸਾ ਧੁਕਾਰੰ ॥
