109.e: The sound of musical instruments and trumpets resounded.

109.g: ਭਈ ਅਸਟ ਸੈ ਕੋਸ ਲਉ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛਾਯੰ ॥
109.e: The shade of canopies spread over eight hundred kos.

109.g: ਭਜੇ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰੰ ਡਰਿਯੋ ਦੇਵ ਰਾਯੰ ॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
109.e: And the sun and moon sped away and Indra, the king of gods was frightened.2.124.

109.g: ਭਕਾ ਭੁੰਕ ਭੇਰੀ ਢਕਾ ਢੁੰਕ ਢੋਲੰ ॥
109.e: The drum and the tabor reverberated.
Now the battle with Nisumbh is described:
DOHRA

109.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਸੁਣਿਯੋ ਜਬੈ; ਰਕਤਬੀਰਜ ਕੋ ਨਾਸ ॥
109.e: When Sumbh and Nisumbh heard about the destruction of Rakat Beej

109.g: ਆਪ ਚੜਤ ਭੈ ਜੋਰਿ ਦਲ; ਸਜੇ ਪਰਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
109.e: They marched forward themselves gathering their forces and bedecking themselves with axes and nooses.1.123.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
One who asks for a false gift,

109.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਰਤੇ; ਘੜੀ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
109.e: shall not take even an instant to die.

109.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
109.e: But one who continually serves the Supreme Lord God and meets the Guru, is said to be immortal. ||1||

109.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
109.e: One whose mind is dedicated to loving devotional worship
sings His Glorious Praises night and day, and remains forever awake and aware.

109.g: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਲੈ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੨॥
109.e: Taking him by the hand, the Lord and Master merges into Himself that person, upon whose forehead such destiny is written. ||2||
His Lotus Feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.
Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.

109.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
109.e: I long for the dust of the feet of His humble servants. The Name of the True Lord is my decoration. ||3||
Standing up and sitting down, I sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, I obtain my Eternal Husband Lord.

109.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
109.e: God has become merciful to Nanak. I cheerfully accept Your Will. ||4||43||50||
MANOHAR STANZA

109.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਮਾਤ ਕਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਹਾਥਿ; ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥਨਿ ਸੰਖ ਪ੍ਰਜ੍ਰਯੋ ਜਬ ਜੁਧੰ ॥
109.e: When the Mother of Universe waged the war, holding her bow in her hand and blowing her conch

109.g: ਗਾਤਹ ਸੈਣ ਸੰਘਾਰਤ ਸੂਰ ਬਬਕਤਿ ਸਿੰਘ ਭ੍ਰਮ︀ਯੋ ਰਣਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੰ ॥
109.e: Her lion walked roaring in the field in great ire, crushing and destroying the forces of the enemy.

109.g: ਕਉਚਹਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਅਭੇਦਿਤ ਅੰਗ; ਸੁਰੰਗ ਉਤੰਗ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਿਤ ਸੁਧੰ ॥
109.e: He goes on tearing with his nails the armours on the bodies of the warriors and the torn limbs appear like

109.g: ਮਾਨੋ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਬੜਵਾਨਲ ਜੁਆਲ; ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਮਧਿ ਬਿਰਾਜਤ ਉਧੰ ॥੩੩॥੧੧੦॥
109.e: The rising flames of fire extended in midst of the ocean.33.110.

109.g: ਪੂਰ ਰਹੀ ਭਵਿ ਭੂਰ ਧਨੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ; ਧੂਰ ਉਡੀ ਨਭ ਮੰਡਲ ਛਾਯੋ ॥
109.e: The sound of the bow permeates the whole universe and the flying dust of the battlefield hath spread over the whole firmament.

109.g: ਨੂਰ ਭਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਣਿ; ਹੂਰਨ ਹੇਰਿ ਹੀਯੋ ਹੁਲਸਾਯੋ ॥
109.e: The brightened faces have fallen after receinging blows and seeing them the hearts of the vampires have been pleased.

109.g: ਪੂਰਣ ਰੋਸ ਭਰੇ ਅਰਿ ਤੂਰਣ; ਪੂਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਰਣ ਭੂਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਯੋ ॥
109.e: The forces of the extremely infuriated enemiesare elegantly stationed in the whole battlefield

109.g: ਚੂਰ ਭਏ ਅਰਿ ਰੂਰੇ ਗਿਰੇ ਭਟ; ਚੂਰਣ ਜਾਨੁਕ ਬੈਦ ਬਨਾਯੋ ॥੩੪॥੧੧੧॥
109.e: And winsome and youthful warriors are falling in bits in this mannera s thouth the apothecary after grinding the earth, hath prepared the digestive medicine (Churan).34.111.
Raag Maajh, Ashtpadheeyaa: First Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
By His Command, all are attuned to the Word of the Shabad,
and all are called to the Mansion of His Presence, the True Court of the Lord.

109.g: ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ, ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
109.e: O my True Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek, my mind is pleased and appeased by the Truth. ||1||

109.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
109.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

109.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
109.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of Peace. Through the Guru's Teachings, it dwells in the mind. ||1||Pause||

109.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
109.e: No one is mine, and I am no one else's.
The True Lord and Master of the three worlds is mine.

109.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੇਰੀ; ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
109.e: Acting in egotism, so very many have died. After making mistakes, they later repent and regret. ||2||

109.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਸੁ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
109.e: Those who recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are glorified with the Naam.

109.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ. ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਚੈ; ਛੂਟਸਿ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
109.e: Everyone's account is kept in the True Court, and through the Beauty of the Naam, they are saved. ||3||
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; they find no place of rest.
Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are brutally beaten.

109.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ; ਮੁਕਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
109.e: Without the Name, there are no companions or friends. Liberation comes only by meditating on the Naam. ||4||
The false shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth.
Bound by duality, they come and go in reincarnation.

109.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
109.e: No one can erase pre-recorded destiny; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||5||
In this world of her parents' house, the young bride did not know her Husband.
Through falsehood, she has been separated from Him, and she cries out in misery.

109.g: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਿ ਬਖਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
109.e: Defrauded by demerits, she does not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. But through virtuous actions, her demerits are forgiven. ||6||
She, who knows her Beloved in her parents' house,
as Gurmukh, comes to understand the essence of reality; she contemplates her Lord.

109.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
109.e: Her comings and goings cease, and she is absorbed in the True Name. ||7||
The Gurmukhs understand and describe the Indescribable.
True is our Lord and Master; He loves the Truth.

109.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
109.e: Nanak offers this true prayer: singing His Glorious Praises, I merge with the True One. ||8||1||
BIJAI STANZA

109.g: ਜੇਤਕ ਬਾਣ ਚਲੇ ਅਰਿ ਓਰ ਤੇ; ਫੂਲ ਕੀ ਮਾਲ ਹੁਐ ਕੰਠਿ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ॥
109.e: All the arrows shot by the enemy bedeck as garlands of flowers around the neck of the goddess.

109.g: ਦਾਨਵ ਪੁੰਗਵ ਪੇਖਿ ਅਚੰਭਵ; ਛੋਡਿ ਭਜੇ ਰਣ ਏਕ ਨ ਗਾਜੇ ॥
109.e: Seeing this wonder the forces of the enemy have run away from the battlefield and none could stay there.

109.g: ਕੁੰਜਰ ਪੁੰਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਤਿਹ ਠਉਰ; ਭਰੇ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤ ਪੈ ਗਨ ਤਾਜੇ ॥
109.e: Many elephants have fallen at that place alongwith many healthy steeds, all are smeared with blood.

109.g: ਜਾਨੁਕ ਨੀਰਧ ਮਧਿ ਛਪੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ; ਭੂਧਰ ਕੇ ਭਯ ਤੇ ਨਗ ਭਾਜੇ ॥੩੨॥੧੦੯॥
109.e: It appears that running away out of the fear of Indra, the mountains have hidden themselves in the sea.32.109.
SANGEET BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
The sounds of the blows of the daggers and swords are being heard.
The sounds of the shafts and gunshots are being heard.
Various sounds of musical instruments are resounding.
The warriors are roaring and shouting loudly.35.112.
The great heroes have been struck.
And the brave fighters are belching.36.113.
The worriors seem pleased on shooting sharp arrows on the bodies.
There are loud shouts with porofound resoundings, and the poets describe them in their verses.37.114.
The demons are running away and the heroes are shouting loudly.
The sounds are produced by the striking axes and daggers. The arrows and the guns are creating their own noses.38.115.
The loud noise of drums and the resounding of conches and trumpets is being heard in the battlefield.
The musical instruments of the warriors are being played and the ghosts and goblins are dancing.39.116.
The noises of the arrows and shafts, daggers and swords are being heard.
The music of the musical instruments and the drumming of the trumpets resounds and the warriors and chieftains are doing their job amidst such resonance.40.117.
The conches, clarionets and the drums resounded.
The trumpets and musical instruments produced their sounds and alongwith their resonance, the warriors thundered.41.118.
NARAAJ STANZA
All the forms of demons created with the spilling of the blood of Rakat Beej on ground, were killed by the goddess.
All the forms that are going to materialize, will also be destroyed by Durga.42.119.
With the showering of weapons (on Rakat Beej), the currents of blood ooxed out (from the body of Rakat Beej).
All the drops that fell (on the ground), the goddess Kali drank them all.43.120.

110.e: RASAAVAL STANZA
The brave warriors are thundering and the horses are speedily moving.
The bows are being pulled and the shafts are raining.5.127.
From this side the lion hath roared and the conch hath been blown.
Its sound is filling the atmosphere. The sky is filled with the dust risen from the battlefield.6.128.
The warriors have bedecked themselves with weapons and are thundering like clouds.
They are furiously moving, carrying countless weapons.7.129.
From all four sides the warriors are closing their ranks, shouting “kill, kill”.
The mighty warriors are thundering and countless weapons are striking blows.8.130.
Carrying the powerful weapons in their hands, their faces and eyes are becoming blood-red.
In great fury, they are marching and showering their arrows.9.131.
Many of the tyrants have been killed and consequently countless weapons are lying scattered hither and thither.
The goddess hath been pleased and is showering her arrows.10.132.
Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

110.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
110.e: Subduing your ego, you shall find a lasting peace, and your emotional attachment to Maya will be dispelled. ||1||

110.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
110.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, I am totally devoted to the True Guru.

110.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੀ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
110.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Divine Light has dawned; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

110.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜੇ; ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
110.e: Search your body and mind, and find the Name.
Restrain your wandering mind, and keep it in check.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
110.e: Night and day, sing the Songs of the Guru's Bani; worship the Lord with intuitive devotion. ||2||
Within this body are countless objects.
The Gurmukh attains Truth, and comes to see them.

110.g: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ. ਦਸਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
110.e: Beyond the nine gates, the Tenth Gate is found, and liberation is obtained. The Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates. ||3||
True is the Master, and True is His Name.
By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell within the mind.

110.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
110.e: Night and day, remain attuned to the Lord's Love forever, and you shall obtain understanding in the True Court. ||4||

110.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ; ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
110.e: Those who do not understand the nature of sin and virtue
are attached to duality; they wander around deluded.

110.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ. ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
110.e: The ignorant and blind people do not know the way; they come and go in reincarnation over and over again. ||5||

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
110.e: Serving the Guru, I have found eternal peace;
my ego has been silenced and subdued.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ. ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ; ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
110.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness has been dispelled, and the heavy doors have been opened. ||6||
Subduing my ego, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.
I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet forever.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
110.e: By Guru's Grace, my mind and body are immaculate and pure; I meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||
From birth to death, everything is for You.
You bestow greatness upon those whom You have forgiven.

110.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ; ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
110.e: O Nanak, meditating forever on the Naam, you shall be blessed in both birth and death. ||8||1||2||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
My God is Immaculate, Inaccessible and Infinite.
Without a scale, He weighs the universe.

110.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
110.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands. Chanting His Glorious Praises, he is absorbed into the Lord of Virtue. ||1||

110.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
110.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord.

110.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ. ਸੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
110.e: Those who are committed to Truth remain awake and aware night and day. They are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||
He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.

110.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
110.e: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, become acceptable.

110.g: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
110.e: They are attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches; as Gurmukh, they live the Truth. ||2||

110.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ; ਸੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
110.e: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads-whose hand can they take?

110.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
110.e: That which is pre-ordained, cannot be erased.

110.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
110.e: Those who meet the True Guru are very fortunate and blessed; through perfect karma, He is met. ||3||
The young bride is fast asleep in her parents' home, night and day.
She has forgotten her Husband Lord; because of her faults and demerits, she is abandoned.

110.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
110.e: She wanders around continually, crying out, night and day. Without her Husband Lord, she cannot get any sleep. ||4||
In this world of her parents' home, she may come to know the Giver of peace,
if she subdues her ego, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

110.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ. ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ; ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
110.e: Her bed is beautiful; she ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord forever. She is adorned with the Decorations of Truth. ||5||
BELI BINDRAM STANZA
The crows are uttering “caw, caw” and the blood of mighty heroes is flowing.
The arrows and swords are waving in the wind and the ghosts and evil spirits are catching the dead.11.133.
The tobors are resounding and the swords are glistening.
The sounds of striking daggers and the thundering of the warriors are being heard.12.134.
The arrows shot from the bows create surprises in the minds of the warriors.
The vampires are fearing from the sound of the labor and the female demons are wandering and laughing.13.135.
Because of the rain of sharp arrows, the blood is splashing.

110.g: ਫਟੀ ਨਖ ਸਿੰਘੰ ਮੁਖੰ ਡਢ ਕੋਲੰ ॥
110.e: The earth splitted because of the roar of the lion and the attack of his nails.

110.g: ਡਮਾ ਡੰਮਿ ਡਉਰੂ ਡਕਾ ਡੁੰਕ ਡੰਕੰ ॥
110.e: The sound of the trumpets and the tabors is being heard.
And the huge vultures and crows are shrieking and flying .3.125.

110.g: ਖੁਰੰ ਖੇਹ ਉਠੀ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਗੈਨ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
110.e: The sky is filled with the dust risen by the hooves of the animals.

110.g: ਦਲੇ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਬਿਧੰ ਭਏ ਪਬ ਚੂਰੰ ॥
110.e: And these animals have broken into prices Vidhyachal mountain and other small mounts.

110.g: ਸੁਣੋ ਸੋਰ ਕਾਲੀ ਗਹੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਣੰ ॥
110.e: The goddess Kali hearing the din, held her weapons in her hands.
While roaring she ate up the limps of the killed youthful warriors.4.126.

111.e: He created the 8.4 million species of beings.

111.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
111.e: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, come to meet the Guru.

111.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ. ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
111.e: Shedding their sins, His servants are forever pure; at the True Court, they are beautified by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
When they are called to settle their accounts, who will answer then?
There shall be no peace then, from counting out by twos and threes.

111.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
111.e: The True Lord God Himself forgives, and having forgiven, He unites them with Himself. ||7||
He Himself does, and He Himself causes all to be done.
Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is met.

111.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
111.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. He Himself unites in His Union. ||8||2||3||
Many warriors are roaring and the jackals, in particular, being pleased, are howling.14.136.
The immortal Durga, the dyer with blood, is moving, pleased with her task.
The roaring lion is running and such is the continuous situation in the battlefield.15.137.
The drums are resounding and the daggers are clanking.
The fighting warriors, in great fury, are striking their swords.16.138.
NARAAJ STANZA
Srriking his foot on the earth Sumbh sent Nisumbh saying
“Go immediately and bring Durga after binding her.”18.140.
Thundering and in great fury, he marched forward alongwith his army.
The trumpets were sounded, hearing which caused the king of gods run away.19.141.
Beating his drums, he marched forward taking countless warriors with him.
He called and gathered so many brave fighters, seeing whom the gods were frightened.20.142.
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
The king of gods trembled and reated all his painful circumstances to Lord Shiva.
When he gave out all his feflections, Shiva asked him about the number of his warriors.21.143.
(He further asked him) to make friends all others through all possible means
So that the victory of the mother of the world is assured.22.144.
Bring out all your powers, and send them in the war
So that they may go before enemies and in great rage destroy them.23.145.
The wise gods did as advised
And sent their boundless powers from amoungst themselves to the battlefield.24.146.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The One Lord Himself moves about imperceptibly.

111.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਾ; ਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
111.e: As Gurmukh, I see Him, and then this mind is pleased and uplifted.

111.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ. ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਏਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
111.e: Renouncing desire, I have found intuitive peace and poise; I have enshrined the One within my mind. ||1||

111.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
111.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the One.

111.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ. ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
111.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, my mind has come to its only home; it is imbued with the True Color of the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

111.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ; ਤੈਂ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
111.e: This world is deluded; You Yourself have deluded it.
Forgetting the One, it has become engrossed in duality.

111.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
111.e: Night and day, it wanders around endlessly, deluded by doubt; without the Name, it suffers in pain. ||2||
Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord, the Architect of Destiny

111.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
111.e: by serving the Guru, they are known throughout the four ages.

111.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
111.e: Those, upon whom the Lord bestows greatness, are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||3||
Being in love with Maya, they do not think of the Lord.
Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they suffer in terrible pain.

111.g: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
111.e: Blind and deaf, they see nothing at all; the self-willed manmukhs rot away in sin. ||4||

111.g: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
111.e: Those, whom You attach to Your Love, are attuned to Your Love.
Through loving devotional worship, they become pleasing to Your Mind.

111.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
111.e: They serve the True Guru, the Giver of eternal peace, and all their desires are fulfilled. ||5||
O Dear Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary forever.
You Yourself forgive us, and bless us with Glorious Greatness.

111.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
111.e: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||6||
Night and day, they are attuned to His Love; they are pleasing to the Lord.
My God merges with them, and unites them in Union.

111.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ. ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ. ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
111.e: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; You Yourself inspire us to understand the Truth. ||7||

111.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
111.e: Those who know the Truth are absorbed in Truth.
They sing the Lord's Glorious Praises, and speak the Truth.

111.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੪॥
111.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain unattached and balanced; in the home of the inner self, they are absorbed in the primal trance of deep meditation. ||8||3||4||
RASAAVAL STANZA
All the powers came and went back paying their obeisance.
They wore terrible arms and killed many great warriors.26.148.
Their faces and eyes are reddened with blood and they are uttering challenging words from their mouths.
They are holding arms, daggers and swords in their hands.27.149.
From the other side, the demons are thundering, and the trumpets are resounding.
They are wearing cruel armour, holding winsome shields in their hands.28.150.
They began to roar from all the four sides and hearing their voices, all the gods trembled.
The sharp arrows were shot and the garments and fly-whisks were torn.29.151.
Inebriated with extreme ferocity, the warriors are seen with brightened faces.
The goddess Durga, being very much pleased, hath begun showering the rain of arrows.30.152.
On this side, the goddess is busy in killing and on the other side the lion is tearing up all.
Hearing the roars of the Ganas (attendants) of Shiva, the demons have become frightened.31.153.
BIRADH NIRAAJ STANZA

111.g: ਚਲੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਸੀਘ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣਿ ਪਾਣਿ ਧਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
111.e: Immediately the powers wore the sword and went towards the arena of war

111.g: ਉਠੇ ਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਡਉਰ; ਡਾਕਣੀ ਡਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
111.e: And with them ran the great vultures nd belching vampires.

111.g: ਹਸੇ ਸੁ ਰੰਗ ਕੰਕ ਬੰਕਯੰ; ਕਬੰਧ ਅੰਧ ਉਠਹੀ ॥
111.e: The terrible crows smiled and the blind headless bodies also moved.

111.g: ਬਿਸੇਖ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਰੁ ਬੀਰ; ਬਾਣ ਧਾਰ ਬੁਠਹੀ ॥੨੫॥੧੪੭॥
111.e: From this side, the gods and other heroes began to shower shafts.25.147.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
One who dies in the Word of the Shabad is truly dead.

111.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਪੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
111.e: Death does not crush him, and pain does not afflict him.

111.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਿਲਿ. ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
111.e: His light merges and is absorbed into the Light, when he hears and merges in the Truth. ||1||

111.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ. ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
111.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Lord's Name, which brings us to glory.

111.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ. ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
111.e: One who serves the True Guru, and focuses his consciousness on Truth, following the Guru's Teachings, is absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||Pause||
This human body is transitory, and transitory are the garments it wears.
Attached to duality, no one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
DOHRA

111.g: ਭਜੀ ਚਮੂੰ ਸਬ ਦਾਨਵੀ; ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਰਖ ਨਿਜ ਨੈਣ ॥
111.e: Seeing with his own eyes the running demon-army

111.g: ਨਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਟ ਭਟ ਜੇ ਹੁਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਬੁਲਿਯੋ ਬੈਣ ॥੧੭॥੧੩੯॥
111.e: Sumbh spoke to the mighty warriors standing near him.17.139.

112.e: DOHRA

112.g: ਸੁੰਭਾਸੁਰ ਜੇਤਿਕੁ ਅਸੁਰ; ਪਠਏ ਕੋਪੁ ਬਢਾਇ ॥
112.e: All those demons, sent by Sumbh, I great fury

112.g: ਤੇ ਦੇਬੀ ਸੋਖਤ ਕਰੇ; ਬੂੰਦ ਤਵਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਇ ॥੮॥੧੬੪॥
112.e: Were destroyed by the goddess like the water-drops on the hot iron-griddle.8.164.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
Diamonds and rubies are produced deep within the self.
They are assayed and valued through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

112.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ. ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
112.e: Those who have gathered Truth, speak Truth; they apply the Touch-stone of Truth. ||1||

112.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ. ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
112.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Word of the Guru's Bani within their minds.

112.g: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ. ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
112.e: In the midst of the darkness of the world, they obtain the Immaculate One, and their light merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||
Within this body are countless vast vistas;
the Immaculate Naam is totally Inaccessible and Infinite.

112.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
112.e: He alone becomes Gurmukh and obtains it, whom the Lord forgives, and unites with Himself. ||2||
My Lord and Master implants the Truth.
By Guru's Grace, one's consciousness is attached to the Truth.

112.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
112.e: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; the true ones merge in Truth. ||3||
The True Carefree Lord is my Beloved.
He cuts out our sinful mistakes and evil actions;

112.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
112.e: with love and affection, meditate forever on Him. He implants the Fear of God and loving devotional worship within us. ||4||

112.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ; ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
112.e: Devotional worship is True, if it pleases the True Lord.
He Himself bestows it; He does not regret it later.

112.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
112.e: He alone is the Giver of all beings. The Lord kills with the Word of His Shabad, and then revives. ||5||

112.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ; ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
112.e: Other than You, Lord, nothing is mine.

112.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਸੇਵੀ, ਤੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
112.e: I serve You, Lord, and I praise You.

112.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ; ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
112.e: You unite me with Yourself, O True God. Through perfect good karma You are obtained. ||6||

112.g: ਮੈ. ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
112.e: For me, there is no other like You.
By Your Glance of Grace, my body is blessed and sanctified.

112.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
112.e: Night and day, the Lord takes care of us and protects us. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||7||

112.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ; ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
112.e: For me, there is no other as Great as You.
You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.
There was rain of arrows and with this the goddess became victorious.
All the tyrants were killed by the goddess and the Mother saved the saints.32.154.
The goddess killed Nisumbh and destroyed the army of demons.
On this side the lion roared and form the other side all the demons fled.33.155.
On the victory of the army of gods, there was rain of flowers.
The saints hailed it nd the demos trembled with fear.34.156.

112.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਬਧਹ ਪੰਚਮੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੫॥
112.e: Here ends the Fifth Chapter entitled ‘The Killing of Nisumbh’ of Chandi Charitra in BACHITTAR NATAK.5.
Now the war with Sumbh is described:
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

112.g: ਲਘੁੰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਜੁਝਿਯੋ, ਸੁਨਿਯੋ ਸੁੰਭ ਰਾਯੰ ॥
112.e: When Sumbh heard about the death of his younger brother

112.g: ਸਜੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ, ਚੜਿਯੋ ਚਉਪ ਚਾਯੰ ॥
112.e: He, in fury and excitement, marched forward to wage war, bedecking himself with arms and amour.

112.g: ਭਯੋ ਨਾਦ ਉਚੰ, ਰਹਿਯੋ ਪੂਰ ਗੈਣੰ ॥
112.e: There was terrible sound which permeted in the firmament.
Hearing this sound, the gods, demons and Shiva all trembled.1.157.

112.g: ਡਰਿਯੋ ਚਾਰ ਬਕਤ੍ਰੰ, ਟਰਿਯੋ ਦੇਵ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
112.e: Brahma was fightened and the throne of Indra, the king of gods, wavered.

112.g: ਡਿਗੇ ਪਬ ਸਰਬੰ, ਸ੍ਰਜੇ ਸੁਭ ਸਾਜੰ ॥
112.e: Seeing the bedecked form of the demon-king, the mountains also began to fall.

112.g: ਪਰੇ ਹੂਹ ਦੈ ਕੈ, ਭਰੇ ਲੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹੰ ॥
112.e: Shriking and screaming in great ire the demons appear

112.g: ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰ ਕੋ, ਸਾਤਵੋ ਸ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਸੋਹੰ ॥੨॥੧੫੮॥
112.e: Like the seventh peak of Sumeru mountain.2.158.

112.g: ਸਜਿਯੋ ਸੈਨ ਸੁਭੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਨਾਦ ਉਚੰ ॥
112.e: Bedecking himself, Sumbh raised a terrible sound
Hearing which the pregnancy of women was miscarried.

112.g: ਪਰਿਯੋ ਲੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਉਠੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੰ ॥
112.e: The furious warriors made continuous use of steel arms and the weapons began to rain.
The voices of vultures and vampires were heard in the battlefield.3.159.

112.g: ਬਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ, ਕਟੇ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮੰ ॥
112.e: With the use of weapons and arms, the winsome armours were being cut

112.g: ਭਲੇ ਕੈ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਯੋ, ਭਟੰ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
112.e: And the warriors performed their religious duties in a nice manner.

112.g: ਉਠੀ ਕੂਹ ਜੂਹੰ, ਗਿਰੇ ਚਉਰ ਚੀਰੰ ॥
112.e: There was consternation in the whole battlefield and the canopies and garments began to fall.

112.g: ਰੁਲੇ ਤਛ ਮੁਛੰ, ਪਰੀ ਗਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੪॥੧੬੦॥
112.e: The chopped bodies were being trodden in the dust and because of the infliction of arrows, the warriors were becoming senseless.4.160.
The warriors fell in the battlefield along with the elephants and goads.
The headless trunks began to dance senselessly.

112.g: ਉਡੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਧੰ, ਰੜੈ ਕੰਕ ਬੰਕੰ ॥
112.e: The large-sized vultures began to fly and the crows with curved beaks began to caw.

112.g: ਭਕਾ ਭੁੰਕ ਭੇਰੀ, ਡਾਹ ਡੂਹ ਡੰਕੰ ॥੫॥੧੬੧॥
112.e: The frightful sound of drums and the clatter of tabors was heard.5.161.

112.g: ਟਕਾ ਟੁਕ ਟੋਪੰ, ਢਕਾ ਢੁਕ ਢਾਲੰ ॥
112.e: There was knocking of helmets and the sound of blows on the shields.
The swords began to chop the bodies with terrible noises.

112.g: ਹਲਾ ਚਾਲ ਬੀਰੰ, ਧਮਾ ਧੰਮਿ ਸਾਗੰ ॥
112.e: The warriors were attacked continuously and the clatter of daggers was being heard.

112.g: ਪਰੀ ਹਾਲ ਹੂਲੰ, ਸੁਣਿਯੋ ਲੋਗ ਨਾਗੰ ॥੬॥੧੬੨॥
112.e: There was such consternation that its noise was heard in the netherworld by the Nagas.6.162.
The vampires, female demons, ghosts
Headless trunks and the kapalikas are dancing in the battlefield.
All the gods appear pleased and the demon-king is getting furious.

112.g: ਕਿਧੋ ਅਗਨਿ ਜੁਆਲੰ, ਭਯੋ ਆਪ ਭੇਸੰ ॥੭॥੧੬੩॥
112.e: It appears that the flame of fire is blazing.7.163.
NARAAJ STANZA

112.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਦੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
112.e: Night and day, day and night, they burn. Without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride suffers in terrible pain. ||2||
Her body and her status shall not go with her to the world hereafter.

112.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਤਿਥੈ ਛੁਟੈ. ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
112.e: Where she is called to answer for her account, there, she shall be emancipated only by true actions.

112.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ; ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
112.e: Those who serve the True Guru shall prosper; here and hereafter, they are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||
She who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,
by Guru's Grace, obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as her home.

112.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
112.e: Night and day, day and night, she constantly ravishes and enjoys her Beloved. She is dyed in the permanent color of His Love. ||4||
The Husband Lord abides with everyone, always;
but how rare are those few who, by Guru's Grace, obtain His Glance of Grace.

112.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
112.e: My God is the Highest of the High; granting His Grace, He merges us into Himself. ||5||
This world is asleep in emotional attachment to Maya.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it ultimately comes to ruin.

112.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ. ਸੋ ਜਾਗਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
112.e: The One who put it to sleep shall also awaken it. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding dawns. ||6||
One who drinks in this Nectar, shall have his delusions dispelled.
By Guru's Grace, the state of liberation is attained.

112.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
112.e: One who is imbued with devotion to the Lord, remains always balanced and detached. Subduing selfishness and conceit, he is united with the Lord. ||7||
He Himself creates, and He Himself assigns us to our tasks.
He Himself gives sustenance to the 8.4 million species of beings.

112.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੫॥
112.e: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam are atuned to Truth. They do that which is pleasing to His Will. ||8||4||5||

113.e: SANGEET NARAAJ STANZA
Alongwith the clattering of swords, the daggers are striking fastly.
The heroic warriors have been inspired to face the fighters. 19.175.
RASAAVAL STANZA
Maajh, Third Mehl:
He is the Enjoyer of all hearts.
The Invisible, Inaccessible and Infinite is pervading everywhere.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
113.e: Meditating on my Lord God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am intuitively absorbed in the Truth. ||1||

113.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
113.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad in their minds.

113.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੂਝੈ. ਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ; ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
113.e: When someone understands the Shabad, then he wrestles with his own mind; subduing his desires, he merges with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The five enemies are plundering the world.
The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand or appreciate this.

113.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ. ਸਬਦਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
113.e: Those who become Gurmukh-their houses are protected. The five enemies are destroyed by the Shabad. ||2||

113.g: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
113.e: The Gurmukhs are forever imbued with love for the True One.
They serve God with intuitive ease. Night and day, they are intoxicated with His Love.

113.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
113.e: Meeting with their Beloved, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True one; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
First, the One created Himself;
second, the sense of duality; third, the three-phased Maya.

113.g: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਉੜੀ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਊਚੀ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
113.e: The fourth state, the highest, is obtained by the Gurmukh, who practices Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

113.g: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ; ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
113.e: Everything which is pleasing to the True Lord is true.

113.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
113.e: Those who know the Truth merge in intuitive peace and poise.

113.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਸਾਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
113.e: The life-style of the Gurmukh is to serve the True Lord. He goes and blends with the True Lord. ||5||

113.g: ਸਚੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ; ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥
113.e: Without the True One, there is no other at all.

113.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ; ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
113.e: Attached to duality, the world is distracted and distressed to death.

113.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ; ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
113.e: One who becomes Gurmukh knows only the One. Serving the One, peace is obtained. ||6||
All beings and creatures are in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

113.g: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ; ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
113.e: You place the chessmen on the board; You see the imperfect and the perfect as well.

113.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
113.e: Night and day, You cause people to act; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||7||
You Yourself unite, and You see Yourself close at hand.
You Yourself are totally pervading amongst all.

113.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੭॥
113.e: O Nanak, God Himself is pervading and permeating everywhere; only the Gurmukhs understand this. ||8||6||7||
SANGEET MADHUBHAAE STANZA
There were sounds of clattering and twanging.
The warriors were shouting loudly and thundering profoundly.10.166.
The resonance of trumpets was precipitating the youthful warriors.
Those brave men were jumping and engaged in chivalrous acts. 11.167.
In great rage, the warriors showed signs of anger on their faces.
They were striking their swords.12.168.
The arrows shot by the warriors were blowing away
And throwing down those coming in front of them.13.169.
The winsome brave horse-riders were fighting courageously.14.170.
Several types of noise were spreading in the battlefield.15.171.
The arms were being swung in the battlefield and the stream of blood was flowing.
Manifesting her frightful form, Kapali Durga was dancing.16.172.
NARAAJ STANZA
Killing the countless tyrants, Durga effaced many sufferings.
The blinds trunks were rising and moving and they were being felled on the ground with the shower of arrows.17.173.
The sounds of working bows and striking daggers are being heard.
In this continuous shower of arrows the significantly honoured heroes have been tasted.18.174.

113.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੬॥
113.e: You Yourself create, destroy and adorn. O Nanak, we are adorned and embellished with the Naam. ||8||5||6||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The Nectar of the Guru's Bani is very sweet.
Rare are the Gurmukhs who see and taste it.

113.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
113.e: The Divine Light dawns within, and the supreme essence is found. In the True Court, the Word of the Shabad vibrates. ||1||

113.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
113.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

113.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਮਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
113.e: The True Guru is the True Pool of Nectar; bathing in it, the mind is washed clean of all filth. ||1||Pause||

113.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
113.e: Your limits, O True Lord, are not known to anyone.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ. ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
113.e: Rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, focus their consciousness on You.

113.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ. ਨ ਰਜਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ; ਸਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
113.e: Praising You, I am never satisfied; such is the hunger I feel for the True Name. ||2||
I see only the One, and no other.
By Guru's Grace, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
113.e: My thirst is quenched by the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I am absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||3||
The Priceless Jewel is discarded like straw;
the blind self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

113.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਸੁਪਨੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
113.e: As they plant, so do they harvest. They shall not obtain peace, even in their dreams. ||4||

113.g: ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
113.e: Those who are blessed with His Mercy find the Lord.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.
He (demon-king) marched forward, in great fury, bedecking himself with an army of warriors.
He moved, wearing his weapons, with shouts of “kill, kill”.9.165.

114.e: RASAAVAL STANZA
When the demon-king Sumbh heard all that had happened, he marched forward in great excitement.
His soldiers bedecked with weapons came forward to wage war.33.189.
The sound created by drums, bows
And trumpets were continuously heard.34.190.
The swords of the persistent and renowned fighters glistened.
The great heroes raised loud shouts and the trumpets sounded.35.191.
The demons thundered from all the four sides and the gods collectively trembled.
Showering her arrows Durga herself is testing the dtength of all.36.192.
The striking swords are glistening and the daggers are striking fastly.
The brave warriors are giving blows of maces on the back of the lion.20.176.
Somewhere the blood is being drunk, somewhere the head is lying broken.
Somewhere there is din and somewhere the heroes are rising again.21.177.
Somewhere the warriors are lying in the dust, somewhere there is repetition of the shouts of “kill, kill”.
Somewhere the minstrels are eulogizing the warriors and somewhere warriors with wounded bellies are lying down.22.178.
The bearers of canopies are running away and somewhere the blood is being flowin.
Somewhere the tyrants are being destroyed and the warriors are running hither and thither like the Persian wheel.23.179.
All the warriors are bedecked with the bow
And all of them are holding their swords like the dreadful saw.24.180.
They are verily of dark complexion like the saltish sea.
Though they have been destroyed several times, but still they are shouting “kill, kill”.25.181.
Bhavani (Durga) hath destroyed all like the jawahan plant destroyed by the continuous rain.
Many other brave demons have been crushed under her feet.26.182.
The enemies have been destroyed in the first round and thrown away. They have been struck on their bodies with weapons and made cool (by death).
Many mighty warriors have been killed and the sound of the drums is continuously being heard.27.183.
Wonderful type of arrows have been shot and because of them many fighters have expired.
When the demon-warriors of great might saw the goddess in person, they became senseless.28.184
Many brave fighters were torn by the lion and thrown on the ground.
And many huge demons were personally killed and destroyed by the goddess.29.185.
Many real heroes who stuck fast before the goddess.
And who were extremely hard-hearted and renowned for their mercilessness ultimately ran away.30.186.
The egoist warriors with brightened faces who ran forward.
And also the mighty and furious heroes were killed by the dreadful death.31.187.
DOHRA

114.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਸਟ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰ ਕੈ; ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
114.e: In this way, destroying the tyrants, Durga again wore her weapons and armour.

114.g: ਬਾਣ ਬੂੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੈ ਬਰਖ; ਸਿੰਘ ਨਾਦ ਪੁਨਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੩੨॥੧੮੮॥
114.e: At first she showered her arrows and then her lion roared heavily.32.188.
Maajh Third Mehl:
Serving the True Guru is the greatest greatness.

114.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ. ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
114.e: The Dear Lord automatically comes to dwell in the mind.

114.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤਾ. ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਲਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
114.e: The Dear Lord is the fruit-bearing tree; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, thirst is quenched. ||1||

114.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
114.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the one who leads me to join the True Congregation.

114.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
114.e: The Lord Himself unites me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
He Himself imbues us with His Love, with effortless ease.

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
114.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

114.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ, ਰਸਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੀ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ. ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
114.e: This mind and body are so imbued, and this tongue is dyed in the deep crimson color of the poppy. Through the Love and the Fear of God, we are dyed in this color. ||1||

114.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
114.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Fearless Lord within their minds.

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
114.e: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Fearless Lord; the Shabad has carried me across the poisonous world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
The idiotic self-willed manmukhs try to be clever,
but in spite of their bathing and washing, they shall not be acceptable.

114.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਆਇਆ. ਤੇਹਾ ਜਾਸੀ; ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
114.e: As they came, so shall they go, regretting the mistakes they made. ||2||
The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything;
death was pre-ordained for them when they came into the world, but they do not understand.

114.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
114.e: The self-willed manmukhs may practice religious rituals, but they do not obtain the Name; without the Name, they lose this life in vain. ||3||
The practice of Truth is the essence of the Shabad.
Through the Perfect Guru, the gate of salvation is found.

114.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ; ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
114.e: So, night and day, listen to the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad. Let yourself be colored by this love. ||4||

114.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
114.e: The tongue, imbued with the Lord's Essence, delights in His Love.
My mind and body are enticed by the Lord's Sublime Love.

114.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
114.e: I have easily obtained my Darling Beloved; I am intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

114.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ; ਸੋਈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
114.e: Those who have the Lord's Love within, sing His Glorious Praises;

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
114.e: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are intuitively absorbed in celestial peace.

114.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ, ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
114.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those who dedicate their consciousness to the Guru's Service. ||6||
The True Lord is pleased with Truth, and only Truth.
By Guru's Grace, one's inner being is deeply imbued with His Love.

114.g: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
114.e: Sitting in that blessed place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, who Himself inspires us to accept His Truth. ||7||

114.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
114.e: That one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtains it.
By Guru's Grace, egotism departs.

114.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੮॥੯॥
114.e: O Nanak, that one, within whose mind the Name dwells, is honored in the True Court. ||8||8||9||

114.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਭੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
114.e: Night and day, they remain in the Fear of God; conquering their fears, their doubts are dispelled. ||5||
Dispelling their doubts, they find a lasting peace.
By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is attained.

114.g: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
114.e: Deep within, they are pure, and their words are pure as well; intuitively, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||
They recite the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,
but deluded by doubt, they do not understand the essence of reality.

114.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
114.e: Without serving the True Guru, they find no peace; they earn only pain and misery. ||7||
The Lord Himself acts; unto whom should we complain?
How can anyone complain that the Lord has made a mistake?

114.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੭॥੮॥
114.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself does, and causes things to be done; chanting the Naam, we are absorbed in the Naam. ||8||7||8||
CHAUPAI
All those demons, carrying their weapons, came in front of the goddess were all subjected to death.
The edges of the swords are glistening and the headless trunks, in dreadful forms are raising their voices.37.193.

115.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
The beautiful horses are roaming hither and thither.
The elephants of the princes are roaring dreadfully.
I serve the True Guru; the Word of His Shabad is beautiful.

115.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
115.e: Through it, the Name of the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

115.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
115.e: The Pure Lord removes the filth of egotism, and we are honored in the True Court. ||2||

115.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
115.e: Without the Guru, the Naam cannot be obtained.
The Siddhas and the seekers lack it; they weep and wail.

115.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
115.e: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained; through perfect destiny, the Guru is found. ||3||

115.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਰਸੀ; ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
115.e: This mind is a mirror; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, see themselves in it.

115.g: ਮੋਰਚਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
115.e: Rust does not stick to those who burn their ego.

115.g: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
115.e: The Unstruck Melody of the Bani resounds through the Pure Word of the Shabad; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are absorbed into the True One. ||4||

115.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਕਿਹੁ. ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
115.e: Without the True Guru, the Lord cannot be seen.

115.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ; ਆਪੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
115.e: Granting His Grace, He Himself has allowed me to see Him.

115.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
115.e: All by Himself, He Himself is permeating and pervading; He is intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

115.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੁ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
115.e: One who becomes Gurmukh embraces love for the One.
Doubt and duality are burned away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

115.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
115.e: Within his body, he deals and trades, and obtains the Treasure of the True Name. ||6||
The life-style of the Gurmukh is sublime; he sings the Praises of the Lord.
The Gurmukh finds the gate of salvation.

115.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
115.e: Night and day, he is imbued with the Lord's Love. He sings the Lord's Glorious Praises, and he is called to the Mansion of His Presence. ||7||
The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord leads us to meet Him.
Through perfect destiny, the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

115.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੯॥੧੦॥
115.e: O Nanak, the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by chanting the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||8||9||10||
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
The horses are neighing and the trumpets are resounding.
The bedecked warriors are roaring profoundly.45.201.
The heroes coming near unhesitatingly are striking blows and jumping.
The smart warriors fight each other and the beautiful heroes are bedecking themselves. The heavenly damsels (apsaras) are feeling inspired.46.202.
The horses are being chopped and the faces are being torn.
The sound created by tridents are being heard. 47.203.
The trumpets are resounding and the youthful warriors are thundering.
The kings and chieftains are bedecked and the elephants are screeching.48.204.
Maajh, Third Mehl:

115.g: ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਏ ਤਾ; ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
115.e: Those who lose their own selves obtain everything.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enshrine Love for the True one.

115.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਘਰਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
115.e: They trade in Truth, they gather in Truth, and they deal only in Truth. ||1||

115.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
115.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

115.g: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
115.e: I am Yours, You are my Lord and Master. You bestow greatness through the Word of Your Shabad. ||1||Pause||
That time, that moment is totally beautiful,
when the True One becomes pleasing to my mind.

115.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
115.e: Serving the True One, true greatness is obtained. By Guru's Grace, the True One is obtained. ||2||
The food of spiritual love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.

115.g: ਅਨ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
115.e: Other essences are forgotten, when the Lord's Essence comes to dwell in the mind.

115.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
115.e: Truth, contentment and intuitive peace and poise are obtained from the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

115.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
115.e: The blind and ignorant fools do not serve the True Guru;

115.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਇ ਕਿਥਹੁ; ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
115.e: how will they find the gate of salvation?

115.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ. ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ; ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
115.e: They die and die, over and over again, only to be reborn, over and over again. They are struck down at Death's Door. ||4||

115.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
115.e: Those who know the essence of the Shabad, understand their own selves.
Immaculate is the speech of those who chant the Word of the Shabad.

115.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ; ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
115.e: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||

115.g: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
115.e: Beautiful is that place, which is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.
There, sitting in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

115.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
115.e: Night and day, the True One is praised; the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad resounds there. ||6||
DOHRA

115.g: ਹੈ ਗੈ ਰਥ ਪੈਦਲ ਕਟੇ; ਬਚਿਯੋ ਨ ਜੀਵਤ ਕੋਇ ॥
115.e: The elephants, horses and warriors on foot were all chopped and none could survive.

115.g: ਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਕਸਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ; ਸੁੰਭ ਕਰੈ, ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੮॥੧੯੪॥
115.e: Then the king Sumbh himself marched forward for war and on seeing him it appears that whatever he desires, he will achive.38.194.
CHAUPI
On this side, Durga after reflecting, called a female messenger of Shiva and making her conscious gave this message in her ear:
“Send Lord Shiva to the place, where the demon-king is standing.”39.195.

115.g: ਸਿਵ ਦੂਤੀ ਜਬ ਇਮ ਸੁਨ ਪਾਵਾ ॥

115.e: When the female messenger of Shiva heard this, she sent Shiva as a messenger of Shiva

115.g: ਸਿਵ ਦੂਤੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਭਯੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥

115.e: Since that day, the name of Durga became" shiv- Duti" ( the messenger of shiva ), all men and women know this.40.196.

115.g: ਸਿਵ ਕਹੀ, ਦੈਤ ਰਾਜ, ਸੁਨਿ ਬਾਤਾ ॥

115.e: Shiva said to the demon-king, “Listen to my words, the mother of she universe hath said this
“That either you return the kingdom to gods or wage the war with me.”41.197.

115.g: ਦੈਤ ਰਾਜ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥

115.e: The demon-king Sumbh did not accept this proposal and in his pride, marched forward for war.
The place where Kali, like death, was thundering, that demon-king reached there.42.198.
There the edges of sword glistened and the ghosts, goblins and evil spirits began to dance.
There the blind headless trunks came into motion senselessly. There many Bhairavas and Bhimas began to roam.43.199.
The clarionets, drums and trumpets sounded any many types.
The tambourines, tabors etc., were played loudly and the musical instruments like Shahnai etc., were being played in such numbers that they cannot be counted.44.200.

116.e: BELI BINDRAM STNZA
All the blows being struck by the weapons have been annulled by the goddess Durga.
Beside these all other blows, that are being struck, are being annulled and the weapons are thrown on the ground by the goddess.59.215.
Kali herself made use of her weapons and made all the weapons of the demons ineffective.

116.g: ਬਜੇ ਸੰਖ ਭੇਰੀ ਉਠੈ ਸੰਖ ਨਾਦੰ ॥
116.e: The sound of conches and drums is rising.
The clarionets are being played continuously.49.205.
The swords and daggers are producing their sounds.

116.g: ਉਠੀ ਕੂਹ ਜੂਹੰ ਭਈ ਰੇਲ ਪੇਲੰ ॥
116.e: There is vehement run in the whole battlefield.

116.g: ਰੁਲੇ ਤਛ ਮੁਛੰ ਗਿਰੇ ਚਉਰ ਚੀਰੰ ॥
116.e: The bodies having been chopped and the garments and fly-whisks having been torn have fallen down.

116.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਹਥ ਮਥੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਰਮ ਬੀਰੰ ॥੫੦॥੨੦੬॥
116.e: Somewhere the hands, somewhere the foreheads and somewhere the armours are lying scattered.50.206.
RASAAVAL STANZA
The mighty enemies are busy in fighting with all their weapons.
Holding their arms, they are shouting “kill, kill”.51.207.
Being completely dressed with their weapons the brave fighters are roaring.
There has been a volley of arrows producing hissing sounds.52.208.
Various types of musical instruments are being played and the Gandharvas are laughing.
The warriors after fixing their banners firmly are busy in fighting and their armours are being torn with arrows.53.209.
From all the four sides, the arrows are being showered.
The fierce and frightful warriors are busy in various types of prattle.54.210.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The four sources of creation are Yours; the spoken word is Yours.
Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.

116.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
116.e: Serving the Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, no one can receive it. ||1||

116.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
116.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

116.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ. ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਹਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
116.e: Through devotion to the Guru, the True One is found; He comes to abide in the mind, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

116.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
116.e: Serving the True Guru, all things are obtained.

116.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
116.e: As are the desires one harbors, so are the rewards one receives.

116.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ. ਸਭਨਾ ਵਥੂ ਕਾ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
116.e: The True Guru is the Giver of all things; through perfect destiny, He is met. ||2||

116.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ; ਇਕੁ. ਨ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
116.e: This mind is filthy and polluted; it does not meditate on the One.

116.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਬਹੁ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
116.e: Deep within, it is soiled and stained by the love of duality.

116.g: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ; ਹੋਰੁ ਵਧੇਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
116.e: The egotists may go on pilgrimages to holy rivers, sacred shrines and foreign lands, but they only gather more of the dirt of egotism. ||3||
Serving the True Guru, filth and pollution are removed.

116.g: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
116.e: Those who focus their consciousness on the Lord remain dead while yet alive.

116.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ. ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
116.e: The True Lord is Pure; no filth sticks to Him. Those who are attached to the True One have their filth washed away. ||4||
Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
The ignorant ones are blind-there is only utter darkness for them.

116.g: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ. ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
116.e: The maggots in manure do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot and putrefy. ||5||
Serving the Lord of Liberation, liberation is achieved.
The Word of the Shabad eradicates egotism and possessiveness.

116.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
116.e: So serve the Dear True Lord, night and day. By perfect good destiny, the Guru is found. ||6||
He Himself forgives and unites in His Union.

116.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
116.e: From the Perfect Guru, the Treasure of the Naam is obtained.

116.g: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
116.e: By the True Name, the mind is made true forever. Serving the True Lord, sorrow is driven out. ||7||
He is always close at hand-do not think that He is far away.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Lord deep within your own being.

116.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੧੨॥
116.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is received. Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||8||11||12||
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
Somewhere the brave fighters are being chopped and somewhere the arrows are being showered.
The horses without saddles are lying in dust in the battlefield.
The warriors of gods and demons both are fighting against one another.
It appears that the dreadful warriors are Bhisham Pitamahas.55.211.
The decorated horses and elephants are thundering
And the arrows of brave warriors are being shot.
The clatter of swords and the resounding of trumpets
Along the sounds of daggers and drums are being heard.56.212.

116.g: ਢਮਾ ਢਮ ਢੋਲੰ ਢਲਾ ਢੁਕ ਢਾਲੰ ॥
116.e: The sounds of drums and shields resound continuously
And the horses running hither and thither have cused consternation.

116.g: ਸਟਾ ਸਟ ਸੈਲੰ ਖਹਾ ਖੂਨਿ ਖਗੰ ॥
116.e: The daggers are being struck violently and the swords are besmeared with blood.

116.g: ਤੁਟੇ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮੰ ਉਠੇ ਨਾਲ ਅਗੰ ॥੫੭॥੨੧੩॥
116.e: Te armours on the bodies of the warriors are breaking and the limbs are coming out with them.57.213.

116.g: ਉਠੇ ਅਗਿ ਨਾਲੰ ਖਹੇ ਖੋਲ ਖਗੰ ॥
116.e: The blows of swords on the helmets create flames of fire.
And in the utter darkness that has spread, the ghosts and goblins considering it night, have awakened.
The vampires are belching and the tabors are being played.
And in accompaniment with their sound, the ghosts and evil spirits are dancing.58.214.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
Those who are True here, are True hereafter as well.
That mind is true, which is attuned to the True Shabad.

116.g: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
116.e: They serve the True One, and practice Truth; they earn Truth, and only Truth. ||1||

116.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ. ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
116.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the True Name.

116.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
116.e: They serve the True One, and are absorbed into the True One, singing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||1||Pause||
The Pandits, the religious scholars read, but they do not taste the essence.
In love with duality and Maya, their minds wander, unfocused.

116.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ. ਸਭ ਸੁਧਿ ਗਵਾਈ; ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
116.e: The love of Maya has displaced all their understanding; making mistakes, they live in regret. ||2||
But if they should meet the True Guru, then they obtain the essence of reality;
the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in their minds.
The wealth of the self-willed manmukhs is false, and false is their ostentatious display.
They practice falsehood, and suffer terrible pain.

116.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
116.e: Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; through birth and death, they lose their lives. ||7||
My True Lord and Master is very dear to me.
The Shabad of the Perfect Guru is my Support.

116.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
116.e: O Nanak, one who obtains the Greatness of the Naam, looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same. ||8||10||11||

117.e: When the gods saw (Sumbh) without weapons, they began to hail the goddess.60.216.
The musical instruments were played in the firmament and no0w the gods also began to raor.
The gods began to view repeatedly and raise shouts of victory.61.217.
Now in great rage in the battlefield, the dreadful Kali raised six hands of her arms powerfully
And struck them on the head of Sumbh and with one blow she destroyed the tyrant.62.218.
Eulogy of the Goddess:
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
O Yoga-fire, Enlightener of the Earth! I salute Thee.

117.g: ਨਮੋ ਸੁੰਭ ਹੰਤੀ ਨਮੋ ਕਰੂਰ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
117.e: O the Destroyer of Sumbh and dreadful manifestation of Death!
O the Destroyer of Dhumar Nain , O the Destroyer of Rakat Beej!
O Blazing like fire Kalika! I salute Thee.4.223.
O Ambika! O Jambhaha (the killer of the demon Jambh) O manifestation of Light! I salute Thee.
O the killer of Chand and Mund! O the Sovereign of Sovereigns! I salute Thee.
O the sawer of the demon Chamar! O the one looking like a portrait! I salute Thee.
O the bearer of knowledge, unique one! I Salute Thee.5.224.

117.g: ਨਮੋ ਪਰਮ ਰੂਪਾ ਨਮੋ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
117.e: O the supreme manifestation of the doer of dreadful actions! I salute thee.
O the bearer of the three modes of Rajas, Sattva and Tamas.

117.g: ਨਮੋ ਮਹਿਖ ਦਈਤ ਕੋ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
117.e: O the manifestation of supreme steel armour, O the destroyer of Mahishasura.
Destroyer of all, the killer of all! I salute Thee.6.225.
O the killer of Biralachh, the destroyer of Karurachh.
O the one showing mercy on Brahma in her delight, O Yog Maya! I salute Thee.

117.g: ਨਮੋ ਜੋਗ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੰ ਧਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੭॥੨੨੬॥
117.e: O Bhairavi, Bhavani, Jalandhari and the Destiny through all! I salute Thee.7.226.
Thou art seated everywhere, up and below.
Thou art Lakshmi, Kamakhya and Kumar Kanya.
Thou art Bhavani and manifestation of Bhairavi and Bhima,
Thou art seated at Hinglaj and Pinglaj, Thou art unique! I salute Thee.8.227.
Thou art the performer of dreadful acts, while infuriated in the battlefield.
Thou art most wise, master of powers and doer of pure deeds.
Thou art most beautiful like and apsara (heavenly damsel), Padmini and the goddess Parbati.
Thou art the source of power of Shiva, the power of Indra and the power of Brahma! I salute Thee.9.228.
Enchantress of the ghosts and goblins!
Thou art the greatest apsara, Parbati and the killer of tyrants.
Performer of gentle acts like children at the places like Hinglaj and Pinglaj.
Thou art the power of Kartikeya and Shiva etc.! I salute thee.10.229.
O the power of Yama, O the power of Bhrigu and the the wielder of weapons in Thy hands, I salute Thee.

117.g: ਨਮੋ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਰਤਾ ਨਮੋ ਤੇਜ ਮਾਣੰ ॥
117.e: Thou art the wearer of arms, most Glorious
Unconquerable for ever and conqueror of all, bearer of elegant shield
And performer of justice at all times, the Merciful Kalika! I salute thee. 11.230.
O the wielder of bow, sword, shield and mace,
The user of the disc, and of the honoured portrait, I salute Thee.
Thou art the mother of the universe and wielder of trident and dagger.

117.g: ਨਮੋ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧੨॥੨੩੧॥
117.e: Thou art the knower of all the knowledge of all sciences! I salute Thee.12.231.
Thou art the preserver and destroyer of all, science! Thou art the rider of the dead.
Thou art the destroyer of tyrants in the manifestation of Kali, I salute Thee.
O Yoga-fire! the power of Kartikeya
O Ambika! o Bhavani! I salute Thee.13.232.

117.g: ਨਮੋ ਦੋਖ ਦਾਹੀ ਨਮੋ ਦੁਖ︀ਯ ਹਰਤਾ ॥
117.e: O the effacer and destroyer of sorrows!
O the wager of war with weapons and arms!
NOW THE WORDS OF VICTORY ARE RELATED:
BELI BINDRAM STANZA
All the gods are hailing the victory of the goddess and showering the flowers.
They brought the saffron and with great delight they applied the mark on their foreheds.1.220.
DOHRA

117.g: ਜਿਮ ਸੁੰਭਾਸੁਰ ਕੋ ਹਨਾ; ਅਧਿਕ ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
117.e: The manner in which, with extreme fury, Kali destroyed the demon-king Sumbh

117.g: ਤ੍ਰਯੋ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੇ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭ; ਚਾਬਤ ਜਾਹ ਕਰਾਲ ॥੬੩॥੨੧੯॥
117.e: All the enemies of the saints are destroyed in the same manner.63.219.

117.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਸੁੰਭ ਬਧਹ ਖਸਟਮੋ ਧਿਆਯ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬॥
117.e: Here ends the Sixth Chapter entitled ‘The Killing of Sumbh’ of Chandi Charitra in BACHITTAR NATAK.6.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The True Guru has imparted the True Teachings.

117.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
117.e: Those who die in the Shabad and subdue their own minds, obtain the door of liberation. ||3||
They erase their sins, and eliminate their anger;

117.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
117.e: they keep the Guru's Shabad clasped tightly to their hearts.

117.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
117.e: Those who are attuned to Truth, remain balanced and detached forever. Subduing their egotism, they are united with the Lord. ||4||
Deep within the nucleus of the self is the jewel; we receive it only if the Lord inspires us to receive it.
The mind is bound by the three dispositions-the three modes of Maya.

117.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ; ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
117.e: Reading and reciting, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary, but they have not found the supreme essence of the fourth state. ||5||
The Lord Himself dyes us in the color of His Love.

117.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
117.e: Only those who are steeped in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are so imbued with His Love.

117.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
117.e: Imbued with the most beautiful color of the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with great pleasure and joy. ||6||

117.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ; ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
117.e: To the Gurmukh, the True Lord is wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and strict self-discipline.
Through the spiritual wisdom of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukh is liberated.

117.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
117.e: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||7||
The Gurmukh realizes that the Lord alone creates, and having created, He destroys.
To the Gurmukh, the Lord Himself is social class, status and all honor.

117.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੧੩॥
117.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; through the Naam, they merge in the Naam. ||8||12||13||
CHAUPAI
All of them extremely eulogized the goddess and repeated the mantra known as “Brahm-Kavach”.
All the saints were pleased because the tyrants have been destroyed.2.221.
The comfort of the saints increased in many ways and not even one demon could survive.
The mother of the universe ever helps the saints and is helpful to them everywhere.3.222.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
Creation and destruction happen through the Word of the Shabad.
Through the Shabad, creation happens again.

117.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
117.e: The Gurmukh knows that the True Lord is all-pervading. The Gurmukh understands creation and merger. ||1||

117.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
117.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Perfect Guru within their minds.

117.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਸਾਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ. ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
117.e: From the Guru comes peace and tranquility; worship Him with devotion, day and night. Chanting His Glorious Praises, merge into the Glorious Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh sees the Lord on the earth, and the Gurmukh sees Him in the water.
The Gurmukh sees Him in wind and fire; such is the wonder of His Play.

117.g: ਸੋ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ. ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ; ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
117.e: One who has no Guru, dies over and over again, only to be re-born. One who has no Guru continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
The One Creator has set this play in motion.

117.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
117.e: In the frame of the human body, He has placed all things.

117.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ. ਕੋਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਮਹਲੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
117.e: Those few who are pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. He calls them into His Wondrous Palace. ||3||
True is the Banker, and true are His traders.
They purchase Truth, with infinite love for the Guru.

117.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
117.e: They deal in Truth, and they practice Truth. They earn Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

117.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ; ਕੋ ਵਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
117.e: Without investment capital, how can anyone acquire merchandise?
The self-willed manmukhs have all gone astray.

117.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ. ਸਭ ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ; ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
117.e: Without true wealth, everyone goes empty-handed; going empty-handed, they suffer in pain. ||5||

117.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
117.e: Some deal in Truth, through love of the Guru's Shabad.
They save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well.

117.g: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
117.e: Very auspicious is the coming of those who meet their Beloved and find peace. ||6||
Deep within the self is the secret, but the fool looks for it outside.
The blind self-willed manmukhs wander around like demons;

117.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
117.e: but where the secret is, there, they do not find it. The manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||7||
He Himself calls us, and bestows the Word of the Shabad.
The soul-bride finds intuitive peace and poise in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

117.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੩॥੧੪॥
117.e: O Nanak, she obtains the glorious greatness of the Naam; she hears it again and again, and she meditates on it. ||8||13||14||

118.e: O most healthy! O Supreme fire!
O the supreme manifestation of young and old women! I salute Thee.14.233.
O the one with dreadful teeth, the rider of the lion, I salute Thee.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਖਗ ਦਗੰ ਝਮਾ ਝਮ ਬਾੜੰ ॥
118.e: Thou art the glistening sword, annulling the daggers.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਰੂੜਿ ਗੂੜੰ ਨਮੋ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪੀ ॥
118.e: Thou art most prodfound, omnipresent,
Eternal and destroyer of tyrants! I salute Thee.15.234.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਰਿਧਿ ਰੂਪੰ ਨਮੋ ਸਿਧ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
118.e: O the bestower of powers!
Preserver of all and destroyer of all
The one of the pure forms like silver and dreadful like the dark night

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਜੋਗ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੰ ਧਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤ੍ਰੀ ॥੧੬॥੨੩੫॥
118.e: Thou art the Yoga fire and the sickle for the tyrants! I salute Thee.16.235.
O the power of righteousness of the Supreme Lord!
Thou art ever new, the destroyer of tyrants
The deceiver of all, the yoga-fire of Shiva
The steel-armour for the saints and the dreadful Kali for the saints! I salute Thee.17.236.
Thou art the breath-moving process and the early morning worship.

118.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਚਉਦਹੂੰ ਲੋਗ ਬੰਧਿਆ ॥
118.e: Who has bound all the fourteen realms in the web of maya.
Thou art Anjani (mother of Hanuman), the crusher of the pride of all,
And the wielder and user of all the weapons! I salute Thee.18.237.
O Anjani! the masher of the pride of tyrants,
The sustainer and bestowed of pleasure to all the saints, I salute thee.
O the manifestation of trident, wielder of sword in Thy hand
The deliverer of all, the cause of causes and the manifestation of the sword! I salute Thee.19.238.
O Kali, with the begging bowl, and the besttower of bliss! I salute Thee.
O one of the most beautiful forms like the sun-rays and moon-beams.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਛੈਲ ਰੂਪਾ ਨਮੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਦਰਣੀ ॥
118.e: The beauteous and the destroyer of the tyrants
The sustainer of the world and the cause of all causes! I salute Thee.20.239.
O the one who showers her weapons in her pleasure,
Thou art the deliverer of all, I salute Thee.
O goddess Durga, Thou art most wise, a Yogini
A goddess and a demoness, I salute Thee.21.240

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਘੋਰਿ ਰੂਪਾ ਨਮੋ ਚਾਰੁ ਨੈਣਾ ॥
118.e: O the one of the dreadful forms and winsome eyes!
Thou art the wielder of trident and dagger and speaker of harsh words, I salute Thee.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਬੁਧੰ ਕਰੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਆਲਾ ॥
118.e: O the blazer of Yoga-fire, the manifestation of supreme wisdom,

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਚੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਮ੍ਰਿੜਾ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੨੨॥੨੪੧॥
118.e: The destroyer of Chand and Munda and performer of the heinous action of crushing their dead bodies! I salute Thee.22.241.
Thou art the bestower of bliss by destroying the great sinners.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਦਾੜ ਗਾੜਾ ਧਰੀ ਦੁਖ︀ਯ ਹਰਣੀ ॥
118.e: Thou art the remover of the anguish of saints by destroying the tyrants with Thy dreadful teeth.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਤਾ ਨਮੋ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਗਾਮੀ ॥
118.e: Thou art the knower of Shastras, knower of the use of weapons

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਜਛ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਧਰੀ ਪੂਰਣ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੨੩॥੨੪੨॥
118.e: Perfect in knowledge of Yakshas, and the fulfiller of the desires! I salute Thee.23.242.
O the giver of suffering to the enemies, all the people worship Thee.
Thou art the creator of all interests and also their destroyer.
Thou art the power of Hanuman
Thou art Kalika and manifestation of the sword and wielder of the power in Thy own hands! I salute thee.24.243.
O the masterly power of Hanuman! Thou art the goddess of Nagarkot (Kangra)
Thou art the manifestation of Kama (love). Thou art Kamakhya, the goddess.
And the bestower of bliss on al like kalratri (Kali)
O the bestower of the great miraculous powers and wealth and wielder of the sword! I salute Thee.25.244.

118.g: ਨਮੋ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਾਹੀ ਨਮੋ ਅਸਟ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
118.e: O Goddess! thou art four-armed, eight-armed,
And sustainer of the whole world.
Think of the Lord, who shall be your Help and Support in the end.

118.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
118.e: The Lord is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. He has no master, and He is not born. He is obtained through love of the True Guru. ||1||

118.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
118.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who eliminate selfishness and conceit.

118.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ. ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
118.e: They eradicate selfishness and conceit, and then find the Lord; they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||
According to their pre-ordained destiny, they act out their karma.
Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.

118.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
118.e: Without good fortune, the Guru is not found. Through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||
The Gurmukhs remain unaffected in the midst of the world.
The Guru is their cushion, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is their Support.

118.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ; ਆਪੇ ਖਪਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
118.e: Who can oppress the Gurmukh? One who tries shall perish, writhing in pain. ||3||
The blind self-willed manmukhs have no understanding at all.
They are the assassins of the self, and the butchers of the world.

118.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ. ਭਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
118.e: By continually slandering others, they carry a terrible load, and they carry the loads of others for nothing. ||4||

118.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਾੜੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
118.e: This world is a garden, and my Lord God is the Gardener.
He always takes care of it-nothing is exempt from His Care.

118.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ; ਵਾਸੂ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
118.e: As is the fragrance which He bestows, so is the fragrant flower known. ||5||
The self-willed manmukhs are sick and diseased in the world.
They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.

118.g: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਤਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
118.e: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, they find no peace. ||6||
The One who created them, knows their condition.
And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.

118.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ. ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ; ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
118.e: Whatever He places within them, that is what prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||

118.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਚੇ; ਮੈ. ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
118.e: I know of no other except the True One.

118.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ; ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
118.e: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.

118.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
118.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the heart of those, unto whom He has given it. ||8||14||15||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,
all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
118.e: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

118.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
118.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani of the Word within their minds.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
118.e: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||Pause||
Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar,
See and behold this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
118.e: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they cause others to hear it. ||2||
Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention on Him.
By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
118.e: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds and bodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||

118.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਜੁ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
118.e: That which God does is beyond anyone's consciousness;

118.g: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
118.e: no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

118.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
118.e: By His Command, the Ambrosial Bani of the Word prevails, and by His Command, we drink in the Amrit. ||4||
The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.
This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
118.e: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear the vibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5||

119.e: O Ambika! Thou art the killer of the demon Jambh, the power of Kartikeya
And the crusher of the dead, O Bhavani! I salute Thee.26.245.
O the destroyer of the enemies of the gods,
White-black and red-coloured.
O fire! the enchancer of bliss by conquering illusion.
Thou art the maya of Unmanifested Brahman and the Shakti of Shiva! I salute Thee.27.246.
Thou art the bestower of cheerfulness to all, the conqueror of all and the manifestation of Kal (death).
O Kapali! (the goddess carrying begging bowl), Shiva-Shakti! (the power of Shiva) and Bhadrakali!
Thou obtainest satisfaction by piercing Durga.
Thou art pure fire-manifestation and also cold-incarnate, I salute Thee.28.247.
O the masticator of the demons, the manifestation of the banners of all religions
The source of the power of Hinglaj and Pinglaj, I salute Thee.

119.g: ਨਮੋ ਦੀਰਘ ਦਾੜਾ ਨਮੋ ਸਿਆਮ ਬਰਣੀ ॥
119.e: O the one of the dreadful teeth, the black complexioned,
