Anjani, the masher of demons! Salute Thee. 29.248.
O the adopter of half-moon and wearer of the moon as an ornament

119.g: ਨਮੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਊਰਧਾ ਨਮੋ ਦਾੜ ਗੂੜੰ ॥
119.e: Thou hast the power of clouds and hast dreadful jaws.
Thy forehead is like the moon, O Bhavani!
Thou art also Bhairavi and Bhutani, Thou art the wielder of the sword, I salute Thee.30.249.
O Kamakhya and Durga! Thou art the cause and deed of Kaliyuga (the iron age).
Like Apsara (heavenly damsels) and the Padmini women, Thou art the fulfiller of all desires.
Thou art the conqueror Yogini of all and performer of Yajnas (sacrifices).
Thou art the nature of all substances, Thou art the creator of the world and the destroyer of the enemies.31.250.
Thou art pure, holy, ancient, great
Perfect, maya and unconquerable.
Thou art formless, unique, nameless and abodeless.
Thou art fearless, unconquerable and treasure of the great Dharma.32.251.
Thou art indestructible, indistinguishable, deedless and Dhrma-incarnate.

119.g: ਨਮੋ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਧਰੇ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮੰ ॥
119.e: O the holder of the arrow in Thy hand and wearer of the armour, I salute Thee.
Thou art unconquerable, indistinguishable, formless, eternal
Shapeless and the cause of nirvana (salvation) and all the works.33.252.
Thou art Parbati, fulfiller of the wishes, the power of Krishna
Most powerful, the power of Vamana and art like the fire of the Yajna (sacrifice).
O the chewer of the enemies and masher of their pride
Sustainer and destroyer in Thy pleasure, I salute Thee.34.253.
O the rider of the steed-like lion
O Bhavani of beautiful limbs! Thou art the destroyer of all engaged in the war.

119.g: ਨਮੋ ਭੀਮਿ ਸਰੂਪਾ ਨਮੋ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
119.e: O the mother of the universe having large body!
Thou art the power of Yama, the giver of the fruit of actions performed in the world, Thou art also the power of Brahma! I salute Thee.35.254.
O the most pure power of God!
Thou art the maya and Gayatri, sustaining all.
Thou art Chamunda, the wearer of the necklace of head, Thou art also the fire of the matted locks of Shiva
Thou art the donor of boons and destroyer of tyrants, but Thou Thyself ever remain indivisible.36.255.

119.g: ਸਬੈ ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰੀ ਬਰੰ ਬ੍ਰਯੂਹ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
119.e: O the Saviour of all the saints and the donor of boons to all
The one who ferries across all over the terrible sea of life, the primary cause of all causes, O Bhavani! The mother of the universe.
I salute Thee again and again, O the manifestation of the sword!

119.g: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਖ ਲੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨੀ ॥੩੭॥੨੫੬॥
119.e: Protect me ever with Thy Grace.37.256.

119.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਨਾਮ ਸਪਤਮੋ ਧਿਆਯ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭॥
119.e: Here ends the Seventh Chapter entitled ‘The Eulogy of the Goddess’ of Chandi of Chandi Charitra in BACHITTAR NATAK.7.
PAURI

119.g: ਖੰਡਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੈ ਸਾਜ ਕੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਭ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: At first the Lord created the double-edged sword and then He created the whole world.

119.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva and then created the play of Nature.

119.g: ਸਿੰਧ ਪਰਬਤ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਥੰਮ੍ਹਾ ਗਗਨਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: He created the oceans, mountains and the earth made the sky stable without columns.

119.g: ਸਿਰਜੇ ਦਾਨੋ ਦੇਵਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: He created the demons and gods and caused strife between them.

119.g: ਤੈ ਹੀ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਦੈਤਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: O Lord! By creating Durga, Thou hast caused the destruction of demons.

119.g: ਤੈਥੋਂ ਹੀ ਬਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਲੈ ਨਾਲ ਬਾਣਾ ਦਹਸਿਰੁ ਘਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: Rama received power from Thee and he killed the ten-headed Ravana with arrows.

119.g: ਤੈਥੋਂ ਹੀ ਬਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਲੈ ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੀ ਪਕੜਿ ਗਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: Krishna received power from Thee and he threw down Kansa by catching his hair.

119.g: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਕਈ ਜੁਗ ਤਿਨੀ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਇਆ ॥
119.e: The great sages and gods, even practising great austerities for several ages
None could know Thy end.2.

119.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਬੀਤਿਆ ਅਧ ਸੀਲੀ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
119.e: The saintly Satyuga (the age of Truth) passed away and the Treta age of semi-righteousness came.
DOHRA

119.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੋ; ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਧਿਐਹੈ ਸੰਤ ॥
119.e: All those saints, who will ever meditate on Thee

119.g: ਅੰਤ ਲਹੈਗੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਫਲੁ; ਪਾਵਹਿਗੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੬॥੨੬੨॥
119.e: They will attain salvation at the end and will realize the Lord.6.262.

119.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਨਾਮ ਅਸਟਮੋ ਧਿਆਯ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੮॥
119.e: Here ends the Eighth Chapter entitled ‘Description of the Praise of Chandi Charitra’ in BACHITTAR NATAK.8.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The Ambrosial Nectar rains down, softly and gently.
How rare are those Gurmukhs who find it.

119.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
119.e: Those who drink it in are satisfied forever. Showering His Mercy upon them, the Lord quenches their thirst. ||1||

119.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
119.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those Gurmukhs who drink in this Ambrosial Nectar.

119.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ. ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
119.e: The tongue tastes the essence, and remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love, intuitively singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's Grace, intuitive understanding is obtained;

119.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ; ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
119.e: subduing the sense of duality, they are in love with the One.

119.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ. ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
119.e: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, then they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; by His Grace, they merge in Truth. ||2||
Above all is Your Glance of Grace, O God.
Upon some it is bestowed less, and upon others it is bestowed more.

119.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
119.e: Without You, nothing happens at all; the Gurmukhs understand this. ||3||
The Gurmukhs contemplate the essence of reality;
Your Treasures are overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

119.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
119.e: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||
Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices their inner minds.

119.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਤਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
119.e: Their minds and bodies are attuned to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word; this Ambrosial Nectar is intuitively heard. ||5||
The deluded, self-willed manmukhs are ruined through the love of duality.

119.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ; ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
119.e: They do not chant the Naam, and they die, eating poison.

119.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
119.e: Night and day, they continually sit in manure. Without selfless service, their lives are wasted away. ||6||

119.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਏ ॥
119.e: They alone drink in this Amrit, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.
By Guru's Grace, they intuitively enshrine love for the Lord.

119.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਸਭ ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
119.e: The Perfect Lord is Himself perfectly pervading everywhere; through the Guru's Teachings, He is perceived. ||7||
He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.
He who has created, shall Himself destroy.

119.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
119.e: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One with intuitive ease. ||8||16||17||
The Lord is One and the Victory is of the True Guru.
May SRI BHAGAUTI JI (The Sword) be Helpful.
The Heroic Poem of Sri Bhagauti Ji
(By) TheTenth King (Guru).

119.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਭਗੌਤੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਈਂ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
119.e: In the beginning I remember Bhagauti, the Lord (Whose symbol is the sword and then I remember Guru Nanak.

119.g: ਫਿਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੈ ਹੋਈਂ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
119.e: Then I remember Guru Arjan, Guru Amar Das and Guru Ram Das, may they be helpful to me.

119.g: ਅਰਜਨ ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨੋ ਸਿਮਰੌ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਹਰਿਰਾਇ ॥
119.e: Then I remember Guru Arjan, Guru Hargobind and Guru Har Rai.

119.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਹਰਿਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
119.e: (After them) I remember Guru Har Kishan, by whose sight all the sufferings vanish.

119.g: ਤੇਗ ਬਹਾਦਰ ਸਿਮਰਿਐ ਘਰ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਵੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
119.e: Then I do remember Guru Tegh Bahadur, though whose Grace the nine treasures come running to my house.
May they be helpful to me everywhere.1.
Description of the Praise of Chandi Charitra:
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
The Yoginis have filled their beautiful vessels (with blood),
And are moving at various places here and there belching thereby.

119.g: ਭਰੇ ਨੇਹ ਗੇਹੰ ਗਏ ਕੰਕ ਬੰਕੰ ॥
119.e: The comely crows and vultures having liking for that place have also departed for their homes,
And the warriors have been left to decay in the battlefield undoubtedly.1.257.
Narada is moving with vina in his hand,
And Shiva, the rider of the Bull, playing his tabor, is looking elegant.

119.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਬਾਜਿ ਗਾਜੀ ਗਜੀ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
119.e: In the battlefield, the thundering heroes have fallen alongwith the elephants and horses

119.g: ਰੁਲੇ ਤਛ ਮੁਛੰ ਨਚੇ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ॥੨॥੨੫੮॥
119.e: And seeing the chopped heroes rolling in dust, the ghosts and goblins are dancing.2.258.
The blind trunks and brave Batital are dancing and the fighting warriors alongwith the dancers,
With the small bells tied around waists have also been killed.
All the resolute assemblies of saints have become fearless.

119.g: ਨਮੋ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਤਾ ਭਲੇ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਜੀਤੇ ॥੩॥੨੫੯॥
119.e: O the mother of the people! Thou hast performed a nice task by conquering the enemies, I salute Thee.3.259.

119.g: ਪੜੇ ਮੂੜ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਧਨੰ ਧਾਮ ਬਾਢੇ ॥
119.e: If any foolish person recites this (poem), his wealth and property will increase here.

119.g: ਸੁਨੈ ਸੂਮ ਸੋਫੀ ਲਰੈ ਜੁਧ ਗਾਢੈ ॥
119.e: If anyone, not participating in the war, listens to it, he will be bestowed with the power of fighting. (in battle).

119.g: ਜਗੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਪੈ ਜਾਪ ਯਾ ਕੋ ॥
119.e: And that Yogi, who repeats it, keeping awake throughout the night,

119.g: ਧਰੈ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਗੰ ਲਹੈ ਸਿਧਤਾ ਕੋ ॥੪॥੨੬੦॥
119.e: He will attain supreme Yoga and miraculous powers.4.260.
Any student, who reads it for the attainment of knowledge,

119.g: ਲਹੈ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਮਦ ਚੇਤੰ ॥
119.e: He will become knowledgeable of all the Shastras.
Anyone either a Yogi or a Sanyasi or a Vairagi, whosoever reads it.

119.g: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਪੁੰਨ੍ਰਯਾਨ ਕੋ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੨੬੧॥
119.e: He will be blessed with all the virtues.5.261.
You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.
You Yourself appraise all people.

119.g: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਹਿ; ਖੋਟੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
119.e: You appraise the true, and place them in Your Treasury; You consign the false to wander in delusion. ||6||
How can I behold You? How can I praise You?
By Guru's Grace, I praise You through the Word of the Shabad.

119.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਸੈ; ਤੂੰ ਭਾਣੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
119.e: In Your Sweet Will, the Amrit is found; by Your Will, You inspire us to drink in this Amrit. ||7||
The Shabad is Amrit; the Lord's Bani is Amrit.
Serving the True Guru, it permeates the heart.

119.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ. ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥੧੬॥
119.e: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Naam is forever the Giver of peace; drinking in this Amrit, all hunger is satisfied. ||8||15||16||
Maajh, Third Mehl:

119.g: ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
119.e: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.
They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.

119.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
119.e: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||

119.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
119.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.

119.g: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
119.e: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||
The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.
By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

119.g: ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
119.e: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||

120.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
120.e: PAURI

120.g: ਇਕ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਨਾਵਣ ਆਈ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ ॥
120.e: One day Durga came for a bath.

120.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ, ਅਪਣੇ ਹਾਲ ਦੀ ॥
120.e: Indra related to her the story agony:

120.g: ਛੀਨ ਲਈ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ, ਸਾਤੇ ਦਾਨਵੀ ॥
120.e: “The demons have seized from us our kingdom."

120.g: ਲੋਕੀ ਤਿਹੀ ਫਿਰਾਈ, ਦੋਹੀ ਆਪਣੀ ॥
120.e: “They have proclaimed their authority over all the three worlds."

120.g: ਬੈਠੇ ਵਾਇ ਵਧਾਈ, ਤੇ ਅਮਰਾਵਤੀ ॥
120.e: “They have played musical instruments in their rejoicings in Amaravati, the city of gods."

120.g: ਦਿਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਭਜਾਈ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਕਸਾਂ ॥
120.e: “All the demons have caused the flight of the gods."

120.g: ਕਿਨੇ ਨ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਾਈ ਮਹਖੇ ਦੈਤ ਨੂੰ ॥
120.e: “None hath gone and conquered Mahikha, the demon."

120.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਮ ਤਕਾਈ, ਦੇਵੀ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ ॥੪॥
120.e: “O goddess Durga, I have come under Thy refuge.”4.

120.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
120.e: PAURI

120.g: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਕੰਧਾਰਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੁੜੇ; ਢੋਲ ਸੰਖ ਨਗਾਰੇ ਬਜੇ ॥
120.e: Both the armies faced each other and the drums, conches and trumpets sounded.

120.g: ਨਚੀ ਕਲ ਸਰੋਸਰੀ; ਕਲ ਨਾਰਦ ਡਉਰੂ ਵਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: The discord danced over all the heads and Kal and Narad sounded their tabor.

120.g: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਉਤਾਰਨ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ ਸੁੰਭ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: Mahishasura and Sumbh were created for removing the pride of the gods.

120.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਤਿਨ ਦੇਵਤੇ; ਤਿਹ ਲੋਕੀ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: They conquered the gods and ruled over the three worlds.

120.g: ਵਡਾ ਬੀਰੁ ਅਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: He was called a great hero and had a canopy moving over his head.

120.g: ਦਿਤਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਤਿਨ ਗਿਰ ਕੈਲਾਸੁ ਤਕਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: Indra was turned out of his kingdom and he looked towards the Kailash mountain.

120.g: ਡਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੋ ਦਾਨਵੀ ਦਿਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: Frightened by the demons, the element of fear grew enormously in his heart

120.g: ਪਾਸ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਦੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
120.e: He came, therefore to Durga.3.

120.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
120.e: DOHRA

120.g: ਰਾਕਸਿ ਆਏ ਰੋਹਲੇ; ਖੇਤ ਭਿੜਨ ਕੇ ਚਾਇ ॥
120.e: The infuriated demons came with the desire of fighting in the battlefield.

120.g: ਲਸਕਨ ਤੇਗਾਂ ਬਰਛੀਆਂ; ਸੂਰਜੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
120.e: The swords and daggers glisten with such brilliance that the sun cannot be seen.6.

120.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
120.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

120.g: ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ; ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
120.e: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.

120.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ; ਫੇਰ ਪਵਹਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
120.e: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.

120.g: ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
120.e: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||

120.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
120.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.

120.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ. ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
120.e: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||

120.g: ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ; ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
120.e: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.

120.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ; ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
120.e: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.

120.g: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
120.e: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into the Light. ||2||

120.g: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ; ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
120.e: The world is burning in the fire of desire,

120.g: ਲੋਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
120.e: in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.

120.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ, ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਪਣੀ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
120.e: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
120.e: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.

120.g: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
120.e: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.

120.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
120.e: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One. ||4||

120.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ; ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
120.e: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
120.e: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
120.e: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
120.e: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
120.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ; ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
120.e: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
120.e: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.

120.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ; ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
120.e: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

120.g: ਸਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ. ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
120.e: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through the Guru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
120.e: Praise the True One, and no other.

120.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
120.e: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

120.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
120.e: PAURI

120.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਬੈਣ ਸੁਣੰਦੀ, ਹਸੀ ਹੜਹੜਾਇ ॥
120.e: Listening to these words (of Indra), Durga laughed heartily.

120.g: ਓਹੀ ਸੀਹੁ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਕਸ ਭਖਣਾ ॥
120.e: She sent for that lion, who was she devourer of demons.

120.g: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ, ਦੇਵਾ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ ॥
120.e: She said to gods, “Do not worry mother any more.”

120.g: ਰੋਹ ਹੋਈ ਮਹਾ ਮਾਈ, ਰਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਰਣੇ ॥੫॥
120.e: For killing the demons, the great mother exhibited great fury.5.

120.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ; ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
120.e: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;

120.g: ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ; ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
120.e: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

120.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
120.e: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਰਿਦੈ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.

120.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
120.e: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.

120.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
120.e: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||

120.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
120.e: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.

120.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ; ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
120.e: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.

120.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
120.e: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||

120.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ; ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
120.e: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.

120.g: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
120.e: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.

120.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਹੋਰੁ; ਕੋਇ. .ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
120.e: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||

120.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
120.e: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.

120.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਲੇ; ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
120.e: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.

120.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ. ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
120.e: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
120.e: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.

120.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ; ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
120.e: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.

120.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
120.e: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||

121.e: PAURI
The drums are being beaten and the armies are engaged in close fight with each other.
The gods and demons have drawn their swords.
And strike them again and again killing warriors.

121.g: ਵਗੈ ਰਤੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੀ, ਜਿਉ ਗੇਰੂ ਬਾਬਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
121.e: The blood flows like waterfall in the same manner as the red ochre colour is washed off from clothes.
The ladies of demons see the fight, while sitting in their lofts.
The carriage of the goddess Durga hath raised a tumult amongst the demons.11.

121.g: ਰਾਕਸਿ ਆਏ ਰੋਹਲੇ; ਤਰਵਾਰੀ ਬਖਤਰ ਸਜੇ ॥
121.e: The demons came in great rage, decorated with swords and armour.

121.g: ਜੁਟੇ ਸਉਹੇ ਜੁਧ ਨੂੰ; ਇਕ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਨ ਭਜੇ ॥
121.e: The warriors were facing the war-front and none of them knows to retrace his steps.
The brave fighters were roaring in the battlefield.7.
PAURI
The dual chained trumpets sounded in the battlefield.
The demon chieftains having matted locks are enveloped in dust.

121.g: ਉਖਲੀਆਂ ਨਾਸਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਜਾਪਨ ਆਲੇ ॥
121.e: Their nostrils are like mortars and the mouths seem like niches.
The brave fighters bearing long moustaches ran in front of the goddess.

121.g: ਸੁਰਪਤ ਜੇਹੇ ਲੜ ਹਟੇ; ਬੀਰ ਟਲੇ ਨ ਟਾਲੇ ॥
121.e: The warriors like the king of gods (Indra) had become tired of fighting, but the brave fighters could not be averted from their stand.

121.g: ਗਜੇ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਘੇਰਿ ਕੈ; ਜਣੁ ਘਣੀਅਰ ਕਾਲੇ ॥੧੩॥
121.e: They roared. On besieging Durga, like dark clouds.13.
PAURI

121.g: ਦੇਖਨ ਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਨੂੰ; ਰਣ ਘੁਰੇ ਨਗਾਰੇ ॥
121.e: Seeing the intense glory of Chandi, the trumpets souded in the battlefield.
The highly furious demons ran on all four sides.

121.g: ਹਥੀਂ ਤੇਗਾਂ ਪਕੜਿ ਕੈ; ਰਣ ਭਿੜੇ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
121.e: Holding their swords in their hands they fought very bravely in the battlefield.

121.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਠੇ ਜੁਧ ਤੇ; ਜੋਧੇ ਜੁਝਾਰੇ ॥
121.e: These militant fighters never ran away from war-arena.

121.g: ਦਿਲ ਵਿਚ ਰੋਹ ਬਢਾਇ ਕੈ; ਮਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
121.e: Highly infuriated they shouted “kill, kill” in their ranks.

121.g: ਮਾਰੇ ਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਨੈ; ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
121.e: The intensely glorious Chandi killed the warriors and threw them in the field.
It appeared that the lightning had eradicated the minarets and thrown them headlong.9.
PAURI

121.g: ਜੰਗ ਮੁਸਾਫਾ ਬਜਿਆ; ਰਣ ਘੁਰੇ ਨਗਾਰੇ ਚਾਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: The war-trumpet sounded and the enthusiastic drums thundered in the battlefield.

121.g: ਝੂਲਣ ਨੇਜੇ ਬੈਰਕਾ; ਨੀਸਾਣ ਲਸਨਿ ਲਿਸਾਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: The lances swung and the lustrous tassels of the banners glistened.

121.g: ਢੋਲ ਨਗਾਰੇ ਪਉਣ ਦੇ; ਊਂਘਨ ਜਾਣ ਜਟਾਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: The drums and trumpets echoed and the worriors were dozing like the drunkard with matted hair.

121.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਦਾਨੋ ਡਹੇ ਰਣ; ਨਾਦ ਵਜਨ ਖੇਤੁ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: Durga and demons waged war in the battlefield where dreadful music is being played.

121.g: ਬੀਰ ਪਰੋਤੇ ਬਰਛੀਏਂ; ਜਣ ਡਾਲ ਚਮੁਟੇ ਆਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: The brave fighters were pierced by daggers like the phylianthus emblica sticking with the bough.

121.g: ਇਕ ਵਢੇ ਤੇਗੀ ਤੜਫੀਅਨ; ਮਦ ਪੀਤੇ ਲੋਟਨਿ ਬਾਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: Some writhe being chopped by the sword like the rolling mad drunkards.

121.g: ਇਕ ਚੁਣ ਚੁਣ ਝਾੜਉ ਕਢੀਅਨ ਰੇਤ ਵਿਚੋਂ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਡਾਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: Some are picked up from the bushes like the process of panning out gold from the sand.

121.g: ਗਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲਾਂ ਬਰਛੀਆਂ; ਤੀਰ ਵਗਨ ਖਰੇ ਉਤਾਵਲੇ ॥
121.e: The maces, tridents, daggers and arrows are being struck with real hurry.

121.g: ਜਣ ਡਸੇ ਭੁਜੰਗਮ ਸਾਵਲੇ; ਮਰ ਜਾਵਨ ਬੀਰ ਰੁਹਾਵਲੇ ॥੮॥
121.e: It appears that black snakes are stinging and the furious heroes are dying.8.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The Lord of the Universe is radiant, and radiant are His soul-swans.
Their minds and their speech are immaculate; they are my hope and ideal.

121.g: ਮਨਿ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
121.e: Their minds are radiant, and their faces are always beautiful; they meditate on the most radiant Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

121.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
121.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

121.g: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
121.e: So chant Gobind, Gobind, the Lord of the Universe, day and night; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind, through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||
Sing of the Lord Gobind with intuitive ease,

121.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
121.e: in the Fear of the Guru; you shall become radiant, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

121.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ. ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
121.e: Remain in bliss forever, and perform devotional worship, day and night. Hear and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind. ||2||
Channel your dancing mind in devotional worship,

121.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਮਨੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
121.e: and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, merge your mind with the Supreme Mind.

121.g: ਸਚਾ ਤਾਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ; ਸਬਦੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
121.e: Let your true and perfect tune be the subjugation of your love of Maya, and let yourself dance to the Shabad. ||3||
People shout out loud and move their bodies,
but if they are emotionally attached to Maya, then the Messenger of Death shall hunt them down.
PAURI
With the flaring up of fight between the armies, innumerable trumpets sounded.
The gods and demons both have raised great tumult like male buffalos.
The infuriated demons strike strong blows causing wounds.

121.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
121.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19||
PAURI
A hundred thousand trumpets resound facing one another.

121.g: ਰਾਕਸ ਰਣੋ ਨ ਭਜਨ, ਰੋਹੇ ਰੋਹਲੇ ॥
121.e: The highly infuriated demons do not flee from the battlefield.
All the warriors roar like lions.

121.g: ਤਣਿ ਤਣਿ ਕੈਬਰ ਛਡਨ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸਾਮਣੇ ॥੧੨॥
121.e: They stretch their bows and shoot the arrows in front it Durga.12.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The Word of the Shabad is Immaculate and Pure; the Bani of the Word is Pure.
The Light which is pervading among all is Immaculate.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ. ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
121.e: So praise the Immaculate Word of the Lord's Bani; chanting the Immaculate Name of the Lord, all filth is washed away. ||1||

121.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
121.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace within their minds.

121.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ; ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਣਿ. ਤਿਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
121.e: Praise the Immaculate Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Listen to the Shabad, and quench your thirst. ||1||Pause||
When the Immaculate Naam comes to dwell in the mind,

121.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
121.e: the mind and body become Immaculate, and emotional attachment to Maya departs.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ. ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
121.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate True Lord forever, and the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad shall vibrate within. ||2||
The Immaculate Ambrosial Nectar is obtained from the Guru.

121.g: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਆ; ਤਿਥੈ. ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
121.e: When selfishness and conceit are eradicated from within, then there is no attachment to Maya.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ. ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
121.e: Immaculate is the spiritual wisdom, and utterly immaculate is the meditation, of those whose minds are filled with the Immaculate Bani of the Word. ||3||

121.g: ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
121.e: One who serves the Immaculate Lord becomes immaculate.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the filth of egotism is washed away.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਵਾਜੈ. ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ. ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
121.e: The Immaculate Bani and the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current vibrate, and in the True Court, honor is obtained. ||4||
Through the Immaculate Lord, all become immaculate.
Immaculate is the mind which weaves the Word of the Lord's Shabad into itself.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
121.e: Blessed and very fortunate are those who are committed to the Immaculate Name; through the Immaculate Name, they are blessed and beautified. ||5||
Immaculate is the one who is adorned with the Shabad.
The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices the mind and body.

121.g: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
121.e: No filth ever attaches itself to the True Name; one's face is made radiant by the True One. ||6||
The mind is polluted by the love of duality.
Filthy is that kitchen, and filthy is that dwelling;

121.g: ਮੈਲਾ ਖਾਇ. ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
121.e: eating filth, the self-willed manmukhs become even more filthy. Because of their filth, they suffer in pain. ||7||
The filthy, and the immaculate as well, are all subject to the Hukam of God's Command.

121.g: ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ॥
121.e: They alone are immaculate, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

121.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
121.e: O Nanak, the Naam abides deep within the minds of the Gurmukhs, who are cleansed of all their filth. ||8||19||20||
PAURI
The drum was beaten and the armies attacked each other.
The goddess caused the dancing of the lioness of steel (sword)

121.g: ਪੇਟ ਮਲੰਦੇ ਲਾਈ, ਮਹਖੇ ਦੈਤ ਨੂੰ ॥
121.e: And gave a blow to the demon Mahisha who was rubbing his belly.
(The sword) pierced the kindneys, intestines and the ribs.

121.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਦਿਲ ਵਿਚ ਆਈ, ਕਹੀ ਸੁਣਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
121.e: Whatever hath come in my mind, I have related that.
It appears that Dhumketu (the shooting star) had displayed its top-knot.10.
PAURI
The drum, wrapped in donkey’s hide, was beaten and the armies attacked each other.

121.g: ਘੇਰ ਲਈ ਵਰਿਆਮੀ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
121.e: The brave demon-warriors besieged Durga.

121.g: ਰਾਕਸ ਵਡੇ ਅਲਾਮੀ, ਭਜ ਨ ਜਾਣਦੇ ॥
121.e: They are greatly knowledgeable in warfare and do not know running back.
They ultimately went to heaven on being killed by the goddess.14.

122.g: ਇਤੀ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਦੈਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
122.e: In this way the demon Mahishasura was killed on the arrival of Durga.

122.g: ਚਉਦਹ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਰਾਣੀ ਸਿੰਘ ਨਚਾਇਆ ॥
122.e: The queen caused the lion to dance in the fourteen worlds.

122.g: ਮਾਰੇ ਬੀਰ ਜਟਾਣੀ; ਦਲ ਵਿਚ ਅਗਲੇ ॥
122.e: She killed a great number of brave demons with matted locks in the battlefield.

122.g: ਮੰਗਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਣੀ; ਦਲੀ ਹੰਘਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
122.e: Challenging the armies, these warriors do not even ask for water.

122.g: ਜਣ ਕਰੀ ਸਮਾਇ ਪਠਾਣੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਗ ਨੂੰ ॥
122.e: It seems that listening to the music, the Pathans have realized the state of ecstasy.

122.g: ਰਤੂ ਦੇ ਹੜਵਾਣੀ; ਚਲੇ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤ ॥
122.e: The flood of the blood of the fighters is flowing.

122.g: ਪੀਤਾ ਫੁਲੁ ਇਆਣੀ; ਘੁਮਨ ਸੂਰਮੇ ॥੨੦॥
122.e: The brave warriors are roaming as if they have ignorantly consumed the intoxicating poppy.20.

122.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
122.e: PAURI

122.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਅਲਾਇਆ; ਵਡ ਜੋਧੀ ਸੰਘਰੁ ਵਾਏ ॥
122.e: Sumbh and Nisumbh ordered the great warriors to sound the bugle of war.

122.g: ਹੋਈ ਅਲੋਪ ਭਵਾਨੀ; ਦੇਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਦੇ ॥
122.e: Bhavani (Durga) disappeard after bestowing kingdom on the gods.

122.g: ਈਸਰ ਦੀ ਬਰਦਾਨੀ; ਹੋਈ ਜਿਤ ਦਿਨ ॥
122.e: The day for which Shiva granted the boon.

122.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ; ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਰਮੇ ॥
122.e: The proud warriors Sumbh and Nisumbh were born.

122.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੀ ਰਾਜਧਾਨੀ; ਤਕੀ ਜਿਤਨੀ ॥੨੧॥
122.e: They planned to conquer the capital of Indra.21.

122.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
122.e: PAURI

122.g: ਸਟ ਪਈ ਜਮਧਾਣੀ; ਦਲਾਂ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ॥
122.e: When the trumpet, enveloped by the hide of the male buffalo, the vehicle of Yama, sounded, the armies attacked each other.

122.g: ਧੂਹਿ ਲਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣੀ; ਦੁਰਗਾ ਮਿਆਨ ਤੇ ॥
122.e: Durga pulled her sword from the scabbard.

122.g: ਚੰਡੀ ਰਾਕਸਿ ਖਾਣੀ; ਵਾਹੀ ਦੈਤ ਨੂੰ ॥
122.e: She struck the demon with that Chandi, the devourer of demons (that is the sword).

122.g: ਕੋਪਰ ਚੂਰ ਚਵਾਣੀ; ਲਥੀ ਕਰਗ ਲੈ ॥
122.e: It broke the skull and face into pieces and pierced through the skeleton.

122.g: ਪਾਖਰ ਤੁਰਾ ਪਲਾਣੀ; ਰੜਕੀ ਧਰਤ ਜਾਇ ॥
122.e: And it further pierced through the saddle and caparison of the horse, and struck on the earth supported by the Bull (Dhaul).

122.g: ਲੈਦੀ ਅਘਾ ਸਿਧਾਣੀ; ਸਿੰਗਾਂ ਧਉਲ ਦਿਆਂ ॥
122.e: It moved further and struck the horns of the Bull.

122.g: ਕੂਰਮ ਸਿਰ ਲਹਿਲਾਣੀ; ਦੁਸਮਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
122.e: Then it struck on the Tortoise supporting the Bull and thus killing the enemy.

122.g: ਵਢੇ ਗਨ ਤਿਖਾਣੀ; ਮੂਏ ਖੇਤ ਵਿਚ ॥
122.e: The demons are lying dead in the battlefield like the pieces of wood sawed by the carpenter.

122.g: ਰਣ ਵਿਚ ਘਤੀ ਘਾਣੀ; ਲੋਹੂ ਮਿਝ ਦੀ ॥
122.e: The press of blood and marrow has been set in motion in the battlefield.

122.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਕਹਾਣੀ; ਚਲਗ ਤੇਗ ਦੀ ॥
122.e: The story of the sword will be related in all the four ages.

122.g: ਬਿਧਣ ਖੇਤ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ; ਮਹਖੇ ਦੈਤ ਨੂੰ ॥੧੯॥
122.e: On the demon Mahisha the period of agony occurred in the battlefield.19.

122.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
122.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

122.g: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
122.e: Serve the True One, and praise the True One.

122.g: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
122.e: With the True Name, pain shall never afflict you.

122.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
122.e: Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace. They enshrine the Guru's Teachings within their minds. ||1||

122.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
122.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who intuitively enter into the peace of Samaadhi.

122.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
122.e: Those who serve the Lord are always beautiful. The glory of their intuitive awareness is beautiful. ||1||Pause||

122.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ; ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
122.e: All call themselves Your devotees,

122.g: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ; ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
122.e: but they alone are Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your mind.

122.g: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
122.e: Through the True Word of Your Bani, they praise You; attuned to Your Love, they worship You with devotion. ||2||

122.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ; ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਤੇਰਾ ॥
122.e: All are Yours, O Dear True Lord.

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
122.e: Meeting the Gurmukh, this cycle of reincarnation comes to an end.

122.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
122.e: When it pleases Your Will, then we merge in the Name. You Yourself inspire us to chant the Name. ||3||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
122.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine the Lord within my mind.

122.g: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ; ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
122.e: Pleasure and pain, and all emotional attachments are gone.

122.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
122.e: I am lovingly centered on the One Lord forever. I enshrine the Lord's Name within my mind. ||4||

122.g: ਭਗਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
122.e: Your devotees are attuned to Your Love; they are always joyful.

122.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
122.e: The nine treasures of the Naam come to dwell within their minds.

122.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
122.e: By perfect destiny, they find the True Guru, and through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||5||

122.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
122.e: You are Merciful, and always the Giver of peace.

122.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
122.e: You Yourself unite us; You are known only to the Gurmukhs.

122.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
122.e: You Yourself bestow the glorious greatness of the Naam; attuned to the Naam, we find peace. ||6||

122.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ; ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
122.e: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
122.e: As Gurmukh, I know no other at all.

122.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ; ਮਨਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਮਨਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
122.e: My mind remains immersed in the One Lord; my mind surrenders to Him, and in my mind I meet Him. ||7||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
122.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord.

122.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
122.e: Our True Lord and Master is Carefree.

122.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥੨੨॥
122.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with the Lord. ||8||21||22||

122.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰਪੁਰੀ ਤੇ ਧਾਵਣਾ; ਵਡ ਜੋਧੀ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
122.e: The great fighters decided to rush towards the kingdom of Indra.

122.g: ਸੰਜ ਪਟੇਲਾ ਪਾਖਰਾ; ਭੇੜ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
122.e: They began to prepare the war-material consisting of armour with belts and saddle-gear.

122.g: ਜੰਮੇ ਕਟਕ ਅਛੂਹਣੀ; ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਗਰਦੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
122.e: An army of lakhs of warriors gathered and the dust rose to sky.

122.g: ਰੋਹ ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
122.e: Sumbh and Nisumbh, full of rage, have marched forward.22.

122.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਨਚਾਏ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
122.e: The love of Maya makes this mind dance, and the deceit within makes people suffer in pain. ||4||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
122.e: When the Lord inspires one to become Gurmukh, and perform devotional worship,

122.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
122.e: then his body and mind are attuned to His Love with intuitive ease.

122.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੈ. ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
122.e: The Word of His Bani vibrates, and the Word of His Shabad resounds, for the Gurmukh whose devotional worship is accepted. ||5||

122.g: ਬਹੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰੇ; ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
122.e: One may beat upon and play all sorts of instruments,

122.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ; ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
122.e: but no one will listen, and no one will enshrine it in the mind.

122.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਿੜ ਬੰਧਿ ਨਾਚੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
122.e: For the sake of Maya, they set the stage and dance, but they are in love with duality, and they obtain only sorrow. ||6||

122.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੈ; ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
122.e: Those whose inner beings are attached to the Lord's Love are liberated.

122.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ; ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
122.e: They control their sexual desires, and their lifestyle is the self-discipline of Truth.

122.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ; ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
122.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they meditate forever on the Lord. This devotional worship is pleasing to the Lord. ||7||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
122.e: To live as Gurmukh is devotional worship, throughout the four ages.

122.g: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ; ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
122.e: This devotional worship is not obtained by any other means.

122.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੦॥੨੧॥
122.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained only through devotion to the Guru. So focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||20||21||

122.g: ਜਾਪਣ ਤੇਗੀ ਆਰੇ, ਮਿਆਨੋ ਧੂਹੀਆਂ ॥
122.e: It appears that the sword pulled from the scabbards are like saws.

122.g: ਜੋਧੇ ਵਡੇ ਮੁਨਾਰੇ, ਜਾਪਨ ਖੇਤ ਵਿਚ ॥
122.e: The warriors look like high minarets in the battlefield.

122.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਆਪ ਸਵਾਰੇ, ਪਬ ਜਵੇਹਣੇ ॥
122.e: The goddess herself killed these mountain-like demons.

122.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਖਨ ਹਾਰੇ, ਧਾਵਨ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ॥
122.e: They never uttered the word ‘defeat’ and ran in front of the goddess.

122.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸਭ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ, ਰਾਕਸਿ ਖੜਗ ਲੈ ॥੧੫॥
122.e: Durga, holding her sword, killed all the demons.15.

122.g: ਵਜੇ ਢੋਲ ਨਗਾਰੇ, ਦਲਾਂ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ॥
122.e: The drums and trumpets have sounded and the armies have attacked each other.

122.g: ਤੀਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਰੈਬਾਰੇ, ਆਮ੍ਹੋ ਸਾਮ੍ਹਣੇ ॥
122.e: The arrows move opposite to each other guidingly.

122.g: ਅਗਣਤ ਬੀਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ, ਲਗਦੀ ਕੈਬਰੀ ॥
122.e: With the infliction of arrows countless warriors have been killed.

122.g: ਡਿਗੇ ਜਾਣਿ ਮੁਨਾਰੇ, ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਜੁ ਦੇ ॥
122.e: Falling like the minarets smote by lightning.

122.g: ਖੁਲੀ ਵਾਲੀਂ ਦੈਤ ਅਹਾੜੇ, ਸਭੇ ਸੂਰਮੇ ॥
122.e: All the demon-fighters with untied hair shouted in agony.

122.g: ਸੁਤੇ ਜਾਣਿ ਜਟਾਲੇ, ਭੰਗਾਂ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੧੭॥
122.e: It seems that the hermits with matted locks are sleeping after eating the intoxicating hemps.17.

122.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
122.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

122.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
122.e: Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.

122.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
122.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are adorned with the Naam.

122.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
122.e: They are forever in bliss, day and night; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, they merge with the Lord of Glory. ||1||

122.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
122.e: PAURI

122.g: ਉਮਲ ਲਥੇ ਜੋਧੇ, ਮਾਰੂ ਬਜਿਆ ॥
122.e: The fatal martial music sounded and the warriors came in the battlefield with enthusiasm.

122.g: ਬਦਲ ਜਿਉ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ, ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਜਿਆ ॥
122.e: Mahishasura thundered in the field like the cloud

122.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਜੇਹਾ ਜੋਧਾ, ਮੈਥਉ ਭਜਿਆ ॥
122.e: “The warrior like Indra fled from me

122.g: ਕਉਣ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਗਾ, ਜਿਨ ਰਣੁ ਸਜਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
122.e: “Who is this wretched Durga, who hath come to srart war with me?”16.

122.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
122.e: PAURI

122.g: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਕੰਧਾਰਾਂ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੁੜੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਉਸਾ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
122.e: Both the armies are facing each other alongwith the resounding big trumpet.

122.g: ਕੜਕ ਉਠਿਆ ਫਉਜ ਤੇ; ਵਡਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
122.e: The highly egoist warrior of the army thundered.

122.g: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਚਲਿਆ ਸੂਰਮੇ; ਨਾਲਿ ਵਡੇ ਹਜਾਰੀ ॥
122.e: He is moving towards the war-arena with thousands of mighty warriors.

122.g: ਮਿਆਨੋ ਖੰਡਾ ਧੂਹਿਆ; ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
122.e: Mahishasura pulled out his huge double-edged sword from his scabbard.

122.g: ਉਮਲ ਲਥੇ ਸੂਰਮੇ; ਮਾਰ ਮਚੀ ਕਰਾਰੀ ॥
122.e: The fighters entered the field enthusiastically and there occurred formidable fighting.

122.g: ਜਾਪੇ ਚਲੇ ਰਤ ਦੇ; ਸਲਲੇ ਜਟਧਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
122.e: It appears that the blood flows like the water (of Ganges) from the tangled hair of Shiva.18.

123.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
123.e: PAURI

123.g: ਦਾਨੋ ਦੇਉ ਅਨਾਗੀ, ਸੰਘਰੁ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
123.e: The demons and gods have started a continuous war.

123.g: ਫੁਲ ਖਿੜੇ ਜਣ ਬਾਗੀਂ, ਬਾਣੇ ਜੋਧਿਆਂ ॥
123.e: The garments of the warriors appear like flowers in the garden.

123.g: ਭੂਤਾਂ ਇਲਾਂ ਕਾਗੀਂ, ਗੋਸਤ ਭਖਿਆ ॥
123.e: The ghosts, vultures and crows have eaten the flesh.

123.g: ਹੁੰਮੜ ਧੁੰਮੜ ਜਾਗੀ, ਘਤੀ ਸੂਰਿਆਂ ॥੨੪॥
123.e: The brave fighters have begun to run about.24.

123.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
123.e: PAURI

123.g: ਭੰਨੇ ਦੈਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ, ਰਾਜੇ ਸੁੰਭ ਥੈ ॥
123.e: The demons ran to their king Sumbh and beseeched

123.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਧੂਮ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ, ਸਣੇ ਸਿਪਾਹੀਆਂ ॥
123.e: “Lochan Dhum has been killed alongwith his soldiers

123.g: ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਜੋਧੇ ਮਾਰੇ, ਅੰਦਰ ਖੇਤ ਦੈ ॥
123.e: “She hath seleted the warriors and killed them in the battlefield

123.g: ਜਾਪਨ ਅੰਬਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ, ਡਿਗਨਿ ਸੂਰਮੇ ॥
123.e: “It seems that the warriors have fallen like the stars from the sky

123.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਪਰਬਤ ਭਾਰੇ, ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਜੁ ਦੇ ॥
123.e: “The huge mountains have fallen, having been smote by the lightning

123.g: ਦੈਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਦਲ ਹਾਰੇ, ਦਹਸਤ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
123.e: “The forces of the demons have been defeated on becoming panicky

123.g: ਬਚੇ ਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਰਹਦੇ ਰਾਇ ਥੈ ॥੨੯॥
123.e: “Those who were left have also been killed and the remaining have come to the king.”29.

123.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
123.e: PAURI

123.g: ਆਈ ਫੇਰ ਭਵਾਨੀ, ਖਬਰੀ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
123.e: The demons hear the news that the goddess Bhavani has come again.

123.g: ਦੈਤ ਵਡੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ, ਹੋਏ ਏਕਠੇ ॥
123.e: The highly egoist demons gathered together.

123.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਧੂਮ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ, ਰਾਇ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
123.e: The king Sumbh sent for the egoist Lochan Dhum.

123.g: ਜਗ ਵਿਚ ਵਡਾ ਦਾਨੋ, ਆਪ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
123.e: He caused himself to be called the great demon.

123.g: ਸਟ ਪਈ ਖਰਚਾਮੀ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਲਿਆਵਣੀ ॥੨੬॥
123.e: The drum enveloped with the hide of donkey was struck and it was proclaimed that Durga would be brought.26.

123.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
123.e: PAURI

123.g: ਢੋਲ ਨਗਾਰੇ ਵਾਏ, ਦਲਾਂ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ॥
123.e: The drums and trumpets were sounded and the armies attacked each other.

123.g: ਰੋਹ ਰੁਹੇਲੇ ਆਏ, ਉਤੇ ਰਾਕਸਾਂ ॥
123.e: The enraged warriors marched against the demons.

123.g: ਸਭਨੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਚਾਏ, ਬਰਛੇ ਪਕੜਿ ਕੈ ॥
123.e: All of them holding their daggers, caused their horses to dance.

123.g: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮਾਰ ਗਿਰਾਏ, ਅੰਦਰ ਖੇਤ ਦੈ ॥
123.e: Many were killed and thrown in the battlefield.

123.g: ਤੀਰੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਈ, ਬੁਠੀ ਦੇਵਤਾ ॥੩੧॥
123.e: The arrows shot by the goddess came in showers.31.

123.g: ਰੋਹ ਦਿਖਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਆ; ਵਰਿਆਮੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਚਾਏ ॥
123.e: Great fury was visulised and the brave fighters caused the horses to dance.

123.g: ਘੁਰੇ ਦਮਾਮੇ ਦੋਹਰੇ; ਜਮ ਬਾਹਣ ਜਿਉ ਅਰੜਾਏ ॥
123.e: The double-trumpets sounded like the loud voice of the male buffalo, the vehicle of Yama.

123.g: ਦੇਉ ਦਾਨੋ ਲੁਝਣ ਆਏ ॥੨੩॥
123.e: The gods and demons have gathered to fight.23.

123.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
123.e: PAURI

123.g: ਰੋਹ ਹੋਇ ਬੁਲਾਏ, ਰਾਕਸਿ ਰਾਇ ਨੇ ॥
123.e: Highly enraged, the king called the demons.

123.g: ਬੈਠੇ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਏ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਲਿਆਵਣੀ ॥
123.e: They decided to capture Durga.

123.g: ਚੰਡ ਅਰ ਮੁੰਡ ਪਠਾਏ, ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਟਕੁ ਦੈ ॥
123.e: Chand and Mund were sent with huge forces.

123.g: ਜਾਪੇ ਛਪਰ ਛਾਏ, ਬਣੀਆ ਕੇਜਮਾ ॥
123.e: It seemed that the swords coming together were like the thatched roofs.

123.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਰਾਇ ਬੁਲਾਏ, ਚਲੇ ਜੁਧ ਨੋ ॥
123.e: All those who were called, marched for war.

123.g: ਜਣ ਜਮ ਪੁਰ ਪਕੜ ਚਲਾਏ, ਸਭੇ ਮਾਰਣੇ ॥੩੦॥
123.e: It appear that they were all caught and sent to the city of Yama for killing.30.

123.g: ਸਟ ਪਈ ਨਗਾਰੇ, ਦਲਾਂ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ॥
123.e: The trumpet was beaten and the armies attack each other.

123.g: ਦਿਤੇ ਦੇਉ ਭਜਾਈ, ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਕਸੀਂ ॥
123.e: The demons have gathered together and have caused the gods to flee.

123.g: ਲੋਕੀ ਤਿਹੀ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ, ਦੋਹੀ ਆਪਣੀ ॥
123.e: They exhibited their authority in the three worlds.

123.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਦੀ ਸਾਮ ਤਕਾਈ, ਦੇਵਾਂ ਡਰਦਿਆਂ ॥
123.e: The gods, having been frightened went under the refuge of Durga.

123.g: ਆਂਦੀ ਚੰਡਿ ਚੜਾਈ; ਉਤੇ ਰਾਕਸਾ ॥੨੫॥
123.e: They caused the goddess Chandi to wage war with demons.25.

123.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
123.e: PAURI

123.g: ਚੋਬੀਂ ਧਉਂਸ ਬਜਾਈ, ਦਲਾਂ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ॥
123.e: The drummers sounded the drums and the armies attacked each other.

123.g: ਰੋਹ ਭਵਾਨੀ ਆਈ, ਉਤੇ ਰਾਕਸਾਂ ॥
123.e: The infuriated Bhavani lodged the attack over the demons.

123.g: ਖਬੈ ਦਸਤ ਨਚਾਈ, ਸੀਹਣ ਸਾਰ ਦੀ ॥
123.e: With her left hand, she caused the dance of the lionss of steel (sword).

123.g: ਬਹੁਤਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਤਨ ਲਾਈ, ਕੀਤੀ ਰੰਗੁਲੀ ॥
123.e: She struck it on the bodies of many worriors and made it colourful.

123.g: ਭਾਈਆਂ ਮਾਰਨ ਭਾਈ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਜਾਣਿ ਕੈ ॥
123.e: The brothers kill brothers mistaking them for Durga.

123.g: ਰੋਹ ਹੋਇ ਚਲਾਈ, ਰਾਕਸਿ ਰਾਇ ਨੂੰ ॥
123.e: Having been infuriated, she struck it on the king of the demons.

123.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਪਠਾਈ, ਲੋਚਨ ਧੂਮ ਨੂੰ ॥
123.e: Lochan Dhum was sent to the city of Yama.

123.g: ਜਾਪੇ ਦਿਤੀ ਸਾਈ, ਮਾਰਨ ਸੁੰਭ ਦੀ ॥੨੮॥
123.e: It seems the she gave the advance money for the killing of Sumbh.28.

123.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
123.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

123.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
123.e: The Divine Light of the Supreme Soul shines forth from the Guru.

123.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
123.e: The filth stuck to the ego is removed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

123.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
123.e: One who is imbued with devotional worship to the Lord night and day becomes pure. Worshipping the Lord, He is obtained. ||1||

123.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਆਪਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ. ਅਵਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
123.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who themselves worship the Lord, and inspire others to worship Him as well.

123.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ. ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
123.e: I humbly bow to those devotees who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

123.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
123.e: The Creator Lord Himself is the Doer of deeds.

123.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
123.e: As He pleases, He applies us to our tasks.

123.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ. ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
123.e: Through perfect destiny, we serve the Guru; serving the Guru, peace is found. ||2||

123.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.e: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, obtain it.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
123.e: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Lord within their minds.

123.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
123.e: Enshrining the Lord within their minds, they are liberated forever. With intuitive ease, they merge into the Lord. ||3||

123.g: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.e: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they do not obtain liberation through them.

123.g: ਦੇਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
123.e: They wander around the countryside, and in love with duality, they are ruined.

123.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਪਟੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
123.e: The deceitful lose their lives in vain; without the Word of the Shabad, they obtain only misery. ||4||

123.g: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
123.e: Those who restrain their wandering mind, keeping it steady and stable,

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.e: obtain the supreme status, by Guru's Grace.

123.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
123.e: The True Guru Himself unites us in Union with the Lord. Meeting the Beloved, peace is obtained. ||5||

123.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
123.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who hear and enshrine the Naam within their minds.

123.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ. ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
123.e: The Dear Lord, the True One, the Highest of the High, subdues their ego and blends them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

123.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
123.e: True is the Dear Lord, and True is His Name.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਕਿਸੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
123.e: By Guru's Grace, some merge with Him.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ. ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
123.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, those who merge with the Lord shall not be separated from Him again. They merge with intuitive ease into the True Lord. ||2||

123.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
123.e: There is nothing beyond You;

123.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ; ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
123.e: You are the One who does, sees, and knows.

123.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
123.e: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires others to act. Through the Guru's Teachings, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

123.g: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.e: The virtuous soul-bride finds the Lord;

123.g: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ; ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
123.e: she decorates herself with the Love and the Fear of God.

123.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ; ਸਚ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
123.e: She who serves the True Guru is forever a happy soul-bride. She is absorbed in the true teachings. ||4||

123.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ; ਤਿਨਾ. ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
123.e: Those who forget the Word of the Shabad have no home and no place of rest.

123.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ; ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
123.e: They are deluded by doubt, like a crow in a deserted house.

123.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ; ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
123.e: They forfeit both this world and the next, and they pass their lives suffering in pain and misery. ||5||

123.g: ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਲਿਖਦਿਆ; ਕਾਗਦ ਮਸੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
123.e: Writing on and on endlessly, they run out of paper and ink.

123.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
123.e: Through the love with duality, no one has found peace.

123.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਤੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ. ਕੂੜਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
123.e: They write falsehood, and they practice falsehood; they are burnt to ashes by focusing their consciousness on falsehood. ||6||

123.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
123.e: The Gurmukhs write and reflect on Truth, and only Truth.

123.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
123.e: The true ones find the gate of salvation.

123.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
123.e: True is their paper, pen and ink; writing Truth, they are absorbed in the True One. ||7||

123.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
123.e: My God sits deep within the self; He watches over us.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
123.e: Those who meet the Lord, by Guru's Grace, are acceptable.

123.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੨੩॥
123.e: O Nanak, glorious greatness is received through the Naam, which is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||23||

123.g: ਭੇਰੀ ਸੰਖ ਵਜਾਏ, ਸੰਘਰਿ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
123.e: The drums and conches were sounded and the war began.

123.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
123.e: PAURI

123.g: ਕੜਕ ਉਠੀ ਰਣ ਚੰਡੀ, ਫਉਜਾਂ ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ॥
123.e: Seeing the armies in the battlefield, Chandi shouted loudly.

123.g: ਧੂਹਿ ਮਿਆਨੋ ਖੰਡਾ, ਹੋਈ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ॥
123.e: She pulled her double-edged sword from her scabbard and came before the enemy.

123.g: ਸਭੇ ਬੀਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ, ਧੂਮਰਨੈਣ ਦੇ ॥
123.e: She killed all the warriors of Dhumar Nain.

123.g: ਜਣ ਲੈ ਕਟੇ ਆਰੇ, ਦਰਖਤ ਬਾਢੀਆਂ ॥੨੭॥
123.e: It seems that the carpenters have chopped the trees with the saw.27.

124.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
124.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

124.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
124.e: The Gurmukhs meet the Lord, and inspire others to meet Him as well.

124.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
124.e: Death does not see them, and pain does not afflict them.

124.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਭ ਤੋੜੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
124.e: Subduing egotism, they break all their bonds; as Gurmukh, they are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

124.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
124.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who look beautiful in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

124.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਚੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
124.e: The Gurmukhs sing, the Gurmukhs dance, and focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

124.g: ਸ੍ਰਣਵਤ ਬੀਜ ਹਕਾਰੇ, ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਸੂਰਮੇ ॥
124.e: Sranwat Beej called all the remaining warriors.

124.g: ਜੋਧੇ ਜੇਡ ਮੁਨਾਰੇ, ਦਿਸਨ ਖੇਤ ਵਿਚਿ ॥
124.e: They seem like minarets in the battlefield.

124.g: ਸਭਨੀ ਦਸਤ ਉਭਾਰੇ, ਤੇਗਾਂ ਧੂਹਿ ਕੈ ॥
124.e: All of them pulling their swords, raised their hands.

124.g: ਮਾਰੋ ਮਾਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ, ਆਏ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ॥
124.e: They came in front shouting “kill, kill”.

124.g: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.e: Some are stuck in falsehood, and false are the rewards they receive.

124.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
124.e: In love with duality, they waste away their lives in vain.

124.g: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
124.e: They drown themselves, and drown their entire family; speaking lies, they eat poison. ||6||

124.g: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ; ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
124.e: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, look within their bodies, into their minds.

124.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
124.e: Through loving devotion, their ego evaporates.

124.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ. ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ; ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ. ਮਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
124.e: The Siddhas, the seekers and the silent sages continually, lovingly focus their consciousness, but they have not seen the mind within the body. ||7||

124.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ; ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
124.e: The Creator Himself inspires us to work;

124.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ; ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
124.e: what can anyone else do? What can be done by our doing?

124.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ. ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ; ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
124.e: O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Name; we receive it, and enshrine it within the mind. ||8||23||24||

124.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
124.e: PAURI

124.g: ਦੈਤੀ ਡੰਡ ਉਭਾਰੀ ਨੇੜੈ, ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
124.e: On coming near, the demons raised the din.

124.g: ਸਿੰਘ ਕਰੀ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸੋਰ ਸੁਣ ॥
124.e: Hearing this clamour, Durga mounted her lion.

124.g: ਖਬੇ ਦਸਤ ਉਭਾਰੀ, ਗਦਾ ਫਿਰਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
124.e: She twirled her mace, raising it with her left hand.

124.g: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਭ ਸੰਘਾਰੀ, ਸ੍ਰਣਵਤ ਬੀਜ ਦੀ ॥
124.e: She killed all the army of Sranwat Beej.

124.g: ਜਣ ਮਦ ਖਾਇ ਮਦਾਰੀ, ਘੂਮਨ ਸੂਰਮੇ ॥
124.e: It appears that the warriors were roaming like the drug addicts taking drugs.

124.g: ਅਗਣਤ ਪਾਉ ਪਸਾਰੀ, ਰੁਲੇ ਅਹਾੜ ਵਿਚਿ ॥
124.e: Innumerable warriors are lying neglected in the battlefield, stretching their legs.

124.g: ਜਾਪੇ ਖੇਡ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਸੁਤੇ ਫਾਗ ਨੂੰ ॥੩੪॥
124.e: It seems that the revelers playing Holi are sleeping.34.

124.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਰਿਸਾਏ, ਮਾਰੇ ਦੈਤ ਸੁਣ ॥
124.e: Sumbh and Nisumbh were highly enraged on hearing this killing.

124.g: ਜੋਧੇ ਸਭ ਬੁਲਾਏ, ਆਪਣੀ ਮਜਲਸੀ ॥
124.e: They called all the brave fighters, who were their advisers.

124.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਦੇਉ ਭਜਾਏ, ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਜੇਵਹੇ ॥
124.e: Those who had caused the gods like Indra run away.

124.g: ਤੇਈ ਮਾਰ ਗਿਰਾਏ, ਪਲ ਵਿਚ ਦੇਵਤਾ ॥
124.e: The goddess killed them in an instant.

124.g: ਓਨੀ ਦਸਤੀ ਦਸਤ ਵਜਾਏ, ਤਿਨਾ ਚਿਤ ਕਰਿ ॥
124.e: Keeping Chand Mund in their mind, they rubbed their hands in sorrow.

124.g: ਫਿਰ ਸ੍ਰਣਵਤ ਬੀਜ ਚਲਾਏ, ਬੀੜੇ ਰਾਇ ਦੇ ॥
124.e: Then Sranwat Beej was prepared and sent by the king.

124.g: ਸੰਜ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਪਾਏ, ਚਿਲਕਤ ਟੋਪੀਆਂ ॥
124.e: He wore the armour with belts and the helmet which glistened.

124.g: ਲੁਝਣ ਨੋ ਅਰੜਾਏ, ਰਾਕਸ ਰੋਹਲੇ ॥
124.e: The infuriated demons shouted loudly for war.

124.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਿਨੇ ਹਟਾਏ, ਜੁਧ ਮਚਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
124.e: After waging war, none could get their retreat.

124.g: ਮਿਲ ਤੇਈ ਦਾਨੋ ਆਏ, ਹੁਣ ਸੰਘਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਾ ॥੩੩॥
124.e: Such demons have gathered together and come, now see the ensuing war.33.

124.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
124.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

124.g: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ; ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
124.e: Within this cave, there is an inexhaustible treasure.

124.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
124.e: Within this cave, the Invisible and Infinite Lord abides.

124.g: ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਪਤੁ. ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
124.e: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, selfishness and conceit are eliminated. ||1||

124.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
124.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their minds.

124.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
124.e: The taste of the Ambrosial Naam is very sweet! Through the Guru's Teachings, drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

124.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ; ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
124.e: Subduing egotism, the rigid doors are opened.

124.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
124.e: The Priceless Naam is obtained by Guru's Grace.

124.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
124.e: Without the Shabad, the Naam is not obtained. By Guru's Grace, it is implanted within the mind. ||2||

124.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ; ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
124.e: The Guru has applied the true ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

124.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
124.e: Deep within, the Divine Light has dawned, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

124.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
124.e: My light has merged into the Light; my mind has surrendered, and I am blessed with Glory in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

124.g: ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਭਾਲਣਿ; ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
124.e: Those who look outside the body, searching for the Lord,

124.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.e: Shall not receive the Naam; they shall instead be forced to suffer the terrible pains of slavery.

124.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ. ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਆਇ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
124.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand; but when they return once again to their own home, then, as Gurmukh, they find the genuine article. ||4||

124.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.e: By Guru's Grace, the True Lord is found.

124.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਖੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
124.e: Within your mind and body, see the Lord, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

124.g: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ. ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
124.e: Sitting in that place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever, and be absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

124.g: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ; ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
124.e: Those who close off the nine gates, and restrain the wandering mind,

124.g: ਦਸਵੈ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.e: come to dwell in the Home of the Tenth Gate.

124.g: ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ. ਵਜਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
124.e: There, the Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates day and night. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Shabad is heard. ||6||

124.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਨੇਰਾ ॥
124.e: Without the Shabad, there is only darkness within.

124.g: ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ; ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
124.e: The genuine article is not found, and the cycle of reincarnation does not end.

124.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਕੁੰਜੀ. ਹੋਰਤੁ ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ. ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
124.e: The key is in the hands of the True Guru; no one else can open this door. By perfect destiny, He is met. ||7||

124.g: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ; ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
124.e: You are the hidden and the revealed in all places.

124.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ; ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
124.e: Receiving Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained.

124.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੪॥੨੫॥
124.e: O Nanak, praise the Naam forever; as Gurmukh, enshrine it within the mind. ||8||24||25||

124.g: ਤਣਿ ਤਣਿ ਤੀਰ ਚਲਾਏ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਧਨਖ ਲੈ ॥
124.e: Durga, taking her bow, stretched it again and again for shooting arrows.

124.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਦਸਤ ਉਠਾਏ, ਰਹੇ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੇ ॥
124.e: Those who raised their hands against the goddess, did not survive.

124.g: ਚੰਡ ਅਰ ਮੁੰਡ ਖਪਾਏ ਦੋਨੋ ਦੇਵਤਾ ॥੩੨॥
124.e: She destroyed both Chand and Mund.32.

125.e: PAURI
The drummer sounded the trumpet and the armies attacked each other.

125.g: ਸਭੋ ਸੈਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ, ਪਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਾਨਵੀ ॥
125.e: All the army of the demons was killed in an instant.

125.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਦਾਨੋ ਮਾਰੇ, ਰੋਹ ਬਢਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: Highly infuriated, Durga killed the demons.

125.g: ਸਿਰ ਵਿਚ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ, ਸ੍ਰਣਵਤ ਬੀਜ ਦੇ ॥੩੭॥
125.e: She struck the sword on the head of Sranwat Beej.37.
The Gurmukhs are celebrated in life and death.
Their lives are not wasted; they realize the Word of the Shabad.

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ, ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
125.e: The Gurmukhs do not die; they are not consumed by death. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord.
The Gurmukhs eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

125.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
125.e: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well. The Gurmukhs redeem their lives. ||3||

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
125.e: The Gurmukhs never suffer bodily pain.
The Gurmukhs have the pain of egotism taken away.

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
125.e: The minds of the Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; no filth ever sticks to them again. The Gurmukhs merge in celestial peace. ||4||
The Gurmukhs obtain the Greatness of the Naam.
The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtain honor.

125.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
125.e: They remain in bliss forever, day and night. The Gurmukhs practice the Word of the Shabad. ||5||
The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Shabad, night and day.
The Gurmukhs are known throughout the four ages.

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ, ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਸਬਦੇ. ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
125.e: The Gurmukhs always sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. Through the Shabad, they practice devotional worship. ||6||
Without the Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.
Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out and scream.

125.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
125.e: Night and day, they are diseased, like maggots in manure, and in manure they endure agony. ||7||
The Gurmukhs know that the Lord alone acts, and causes others to act.
In the hearts of the Gurmukhs, the Lord Himself comes to dwell.

125.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
125.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. It is received from the Perfect Guru. ||8||25||26||
Innumerable mighty demons were steeped in blood.

125.g: ਜੋਧੇ ਜੇਡ ਮੁਨਾਰੇ, ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ਦੈ ॥
125.e: Those minarets-like demons in the battlefield
They challenged Durga and came in front of her.
Durga killed all the coming demons.

125.g: ਰਤੂ ਦੇ ਪਰਨਾਲੇ, ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਭੁਇ ਪਏ ॥
125.e: From their bodies the drains of blood fell on the ground.
Some of the active demons arise out of them laughingly.38.
The enchained trumpets and bugles sounded.
The warriors fought with daggers bedecked with tassels.
The war of bravery was waged between Durga and demos.

125.g: ਮਾਰ ਮਚੀ ਮੁਹਰਾਲੀ, ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ਦੈ ॥
125.e: There had been extreme destruction in the battlefield.

125.g: ਜਣ ਨਟ ਲਥੇ ਛਾਲੀ, ਢੋਲਿ ਬਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: It appears that the actors, sounding their drum, have jumped into the war-arena.
The dagger penetrated in the corpse seems like a blood stained fish entrapped in the net.

125.g: ਘਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਉ ਛੰਛਾਲੀ ਤੇਗਾਂ ਹਸੀਆਂ ॥
125.e: The swords glistened like the lightning in the clouds.
The swords have covered (the battlefield) like the winter-fog.39.
With the striking of swords on the armour, the clatter arises.

125.g: ਘਾੜ ਘੜਨਿ ਠਠਿਆਰੇ, ਜਾਣਿ ਬਣਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੫॥
125.e: It seems that the tinkers are fashioning the vessels with the blows of hammer.35.
When the trumpet enveloped by the hide of the male buffalo, the vehicle of Yama, sounded, the armies attacked each other.

125.g: ਘੂਮਰ ਬਰਗ ਸਤਾਣੀ, ਦਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਤੀਓ ॥
125.e: (The goddess) was the cause of flight and consternation in the battlefield.
The warriors fall alongwith their horses and saddles.

125.g: ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਪਾਣੀ, ਘਾਇਲ ਘੂਮਦੇ ॥
125.e: The wounded ones arise and ask for water while roaming.
Such a great calamity fell on the demons.
From this side the goddess rose like thundering lightning.36.
The trumpets were sounded with the beating of drum-stick and the armies attacked each other.
The youthful warriors pulled out their swords from their scabbards.
Sranwat Beej increased himself into innumerable forms.

125.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸਉਹੇਂ ਆਈਆਂ, ਰੋਹ ਬਢਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: Which came in front of Durga, highly enraged.

125.g: ਸਭਨੀ ਆਣ ਵਗਾਈਆਂ, ਤੇਗਾਂ ਧੂਹ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: All of them pulled out their swords and struck.

125.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸਭ ਬਚਾਈਆਂ, ਢਾਲ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: Durga saved herself from all, holding her shield carefully.

125.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਆਪ ਚਲਾਈਆਂ, ਤਕਿ ਤਕਿ ਦਾਨਵੀ ॥
125.e: The goddess herself then struck her sword looking carefully toward the demons.
She steeped her naked swords in blood.

125.g: ਸਾਰਸੁਤੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਈਆਂ, ਮਿਲ ਕੈ ਦੇਵੀਆਂ ॥
125.e: It appeared that the goddesses gathering together, took their bath in river Saraswati.

125.g: ਸਭੇ ਮਾਰ ਗਿਰਾਈਆਂ, ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ਦੈ ॥
125.e: The goddess hath killed and thrown on the ground in the battlefield (all the forms of Sranwat Beej).
Immediately then the forms again increased greatly.40.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The One Light is the light of all bodies.
The Perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word of the Shabad.

125.g: ਆਪੇ. ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
125.e: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created the Creation. ||1||

125.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
125.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

125.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ. ਕੋ, ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
125.e: Without the Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom; the Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||1||Pause||

125.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਆਪੇ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
125.e: You Yourself are Beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.
You Yourself, by Your Kind Mercy, weave the thread of the world.

125.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
125.e: You Yourself bestow pain and pleasure, O Creator. The Lord reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||2||
The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act.
Through Him, the Word of the Guru's Shabad is enshrined within the mind.

125.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
125.e: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani emanates from the Word of the Shabad. The Gurmukh speaks it and hears it. ||3||
He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
One who breaks out of bondage is liberated forever.

125.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ; ਆਪੇ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
125.e: The True Lord is liberated forever. The Unseen Lord causes Himself to be seen. ||4||
He Himself is Maya, and He Himself is the Illusion.
He Himself has generated emotional attachment throughout the entire universe.

125.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਆਪੇ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
125.e: He Himself is the Giver of Virtue; He Himself sings the Lord's Glorious Praises. He chants them and causes them to be heard. ||5||
He Himself acts, and causes others to act.
He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

125.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
125.e: Without You, nothing can be done. You Yourself have engaged all in their tasks. ||6||
He Himself kills, and He Himself revives.
He Himself unites us, and unites us in Union with Himself.

125.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
125.e: Through selfless service, eternal peace is obtained. The Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||7||
PAURI

125.g: ਸੂਰੀ ਸੰਘਰਿ ਰਚਿਆ; ਢੋਲ ਸੰਖ ਨਗਾਰੇ ਵਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: Sounding their drums, conches and trumpets, the warriors have begun the war.

125.g: ਚੰਡ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ਕਾਲਕਾ; ਮਨ ਬਾਹਲਾ ਰੋਸ ਬਢਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: Chandi, being highly enraged, remembered Kali in her mind.

125.g: ਨਿਕਲੀ ਮਥਾ ਫੋੜਿ ਕੈ; ਜਨ ਫਤੇ ਨੀਸਾਣ ਬਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: She came out shattering the forehead of Chandi, sounding the trumpet and flying flag of victory.

125.g: ਜਾਗ ਸੁ ਜੰਮੀ ਜੁਧ ਨੂੰ; ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਜਣ ਮਰੜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: On manifesting herself, she marched for war, like Bir Bhadra manifesting from Shiva.

125.g: ਦਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਘੇਰਾ ਘਤਿਆ ਜਣ ਸੀਂਹ ਤੁਰਿਆ ਗਣਿਣਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: The battlefield was surrounded by her and she seemed moving like a roaring lion.

125.g: ਆਪ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਹੋਇਆ, ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਤੇ ਖੁਨਸਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: (The demon-king) himself was in great anguish, while exhibiting his anger over the three worlds.

125.g: ਰੋਹ ਸਿਧਾਇਆਂ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਪਾਨ; ਕਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਖੜਗ ਉਠਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: Durga, being enraged, hath marched, holding her disc in her hand and raising her sword.

125.g: ਅਗੈ ਰਾਕਸ ਬੈਠੇ ਰੋਹਲੇ; ਤੀਰੀ ਤੇਗੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: There before her there were infuriated demons, she caught and knocked down the demons.

125.g: ਪਕੜ ਪਛਾੜੇ ਰਾਕਸਾਂ; ਦਲ ਦੈਤਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: Going within the forces of demons, she caught and knocked down the demons.

125.g: ਬਹੁ ਕੇਸੀ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨਿ; ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੂਮ ਰਚਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: She threw down by catching them from their hair and raising a tumult among their forces.

125.g: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਚੁਣ ਸੂਰਮੇ; ਗਹਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਦਏ ਚਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
125.e: She picked up mighty fighters by catching them with the corner of her bow and throwing them

126.g: ਚੋਬੀ ਧਉਸਾ ਪਾਈਆਂ, ਦਲਾਂ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ॥
126.e: The drummer beat the trumpet and armies attacked each other.

126.g: ਦਸਤੀ ਧੂਹ ਨਚਾਈਆਂ ਤੇਗਾਂ ਨੰਗੀਆਂ ॥
ਸੂਰਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਤਨ ਲਾਈਆਂ ਗੋਸਤ ਗਿਧੀਆਂ ॥
126.e: With their hands they pulled the naked sword and caused their dance.

126.g: ਬਿਧਣ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਈਆਂ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਘੋੜਿਆਂ ॥
126.e: These devourers of meat were struck on the bodies of the warriors.

126.g: ਜੋਗਣੀਆਂ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਾਈਆਂ ਲੋਹੂ ਭਖਣਾ ॥
126.e: The nights of agony have come for the men and horses.

126.g: ਫਉਜਾਂ ਮਾਰ ਹਟਾਈਆਂ, ਦੇਵਾਂ ਦਾਨਵਾਂ ॥
126.e: The Yoginis have come together speedily in order to drink the blood.

126.g: ਭਜਦੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈਆਂ ਰਾਜੇ ਸੁੰਭ ਥੈ ॥
126.e: They told the story of their repulsion before the king Sumbh.

126.g: ਭੁਈਂ ਨ ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਈਆਂ ਬੂੰਦਾ ਰਕਤ ਦੀਆ ॥
126.e: The drops of blood (of Sranwat Beej) could not fall on the earth.

126.g: ਕਾਲੀ ਖੇਤ ਖਪਾਈਆਂ ਸਭੇ ਸੂਰਤਾਂ ॥
126.e: Kali destroyed all the manifestations of (Sranwat Beej) in the battlefield.

126.g: ਬਹੁਤੀ ਸਿਰੀ ਬਿਹਾਈਆਂ, ਘੜੀਆਂ ਕਾਲ ਕੀਆਂ ॥
126.e: The last moments of death came over the heads of many fighters.

126.g: ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਮਾਈਆਂ, ਜੂਝੇ ਸੂਰਮੇ ॥੪੩॥
126.e: The brave fighters could not even be recognized by their mothers, who gave birth to them.43.

126.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
126.e: PAURI

126.g: ਆਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਹਰੀਆਂ, ਸੈਣ ਸੂਰਿਆਂ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
126.e: The willing workers got engaged in work and as warriors they equipped the army.

126.g: ਚਲੇ ਸਉਹੇ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ, ਜਣ ਕਾਬੈ ਹਾਜੀ ॥
126.e: They marched in front of Durga, like pilgrims going for Haj to Kaabah (Mecca).

126.g: ਤੀਰੀ ਤੇਗੀ ਜਮਧੜੀ, ਰਣ ਵੰਡੀ ਭਾਜੀ ॥
126.e: They are inviting the warriors in the battlefield through the medium of arrows, swords and daggers.

126.g: ਇਕ ਘਾਇਲ ਘੂਮਨ ਸੂਰਮੇ, ਜਣ ਮਕਤਬ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
126.e: Some wounded warriors are swinging like the Quadis in the school, reciting the holy Quran.

126.g: ਇਕ ਬੀਰ ਪਰੋਤੇ ਬਰਛੀਏ, ਜਿਉ ਝੁਕ ਪਉਨ ਨਿਵਾਜੀ ॥
126.e: Some brave fighters are pierced by daggers and lining like a devout Muslim performing prayer.

126.g: ਇਕ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸਉਹੇ ਖੁਨਸ ਕੈ, ਖੁਨਸਾਇਨ ਤਾਜੀ ॥
126.e: Some go in front of Durga in great fury by inciting their malicious horses.

126.g: ਇਕ ਧਾਵਨ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਸਾਮ੍ਹਣੇ, ਜਿਉ ਭੁਖਿਆਏ ਪਾਜੀ ॥
126.e: Some run in front of Durga like the hungry scoundrels

126.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰਜੇ ਜੁਧ ਤੇ, ਰਜ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਜੀ ॥੪੫॥
126.e: Who had never been satisfied in the war, but now they are satiated and pleased.45.

126.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
126.e: PAURI

126.g: ਓਰੜ ਫਉਜਾਂ ਆਈਆਂ ਬੀਰ ਚੜੇ ਕੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
126.e: The forces came in great numbers and the ranks of warriors marched forward

126.g: ਸੜਕ ਮਿਆਨੋ ਕਢੀਆਂ, ਤਿਖੀਆਂ ਤਰਵਾਰੀ ॥
126.e: They pulled their sharp swords from their scabbards.

126.g: ਕੜਕ ਉਠੇ ਰਣ ਮਚਿਆ ਵਡੇ ਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
126.e: With the blazing of the war, the great egoist warriors shouted loudly.

126.g: ਸਿਰ ਧੜ ਬਾਹਾਂ ਗਨ ਲੇ, ਫੁਲ ਜੇਹੈ ਬਾੜੀ ॥
126.e: The pieces of head, trunk and arms look like garden-flowers.

126.g: ਜਾਪੇ ਕਟੇ ਬਾਢੀਆਂ ਰੁਖ ਚੰਦਨ ਆਰੀ ॥੪੮॥
126.e: And (the bodies) appear like the trees of sandalwood cut and sawed by the carpenters.48.

126.g: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਕੰਧਾਰਾਂ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੁੜੇ; ਜਾ ਸਟ ਪਈ ਖਰਵਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
126.e: When the trumpet, enveloped by the hide of a donkey, was beaten, both the forces faced each other.

126.g: ਤਕ ਤਕ ਕੈਬਰਿ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ; ਤਕ ਮਾਰੇ ਭਲੇ ਜੁਝਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
126.e: Looking at the warriors, Durga pointedly shot her arrows on the brave fighters.

126.g: ਪੈਦਲ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਾਥੀਆਂ; ਸੰਗਿ ਰਥ ਗਿਰੇ ਅਸਵਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
126.e: The warriors on foot were killed, the elephants were killed alongwith the fall of the chariots and horse- riders.

126.g: ਬਜੇ ਸੰਗਲੀਆਲੇ, ਸੰਘਰ ਡੋਹਰੇ ॥
126.e: The enchained double trumpets sounded.

126.g: ਡਹੇ ਜੁ ਖੇਤ ਜਟਾਲੇ, ਹਾਠਾਂ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ॥
126.e: Gathering together in ranks, the warriors with matted hair are engaged in war in the battlefield.

126.g: ਨੇਜੇ ਬੰਬਲੀਆਲੇ, ਦਿਸਨ ਓਰੜੇ ॥
126.e: The lances bedecked with tassels seem leaning

126.g: ਚਲੇ ਜਾਣ ਜਟਾਲੇ, ਨਾਵਣ ਗੰਗ ਨੂੰ ॥੪੬॥
126.e: Like the hermits with matted locks going towards the Ganges for taking a bath.46.

126.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
126.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

126.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
126.e: My God is pervading and permeating all places.

126.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
126.e: By Guru's Grace, I have found Him within the home of my own heart.

126.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
126.e: I serve Him constantly, and I meditate on Him single-mindedly. As Gurmukh, I am absorbed in the True One. ||1||

126.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
126.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord, the Life of the World, within their minds.

126.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
126.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I merge with intuitive ease into the Lord, the Life of the World, the Fearless One, the Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

126.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ; ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
126.e: Within the home of the self is the earth, its support and the nether regions of the underworld.

126.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
126.e: Within the home of the self is the Eternally Young Beloved.

126.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
126.e: The Giver of peace is eternally blissful. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||2||

126.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
126.e: When the body is filled with ego and selfishness,

126.g: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ; ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
126.e: the cycle of birth and death does not end.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
126.e: One who becomes Gurmukh subdues egotism, and meditates on the Truest of the True. ||3||

126.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਈ ॥
126.e: Within this body are the two brothers, sin and virtue.

126.g: ਦੁਹੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ; ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
126.e: When the two joined together, the Universe was produced.

126.g: ਦੋਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ. ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
126.e: Subduing both, and entering into the Home of the One, through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||4||

126.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਨੇਰਾ ॥
126.e: Within the home of the self is the darkness of the love of duality.

126.g: ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਛੋਡੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
126.e: When the Divine Light dawns, ego and selfishness are dispelled.

126.g: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
126.e: The Giver of peace is revealed through the Shabad, meditating upon the Naam, night and day. ||5||

126.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ; ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
126.e: Deep within the self is the Light of God; It radiates throughout the expanse of His creation.

126.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
126.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

126.g: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
126.e: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and eternal peace is obtained, as one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

126.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ; ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
126.e: Within the mansion is the treasure house, overflowing with jewels.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
126.e: The Gurmukh obtains the Infinite Naam, the Name of the Lord.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ; ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
126.e: The Gurmukh, the trader, always purchases the merchandise of the Naam, and always reaps profits. ||7||

126.g: ਆਪੇ ਵਥੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
126.e: The Lord Himself keeps this merchandise in stock, and He Himself distributes it.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਹਿ; ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
126.e: Rare is that Gurmukh who trades in this.

126.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੭॥੨੮॥
126.e: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain it. Through His Mercy, it is enshrined in the mind. ||8||27||28||

126.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
126.e: PAURI

126.g: ਦੁਹਾ ਕੰਧਾਰਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੁੜੇ, ਅਣੀਆਰਾਂ ਚੋਈਆ ॥
126.e: Both the armies are facing each other and the blood is dripping from the tips of arrows.

126.g: ਧੂਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਣਾਂ ਤਿਖੀਆ ਨਾਲ ਲੋਹੂ ਧੋਈਆਂ ॥
126.e: Pulling the sharp swords, they have been washed with blood.

126.g: ਹੂਰਾਂ ਸ੍ਰਣਤ ਬੀਜ ਨੂੰ, ਘਤਿ ਘੇਰਿ ਖਲੋਈਆਂ ॥
126.e: The heavenly damsels (houris), surrounding Sranwat Beej, are standing

126.g: ਲਾੜਾ ਦੇਖਣ ਲਾੜੀਆਂ ਚਉਗਿਰਦੇ ਹੋਈਆਂ ॥੪੨॥
126.e: Like the brides surrounding the bridegroom in order to see him.42.

126.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਰਹਾਲੀ, ਸ੍ਰਣਵਤ ਬੀਜ ਦੀ ॥
126.e: Sumbh heard the bad news about the death of Sranwat Beej

126.g: ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਝਾਲੀ, ਦੁਰਗਾ ਆਂਵਦੀ ॥
126.e: And that none could withstand the marching Durga in the battlefield.

126.g: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਬੀਰ ਜਟਾਲੀ, ਉਠੇ ਆਖ ਕੈ ॥
126.e: Many brave fighters with matted hair got up saing

126.g: ਚੋਟਾ ਪਾਨ ਤਬਾਲੀ ਜਾਸਨ ਜੁਧ ਨੂੰ ॥
126.e: That drummers should sound the drums because they would go for war.

126.g: ਥਰਿ ਥਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਚਾਲੀ ਦਲਾਂ ਚੜੰਦਿਆਂ ॥
126.e: When the armies marched, the earth trembled

126.g: ਨਾਉ ਜਿਵੇ ਹੈ ਹਾਲੀ, ਸਹੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਿਚਿ ॥
126.e: Like the shaking boat, which is still in the river.

126.g: ਧੂੜਿ ਉਤਾਹਾਂ ਘਾਲੀ, ਛੜੀ ਤੁਰੰਗਮਾਂ ॥
126.e: The dust arose with the hooves of the horses

126.g: ਜਾਣਿ ਪੁਕਾਰੂ ਚਾਲੀ, ਧਰਤੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਥੈ ॥੪੪॥
126.e: And it seemed that the earth is going to Indra for a complaint.44.

126.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
126.e: PAURI

126.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਅਤੈ ਦਾਨਵੀ ਸੂਲ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਕੰਗਾਂ ॥
126.e: The forces of Durga and demons are piercing each other like sharp thorns.

126.g: ਵਾਛੜ ਘਤੀ ਸੂਰਿਆਂ ਵਿਚ ਖੇਤ ਖਤੰਗਾਂ ॥
126.e: The warriors showered arrows in the battlefield.

126.g: ਧੂਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣਾ ਤਿਖੀਆਂ ਬਢ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਅੰਗਾਂ ॥
126.e: Pulling their sharp swords, they chop the limbs.

126.g: ਪਹਲਾ ਦਲਾਂ ਮਿਲੰਦਿਆਂ ਭੇੜ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹੰਗਾ ॥੪੭॥
126.e: When the forces met, at first there was war with swords.47.

126.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
126.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

126.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ; ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
126.e: The Lord Himself leads us to merge with Him and serve Him.

126.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
126.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the love of duality is eradicated.

126.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
126.e: The Immaculate Lord is the Bestower of eternal virtue. The Lord Himself leads us to merge in His Virtuous Goodness. ||1||

126.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
126.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Truest of the True within their hearts.

126.g: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
126.e: The True Name is eternally pure and immaculate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is enshrined within the mind. ||1||Pause||

126.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
126.e: The Guru Himself is the Giver, the Architect of Destiny.

126.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
126.e: The Gurmukh, the humble servant who serves the Lord, comes to know Him.

126.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
126.e: Those humble beings look beautiful forever in the Ambrosial Naam. Through the Guru's Teachings, they receive the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

126.g: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ; ਇਕੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
126.e: Within the cave of this body, there is one beautiful place.

126.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
126.e: Through the Perfect Guru, ego and doubt are dispelled.

126.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
126.e: Night and day, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, you shall find Him. ||3||

126.g: ਆਪੇ; ਊਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
126.e: He Himself is the Highest of the High.

126.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ; ਸੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
