126.e: How rare are those who behold Him. He causes Himself to be seen.

126.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੬॥੨੭॥
126.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the hearts of those who see the Lord themselves, and inspire others to see Him as well. ||8||26||27||

126.g: ਰਣ ਕਾਲੀ ਗੁਸਾ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੧॥
126.e: In her fury, Kali hath done this in the battlefield.41.

127.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
127.e: PAURI

127.g: ਦੋਹਾਂ ਕੰਧਾਰਾਂ ਮੁਹ ਜੁੜੇ, ਦਲ ਘੁਰੇ ਨਗਾਰੇ ॥
127.e: The trumpets have sounded in the army and both the forces face each other.

127.g: ਓਰੜ ਆਏ ਸੂਰਮੇ, ਸਿਰਦਾਰ ਅਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
127.e: The chief and brave warriors swayed in the field.

127.g: ਲੈ ਕੇ ਤੇਗਾਂ ਬਰਛੀਆਂ, ਹਥਿਆਰ ਉਭਾਰੇ ॥
127.e: They raised their weapons including the swords and daggers.

127.g: ਟੋਪ ਪਟੇਲਾ ਪਾਖਰਾਂ, ਗਲਿ ਸੰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
127.e: They have bedecked themselves with helmets on their heads, and armour around their necks alongwith their horse-sddles with belts.

127.g: ਲੈ ਕੇ ਬਰਛੀ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ, ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨਵ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
127.e: Durga holding her dagger, killed many demons.

127.g: ਚੜੇ ਰਥੀ ਗਜ ਘੋੜਿਈ, ਮਾਰ ਭੁਇ ਤੇ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
127.e: She killed and threw those on the round who were riding chariots, elephants and horses.

127.g: ਜਣੁ ਹਲਵਾਈ ਸੀਖ ਨਾਲ, ਵਿੰਨ੍ਹ ਵੜੇ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
127.e: It appear that the confectioner has cooked small round cakes of grounded pulse, piercing them with a spike.52.

127.g: ਸੋਹਨ ਸੰਜਾ ਬਾਗੜਾ; ਜਣੁ ਲਗੇ ਫੁਲ ਅਨਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: The tips of arrows penetrated in the armour like the flowers on pomegranate-plants.

127.g: ਗੁਸੇ ਆਈ ਕਾਲਕਾ; ਹਥਿ ਸਜੇ ਲੈ ਤਰਵਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: The goddess Kali got enraged, holding her sword in her right hand

127.g: ਏਦੂ ਪਾਰਉ ਓਤ ਪਾਰ; ਹਰਨਾਕਸਿ ਕਈ ਹਜਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: She destroyed several thousand demons (Hiranayakashipus) from this end of the field to the other end.

127.g: ਜਿਣ ਇਕਾ ਰਹੀ, ਕੰਧਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: The only one is conquering the army

127.g: ਸਦ ਰਹਮਤ, ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਰ ਕਉ ॥੪੯॥
127.e: O goddess! Hail, hail to Thy blow.49.

127.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
127.e: PAURI

127.g: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਕੰਧਾਰਾਂ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੁੜੇ; ਸਟ ਪਈ ਜਮਧਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: The trumpet, enveloped by the hide of the male buffalo, the vehicle of Yama, was beaten and both the armies faced each other.

127.g: ਤਦ ਖਿੰਗ ਨਸੁੰਭ ਨਚਾਇਆ; ਡਾਲ ਉਪਰਿ ਬਰਗਸਤਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: Then Nisumbh caused the horse to dance, putting on his back the saddle-armour.

127.g: ਫੜੀ ਬਿਲੰਦ ਮਗਾਇਉਸ; ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਲਤਾਨ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: She held the big bow, which was caused to be brought on order form Musltan.

127.g: ਗੁਸੇ ਆਈ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ; ਰਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਘਤਣ ਘਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: In her fury, she came in front in order to fill the battlefield with the mud of blood and fat.

127.g: ਅਗੈ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ; ਬਢ ਸੁੰਭਨ ਬਹੀ ਪਲਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: Durga struck the sword in front of her, cutting the demon-king, penetrated through the horse-saddle.

127.g: ਰੜਕੀ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਧਰਤ ਕਉ; ਬਢ ਪਾਖਰ ਬਢ ਕਿਕਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: Then it penetrated further and struck the earth after cutting the saddle-armour and the horse.

127.g: ਬੀਰ ਪਲਾਣੋ ਡਿਗਿਆ; ਕਰਿ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਸੁੰਭ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: The great hero (Nisumbh) fell down from the horse-saddle, offering salutation to the wise Sumbh.

127.g: ਸਾਬਾਸ, ਸਲੋਣੇ ਖਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: Hail, hail, to the winsome chieftain (Khan).

127.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਬਾਸ, ਤੇਰੇ ਤਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: Hail, hail, ever to thy strength.

127.g: ਤਾਰੀਫਾਂ, ਪਾਨ ਚਬਾਣ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: Praises are offered for the chewing of betel.

127.g: ਸਦ ਰਹਮਤ, ਕੈਫਾਂ ਖਾਨ ਕਉ ॥
127.e: Hail, hail to thy addiction.

127.g: ਸਦ ਰਹਮਤ, ਤੁਰੇ ਨਚਾਣ ਕਉ ॥੫੦॥
127.e: Hail hail, to thy horse-control.50.

127.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
127.e: PAURI

127.g: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਕੰਧਾਰਾਂ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੁੜੇ, ਨਾਲ ਧਉਸਾ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
127.e: Alongwith the sounding of the large trumpet, both the forces faced each other.

127.g: ਲਈ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ, ਵਰ ਜਾਗਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
127.e: Durga held out her sword, appearing like great lustrous fire

127.g: ਲਾਈ ਰਾਜੇ ਸੁੰਭ ਨੋ, ਰਤੁ ਪੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
127.e: She struck it on the king Sumbh and this lovely weapon drinks blood.

127.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਪਾਲਾਣੋ ਡਿਗਿਆ, ਉਪਮਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
127.e: Sumbh fell down from the saddle for which the following simile hath been thought.

127.g: ਡੁਬ ਰਤੂ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੀ, ਬਰਛੀ ਦੁਧਾਰੀ ॥
127.e: That the double-edged dagger, smeared with blood, which hath come out (from the body of Sumbh)

127.g: ਜਾਣ ਰਜਾਦੀ ਉਤਰੀ, ਪੈਨ ਸੂਹੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੫੩॥
127.e: Seems like a princess coming down from her loft, wearing the red sari.53.

127.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
127.e: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.

127.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
127.e: Let the Lord (The Primal Lord, who known as Sri Bhagauti Ji—The Primal Mother) be helpful.

127.g: ਅਥ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਲਿਖ︀ਯਤੇ ॥
127.e: Thus the book named GYAN PRABODH (Unforldment of Knowledge) is being written.
Gyan Prabodh of Tenth Sovereign (Guru).

127.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
127.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA BY THY GRACE.

127.g: ਨਮੋ ਨਾਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਧ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
127.e: Salutation to Thee, O Perfectt Lord! Thou art the Doer of Perfect Karmas (actions).

127.g: ਅਛੇਦੀ ਅਭੇਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਏਕ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art Unassailable, Indiscriminate and ever of One Discipline.

127.g: ਕਲੰਕੰ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਿਹਕਲੰਕੀ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
127.e: Thou art without blemishes, O Unblemished entity.

127.g: ਅਛੇਦੰ ਅਭੇਦੰ ਅਖੇਦੰ ਅਨੂਪੇ ॥੧॥
127.e: Invvincible, Unmysterious, Unharmed and Unequalled Lord.1.

127.g: ਨਮੋ ਲੋਕ ਲੋਕੇਸ੍ਵਰੰ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੇ ॥
127.e: Salutation to Thee, O the Lord of people and Master of all.

127.g: ਸਦੈਵੰ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਥੰ ਅਨਾਥੇ ॥
127.e: Thou art ever the Comrade and Lord of the patronless.

127.g: ਨੋਮ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੰ ਅਨੇਕੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
127.e: Salutation to Thee, O One Lord pervading in many forms.

127.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਹੰ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੇ ॥੨॥
127.e: Always the king of all and always the monarch of all.2.

127.g: ਅਛੇਦੰ ਅਭੇਦੰ ਅਨਾਮੰ ਅਠਾਮੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art unassailable, indiscriminate, without Name and place.

127.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬਦਾ ਸਿਧਦਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਧਾਮੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art the Master of all powers and the home of intellect,

127.g: ਅਜੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਕੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਭਰੰਮੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art neither in yantras, nor in mantras, nor in other activities nor in any religious discipline.

127.g: ਅਖੇਦੰ ਅਭੇਦੰ ਅਛੇਦੰ ਅਕਰਮੰ ॥੩॥
127.e: Thou art without suffering. without mystery, without destruction and without action.3.

127.g: ਅਗਾਧੇ ਅਬਾਧੇ ਅਗੰਤੰ ਅਨੰਤੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art unfathomable, unattached, inaccessible and endless.

127.g: ਅਲੇਖੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ਅਭੂਤੰ ਅਗੰਤੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art accountless, guiseless, elementless and innumerable.

127.g: ਨ ਰੰਗੰ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ਨ ਪਾਤੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art without colour, form, caste and lineage.

127.g: ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੋ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੋ ਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੋ ਨ ਮਾਤੰ ॥੪॥
127.e: Thou art without enemy, friend, son and mother.4.

127.g: ਅਭੂਤੰ ਅਭੰਗੰ ਅਭਿਖੰ ਭਵਾਨੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art element less, indivisible, want less and only Thyself.

127.g: ਪਰੇਯੰ ਪੁਨੀਤੰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art beyond everything. Thou art holy, immaculate and supreme.

127.g: ਅਗੰਜੇ ਅਭੰਜੇ ਅਕਾਮੰ ਅਕਰਮੰ ॥
127.e: Thou art invincible, indivisible, without desires and actions.

127.g: ਅਨੰਤੇ ਬਿਅੰਤੇ ਅਭੂਮੇ ਅਭਰਮੰ ॥੫॥
127.e: Thou art endless, boundless, all-pervasive and illusionless.5.

127.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
127.e: Maajh, Third Mehl:

127.g: ਊਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ; ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
127.e: Sublime is their birth, and the place where they dwell.

127.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
127.e: Those who serve the True Guru remain detached in the home of their own being.

127.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
127.e: They abide in the Lord's Love, and constantly imbued with His Love, their minds are satisfied and fulfilled with the Lord's Essence. ||1||

127.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
127.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read of the Lord, who understand and enshrine Him within their minds.

127.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
127.e: The Gurmukhs read and praise the Lord's Name; they are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

127.g: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਰਿ; ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
127.e: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

127.g: ਉਪਾਇ. ਨ ਕਿਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
127.e: He cannot be obtained by any effort.

127.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ; ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
127.e: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness, we are united in His Union. ||2||

127.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜੈ; ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
127.e: One who reads, while attached to duality, does not understand.

127.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
127.e: He yearns for the three-phased Maya.

127.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
127.e: The bonds of the three-phased Maya are broken by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru's Shabad, liberation is achieved. ||3||

127.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ; ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
127.e: This unstable mind cannot be held steady.

127.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੈ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
127.e: Attached to duality, it wanders in the ten directions.

127.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ. ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
127.e: It is a poisonous worm, drenched with poison, and in poison it rots away. ||4||

127.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ; ਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ॥
127.e: Practicing egotism and selfishness, they try to impress others by showing off.

127.g: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
127.e: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they gain no acceptance.

127.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
127.e: Without You, Lord, nothing happens at all. You forgive those who are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad. ||5||

127.g: ਉਪਜੈ ਪਚੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
127.e: They are born, and they die, but they do not understand the Lord.

127.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
127.e: Night and day, they wander, in love with duality.

127.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
127.e: The lives of the self-willed manmukhs are useless; in the end, they die, regretting and repenting. ||6||

127.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ; ਸਿਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
127.e: The Husband is away, and the wife is getting dressed up.

127.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁ; ਐਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
127.e: This is what the blind, self-willed manmukhs are doing.

127.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ. ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
127.e: They are not honored in this world, and they shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. They are wasting their lives in vain. ||7||

127.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
127.e: How rare are those who know the Name of the Lord!

127.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
127.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, the Lord is realized.

127.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
127.e: Night and day, they perform the Lord's devotional service; day and night, they find intuitive peace. ||8||

127.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ; ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
127.e: That One Lord is pervading in all.

127.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ; ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
127.e: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

127.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੯॥੨੯॥੩੦॥
127.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are beautiful. Granting His Grace, God unites them with Himself. ||9||29||30||

127.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
127.e: PAURI

127.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਅਤੈ ਦਾਨਵੀ ਭੇੜ ਪਇਆ ਸਬਾਹੀਂ ॥
127.e: The war between Durga and the demons started early in the morning.

127.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਜੂਤੇ ਦੁਰਗਸਾਹ ਗਹ ਸਭਨੀਂ ਬਾਹੀਂ ॥
127.e: Durga held her weapons firmly in all her arms.

127.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਸੰਘਾਰਿਆ ਵਥ ਜੇਹੇ ਸਾਹੀਂ ॥
127.e: She killed both Sumbh and Nisumbh, who were the masters of all the materials.

127.g: ਫਉਜਾਂ ਰਾਕਸਿ ਆਰੀਆਂ ਦੇਖਿ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀਂ ॥
127.e: Seeing this, the helpless forces of the demons, weep bitterly.

127.g: ਮੁਹਿ ਕੁੜੂਚੇ ਘਾਹ ਦੇ ਛਡ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਾਹੀਂ ॥
127.e: Accepting their defeat (by putting the straws of grass in their mouth), and leaving their horses in the way

127.g: ਭਜਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਮਾਰੀਅਨ ਮੁੜ ਝਾਕਨ ਨਾਹੀਂ ॥੫੪॥
127.e: They are being killed, while fleeing, without looking back.54.

127.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
127.e: PAURI

127.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਪਠਾਇਆ, ਜਮ ਦੇ ਧਾਮ ਨੋ ॥
127.e: Sumbh and Nisumbh were dispatched to the abode of Yama

127.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਦ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ, ਰਾਜ ਅਭਿਸੇਖ ਨੋ ॥
127.e: And Indra was called for crowning him.

127.g: ਸਿਰ ਪਰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ, ਰਾਜੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੈ ॥
127.e: The canopy was held up over the head of king Indra.

127.g: ਚਉਦਹ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਛਾਇਆ, ਜਸੁ ਜਗਮਾਤ ਦਾ ॥
127.e: The praise of the mother of the universe spread over all the fourteen worlds.

127.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਪਾਠ ਬਣਾਇਆ, ਸਭੇ ਪਉੜੀਆਂ ॥
127.e: All the Pauris (stanza) of this DURGA PATH (The text about the exploits of Durga) have been composed

127.g: ਫੇਰ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਇਆ, ਜਿਨ ਇਹ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੫੫॥
127.e: And that person who sings it, will not take birth again.55.

127.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
127.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, search this cave.

127.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
127.e: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the self.

127.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ. ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
127.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and decorate yourself with the Shabad. Meeting with your Beloved, you shall find peace. ||4||

127.g: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ. ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
127.e: The Messenger of Death imposes his tax on those who are attached to duality.

127.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ; ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਏ ॥
127.e: He inflicts punishment on those who forget the Name.

127.g: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ; ਰਤੀਅਹੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
127.e: They are called to account for each instant and each moment. Every grain, every particle, is weighed and counted. ||5||

127.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ; ਪਿਰੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
127.e: One who does not remember her Husband Lord in this world is being cheated by duality;

127.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਮੁਠੀ; ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
127.e: She shall weep bitterly in the end.

127.g: ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਲਿਓ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ; ਸੁਪਨੈ. ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
127.e: She is from an evil family; she is ugly and vile. Even in her dreams, she does not meet her Husband Lord. ||6||

127.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ; ਪਿਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
127.e: She who enshrines her Husband Lord in her mind in this world

127.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ; ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
127.e: His Presence is revealed to her by the Perfect Guru.

127.g: ਕਾਮਣਿ. ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ; ਸਬਦੇ. ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
127.e: That soul-bride keeps her Husband Lord clasped tightly to her heart, and through the Word of the Shabad, she enjoys her Husband Lord upon His Beautiful Bed. ||7||

127.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ; ਸਦਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
127.e: The Lord Himself sends out the call, and He summons us to His Presence.

127.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ; ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
127.e: He enshrines His Name within our minds.

127.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
127.e: O Nanak, one who receives the greatness of the Naam night and day, constantly sings His Glorious Praises. ||8||28||29||

127.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
127.e: PAURI

127.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਅਤੈ ਦਾਨਵੀ, ਗਹ ਸੰਘਰਿ ਕਥੇ ॥
127.e: Durga and demons sounded their trumpets, in the remarkable war.

127.g: ਓਰੜ ਉਠੇ ਸੂਰਮੇ, ਆਇ ਡਾਹੇ ਮਥੇ ॥
127.e: The warriors arose in great numbers and have come to fight.

127.g: ਕਟ ਤੁਫੰਗੀ ਕੈਬਰੀ, ਦਲ ਗਾਹਿ ਨਿਕਥੇ ॥
127.e: They have come to tread through the forces in order to destroy (the enemy) with guns and arrows.

127.g: ਦੇਖਣਿ ਜੰਗ ਫਰੇਸਤੇ, ਅਸਮਾਨੋ ਲਥੇ ॥੫੧॥
127.e: The angels come down (to the earth) from the sky in order to see the war.51.

128.e: NARAAJ STANZA
He is Boundless and Primal Lord
He is endless and Indiscriminate from illusion.
He is Unfathomable and Destroyer of ailments
He is always with everyone.1.9.
His painting is marvelous
He is Indivisible and Destroyer on tyrants.
He is Indiscriminate from the very beginning and always sustains all.2.10.
He is Indivisible and hast terrible form
His Powerful Entity manifests all.
He is the death of death and is also always the Protector.3.11.
He is the Kind and Merciful entity and is ever the Sovereign of all.
He is boundless and fulfiller of the hopes of all
He is very far away and also very near.4.12.
He is Invisible but abides in inner meditation
He is always honoured by all.
He is Merciful and Eternal and is always honoured by all.5.13.
Therefore I meditate on Thee,
I meditate on Thee. PAUSE.
He is Unfathomable and destroyer of ailment
He is far beyond and supremely aborable.
He is worshipped by all in the past, present and future
He is always the Supreme Purusha. 6. 14.
Thou art of such attributes
Thou art of such attributes. PAUSE.
He, the merciful Lord performs actions of kindness
He is invincible and destroys illusions.
He is the Sustainer of people in past, present and future and is always compassionate towards all.7.15.
Therefore I repeat Thy Name,
I repeat Thy Name. PAUSE.
He is Supreme in remaining peaceful

128.g: ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਛੂ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
128.e: His form and mark cannot be comprehended at all.

128.g: ਕਹਾ ਬਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਕਉਨ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
128.e: Where doth He live? and in what guise He moves?

128.g: ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
128.e: What is His Name? and how is He called?

128.g: ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਬਖਾਨੋ, ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੬॥
128.e: What should I say? I lack expression.6.
He is Unborn, Unconquerable, Most beautiful and Supreme.
He is Unassailable, Indiscriminate, Formless and Unmatchable.
He is Incorrigible, Unfathomable, and Indestructible by enemies.
He, who rememberest Thee, Thou makest him griefless, He is the Deliverer and Merciful Lord.7.
He is ever the Giver of Power and intellect to all.
Salutations to Him, the Knower of the secrets of the people and their Lord.
He is unassailable, fearless, the Primal Entity and Boundless.
He is unassailable, invincible, Primal, non-dual and very difficult to realise.8.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The self-willed manmukhs read and recite; they are called Pandits-spiritual scholars.
But they are in love with duality, and they suffer in terrible pain.

128.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ. ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
128.e: Intoxicated with vice, they understand nothing at all. They are reincarnated, over and over again. ||1||

128.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
128.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who subdue their ego, and unite with the Lord.

128.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
128.e: They serve the Guru, and the Lord dwells within their minds; they intuitively drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

128.g: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
128.e: The Pandits read the Vedas, but they do not obtain the Lord's essence.
Intoxicated with Maya, they argue and debate.

128.g: ਅਗਿਆਨਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
128.e: The foolish intellectuals are forever in spiritual darkness. The Gurmukhs understand, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
The Indescribable is described only through the beauteous Word of the Shabad.
Through the Guru's Teachings, the Truth becomes pleasing to the mind.

128.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
128.e: Those who speak of the truest of the true, day and night-their minds are imbued with the Truth. ||3||

128.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
128.e: Those who are attuned to Truth, love the Truth.
The Lord Himself bestows this gift; He shall not take it back.

128.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
128.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True Lord is known forever; meeting the True One, peace is found. ||4||

128.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ; ਤਿਨਾ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
128.e: The filth of fraud and falsehood does not stick to those who,
By Guru's Grace, remain awake and aware, night and day.

128.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
128.e: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; their light merges into the Light. ||5||

128.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
128.e: They read about the three qualities, but they do not know the essential reality of the Lord.
They forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all, and they do not recognize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

128.g: ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪੇ. ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
128.e: They are engrossed in emotional attachment; they do not understand anything at all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. ||6||
The Vedas proclaim that Maya is of three qualities.
The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, do not understand.

128.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ, ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
128.e: They read of the three qualities, but they do not know the One Lord. Without understanding, they obtain only pain and suffering. ||7||

128.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
128.e: When it pleases the Lord, He unites us with Himself.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, skepticism and suffering are dispelled.

128.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੦॥੩੧॥
128.e: O Nanak, True is the Greatness of the Name. Believing in the Name, peace is obtained. ||8||30||31||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The Lord Himself is Unmanifest and Unrelated; He is Manifest and Related as well.
Those who recognize this essential reality are the true Pandits, the spiritual scholars.

128.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
128.e: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well, when they enshrine the Lord's Name in the mind. ||1||

128.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ. ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
128.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who taste the essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

128.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
128.e: Those who taste this essence of the Lord are the pure, immaculate beings. They meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Those who reflect upon the Shabad are beyond karma.
They subdue their ego, and find the essence of wisdom, deep within their being.

128.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
128.e: They obtain the nine treasures of the wealth of the Naam. Rising above the three qualities, they merge into the Lord. ||2||
Those who act in ego do not go beyond karma.
It is only by Guru's Grace that one is rid of ego.

128.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
128.e: Those who have discriminating minds, continually examine their own selves. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they sing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||3||
The Lord is the most pure and sublime Ocean.
The Saintly Gurmukhs continually peck at the Naam, like swans pecking at pearls in the ocean.

128.g: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
128.e: They bathe in it continually, day and night, and the filth of ego is washed away. ||4||
The pure swans, with love and affection,
Dwell in the Ocean of the Lord, and subdue their ego.

129.e: Thou art of Unlimited brilliance and Thy Light hath illumined the world
Thou art Primal, Unassailable, Fearless and Indestructible.
Thou art the Supreme Essence and enlightener of the path of subtle Truth
Thou art Primal entity, Indivisible and Unattached.5.25.
Thou art Primal, fearless and Unfathomable Entity
He is far beyond, superb and supreme.
He is the destroyer of ghosts since ancient times and always abides with all.8.16.
The assembly is mighty and indivisible, Thy rule is fearless.
The flame of Thy fire is illumined like the row of lamps.9.17.
The eyes of the Merciful and Kind Lord humiliate the arrows of Cupaid.
Thou art wearing such crown on Thy head which debases the pride of sum.10.18.
Thy wide and red eyes destroy the pride of Cupid.
The brilliance of the flame of Thy fire puzzles brightness of Thy Kingdom.11.19
The illumination of the flame of Thy fire puzzles brightness of Thy Kingdom.
Even Durga praises the brilliance of that conquering light.12.20.
TRIBHANGI STANZA : BY THY GRACE

129.g: ਅਨਕਾਦ ਸਰੂਪੰ, ਅਮਿਤ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ; ਅਚਲ ਸਰੂਪੰ ਬਿਸੁ ਕਰਣੰ ॥
129.e: He is without distress from the very beginning, Master of Unlimited wealth, an immovable Entity and Creator of the Universe.

129.g: ਜਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ, ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਸੰ, ਅਮਿਤ ਅਗਾਸੰ ਸਰਬ ਭਰਣੰ ॥
129.e: There is illumination of His Light in the world He is indestructible from the very beginning  He, of Boundless Heaven, is the Sustainer of all.

129.g: ਅਨਗੰਜ ਅਕਾਲੰ, ਬਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੰ, ਦੀਨ ਦਿਆਲੰ ਸੁਭ ਕਰਣੰ ॥
129.e: He is Invincible, Deathless, Sustainer of the Universe, Merciful Lord of the lowely and Performer of Good actions.

129.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪੰ, ਅਨਹਦ ਰੂਪੰ, ਅਮਿਤ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ, ਤਵ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੧॥੨੧॥
129.e: He is Blissful Entity, and Unlimited Entity of Boundless wealth, I am in Thy refuge.1.21.

129.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਭਰਣੰ, ਜਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਰਣੰ, ਅਧਰਣ ਧਰਣੰ ਸਿਸਟ ਕਰੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art the Sustainer of the Universe, the Creator of the world, the Support of the helpless and the author of macrocosm.

129.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪੀ, ਅਨਹਦ ਰੂਪੀ, ਅਮਿਤ ਬਿਭੂਤੀ ਤੇਜ ਬਰੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art Blissful and Unlimited Entity, of Unlimited wealth and of Supreme magnificence.

129.g: ਅਨਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੰ, ਸਭ ਜਗ ਥਾਪੰ, ਅਲਖ ਅਤਾਪੰ ਬਿਸੁ ਕਰੰ ॥
129.e: Thy Glory is indivisible, Thou art the establisher of the whole world, Incomprehensible, without suffering and Creator of the world.

129.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ, ਤੇਜ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ, ਸਰਬ ਉਦਾਸੀ, ਏਕ ਹਰੰ ॥੨॥੨੨॥
129.e: Thou art Non-dual, indestructible, Illuminator of Thy Light, Detached from all and the only Lord.2.22.

129.g: ਅਨਖੰਡ ਅਮੰਡੰ, ਤੇਜ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੰ, ਜੋਤਿ ਉਦੰਡੰ ਅਮਿਤ ਮਤੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art indivisible, Unestablished, of Supreme Splendour and Light, and of Boundless intellect.

129.g: ਅਨਭੈ ਅਨਗਾਧੰ, ਅਲਖ ਅਬਾਧੰ, ਬਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਧੰ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art Fearless, Unfathomable, Incomprehensible, Unttached, Keeper of the Universe under discipline and of infinite movement.

129.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪੀ, ਅਨਹਦ ਰੂਪੀ, ਅਚਲ ਬਿਭੂਤੀ ਭਵ ਤਰਣੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art Blissful and Unlimited Entity, of stable wealth and the causer of swimming across the dreadful world-ocean.

129.g: ਅਨਗਾਧਿ ਅਬਾਧੰ, ਜਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਧੰ, ਸਰਬ ਅਰਾਧੰ, ਤਵ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੩॥੨੩॥
129.e: Thou art the unfathomable, Unattached, Keeper of the world under discipline and meditated upon by all I am in Thy refuge.3.23.

129.g: ਅਕਲੰਕ ਅਬਾਧੰ, ਬਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਧੰ, ਜਗਤ ਅਰਾਧੰ ਭਵ ਨਾਸੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art Unblemished, Unattached, Keeper of the Universe under discipline, remembered by the world and destroyer of fear.

129.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਭਰਣੰ, ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣੰ, ਪਤਤ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਸਭ ਸਾਥੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art the Sustainer of the universe, destroyer of sins, redeemer of the sinners and be comrade of all.

129.g: ਅਨਾਥਨ ਨਾਥੇ, ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਗਾਥੇ, ਅਮਿਤ ਅਨਾਥੇ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art the Master of the masterless, Uncreated, Undescribed, Unlimited, Patronless and remover of sufferings.

129.g: ਅਗੰਜ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ, ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ, ਜਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਸੀ, ਤੁਯ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
129.e: Thou art Invincible, Indestructible, Illuminator of Light, the destroyer of the world, I am in Thy refuge.4.24.
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The whole world is engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.
Those who are controlled by the three qualities are attached to Maya.

129.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ; ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
129.e: By Guru's Grace, a few come to understand; they center their consciousness in the fourth state. ||1||

129.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ. ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
129.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away their emotional attachment to Maya, through the Shabad.

129.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ. ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ. ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
129.e: Those who burn away this attachment to Maya, and focus their consciousness on the Lord are honored in the True Court, and the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
The source, the root, of the gods and goddesses is Maya.
For them, the Simritees and the Shaastras were composed.

129.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ; ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
129.e: Sexual desire and anger are diffused throughout the universe. Coming and going, people suffer in pain. ||2||

129.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ; ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
129.e: The jewel of spiritual wisdom was placed within the universe.
By Guru's Grace, it is enshrined within the mind.

129.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
129.e: Celibacy, chastity, self-discipline and the practice of truthfulness are obtained from the Perfect Guru, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
In this world of her parents' home, the soul-bride has been deluded by doubt.
Attached to duality, she later comes to regret it.

129.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ; ਸੁਖੁ. .ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
129.e: She forfeits both this world and the next, and even in her dreams, she does not find peace. ||4||
The soul-bride who remembers her Husband Lord in this world,
by Guru's Grace, sees Him close at hand.

129.g: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ, ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
129.e: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||
Blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who find the True Guru;
through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they burn their love of duality.

129.g: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
129.e: The One Lord is permeating and pervading deep within the heart. Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

129.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
129.e: Those who do not serve the True Guru-why did they even come into this world?
Cursed are their lives; they have uselessly wasted this human life.

129.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
129.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam. Without the Naam, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||
The One who created the Universe, He alone knows it.
He unites with Himself those who realize the Shabad.

129.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
129.e: O Nanak, they alone receive the Naam, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is recorded. ||8||1||32||33||
TRIBHANGI STANZA

129.g: ਅਖੰਡ ਉਦਾਸੀ, ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ; ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਕਰੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art Indivisible, Unattached, the Supreme Enlightener, Primal, Indestructible and Creator of the universe.

129.g: ਜਗਤਾਵਲ ਕਰਤਾ, ਜਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਰਤਾ; ਸਭ ਜਗ ਭਰਤਾ ਸਿਧ ਭਰੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art the creator, destroyer and Sustainer of the world and the Treasure of Powers.

129.g: ਅਛੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ, ਤੇਜ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ; ਰੂਪ ਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਛਿਤੰ ॥
129.e: Thou art Unassailable, Indestructible, Illuminator of the Light, and the outlay of beauty of all the earth.

129.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪੀ, ਅਨਹਦ ਰੂਪੀ; ਅਲਖ ਬਿਭੂਤੀ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤੰ ॥੬॥੨੬॥
129.e: Thou art Blissful and Unlimited Entity, Incomprehensible wealth and of Unlimited movement.6.26.
Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
The Primal Being is Himself remote and beyond.
He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.

129.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
129.e: The One Lord is pervading in all; those who become Gurmukh are honored. ||1||

129.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
129.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

129.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
129.e: Day and night, they are in love with the True Word of the Shabad. They obtain their home in the Ocean of the Lord. ||5||

129.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
129.e: The self-willed manmukhs shall always be filthy cranes, smeared with the filth of ego.

129.g: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ; ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
129.e: They may bathe, but their filth is not removed.

129.g: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
129.e: One who dies while yet alive, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is rid of this filth of ego. ||6||
The Priceless Jewel is found, in the home of one's own being,
when one listens to the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect True Guru.

129.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ; ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
129.e: By Guru's Grace, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled; I have come to recognize the Divine Light within my own heart. ||7||
The Lord Himself creates, and He Himself beholds.
Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.

129.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
129.e: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the heart; by Guru's Grace, it is obtained. ||8||31||32||

130.g: ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਿਹ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
130.e: Thou art without affection, colour, mark and form.

130.g: ਰੰਕ ਭਯੋ ਰਾਵਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
130.e: Somewhere Thou art pauper, somewhere chieftain and somwerher king.

130.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਰਤਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੂਪੰ ॥੭॥੨੭॥
130.e: Somewhere Thou art ocean, somewhere stream and somewhere a well.7.27.

130.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
130.e: CHAPAI STANZA

130.g: ਬੇਦ ਭੇਦ ਨਹੀ ਲਖੈ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
130.e: The Vedas and even Brahma do not know the secret of Brahman.

130.g: ਬਿਆਸ ਪਰਾਸੁਰ ਸੁਕ ਸਨਾਦਿ; ਸਿਵ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
130.e: Vyas, Parashar, Sukhedev, Sanak etc., and Shiva do not know His Limits.

130.g: ਸਨਤਿ ਕੁਆਰ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਰਬ; ਜਉ ਸਮਾ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
130.e: Sanat Kumar, Sanak etc., all of them do not comprehend the time.

130.g: ਲਖ ਲਖਮੀ ਲਖ ਬਿਸਨ ਕਿਸਨ; ਕਈ ਨੇਤ ਬਤਾਵਹਿ ॥
130.e: Lakhs of Lakshmis and Vishnus and many Krishnas call Him “NETI”.

130.g: ਅਸੰਭ ਰੂਪ ਅਨਭੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ; ਅਤਿ ਬਲਿਸਟ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਕਰਣ ॥
130.e: He is an Unborn Entity, His Glory is manifested through knowledge, He is most powerful and cause of the creation of water and land.

130.g: ਅਚੁਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਮਿਤ, ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ, ਤਵ ਸਰਣ ॥੧॥੩੨॥
130.e: He is imperishable, boundless, Non-dual, Unlimited and the Transcendent Lord, I am in Thy Refuge. 1 .32

130.g: ਅਚੁਤ ਅਭੈ ਅਭੇਦ ਅਮਿਤ; ਆਖੰਡ ਅਤੁਲ ਬਲ ॥
130.e: He is imperishable, boundless, Non-dual, Unlimited, Indivisible, and hath Unweighable Strenght.

130.g: ਅਟਲ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਖੈ; ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦਲ ॥
130.e: He is Eternal, Infinite, Beginningless, Indivisible, and Master of Mighty forces.

130.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਅਮਿਤ ਅਨਤੋਲ ਅਭੂ; ਅਨਭੇਦ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
130.e: He is Limits Boundless, Unweighable, elementless, indiscriminated and Invincible.

130.g: ਅਨਬਿਕਾਰ ਆਤਮ ਸਰੂਪ; ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਨ ਰੰਜਨ ॥
130.e: He is Spiritual Entity without vices, pleasing to gods, men and sages.

130.g: ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਰੂਪ ਅਨਭੈ ਸਦਾ; ਮੁਨ ਜਨ ਗਨ ਬੰਦਤ ਚਰਨ ॥
130.e: He is and Entity without vices, always Fearless, the assemblies of sages and men bow at His Feet.

130.g: ਭਵ ਭਰਨ ਕਰਨ, ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਹਰਨ; ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ॥੨॥੩੩॥
130.e: He pervades the world, removes the sufferings and blemishes, Supremely Glorious and effacer of illusions and fears.2.33.

130.g: ਕਲਸ ॥
ਆਜਾਨੁ ਬਾਹੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕਰ ਧਰਣੰ ॥
130.e: Thou hast long arms uptil Thy Kness, thou holdest the bow in Thy hand.

130.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗ ਜੋਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਰਣੰ ॥
130.e: Thou hast unlimited light, Thou art the illuminator of light in the world.

130.g: ਖੜਗ ਪਾਣ ਖਲ ਦਲ ਬਲ ਹਰਣੰ ॥
130.e: Thou art the bearer of sword in Thy hand and remover of the strength of the forces of foolish tyrants.

130.g: ਮਹਾਬਾਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਭਰਣੰ ॥੯॥੨੯॥
130.e: Thou art the Most Powerful and Sustainer of the Universe.9.29.

130.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
130.e: TRIBHANGI STANZA

130.g: ਖਲ ਦਲ ਬਲ ਹਰਣੰ, ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਰਣੰ; ਅਸਰਣ ਸਰਣੰ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤੰ ॥
130.e: Thou art the remover of the strength of the forces of foolish tyrants and causest fear fear amongst them Thou art the Keeper of patroness under Thy refuge and hast Unlimited movement.

130.g: ਚੰਚਲ ਚਖ ਚਾਰਣ, ਮਛ ਬਿਡਾਰਣ; ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਣ ਅਮਿਤ ਮਤੰ ॥
130.e: Thy mercurial eyes even undo the movement of the fishes Thou art the destroyer of sins and hast Unlimited intellect.

130.g: ਆਜਾਨ ਸੁ ਬਾਹੰ, ਸਾਹਨ ਸਾਹੰ; ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਾਹੰ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ॥
130.e: Thou hast long arms upto the Knees and art the king of kings, Thy Praise Pervades all likewise.

130.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਬਨ ਰਹਿਤਾ, ਬਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਨਿ ਕਹਿਤਾ; ਖਲ ਦਲਿ ਦਹਿਤਾ ਸੁ ਨਰਿ ਸਹੀ ॥੧੦॥੩੦॥
130.e: Thou abidest in waters, on land and in forests, Thou art praised by forest and blades of grass O Supreme Purusha! Thou art the consumer of the forces of foolish tyrants.10.30.

130.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
130.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

130.g: ਨਮੋ ਨਾਥ ਨ੍ਰਿਦਾਇਕ; ਨਮੋ ਨਿਮ ਰੂਪ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ॥
130.e: Salutation to Him the Merciful Donor Lord! Salutation to Him, the Transcendent and Modest Lord!

130.g: ਅਗੰਜਾਣ ਅਗੰਜਣ ਅਭੰਜ; ਅਨਭੇਦ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
130.e: The Destroyer of Indestructible, Invincible, Indiscriminate and Imperishable Lord.

130.g: ਅਛੈ ਅਖੈ ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਭੈ; ਅਨਭਿਜ ਅਭੇਦਨ ॥
130.e: Inassailable, Incorruptible, Devoid of vices, Fearless, unattached and Undistinguishable Lord.

130.g: ਅਖੈਦਾਨ ਖੇਦਨ ਅਖਿਜ; ਅਨਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਛੇਦਨ ॥
130.e: Affliction of the Unafflicted, Blissful without blemish and the Unassailable.

130.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
130.e: CHHAPAI STANZA : BY THY GRACE

130.g: ਮੁਖ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਰ ਲਸਤ ਜੋਤਿ; ਉਦੋਤ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤਿ ॥
130.e: On his facial sphere glistens the brilliant light of infinite movement.

130.g: ਜਟਤ ਜੋਤ ਜਗਮਗਤ ਲਜਤ; ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਿਖਤਿ ਪਤਿ ॥
130.e: Such is the setting and illumination of that Light that lakhs and millions of moon feel shy before it.

130.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤੀ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ; ਚਉਚਕ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
130.e: He carries the four corners of the world on His hand and thus the universal monarchs are amazed.

130.g: ਪਦਮ ਨਾਥ ਪਦਮਾਛ ਨਵਲ, ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਰਿਹਰਿ ॥
130.e: The Ever-new Lord with lotus-eyes, He is the Lord of men.

130.g: ਕਾਲਖ ਬਿਹੰਡਣ, ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣ, ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਨ ਬੰਦਤ ਚਰਣ ॥
130.e: Remover of darkness and destroyer of sins, all the gods, men and sages bow at His Feet.

130.g: ਖੰਡਣ ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਣ ਅਭੈ, ਨਮੋ, ਨਾਥ ਭਉ ਭੈ ਹਰਣ ॥੩॥੩੪॥
130.e: He is breaker of the unbreakable He is the establisher on the Fearless position Salutation to Thee, O Lord, the remover of fear.3.34.

130.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ. ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
130.e: He has no form or shape; He is seen within each and every heart. The Gurmukh comes to know the unknowable. ||1||Pause||

130.g: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
130.e: You are God, Kind and Merciful.

130.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
130.e: Without You, there is no other at all.

130.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
130.e: When the Guru showers His Grace upon us, He blesses us with the Naam; through the Naam, we merge in the Naam. ||2||

130.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
130.e: You Yourself are the True Creator Lord.

130.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
130.e: Your treasures are overflowing with devotional worship.

130.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
130.e: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. Their minds are enraptured, and they easily and intuitively enter into Samaadhi. ||3||

130.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
130.e: Night and day, I sing Your Glorious Praises, God.

130.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
130.e: I praise You, O my Beloved.

130.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਾ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
130.e: Without You, there is no other for me to seek out. It is only by Guru's Grace that You are found. ||4||

130.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
130.e: The limits of the Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord cannot be found.

130.g: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤੂੰ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
130.e: Bestowing Your Mercy, You merge us into Yourself.

130.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
130.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Lord. Serving the Shabad, peace is found. ||5||

130.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
130.e: Praiseworthy is the tongue which sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

130.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ; ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
130.e: Praising the Naam, one becomes pleasing to the True One.

130.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
130.e: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love. Meeting the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||6||

130.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
130.e: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego.

130.g: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ; ਸਭ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
130.e: They lose their whole lives in the gamble.

130.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
130.e: Within is the terrible darkness of greed, and so they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

130.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
130.e: The Creator Himself bestows Glory

130.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ; ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
130.e: On those whom He Himself has so pre-destined.

130.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੪॥
130.e: O Nanak, they receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find peace. ||8||1||34||

130.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
130.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, First House:

130.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ; ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥
130.e: The Unseen Lord is within, but He cannot be seen.

130.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ; ਲੈ ਗੁਝਾ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
130.e: He has taken the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and He keeps it well concealed.

130.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ. ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
130.e: The Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord is the highest of all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known. ||1||

130.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
130.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who chant the Naam, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

130.g: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਧਾਰੇ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
130.e: The Beloved Saints were established by the True Lord. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained. ||1||Pause||

130.g: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ; ਜਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਦੇ ॥
130.e: The One who is sought by the Siddhas and the seekers,

130.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ॥
130.e: upon whom Brahma and Indra meditate within their hearts,

130.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
130.e: whom the three hundred thirty million demi-gods search for-meeting the Guru, one comes to sing His Praises within the heart. ||2||

130.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਪੇ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
130.e: Twenty-four hours a day, the wind breathes Your Name.

130.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ; ਪਾਇਕ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
130.e: The earth is Your servant, a slave at Your Feet.

130.g: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
130.e: In the four sources of creation, and in all speech, You dwell. You are dear to the minds of all. ||3||

130.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
130.e: The True Lord and Master is known to the Gurmukhs.

130.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
130.e: He is realized through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru.

130.g: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਅਘਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
130.e: Those who drink it in are satisfied. Through the Truest of the True, they are fulfilled. ||4||

130.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਾ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
130.e: In the home of their own beings, they are peacefully and comfortably at ease.

130.g: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥
130.e: They are blissful, enjoying pleasures, and eternally joyful.

130.g: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
130.e: They are wealthy, and the greatest kings; they center their minds on the Guru's Feet. ||5||

130.g: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ; ਤੈਂ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
130.e: First, You created nourishment;

130.g: ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ; ਤੈਂ ਜੰਤੁ ਉਪਾਹਾ ॥
130.e: then, You created the living beings.

130.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
130.e: There is no other Giver as Great as You, O my Lord and Master. None approach or equal You. ||6||

130.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਠਾ; ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
130.e: Those who are pleasing to You meditate on You.

130.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
130.e: They practice the Mantra of the Holy.

130.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਦਰਗਹ ਠਾਕ, ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
130.e: They themselves swim across, and they save all their ancestors and families as well. In the Court of the Lord, they meet with no obstruction. ||7||

130.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
130.e: TRIBHANGI STANZA

130.g: ਸਰਤਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੂਪੰ, ਸਮੁਦ ਸਰੂਪੰ; ਅਲਖ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤੰ ॥
130.e: Somewhere Thou art in the form of stream, somewhere well and somewhere Ocean Thou art of Incomprehensible wealth and Unlimited movement.

130.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ, ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ; ਤੇਜ ਸੁਰਾਸੀ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
130.e: Thou art Non-dual, Indestructible, Illuminator of thy light, the outlay of splendour and Creator of the Uncreated.

130.g: ਜਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ, ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਖੰ; ਅਮਿਤ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ॥
130.e: Thou art without form and mark, Thou art Incomprehensible, Guiseless, Unlimited, Unblemished, manifesting all forms.

130.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣੰ, ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਣੰ; ਅਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਣੰ ਏਕ ਦਈ ॥੮॥੨੮॥
130.e: Thou art the remover of sins, the redeemer of sinners and the only Motivator of keeping the patronless under refuge.8.28.

130.g: ਕਲਸ ॥
ਅਤਿ ਬਲਿਸਟ, ਦਲ ਦੁਸਟ ਨਿਕੰਦਨ ॥
130.e: Thou art Most Powerful and Destroyer of the forces of the tyrants.

130.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ, ਸਗਲ ਜਗ ਬੰਦਨ ॥
130.e: Thy Glory is unlimited and all the world bows before Thee.

130.g: ਸੋਹਤ, ਚਾਰੁ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰ ਚੰਦਨ ॥
130.e: The beautiful painting appears good-looking like the moon.

130.g: ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਣ, ਦੁਸਟ ਦਲ ਦੰਡਨ ॥੧੧॥੩੧॥
130.e: Thou art the Destroyer of sins Punisher of the forces of the tyrants.11.31.

131.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
131.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

131.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
131.e: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?

131.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ; ਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
131.e: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.

131.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ. ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
131.e: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||

131.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
131.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body are pleased with You.

131.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ. ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
131.e: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You. ||1||Pause||

131.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
131.e: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,

131.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
131.e: comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.

131.g: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ; ਤੂੰਹੈ; ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
131.e: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||

131.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ; ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
131.e: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.

131.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ; ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
131.e: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.

131.g: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ. ਰਾਖੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
131.e: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3||

131.g: ਆਜਾਨ ਬਾਹੁ; ਸਾਰੰਗਧਰ, ਖੜਗਪਾਣ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਦਲਣ ॥
131.e: The Lord with long arms upto knees, wearer of the bow and the sword for vanquishing the enemies.

131.g: ਨਰ ਵਰ ਨਰੇਸ ਨਾਇਕ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਣਿ, ਨਮੋ, ਨਵਲ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਰਵਣਿ ॥੪॥੩੫॥
131.e: The Sovereign of good people, hero and Master of armies Salutation to Him who Pervades water and lands.4.35.

131.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ, ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣ, ਦੁਰਮਤ ਹੰਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਖੰਡਣ ॥
131.e: He is the Merciful Lord of the lowly, destroyer of suffering, and vicious intellect and the refuter of suffering.

131.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਨ ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਦਨ, ਮੂਰਤ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਡਨ ॥
131.e: He is greatly peaceful, captivator of the heart, alluring like Cupid and Creator of the world.

131.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜ ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਖੈ, ਆਭੰਜ ਅਮਿਤ ਬਲ ॥
131.e: He is the Lord of Limitless Glory, without vices, indestructible, Invincible having Boundless Power.

131.g: ਨਿਰਭੰਜ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ, ਨਿਰਜੁਰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜਲ ਥਲ ॥
131.e: He is Unbreakable, without fear and enmity, without malice and the monarch of waters and lands.

131.g: ਅਛੈ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਛੂ ਅਛਿਤ, ਅਛੈ ਅਛਾਨ ਅਛਰ ॥
131.e: He is unassailable Entity, Untouchable, Eternal, Imperishable, Unhidden and without deception.

131.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਦ੍ਵਿਯ ਅਮਰ, ਅਭਿਬੰਦਤ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਅਸੁਰ ॥੫॥੩੬॥
131.e: He is Non-dual Entity, Unique, Immortal and is deeply abored by gods, men and demons.5.36.

131.g: ਕੁਲ ਕਲੰਕ ਕਰਿ ਹੀਨ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਕਰ ॥
131.e: He is the ocean and source of Mercy and remover of blemishes from all.

131.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀ ਸੂਰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਰ ॥
131.e: He is the cause of causes, Powerful, Merciful Entity and prop of creation.

131.g: ਕਾਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਰ ਹੀਨ; ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
131.e: He is the destroyer of the actions of death and none knows His doning.

131.g: ਕਹਾ ਕਹੈ, ਕਹਿ ਕਰੈ, ਕਹਾ ਕਾਲਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
131.e: What doth he say and do? What facts doth reveal Him?

131.g: ਕੰਜਲਕ ਨੈਨ ਕੰਬੂ ਗ੍ਰੀਵਹਿ, ਕਟਿ ਕੇਹਰ ਕੁੰਜਰ ਗਵਨ ॥
131.e: His eyes are like lotus, neck like conchshell, waist like lion and gait like elephant.

131.g: ਕਦਲੀ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਕਰਪੂਰ ਗਤ, ਬਿਨ ਅਕਾਲ, ਦੁਜੋ ਕਵਨ ॥੬॥੩੭॥
131.e: Legs like banana, swiftness like deer and fragrance like camphor, O non-temporal Lord! Who else can be without thee with such attributes?6.37.

131.g: ਅਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਬੈ; ਅਨਭੂਤ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
131.e: He is an Incomprehensible Entity, accountless, valueless, elementless and Unbreakable.

131.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਜੈ; ਅਨਗਾਧ ਅਗੰਜਨ ॥
131.e: He is the Primal Purusha, without vices, Unconquerable, Unfathomable and Invincible.

131.g: ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਜੁਰ ਸਰੂਪ; ਨਿਰ ਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ॥
131.e: He is without vices, Unmalicious Entity, Unblemished and transcendent.

131.g: ਅਭੰਜਾਨ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਨਭੇਦ; ਅਨਭੂਤ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
131.e: He is the Breaker of the Unbreakable, Indiscriminate, Elementless and Infrangible.

131.g: ਸਾਹਾਨ ਸਾਹ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਮਤ; ਬਡ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਡਵੈ ਬਖਤ ॥
131.e: He is the king of kings, Beautiful, of propitious intellect, of handsome countenance and Most Fortunate.

131.g: ਕੋਟਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਭੂਅ ਭਾਨ ਜਿਮ; ਤਪਤ ਤੇਜ ਇਸਥਿਤ ਤਖਤ ॥੭॥੩੮॥
131.e: He is seated on His throne with the effulgence of millions of earthly suns.7.38.

131.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
131.e: CHHAPAI STANZA : BY THY GRACE

131.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਚਾਰ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ; ਚਉਕੁੰਟ ਚਵਗਨ ॥
131.e: Visualizing the Beauty of the Universal monarch all the four directions seem stunned.

131.g: ਕੋਟ ਸੂਰ ਸਮ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜ ਨਹੀ; ਦੂਨ ਚਵਗਨ ॥
131.e: He hath the light of millions of suns, nay, even the light is two four times.

131.g: ਕੋਟ ਚੰਦ ਚਕ ਪਰੈ; ਤੁਲ ਨਹੀ ਤੇਜ ਬਿਚਾਰਤ ॥
131.e: A million moons are astonished to fine their light very dim as compared to His Light.

131.g: ਬਿਆਸ ਪਰਾਸਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਭੇਦ ਨਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਾਰਤ ॥
131.e: Vyas, Parshar, Brahma and Vedas cannot describe His mystery.

131.g: ਸਾਹਾਨ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੁਘਰਿ; ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਬਲ ॥
131.e: He is the king of kings, the Lord of Wisdom, Supremely Glorious, Beautiful and Powerful.

131.g: ਰਾਜਾਨ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਬਲ; ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜ ਅਛੈ ਅਛਲ ॥੮॥੩੯॥
131.e: He is the monarch of monarchs, the Lord of the Mighty having Unlimited Splendour, Unassailable and without deceprion.8.39.

131.g: ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ; ਤੂੰ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
131.e: You are so Great! You are the Highest of the High!

131.g: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ; ਅਤਿ ਮੂਚੋ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
131.e: You are Infinite, You are Everything!

131.g: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੫॥
131.e: I am a sacrifice to You. Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||8||1||35||

131.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
131.e: KABIT : BY THY GRACE

131.g: ਗਹਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਸੋ ਅਗਾਹ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਗਾਈਅਤੁ; ਛੇਦਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ, ਸੋ ਅਛੇਦ ਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
131.e: He, who cannot be grasped, He is called Inaccessible and He, who cannot be assailed is recognized as unassailable.

131.g: ਗੰਜਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ, ਸੋ ਅਗੰਜ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਅਤੁ; ਭੰਜਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ, ਸੋ ਅਭੰਜ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
131.e: He who cannot be destroyed is known as indestructible and He, who cannot be divided in considered as indivisible.

131.g: ਸਾਧਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ, ਸੋ ਅਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਰ; ਛਲਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ, ਸੋ ਅਛਲ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
131.e: He, who cannot be disciplined, may be called incorrigible and He, who cannot be deceived is considered as Undeceivable.

131.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਸੋ ਅਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨ; ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਸੋ ਅਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੧॥੪੦॥
131.e: He, who is without the impact of mantras (incantations) may be considered as Unspellable and He, who is without the impact of Yantras (mystical diagrams) may be known as Unmagical.1.40.

131.g: ਜਾਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਸੋ ਅਜਾਤ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨ ਜੀਅ; ਪਾਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਸੋ ਅਪਾਤ ਕੈ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: Consider Him as casteless in Thy mind, Who is devoid of caste, call Him lineageless who is devoid of lineage.

131.g: ਭੇਦ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਅਭੇਦ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਭਾਖੀਅਤੁ ਛੇਦ︀ਯੋ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਛੇਦ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He may be called as Indiscriminate, who is devoid of discriminations He, who cannot be assailed, may be spoken as Unassailable.

131.g: ਖੰਡਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ, ਸੋ ਅਖੰਡ ਜੂ ਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਖਿਆਲ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਗਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He, who cannot be divided, may be considered as indivisible He, who cannot be grasped in thought, always makes us sorrowful.

131.g: ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਅਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਪੀਅਤੁ; ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਤਾ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥੪੧॥
131.e: He, who is without the impact of mystical diagrams, may be muttered as Unmagical He who doth not come in contemplation, may be contemplated upon and meditated.2.41.

131.g: ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰੀਪਤਿ ਛੈਲ ਰੂਪ ਛਿਤਨਾਥ; ਛੌਣੀ ਕਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਰ ਛਤ੍ਰੀਪਤ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He is sung as the canopied monarch, the Lord of canopies, a winsome entity, the Master and Creator of the earth and the superb support.

131.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਨਾਥ ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਬੇਦਨਾਥ ਬਾਲਾਕਰ; ਬਾਜੀਗਰਿ ਬਾਨਧਾਰੀ ਬੰਧ ਨ ਬਤਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He is the Lord Sustainer of the Universe, Master of Vedas depicted as Lord having discipline.

131.g: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਦੂਧਾਧਾਰੀ, ਬਿਦਿਆਧਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ; ਧਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਲਗਾਵੈ, ਨੈਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: The Yogis performing Neoli Karma (cleansing of intestines), those subsisting only on milk, learned and celibates, all meditate upon Him, but without an iota of getting His comprehension.

131.g: ਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਾਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਮਹਾਰਾਜਾ ਐਸੋ ਰਾਜ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਉਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਉਨ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
131.e: He is the king of kings and emperor of emperors, Who else should be meditated upon, forsaking such a Supreme monarch?.3.42.

131.g: ਜੁਧ ਕੇ ਜਿਤਈਆ, ਰੰਗ ਭੂਮ ਕੇ ਭਵਈਆ; ਭਾਰ ਭੂਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਟਈਆ, ਨਾਥ ਤੀਨ ਲੋਕ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: His Name is sung in all the three worlds, who is the conqueror of wars, the mover on the stage and the effacer of the burden of earth.

131.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਤਨਈਆ ਹੈ ਨ ਮਈਆ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਈਆ ਕੋਊ; ਛਉਨੀ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਛਈਆ ਛੋਡ, ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He hath neither a son, nor mother non brother He is the Support of the earth, forsaking such Lord whom should we love?

131.g: ਸਾਧਨਾ ਸਧਈਆ, ਧੂਲ ਧਾਨੀ ਕੇ ਧੁਜਈਆ; ਧੋਮ ਧਾਰ ਕੇ ਧਰਈਆ, ਧਿਆਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: We should always meditate upon Him who is instrumental in all accomplishments, establisher of the earth and Support of the sky.

131.g: ਆਉ ਕੇ ਬਢਈਆ, ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਜਪਈਆ; ਅਉਰ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਈਆ ਛੋਡ, ਅਉਰ ਕਉਨ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੪॥੪੩॥
131.e: When should we meditate upon forsaking the Lord who prolongs the age of our life, who causes the Name to be repeated and all other works to be done?4.43.

131.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ, ਖੈਰ ਖੂਬੀ ਕੋ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ; ਗਜ ਗਾਜੀ ਕੋ ਗਜਿੰਦਾ, ਸੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੈ ਬਤਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He is called the creator, who completes all the errands, who gives the comfort and honour and who is the destroyer of warriors stout like elephants.

131.g: ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਚਲਿੰਦਾ, ਘਾਉ ਘਾਮ ਤੇ ਬਚਿੰਦਾ; ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛੈਨੀ ਕੇ ਛਲਿੰਦਾ, ਸੋ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He is the wielder of bow, the Protector from all types of afflictions, Deceiver of the universal monarchs and Donor of everything without asking. He should be worshipped with diligence.

131.g: ਜਰ ਕੇ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ, ਜਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਜਨਿੰਦਾ; ਜੋਤ ਜੇਬ ਕੋ ਗਜਿੰਦਾ, ਜਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
131.e: He is the Giver of wealth, Knower of life and honour and sorter of light and reputation His Praises should be sung.

131.g: ਦੋਖ ਕੇ ਦਲਿੰਦਾ, ਦੀਨ ਦਾਨਸ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ; ਦੋਖ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਦਲਿੰਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ, ਦੂਜੋ ਕਉਨ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੫॥੪੪॥
131.e: He is the effacer of blemishes, the giver of religious discipline and wisdom and the destroyer of vicious people. Whom else should we remember?5.44.

131.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
131.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
131.e: Who is liberated, and who is united?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
131.e: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ. ਕਉਣੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
131.e: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||

131.g: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਧਾ; ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
131.e: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?

131.g: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ; ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
131.e: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?

131.g: ਕਉਣ ਕਰਮ. ਕਉਣ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ; ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
131.e: Who is subject to karma, and who is beyond karma? Who chants the Name, and inspires others to chant it? ||2||

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ; ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.e: Who is happy, and who is sad?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ; ਕਉਣੁ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.e: Who, as sunmukh, turns toward the Guru, and who, as vaymukh, turns away from the Guru?

131.g: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ. ਕਉਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
131.e: How can one meet the Lord? How is one separated from Him? Who can reveal the way to me? ||3||

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
131.e: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
131.e: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ. ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
131.e: What is that lifestyle, by which we may come to meditate on the Supreme Lord? How may we sing the Kirtan of His Praises? ||4||

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
131.e: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
131.e: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.

131.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
131.e: Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows the Lord's Value. ||5||

131.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਾਧਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
131.e: Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
131.e: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ. ਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
131.e: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.e: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.e: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away from the Guru.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁਰੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
131.e: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. The Gurmukh reveals the way. ||7||

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖਰੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
131.e: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
131.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲ. ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
131.e: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||

131.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਬਣਤ, ਬਣਾਈ ਆਪੇ ॥
131.e: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.

131.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ, ਕਰਾਏ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
131.e: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.

131.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਅਨੰਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥੨॥੩੬॥
131.e: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shall merge into the One once again. ||9||2||36||

132.e: You pulled me out of the deep, dark well onto the dry ground.
Showering Your Mercy, You blessed Your servant with Your Glance of Grace.

132.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
132.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Immortal Lord. By speaking and hearing these Praises, they are not used up. ||4||
Here and hereafter, You are our Protector.

132.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
132.e: In the womb of the mother, You cherish and nurture the baby.

132.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
132.e: The fire of Maya does not affect those who are imbued with the Lord's Love; they sing His Glorious Praises. ||5||
What Praises of Yours can I chant and contemplate?

132.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
132.e: Deep within my mind and body, I behold Your Presence.

132.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ. ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
132.e: You are my Friend and Companion, my Lord and Master. Without You, I do not know any other at all. ||6||

132.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ; ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
132.e: O God, that one, unto whom You have given shelter,

132.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ; ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
132.e: is not touched by the hot winds.

132.g: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
132.e: O my Lord and Master, You are my Sanctuary, the Giver of peace. Chanting, meditating on You in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, You are revealed. ||7||
You are Exalted, Unfathomable, Infinite and Invaluable.

132.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੋਲਾ ॥
132.e: You are my True Lord and Master. I am Your servant and slave.

132.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ. ਸਾਚੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੩੭॥
132.e: You are the King, Your Sovereign Rule is True. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||8||3||37||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

132.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ; ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
132.e: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the mind is held steady. ||1||Pause||

132.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ; ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਭੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
132.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Divine Guru, one's fears are erased and dispelled. ||1||

132.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ; ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
132.e: Entering the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, how could anyone feel grief any longer? ||2||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
Continually, continuously, remember the Merciful Lord.
Never forget Him from your mind. ||Pause||
Join the Society of the Saints,

132.g: ਜਿਤੁ; ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
132.e: and you shall not have to go down the path of Death.

132.g: ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ; ਤੇਰੇ ਕੁਲਹਿ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
132.e: Take the Provisions of the Lord's Name with you, and no stain shall attach itself to your family. ||1||
Those who meditate on the Master
shall not be thrown down into hell.

132.g: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ. ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
132.e: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within their minds. ||2||
They alone are beautiful and attractive,
who abide in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

132.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੰਜਿਆ; ਸੇਈ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
132.e: Those who have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name-they alone are deep and thoughtful and vast. ||3||
Drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name,
and live by beholding the face of the Lord's servant.

132.g: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ. ਸਵਾਰਿ ਲੈ; ਨਿਤ ਪੂਜਹੁ. ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਵ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
132.e: Let all your affairs be resolved, by continually worshipping the Feet of the Guru. ||4||
He alone meditates on the Lord of the World,
Whom the Lord has made His Own.

132.g: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ; ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
132.e: He alone is a warrior, and he alone is the chosen one, upon whose forehead good destiny is recorded. ||5||
Within my mind, I meditate on God.
For me, this is like the enjoyment of princely pleasures.

132.g: ਮੰਦਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ; ਤਰੇ. ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
132.e: Evil does not well up within me, since I am saved, and dedicated to truthful actions. ||6||
I have enshrined the Creator within my mind;
I have obtained the fruits of life's rewards.

132.g: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ; ਤੇਰਾ. ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
132.e: If your Husband Lord is pleasing to your mind, then your married life shall be eternal. ||7||
I have obtained everlasting wealth;
I have found the Sanctuary of the Dispeller of fear.

132.g: ਲਾਇ ਅੰਚਲਿ. ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੪॥੩੮॥
132.e: Grasping hold of the hem of the Lord's robe, Nanak is saved. He has won the incomparable life. ||8||4||38||

132.g: ਸਾਲਿਸ ਸਹਿੰਦਾ, ਸਿਧਤਾਈ ਕੋ ਸਧਿੰਦਾ; ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਮੈ ਅਵਿੰਦਾ, ਏਕੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਥ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.e: He endures everything peacefully, He is engrossed in attainment of perfection, and He is the Only Lord who pervades in all limbs.

132.g: ਕਾਲਖ ਕਟਿੰਦਾ, ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਕੋ ਖੁਨਿੰਦਾ; ਗ੍ਰਬ ਗਾਫਲ ਗਿਲਿੰਦਾ, ਗੋਲ ਗੰਜਖ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.e: He is the remover of darkness, the masher of the Pathans of Khorasan, perisher of the egoists and idlers, He is described as the destroyer of people full of vices.

132.g: ਗਾਲਬ ਗਰੰਦਾ, ਜੀਤ ਤੇਜ ਕੇ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ; ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਪ ਕੇ ਚਲਿੰਦਾ ਛੋਡ, ਅਉਰ ਕਉਨ ਆਨੀਐ ॥
132.e: Whom should we worship except the Lord who is the Vanquisher of the Conquerors, giver of the Glory of conquest and who shoots the miraculous arrows from His bow.

132.g: ਸਤਤਾ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ, ਸਤਤਾਈ ਕੋ ਸੁਖਿੰਦਾ; ਕਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਛੋਡ, ਦੂਜਾ ਕਉਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੬॥੪੫॥
132.e: Whom else should we adore except him who is the Giver of Truth and Drier of falsehood and performer of Graceful acts?6.45.

132.g: ਜੋਤ ਕੋ ਜਗਿੰਦਾ, ਜੰਗੇ ਜਾਫਰੀ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਮਲਿੰਦਾ, ਪੈ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.e: He is the Enlightener of the light, Giver of the victory in wars and is known as the Destroyer of the murderer of the friends.

132.g: ਪਾਲਕ ਪੁਨਿੰਦਾ, ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਿੰਦਾ; ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਸੁਨਿੰਦਾ, ਪੈ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਤੇਜ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.e: He is the Sustainer, Giver of shelter, Far-sighted and knower, He is considered as listener of entertaining modes of music and full of blissful splendour.

132.g: ਜਾਪ ਕੇ ਜਪਿੰਦਾ, ਖੈਰ ਖੂਬੀ ਕੇ ਦਹਿੰਦਾ; ਖੂਨ ਮਾਫ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ, ਹੈ ਅਭਿਜ ਰੂਪ ਠਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.e: He is cause of the repetition of His Name and Giver of peace and hounour He is the forgiver of the blemishes and is considered as Unattached.

132.g: ਆਰਜਾ ਦਹਿੰਦਾ, ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਕੋ ਬਿਢੰਦਾ; ਦੁਸਟ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੇ ਦਲਿੰਦਾ ਛੋਡ, ਦੂਜੋ ਕੌਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੭॥੪੬॥
132.e: He is the prolonger of life, the Promoter of the entertainments of music and the masher of tyrants and malevolent, whom else should we then ADORE? 7.46.

132.g: ਆਤਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਜਾਹ, ਸਿਧਤਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਤਾਹ; ਬੁਧਤਾ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਜਾਹ, ਸਿਧਤਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
132.e: His Self is Supreme, He is Power-incarnate, His wealth is His Intellect and His Nature is that of a Redeemer.

132.g: ਰਾਗ ਭੀ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਤਾਹਿ, ਰੂਪ ਭੀ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਜਾਹਿ; ਅੰਗ ਭੀ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਤਾਹ, ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
132.e: He is without affection, colour, form and mark, still He hath beautiful limbs and His Nature is that of Love.

132.g: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ, ਪਰਮਤਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ; ਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ, ਬਿਭੂਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
132.e: His painting of the universe is Wonderful and Supremely Spotless He is friend of friends and Supreme Donor of wealth.

132.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ, ਕਿ ਸਾਹਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਹ ਹੈ; ਕਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ, ਕਿ ਰਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਉ ਹੈ ॥੮॥੪੭॥
132.e: He is the god of gods monarch of monarch He is the king of kings and chieftain of the chiefs.8.47.

133.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ; ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
133.e: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.

133.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਾ ॥
133.e: Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with our tongues.

133.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਆਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਗਣਾ ॥
133.e: Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.

133.g: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਣਾ ॥
133.e: Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.

133.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ; ਰਵਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਣਾ ॥
133.e: The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in the forests as well.

133.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਕਿਤੜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਣਾ ॥
133.e: Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!

133.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਣਾ ॥
133.e: Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੰਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਾ ॥
133.e: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is so thirsty!

133.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਾ ॥੨॥
133.e: I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||

133.g: ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੩॥
133.e: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||

133.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
133.e: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||

133.g: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੫॥
133.e: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||

133.g: ਸਭ ਛਡਾਈ ਖਸਮਿ ਆਪਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਠਰੂਰੇ ॥੬॥
133.e: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditating on the Lord. ||6||

133.g: ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ, ਤਪਾਵਸੋ; ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ. ਹੋਇ ਮੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
133.e: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed. ||7||
Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-present Lord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||
ARDH NARAAJ STANZA: BY THY GRACE
O Lord! Thou art Praiseworthy
Thou art the Banner of Honuor.
Thou art All-Pervading
Thou art the ONLY ONE.1.67.
Thou art in water
Thou art on Land.
Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

133.g: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਵੀਛੁੜੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
133.e: By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.

133.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ; ਥਕਿ ਆਏ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
133.e: We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the ten directions. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.

133.g: ਧੇਨੁ. ਦੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ; ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
133.e: Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.

133.g: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖ ਕੁਮਲਾਵਤੀ; ਉਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
133.e: Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹ. ਨ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਾਜਨੈ; ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
133.e: If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?

133.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ, ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ; ਭਠਿ ਨਗਰ ਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
133.e: Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those towns and villages are like burning furnaces.

133.g: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ; ਸਣੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਮ ॥
133.e: All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are all useless and vain.

133.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ; ਮੀਤ ਸਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
133.e: Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are like the Messenger of Death.

133.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
133.e: This is Nanak's prayer: "Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
133.e: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence". ||1||

133.g: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ; ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
133.e: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਲਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
133.e: She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attached to Maya, the deceitful one.

133.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਓਹੁ ॥
133.e: Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.

133.g: ਪਲਚਿ ਪਲਚਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੁਈ; ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
133.e: Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world is perishing.

133.g: ਇਕਸੁ. ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਗੈ. ਲਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਹਿ ॥
133.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.

133.g: ਦਯੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ. ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
133.e: Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.

133.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਣੀ. ਜੋ ਲਗੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
133.e: Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord.

134.g: ਭਾਦੁਇ. ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.

134.g: ਲਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ; ਕਾਰਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.

134.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ. ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਸਸੀ; ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਕਹਸਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.

134.g: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਨਿ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ; ਕਿਸੈ. ਨ ਦੇਨੀ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.

134.g: ਛਡਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ; ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.

134.g: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਪੇ; ਸਿਆਹਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.

134.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ; ਕਰਮਾ ਸੰਦੜਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.

134.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਚਰਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਤੁ ॥
134.e: Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.

134.g: ਸੇ ਭਾਦੁਇ. ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੭॥
134.e: Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਦਾਵਣਿ ਲਗਿਆ; ਕਿਸੈ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one can keep him in bondage.

134.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਉਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.

134.g: ਰੰਗ ਸਭੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ; ਜੇਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.

134.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਜੀਅ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.

134.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ; ਸੇਈ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.

134.g: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਰੋਵੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?

134.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੰਨਿ ॥
134.e: Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss is enjoyed.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
134.e: In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose forehead such good destiny is recorded. ||4||

134.g: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ. ਨ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
134.e: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.

134.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ; ਮਾਣਸ ਸੰਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
134.e: They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have come to rely upon mere mortals.

134.g: ਦੁਯੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ; ਗਲਿ ਪਈਸੁ. ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
134.e: In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the noose of Death.

134.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ; ਮਥੈ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
134.e: As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.

134.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਗਈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
134.e: The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and then depart with no hope at all.

134.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਾਧੂ ਭੇਟੀਐ; ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥
134.e: Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.

134.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
134.e: Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

134.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ. ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
134.e: Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.

134.g: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੫॥
134.e: The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||

134.g: ਅਸੁਨਿ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
134.e: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?

134.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
134.e: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

134.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ; ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
134.e: Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her only Support.

134.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਕੂੜਾਵਿਆ; ਦਿਸਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
134.e: The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
134.e: The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drink these in.

134.g: ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
134.e: The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God, the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਨੋ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
134.e: My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!

134.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
134.e: Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.

134.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
134.e: O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word of His Shabad.

134.g: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
134.e: Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with the Necklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||

134.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
134.e: Nanak makes this prayer to God: "Please, come and unite me with Yourself."

134.g: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਗੈ; ਜਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
134.e: The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||
Thy winsome luster astonishes the moonlight
The clique of tyrants is suppressed
Such is the glamour of Thy metropolis (world).1.79.
Moving like Chandika (Goddess) in the battlefield

135.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਦਰਸਨ ਘਣੀ; ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
135.e: My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.

135.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ; ਹਉ. ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
135.e: The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.

135.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ. ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
135.e: Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.

135.g: ਜਿੰਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ; ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
135.e: Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

135.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ; ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
135.e: They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, "God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe."

135.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ; ਸਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
135.e: Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated from Him again.

135.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
135.e: Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.

135.g: ਅਸੂ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸੰਦੀਆ; ਜਿਨਾ. ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੮॥
135.e: In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell in peace. ||8||

135.g: ਮਾਘਿ. ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ; ਧੂੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
135.e: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

135.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਣਿ; ਸਭਨਾ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
135.e: Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.

135.g: ਜਨਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
135.e: In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind.

135.g: ਪੋਖਿ. ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ; ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
135.e: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.

135.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ; ਦਰਸਨਿ ਲਗੜਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
135.e: Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

135.g: ਓਟ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ; ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
135.e: Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.

135.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ. ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ. ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੁ ॥
135.e: Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.

135.g: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ. ਤਹ ਮਿਲੀ; ਸਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥
135.e: From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

135.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੀਆਹੁ ॥
135.e: When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again suffer separation from Him.

135.g: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ. ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ. ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥
135.e: I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

135.g: ਸਰਮ ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
135.e: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.

135.g: ਪੋਖੁ ਸੋੁਹੰਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ; ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧੧॥
135.e: Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord has forgiven. ||11||

135.g: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ; ਦੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
135.e: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.

135.g: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਤੇ ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਵਿਆਪਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
135.e: Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.

135.g: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ; ਲਗਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
135.e: Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

135.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਉੜੇ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ; ਜਿਤੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੋਗ ॥
135.e: In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.

135.g: ਵਿਚੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ; ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
135.e: No one can then serve as your intermediary. Unto whom can we turn and cry?

135.g: ਕੀਤਾ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
135.e: By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the very beginning.

135.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਓਗ ॥
135.e: By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.

135.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥
135.e: Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.

135.g: ਕਤਿਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਸੋਚ ॥੯॥
135.e: In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||
Thou destroyest in an instant seemingly imperishable warriors.
Thou movest like the fire of lightning
O Infinite Lord! Thy Thorne is visualized in all directions.2.80.
Thy Pure emotions gleam
And destroy the forces of suffering.
The row of Thy horses looks graceful
Seeing which the horse of the Ocean gets angry.3.81.
Thou art radiant like the great ball of the Sun
Beyond the tunes of worldly joys.
Thou art everlasting like the Bunyan-seed
And art Blissful ever perfectly.4.82.
The Treasure of Thy wealth is inexhaustible
O Immaculate Lord! Thou art not united with anyone.
Thy seat is eternal
Thou art accountless, guiseless and Imperishable.5.83.
The row of thy teeth looks graceful
Seeing which the dark clouds feel jealous.
The small bells look elegant in the string round Thy waist
Seeing Thy effulgence the splendour of the Sun feels jealous.6.84.
The crest on Thy head seems splendid
Like the shaft high up in the clouds.
The Crown on Thy head looks elegant
Seeing which the moon feels shy.7.85.
The rows of demons are moving
And both the armies are running.
