When Thou usest Thy arms and weapons
And Thy disc moves in all the four directions.8.86.
Thy Inaccesible Glory looks elegant
Therefore the great sages and Shiva are covetous to have Thy Sight.
They remember Thy Name many times
Even then they have not been able go know Thy limits.9.87.
Many with faces upside down light the fire
Many ascetics roam forsaking their sleep.
Many perform austerity of five fires
Even they have not been able to know thy limits.10.88.
The performance of Neoli Karma (cleansing of intestines): the innumerable religious acts of giving charities
Abiding at pilgrim-stations for numberless times
All these acts do not equal do not equal the merit of the remembrance of the Name of One Lord.11.89.
The performance of innumerable acts of sacrifices
The performance of the religious act of giving elephants etc. in charity
Wandering in many countries
All these acts do not equal the merit of the remembrance of the Name of One Lord.12.90.
Dwelling in solitary confinement
Wandering in millions of forests
Becoming unattached many recite mantras
Many roam like hermits.13.91.
Many move in various guises and adopt several postures

135.g: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.

135.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ; ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਮੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.

135.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of the Holy Saints.

135.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ; ਸੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.

135.g: ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਉਤਰੈ; ਸੇ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.

135.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.

135.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ; ਕੰਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.

135.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.e: Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door.

135.g: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਜਨਮੜੀਆਹ ॥੧੦॥
135.e: Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||10||

136.e: BRIDH NARAAJ STANZA

136.g: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ. ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ. ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
136.e: In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, unto whom the Lord, the Friend, has been revealed.

136.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
136.e: The Saints, the Lord's helpers, in their mercy, have united me with Him.

136.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ; ਹੁਣਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
136.e: My bed is beautiful, and I have all comforts. I feel no sadness at all.

136.g: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ; ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
136.e: My desires have been fulfilled-by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sovereign Lord as my Husband.

136.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੀ; ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਲਾਇ ॥
136.e: Join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of rejoicing and the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ; ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ. ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
136.e: There is no other like the Lord-there is no equal to Him.

136.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
136.e: He embellishes this world and the world hereafter, and He gives us our permanent home there.

136.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
136.e: He rescues us from the world-ocean; never again do we have to run the cycle of reincarnation.

136.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ. ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ; ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
136.e: I have only one tongue, but Your Glorious Virtues are beyond counting. Nanak is saved, falling at Your Feet.

136.g: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ. ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
136.e: In Phalgun, praise Him continually; He has not even an iota of greed. ||13||

136.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ. ਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
136.e: Sexual desire and anger shall not seduce you, and the dog of greed shall depart.

136.g: ਸਚੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ; ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
136.e: Those who walk on the Path of Truth shall be praised throughout the world.

136.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਗਲ ਪੁੰਨ; ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
136.e: Be kind to all beings-this is more meritorious than bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the giving of charity.

136.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ; ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
136.e: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Mercy, is a wise person.

136.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
136.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have merged with God.

136.g: ਮਾਘਿ ਸੁਚੇ. ਸੇ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ; ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨॥
136.e: In Maagh, they alone are known as true, unto whom the Perfect Guru is Merciful. ||12||
Millions hold million types of fasts.
One may roam in many directions
He may observe many types of guises.14.92.
One may perform m,illions of types of charities
He may perform many types of sacrifices and actions.
One may adopt the religious garb of mendicant
He may perform many rituals of a hermit. 15.93.
One may read the religious texts continuously
He may perform many ostentations.
None of them equals the Name of One Lord
They are all an illusion like the world.16.94.
One may perform the religious acts of the ancient ages
He may perform the ascetic and monastic works.
He may perform the works of mercy etc., and magic
They are all wworks of great restraint, prevalent from times immemorial.17.95.
One may wander in many countries
He may adopt the discipline of giving million of charities.
Many songs of knowledge are sung
He may be proficient in innumerable types of knowledge and contemplation.18.96.
Those who are superb by achieving millions of types of knowledge
They are also observing many good actions.
Like Vyas, Narad etc.,
they even have not been able to know the secret of a Brahman.19.97.
Though millions of yantras and mantras may be practiced
And innumerable Tantras may be made.
One may even sit on the seat of Vyas
And forsake many types of food.20.98.
All the gods and demons remember Him
All the Yakshas and Gandharvas worship Him.
The Visyadhars sing His Prises
The reamaing categories including Nagas remember His Name.21.99.
He is remembered by all in this and other worlds
He hath put the seven oceans at their places.
He is known in all the four directions
The wheel of His Discipline keeps moving.22.100.
He is remembered by serpents and octopus
The vegetation narrates His Praises.
The beings of sky, earth and water remember Him
The beings in water and on land repeat His Name.23.101.
Millions of four-headed Brahmas
Recite the four Vedas.
Millions of Shiva worship that Wonderful Entity
Millions of Vishnus adore Him.24.102.
Innumerable Sarswatis goddess and Satis (Parvati-goddess)
And Lakshmis goddess and Satis (Parvati-goddess) and Lakshmis goddess sing His Praises.
Innumerable Sheshanaga eulogize Him
That Lord is comprehended as infinite ultimeately.25.103.
Maajh, Fifth Mehl: Day And Night:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

136.g: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ. ਦਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣ ॥
136.e: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.

136.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵਾਂ; ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਿਠੜੇ ਵੈਣ ॥
136.e: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.

136.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣ ॥
136.e: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, you are my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.

136.g: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ; ਸੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਵਸਨਿ ਭੈਣ ॥
136.e: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਗੈਣ ॥
136.e: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen all realms.

136.g: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ; ਦੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੇਣ ॥
136.e: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyone else?

136.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ; ਹੋਰੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਣ ॥
136.e: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ. ਖਾਕੂ ਰੂਲਣਾ; ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਥੈ. ਵੈਣ ॥
136.e: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. Unto whom should we utter our cries of distress?

136.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ. ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣ ॥੧॥
136.e: This is Nanak's prayer: "May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being." ||1||

136.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਸੋ ਸੁਣੇ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
136.e: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.

136.g: ਮਰਣਿ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
136.e: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all.

136.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਰੇ ॥
136.e: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ; ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
136.e: Those who meditate on the Perfect Guru, the Lord-Incarnate-they are judged true in the Court of the Lord.

136.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ; ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
136.e: The Lord's Feet are the Treasure of all peace and comfort for them; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

136.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਈਆ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਰੇ ॥
136.e: They obtain love and devotion, and they do not burn in corruption.

136.g: ਕੂੜ ਗਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਸੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
136.e: Falsehood has vanished, duality has been erased, and they are totally overflowing with Truth.

136.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ; ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
136.e: They serve the Supreme Lord God, and enshrine the One Lord within their minds.

136.g: ਮਾਹ ਦਿਵਸ. ਮੂਰਤ ਭਲੇ; ਜਿਸ ਕਉ. ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
136.e: The months, the days, and the moments are auspicious, for those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace.

136.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਰਸ ਦਾਨੁ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧॥
136.e: Nanak begs for the blessing of Your Vision, O Lord. Please, shower Your Mercy upon me! ||14||1||

137.g: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ. ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
137.e: Vaar In Maajh, And Saloks Of The First Mehl: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa"

137.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
137.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

137.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
137.e: Salok, First Mehl:

137.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ. ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ. ਤਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
137.e: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.

137.g: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
137.e: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||

137.g: ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਆਦਿ; ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
137.e: He is Beginningless, Unfathomable and Source of all beings that Beginningless Lord be worshipped.

137.g: ਅਗੰਜ ਅਭੰਜ ਅਰੰਜ ਅਗੰਜ; ਗੰਜ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
137.e: He is Indestructible, Unbreakable, griefless and Inexhaustible teasure, He should be meditated upon.

137.g: ਅਲੇਖ ਅਭੇਖ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਅਰੇਖ; ਅਸੇਖ ਕੋ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
137.e: He is accountless, guiseless, without blemish, without mark nd without a remander, He should be recognized.

137.g: ਨ ਭੂਲ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ; ਭਰਮ ਭੇਖ ਠਾਨੀਐ ॥੧॥੧੦੪॥
137.e: Even by mistake He should not be considered in Yantras, tantrasa, mantras, illusions and guises.1.104.

137.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਪਾਲ; ਦਇਆਲ ਕੋ ਉਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
137.e: The Name of that Lord be uttered who is Merciful, Beloved, deathless, Patronless and Compassionate.

137.g: ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਭਰਮ; ਕਰਮ ਮੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
137.e: We should reflect upon Him in all works whether irreligious, or fallacious.

137.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਦਾਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ; ਧਿਆਨਵਾਨ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥
137.e: We should visualize Him in Infinite charities, in contemplation, in knowledge and in those who contemplate.

137.g: ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ; ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥੨॥੧੦੫॥
137.e: Forsaking the irreligious Karms, we should comprehend the Karms that are religious and spiritual.2.105.

137.g: ਬ੍ਰਤਾਦਿ ਦਾਨ ਸੰਜਮਾਦਿ; ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਮਣੰ ॥
137.e: The Karmas which come in the categories of fasts etc., charities, restraints etc., bathing at pilgrim-stations and worship of gods

137.g: ਹੈ ਆਦਿ ਕੁੰਜਮੇਦ; ਰਾਜਸੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਨ ਭਰਮਣੰ ॥
137.e: Which are to be performed without illusion including the horse-sacrifice, elephant-sacrifice and Rajsu sacrifice performed by a universal monarch

137.g: ਨਿਵਲ ਆਦਿ ਕਰਮ ਭੇਖ; ਅਨੇਕ ਭੇਖ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
137.e: And the Neoli Karma of Yogis (cleansing of intestines) etc., may all be considered as Karmas of various sects and guises.

137.g: ਅਦੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ; ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥੧੦੬॥
137.e: In the absence of the pure Karmas related to the Invisible Lord, all the other Karmas he considered as illusion and hyposcrisy.3.106.

137.g: ਅਜਾਤ ਪਾਤ ਅਮਾਤ ਤਾਤ; ਅਜਾਤ ਸਿਧ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ॥
137.e: He is without caste and lineage, without mother and father He is Unborn and ever perfect.

137.g: ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪਉਤ੍ਰ; ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬਦਾ ॥
137.e: He is without enemy and friend, without son and grandson and He is always everywhere.

137.g: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡ ਚੰਡ ਉਦੰਡ; ਅਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥
137.e: He is Supremely Glorious and is called the crusher and breaker of the Unbreakable.

137.g: ਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਰੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ; ਭੇਖ ਮੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥੪॥੧੦੭॥
137.e: He cannot be placed in the garb of form, colour, mark and calculation.4.107.

137.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਆਦਿ; ਆਸਨਾਦਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਆਸਨੰ ॥
137.e: Bathing at innumerable pilgrim-stations etc., adopting various postures etc., following the discipline of worship according to Narad Pancharatra

137.g: ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਉ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ; ਅਉ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਨੰ ॥
137.e: Adoption of Vairagya (monasticism and asceticlism) and Sannyas (renunciation) and observing yogic discipline of olden times:

137.g: ਅਨਾਦਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਜਮਾਦਿ; ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥
137.e: Visiting ancient pilgrim-stations and observing restraints etc., fasts and other rules

137.g: ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ; ਸਮਸਤ ਭਰਮ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥੫॥੧੦੮॥
137.e: Without the Beginningless and Unfathomable Lord, all the above Karmas be considered as illusion.5.108.
First Mehl:

137.g: ਪਹਿਲੈ; ਪਿਆਰਿ ਲਗਾ. ਥਣ ਦੁਧਿ ॥
137.e: First, the baby loves mother's milk;

137.g: ਦੂਜੈ; ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
137.e: second, he learns of his mother and father;

137.g: ਤੀਜੈ; ਭਯਾ ਭਾਭੀ ਬੇਬ ॥
137.e: third, his brothers, sisters-in-law and sisters;

137.g: ਚਉਥੈ; ਪਿਆਰਿ ਉਪੰਨੀ ਖੇਡ ॥
137.e: fourth, the love of play awakens.

137.g: ਪੰਜਵੈ; ਖਾਣ ਪੀਅਣ ਕੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
137.e: Fifth, he runs after food and drink;

137.g: ਛਿਵੈ; ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
137.e: sixth, in his sexual desire, he does not respect social customs.

137.g: ਸਤਵੈ; ਸੰਜਿ ਕੀਆ. ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
137.e: Seventh, he gathers wealth and dwells in his house;

137.g: ਅਠਵੈ; ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਨ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
137.e: eighth, he becomes angry, and his body is consumed.

137.g: ਨਾਵੈ; ਧਉਲੇ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
137.e: Ninth, he turns grey, and his breathing becomes labored;

137.g: ਦਸਵੈ; ਦਧਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
137.e: tenth, he is cremated, and turns to ashes.

137.g: ਗਏ. ਸਿਗੀਤ; ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਧਾਹ ॥
137.e: His companions send him off, crying out and lamenting.

137.g: ਉਡਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ; ਦਸਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
137.e: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to go.

137.g: ਰਸਾਵਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
137.e: RASAAVAL STANZA

137.g: ਦਇਆਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
137.e: The religious discipline like Mercy etc.,

137.g: ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ਆਦਿ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
137.e: The Karmas like Sannyas (renunciation) etc.,

137.g: ਗਜਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
137.e: The Charities of elephants etc.,
The places of sacrifice of horses etc.,1.109.

137.g: ਸੁਵਰਨ ਆਦਿ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
137.e: The charities like gold etc.,

137.g: ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਆਦਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੰ ॥
137.e: The bath in the sea etc.,

137.g: ਬਿਸੁਵਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਭਰਮੰ ॥
137.e: Wanderings in the universe etc.,

137.g: ਬਿਰਕਤਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਕਰਮੰ ॥੨॥੧੧੦॥
137.e: The works of austerities etc.,2.110.

137.g: ਨਿਵਲ ਆਦਿ ਕਰਣੰ ॥
137.e: The Karma like Neoli (cleansing of intestines) etc.,

137.g: ਸੁ ਨੀਲ ਆਦਿ ਬਰਣੰ ॥
137.e: Wearing of blue clothes etc.,

137.g: ਅਨੀਲ ਆਦਿ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
137.e: Contemplation of Colourless etc.,

137.g: ਜਪਤ ਤਤ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੰ ॥੩॥੧੧੧॥
137.e: The Supreme Essence is the Remembrance of the Name.3.111.

137.g: ਅਮਿਤਕਾਦਿ ਭਗਤੰ ॥
137.e: O Lord! The types of Thy devotion are unlimited,

137.g: ਅਵਿਕਤਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਕਤੰ ॥
137.e: Thy affection is unmanifested.

137.g: ਪ੍ਰਛਸਤੁਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਪੰ ॥
137.e: Thou becomest apparent to the seeker

137.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਗਤਾ ਅਥਾਪੰ ॥੪॥੧੧੨॥
137.e: Thou art Unestablished by devotions.4.112.

137.g: ਸੁ ਭਗਤਾਦਿ ਕਰਣੰ ॥
137.e: Thou art the doer of all the works of Thy devotees

137.g: ਅਜਗਤੁਆ ਪ੍ਰਹਰਣੰ ॥
137.e: Thou art the destroyer of the sinners.

137.g: ਬਿਰਕਤੁਆ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ ॥
137.e: Thou art the illuminator of detachment

137.g: ਅਵਿਗਤੁਆ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਸੰ ॥੫॥੧੧੩॥
137.e: Thou art the destroyer of tyranny.5.113.

137.g: ਸਮਸਤੁਆ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੰ ॥
137.e: Thou art the Sumpreme Authority over all

137.g: ਧੁਜਸਤੁਆ ਧਰਾਨੰ ॥
137.e: Thou art the axle of the banner.

137.g: ਅਵਿਕਤੁਆ ਅਭੰਗੰ ॥
137.e: Thou art ever Unassailable

137.g: ਇਕਸਤੁਆ ਅਨੰਗੰ ॥੬॥੧੧੪॥
137.e: Thou art the only one Formless Lord.6.114.

137.g: ਉਅਸਤੁਆ ਅਕਾਰੰ ॥
137.e: Thou Thyself manifestest Thy Forms

137.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਸਤੁਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰੰ ॥
137.e: Thou art Merciful to the deserving.

137.g: ਖਿਤਸਤੁਆ ਅਖੰਡੰ ॥
137.e: Thou pervadest the earth indivisibly

137.g: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ. ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ; ਵਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
137.e: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.

137.g: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ; ਕਿਛੁ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
137.e: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.

137.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ; ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
137.e: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble, like the dust of the feet of the Saints.

137.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੈਆਲ ਦੇਵ; ਪਤਿਤ. ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
137.e: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.

137.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਖਦਾ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
137.e: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator has been our Saving Grace.

137.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
137.e: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.

137.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
137.e: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.

137.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੰਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
137.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||

137.g: ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
137.e: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.

137.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਿਤੀਨੁ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
137.e: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.

137.g: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਜਪੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
137.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.

137.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ; ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥
137.e: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.

137.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ; ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
137.e: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.

137.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ; ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
137.e: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.

137.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ; ਦੋਖ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਹੰਤੁ ॥
137.e: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.

137.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ. ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਸੋ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
137.e: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||

137.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਣੋ; ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
137.e: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.

137.g: ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ. ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੇ; ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ॥
137.e: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.

137.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ; ਜਨ ਧੂੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
137.e: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet of the humble.

137.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
137.e: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.

137.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
137.e: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of the Holy.

137.g: ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ. ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਕਿਥੈ ਕੂਕਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
137.e: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?

137.g: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ. ਤਮ ਹਰਣ; ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਮਾਉ ॥
137.e: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomable and Unapproachable Lord.

137.g: ਮਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
137.e: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.

137.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
137.e: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1||

138.e: Pauree:

138.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
138.e: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself put it to work.

138.g: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
138.e: Administering the drug of emotional attachment, You Yourself have led the world astray.

138.g: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ; ਨਹ ਤਿਪਤੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
138.e: The fire of desire is deep within; unsatisfied, people remain hungry and thirsty.

138.g: ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
138.e: This world is an illusion; it dies and it is re-born-it comes and it goes in reincarnation.

138.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ; ਸਭਿ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
138.e: Without the True Guru, emotional attachment is not broken. All have grown weary of performing empty rituals.

138.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸੁਖਿ ਰਜਾ. ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
138.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Filled with a joyful peace, they surrender to Your Will.

138.g: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ; ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
138.e: They save their families and ancestors; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.
He came and he went, and now, even his name has died.
After he left, food was offered on leaves, and the birds were called to come and eat.
O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs love the darkness.
Without the Guru, the world is drowning. ||2||
Second Mehl:

138.g: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ. ਦਿਤਾ ਚੰਗਾ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.e: They prefer the gift, instead of the Giver; such is the way of the self-willed manmukhs.

138.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.e: What can anyone say about their intelligence, their understanding or their cleverness?

138.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.e: The deeds which one commits, while sitting in one's own home, are known far and wide, in the four directions.

138.g: ਜੋ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਨਾਉ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪਾਪਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.e: One who lives righteously is known as righteous; one who commits sins is known as a sinner.

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਕਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ. ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.e: You Yourself enact the entire play, O Creator. Why should we speak of any other?

138.g: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤਿ. ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੋਲਹਿ; ਵਿਣੁ ਜੋਤੀ. ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ. ਦਿਖਾ ਸਿਆਣੀਐ ॥
138.e: As long as Your Light is within the body, You speak through that Light. Without Your Light, who can do anything? Show me any such cleverness!

138.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨॥
138.e: O Nanak, the Lord alone is Perfect and All-knowing; He is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||2||
Salok, First Mehl:

138.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ. ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
138.e: He placed the soul in the body which He had fashioned. He protects the Creation which He has created.

138.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੈ. ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬੋਲੈ; ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
138.e: With their eyes, they see, and with their tongues, they speak; with their ears, they bring the mind to awareness.

138.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲੈ. ਹਥੀ ਕਰਣਾ; ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
138.e: With their feet, they walk, and with their hands, they work; they wear and eat whatever is given.

138.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ. ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਅੰਧਾ. ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
138.e: They do not know the One who created the Creation. The blind fools do their dark deeds.

138.g: ਜਾ ਭਜੈ ਤਾ ਠੀਕਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਘਾੜਤ. ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
138.e: When the pitcher of the body breaks and shatters into pieces, it cannot be re-created again.

138.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ; ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
138.e: O Nanak, without the Guru, there is no honor; without honor, no one is carried across. ||1||
First Mehl:

138.g: ਦਸ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ. ਬੀਸ ਰਵਣਿ; ਤੀਸਾ ਕਾ. ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
138.e: At the age of ten, he is a child; at twenty, a youth, and at thirty, he is called handsome.

138.g: ਚਾਲੀਸੀ. ਪੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ, ਪਚਾਸੀ. ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ; ਸਠੀ ਕੇ. ਬੋਢੇਪਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
138.e: At forty, he is full of life; at fifty, his foot slips, and at sixty, old age is upon him.

138.g: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾ. ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ; ਅਸੀਹਾਂ ਕਾ. ਵਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
138.e: At seventy, he loses his intellect, and at eighty, he cannot perform his duties.

138.g: ਨਵੈ ਕਾ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਣੀ; ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ. ਅਪ ਬਲੁ ॥
138.e: At ninety, he lies in his bed, and he cannot understand his weakness.

138.g: ਢੰਢੋਲਿਮੁ ਢੂਢਿਮੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਧਵਲਹਰੁ ॥੩॥
138.e: After seeking and searching for such a long time, O Nanak, I have seen that the world is just a mansion of smoke. ||3||
PAADHRAI STANZA BY THY GRACE
On a day the curious soul (asked): The infinite and Desire less Lord, the Intuitive Entity.
Of everlasting Glory and long-armed
The King of kings and Emperor of emperors.1.126.
The soul said to the Higher Soul
The Germinating Entity, Unmanifested and Invincible
Thou canst not be attached with anything.7.115.
Thou art the superb Abode among abodes
Thou art the householder among householders.
Thou art conscious Entity devoid of ailments
Thou art there on the eath but hidden.8.116.
Thou art conqueror and without effect on muttering
Thou art Fearless and Invisible.
Thou art the Only One amongst many :
Thou art ever indivisble.9.117
Thou art beyond all ostentations
Thou art far away from all pressures.
Thou canst not be vanquished by anyone
Thy limits canst not be measured by anyone.10.118.
Thou art beyond all ailments and agonies
Thou canst not established.
Thou art the masher of all blemishes from the beginning
There is none other so extraordinary as Thou.11.119.
Thou art Most Holy
Thou promptest the flourishing of the world.
Distinctively Thou art Supporting
O guideless Lord! Thou art worshipped by all.12.120.
Thou art the sap in flowers and fruits
Thou art the inspirer in the hearts.
Thou art the one to resist among the resistant
Thou art the destroyer of the three worlds (or modes).13.121.
Thou art the colour as well as devoid of colour
Thou art the beauty as well as the lover of beauty.
Thou art the Only One and ONLY ONE like Thyself
Thou art the Only One now and shall be the Only One in future.14.122.
Thou art described as the Donor of boons
Thou art the Only One, the Only One.
Thou art affectionate and accountless
Thou art depicted as markless.15.123.
Thou art in the three worlds and also the destroyer of three modes
O Lord! Thou art in every colour.
Thou art the earth and also the Lord of the earth.
O Guiseless Lord! All adore Thee.16.124.
Thou art the Suprb of the eminent ones.
Thou art the Giver of reward in an instant.
Thou art the Sovereign of men.
Thou art the destroyer of the Masters of the armies.17.125.
Pauree:

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਤੀ ॥
138.e: You, O Creator Lord, are Unfathomable. You Yourself created the Universe,

138.g: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ; ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
138.e: its colors, qualities and varieties, in so many ways and forms.

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ. ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈਐ; ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮਾਤੀ ॥
138.e: You created it, and You alone understand it. It is all Your Play.

138.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
138.e: Some come, and some arise and depart; but without the Name, all are bound to die.

138.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ; ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ. ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
138.e: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the deep crimson color of the poppy; they are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

138.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ; ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੀ ॥
138.e: So serve the True and Pure Lord, the Supremely Powerful Architect of Destiny.

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡਾਤੀ ॥
138.e: You Yourself are All-knowing. O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great!

138.g: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ. ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਚਿਆ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹਉ. ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
138.e: O my True Lord, I am a sacrifice, a humble sacrifice, to those who meditate on You within their conscious mind. ||1||

139.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
139.e: Salok, First Mehl:

139.g: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੈ ਪਰਬਤਿ. ਗੁਫਾ ਕਰੀ; ਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
139.e: I may make a cave, in a mountain of gold, or in the water of the nether regions;

139.g: ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ. ਕੈ ਆਕਾਸੀ; ਉਰਧਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
139.e: I may remain standing on my head, upside-down, on the earth or up in the sky;

139.g: ਪੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਾ; ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਿ ॥
139.e: I may totally cover my body with clothes, and wash them continually;

139.g: ਬਗਾ ਰਤਾ. ਪੀਅਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ; ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
139.e: I may shout out loud, the white, red, yellow and black Vedas;

139.g: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ. ਰਹਾ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
139.e: I may even live in dirt and filth. And yet, all this is just a product of evil-mindedness, and intellectual corruption.

139.g: ਨਾ ਹਉ. ਨਾ ਮੈ, ਨਾ ਹਉ ਹੋਵਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
139.e: I was not, I am not, and I will never be anything at all! O Nanak, I dwell only on the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

139.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
139.e: Salok, Second Mehl:

139.g: ਅਖੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ; ਵਿਣੁ ਕੰਨਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ॥
139.e: To see without eyes; to hear without ears;

139.g: ਪੈਰਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਚਲਣਾ; ਵਿਣੁ ਹਥਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
139.e: to walk without feet; to work without hands;

139.g: ਜੀਭੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ; ਇਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
139.e: to speak without a tongue-like this, one remains dead while yet alive.

139.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਕੈ; ਤਉ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥
139.e: O Nanak, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merge with your Lord and Master. ||1||
First Mehl:

139.g: ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲਿ. ਪਖਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ; ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
139.e: They wash their clothes, and scrub their bodies, and try to practice self-discipline.

139.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗੀ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ; ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
139.e: But they are not aware of the filth staining their inner being, while they try and try to wash off the outer dirt.

139.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਭੂਲਿ; ਪਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
139.e: The blind go astray, caught by the noose of Death.

139.g: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
139.e: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.

139.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
139.e: O Nanak, the egotism of the Gurmukhs is broken, and then, they meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

139.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
139.e: They chant the Naam, meditate on the Naam, and through the Naam, they are absorbed in peace. ||2||

139.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
139.e: Beautiful and sublime is the glory and the understanding of those who focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||2||

139.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
139.e: Salok, First Mehl:

139.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ. ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
139.e: Telling lies, they eat dead bodies.

139.g: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
139.e: Pauree:

139.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ; ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: Destiny has brought together and united the body and the soul-swan.

139.g: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: He who created them, also separates them.

139.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗੁ; ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: The fools enjoy their pleasures; they must also endure all their pains.

139.g: ਸੁਖਹੁ ਉਠੇ ਰੋਗ; ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: From pleasures, arise diseases and the commission of sins.

139.g: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ; ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: From sinful pleasures come sorrow, separation, birth and death.

139.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇ; ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: The fools try to account for their misdeeds, and argue uselessly.

139.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ; ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: The judgement is in the Hands of the True Guru, who puts an end to the argument.

139.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ. ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ; ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
139.e: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. It cannot be changed by anyone's efforts. ||4||

139.g: ਇਹ ਕਉਨ ਆਹਿ ਆਤਮਾ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜਿ ਅਤਿਭੁਤਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥੨॥੧੨੭॥
139.e: “What is this Soul Entity? Which hath indelible glory and which is of queer substance.”2.127.

139.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
139.e: Pauree:

139.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਤੁਧੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: Forever and ever, You are the only One; You set the play of duality in motion.

139.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: You created egotism and arrogant pride, and You placed greed within our beings.

139.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ; ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: Keep me as it pleases Your Will; everyone acts as You cause them to act.

139.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: Some are forgiven, and merge with You; through the Guru's Teachings, we are joined to You.

139.g: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: Some stand and serve You; without the Name, nothing else pleases them.

139.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਾਰ ਵੇਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਇਕਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: Any other task would be worthless to them-You have enjoined them to Your True Service.

139.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ; ਇਕਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ. ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
139.e: In the midst of children, spouse and relations, some still remain detached; they are pleasing to Your Will.

139.g: ਓਹਿ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
139.e: Inwardly and outwardly, they are pure, and they are absorbed in the True Name. ||3||

139.g: ਪਰਾਤਮਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
139.e: The Higher Soul said:

139.g: ਯਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਆਹਿ ਆਤਮਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
139.e: “This Soul is itself Brahman

139.g: ਜਿਹ ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜਿ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਕਾਮ ॥
139.e: ” Who is of Everlasting Glory and is Unmanisfested and Desireless.

139.g: ਜਿਹ ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਲ ॥
139.e: Who is indiscriminate, actionless and deathless

139.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬਾ ਦਿਆਲ ॥੩॥੧੨੮॥
139.e: Who hath no enemy and friend and is Merciful towards all.3.1228.

139.g: ਡੋਬਿਯੋ ਨ ਡੁਬੈ ਸੋਖਿਯੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
139.e: It is neither drowned nor soaked

139.g: ਕਟਿਯੋ ਨ ਕਟੈ ਨ ਬਾਰਿਯੋ ਬਰਾਇ ॥
139.e: It can neither be chopped nor burnt.

139.g: ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਨੈਕ ਸਤ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਤ ॥
139.e: It cannot be assailed by the blow of weapon

139.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਤ ॥੪॥੧੨੯॥
139.e: It hath neither an enemy nor a friend, neither caste not lineage.4.129.

139.g: ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਘਾਇ ॥
ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਨੈਕ ਖੰਡਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
139.e: By the blow of thousands of enemies, It is neither wasted away nor fragmented.

139.g: ਨਹੀ ਜਰੈ ਨੈਕ ਪਾਵਕ ਮੰਝਾਰ ॥
ਬੋਰੈ ਨ ਸਿੰਧ ਸੋਖੈ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਯਾਰ ॥੫॥੧੩੦॥
139.e: It is not burnt even in the fire. It is neither drowned in the sea nor soaked by the air.5.130.

139.g: ਇਕ ਕਰ︀ਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਸਨ ਆਤਮਾ ਦੇਵ ॥
ਅਨਭੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਅਨਿਭਉ ਅਭੇਵ ॥
139.e: Then the Soul questioned the Lord thus : “O Lord! Thou art Invincible, Intuitive and Indiscriminate Entity

139.g: ਯਹਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਵਰਗ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦਾਨ ॥
139.e: “This world mentions four categories of Charities

139.g: ਕਿਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ ਵਰਗ, ਕਿਜੈ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥੬॥੧੩੧॥
139.e: Which are these categories, tell me Graciously.”6.131.

139.g: ਇਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਧਰਮ, ਇਕ ਦਾਨ ਧਰਮ ॥
139.e: One is political discipline, one is ascetic’s discipline

139.g: ਇਕ ਭੋਗ ਧਰਮ, ਇਕ ਮੋਛ ਕਰਮ ॥
139.e: One is householder’s discipline, one is ascetic’s discipline.

139.g: ਇਕ ਚਤੁਰ ਵਰਗ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਭਣੰਤ ॥
139.e: All the world knows this one of four categories

139.g: ਸੇ ਆਤਮਾਹ ਪਰਾਤਮਾ ਪੁਛੰਤ ॥੭॥੧੩੨॥
139.e: That Soul makes enquiries from the Lord.7.132.

139.g: ਇਕ ਰਾਜ ਧਰਮ ਇਕ ਧਰਮ ਦਾਨ ॥
139.e: One is political discipline and one is religious discipline

139.g: ਇਕ ਭੋਗ ਧਰਮ ਇਕ ਮੋਛਵਾਨ ॥
139.e: One is householder’s discipline, one is ascetic’s discipline .

139.g: ਤੁਮ ਕਹੋ ਚਤ੍ਰ ਚਤ੍ਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
139.e: Tell me Graciously Thy thoughts about all the four:

139.g: ਜੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਭਏ ਜੁਗ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੮॥੧੩੩॥
139.e: And also tell me their originators in long ages in three epochs.8.133.

139.g: ਬਰਨੰਨ ਕਰੋ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਦਾਨ ॥
139.e: Describe to me the first discipline

139.g: ਜਿਮ ਦਾਨ ਧਰਮ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ॥
139.e: How this religious discipline was observed by the kings.

139.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਰ ਦਾਨ ਦੰਤ ॥
139.e: In Satyuga charities were given by performing virtuous actions

139.g: ਭੂਮਾਦਿ ਦਾਨ ਕੀਨੇ ਅਕੰਥ ॥੯॥੧੩੪॥
139.e: Indescribable charities of lands etc  , were given.9.134.

139.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਜੁਗ ਮਹੀਪ ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਤ ॥
ਗਾਥਾ ਅਨੰਤ ਉਪਮਾ ਅਗਾਤ ॥
139.e: It is difficult to describe the king of three ages, their story is endless and the Praise indescribable.

139.g: ਜੋ ਕੀਏ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਜਗ ਧਰਮ ॥
ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਤੇ ਅਮਿਤ ਕਰਮ ॥੧੦॥੧੩੫॥
139.e: By performing sacrifices, the religious discipline unlimited action.10.135.

139.g: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਜੋ ਭਏ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
ਇਹਿ ਭਰਥ ਖੰਡਿ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਬੂ ਦੀਪ ॥
139.e: The kings that reigned before Kaliyuga, in the Jambu Dvipa in the Bharat Khand.

139.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਬਰਣੌ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈਣ ॥
ਰਾਜਾ ਯੁਧਿਸਟ੍ਰ ਭੂ ਭਰਥ ਏਣ ॥੧੧॥੧੩੬॥
139.e: I describe them with Thy Strength and Glory, The king Yadhishtra was the unblemished Sustainer of the earth.11.136.

139.g: ਖੰਡੇ ਅਖੰਡ ਜਿਹ ਚਤੁਰ ਖੰਡ ॥
ਕੈਰੌ ਕੁਰਖੇਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ॥
139.e: He (Yadhishtra) broke the unbreakable ones in the four khands (regions), He destroyed the Kauravas with great might in the war of Kurukshetra.

139.g: ਜਿਹ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਡ ਜਿਤਿਯੋ ਦੁਬਾਰ ॥
ਅਰਜਨ ਭੀਮਾਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਜੁਝਾਰ ॥੧੨॥੧੩੭॥
139.e: He conquered twice all the four directions. The mighty warriors like Arjuna and Bhim were his brothers.12.137.

139.g: ਅਰਜਨ ਪਠਿਯੋ ਉਤਰ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
ਭੀਮਹਿ ਕਰਾਇ ਪੂਰਬ ਪਯਾਨ ॥
139.e: He sent Arjuna toward the North for conquest, Bhim went for conquest to the east.

139.g: ਸਹਿਦੇਵ ਪਠਿਯੋ ਦਛਣ ਸੁਦੇਸ ॥
ਨੁਕਲਹਿ ਪਠਾਇ ਪਛਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥੧੩॥੧੩੮॥
139.e: Sahdev was sent to the country in the South, Nakul was sent to the West.13.138.

139.g: ਮੰਡੇ ਮਹੀਪ ਖੰਡਿਯੋ ਖਤ੍ਰਾਣ ॥

139.e: Second Mehl:

139.g: ਦਿਸੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸਾਉ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
139.e: He is seen, heard and known, but His subtle essence is not obtained.

139.g: ਰੁਹਲਾ ਟੁੰਡਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ; ਕਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ. ਧਾਇ ॥
139.e: How can the lame, armless and blind person run to embrace the Lord?

139.g: ਭੈ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ. ਕਰ ਭਾਵ ਕੇ; ਲੋਇਣ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
139.e: Let the Fear of God be your feet, and let His Love be your hands; let His Understanding be your eyes.

139.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ; ਇਵ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
139.e: Says Nanak, in this way, O wise soul-bride, you shall be united with your Husband Lord. ||2||

140.e: First Mehl:

140.g: ਜਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ; ਕਿਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
140.e: Since I am no one, what can I say? Since I am nothing, what can I be?

140.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ. ਕਹਿਆ ਕਥਨਾ; ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵਾਂ ॥
140.e: As He created me, so I act. As He causes me to speak, so I speak. I am full and overflowing with sins-if only I could wash them away!

140.g: ਆਪਿ. ਨ ਬੁਝਾ, ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਈ; ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਹੋਵਾਂ ॥
140.e: I do not understand myself, and yet I try to teach others. Such is the guide I am!

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ. ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੈ; ਸਭਸੁ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
140.e: O Nanak, the one who is blind shows others the way, and misleads all his companions.

140.g: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ; ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
140.e: But, going to the world hereafter, he shall be beaten and kicked in the face; then, it will be obvious, what sort of guide he was! ||2||

140.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
140.e: Salok, First Mehl:

140.g: ਜੇ ਰਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਕਪੜੈ; ਜਾਮਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਲੀਤੁ ॥
140.e: If one's clothes are stained with blood, the garment becomes polluted.

140.g: ਜੋ ਰਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਮਾਣਸਾ; ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
140.e: Those who suck the blood of human beings-how can their consciousness be pure?

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਾ; ਦਿਲਿ ਹਛੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
140.e: O Nanak, chant the Name of God, with heart-felt devotion.

140.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ; ਝੂਠੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
140.e: Everything else is just a pompous worldly show, and the practice of false deeds. ||1||

140.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
140.e: Pauree:

140.g: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੂੰ; ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
140.e: Through all the months and the seasons, the minutes and the hours, I dwell upon You, O Lord.

140.g: ਤੂੰ ਗਣਤੈ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
140.e: No one has attained You by clever calculations, O True, Unseen and Infinite Lord.

140.g: ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
140.e: That scholar who is full of greed, arrogant pride and egotism, is known to be a fool.

140.g: ਨਾਉ ਪੜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਝੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
140.e: So read the Name, and realize the Name, and contemplate the Guru's Teachings.

140.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ; ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
140.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have earned the wealth of the Naam; I possess the storehouses, overflowing with devotion to the Lord.

140.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
140.e: Believing in the Immaculate Naam, one is hailed as true, in the True Court of the Lord.

140.g: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
140.e: The Divine Light of the Infinite Lord, who owns the soul and the breath of life, is deep within the inner being.

140.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ; ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
140.e: You alone are the True Banker, O Lord; the rest of the world is just Your petty trader. ||6||

140.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਰਣ ਬਧਹ ॥
140.e: The Slaying of Sri Baran:

140.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਰਣੇ ਸੁਕਰਨਿ ਸਿਯਾਮ; ਸੁਵਰਨ ਪੂਛ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
140.e: (The Sacrificial horse) is of white colour, black ears having golden tail

140.g: ਰਤਨ ਤੁੰਗ ਉਤੰਗ ਬਾਜਤ; ਉਚ ਸ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
140.e: With eyes high and wide and lofty neck like Unhchyishravas

140.g: ਅਵਰੀ ਨੋ; ਸਮਝਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
140.e: And yet, they go out to teach others.

140.g: ਮੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ; ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
140.e: They are deceived, and they deceive their companions.

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
140.e: O Nanak, such are the leaders of men. ||1||

140.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
140.e: Pauree:

140.g: ਇਕਿ. ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਹਿ; ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
140.e: Some pick and eat fruits and roots, and live in the wilderness.

140.g: ਇਕਿ. ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ; ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸਾ ॥
140.e: Some wander around wearing saffron robes, as Yogis and Sanyaasees.

140.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ; ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
140.e: But there is still so much desire within them-they still yearn for clothes and food.

140.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ; ਨ ਗਿਰਹੀ. ਨ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
140.e: They waste their lives uselessly; they are neither householders nor renunciates.

140.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ. ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
140.e: The Messenger of Death hangs over their heads, and they cannot escape the three-phased desire.

140.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ. ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ; ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
140.e: Death does not even approach those who follow the Guru's Teachings, and become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

140.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
140.e: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their true minds; within the home of their own inner beings, they remain detached.

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੇ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
140.e: O Nanak, those who serve their True Guru, rise from desire to desirelessness. ||5||

140.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
140.e: Salok, First Mehl:

140.g: ਮਿਹਰ ਮਸੀਤਿ. ਸਿਦਕੁ ਮੁਸਲਾ; ਹਕੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
140.e: Let mercy be your mosque, faith your prayer-mat, and honest living your Koran.

140.g: ਸਰਮ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ. ਸੀਲੁ ਰੋਜਾ; ਹੋਹੁ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ॥
140.e: Make modesty your circumcision, and good conduct your fast. In this way, you shall be a true Muslim.

140.g: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਬਾ. ਸਚੁ ਪੀਰੁ; ਕਲਮਾ ਕਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
140.e: Let good conduct be your Kaabaa, Truth your spiritual guide, and the karma of good deeds your prayer and chant.

140.g: ਤਸਬੀ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
140.e: Let your rosary be that which is pleasing to His Will. O Nanak, God shall preserve your honor. ||1||

140.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
140.e: Fourth Mehl:

140.g: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ, ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
140.e: Those, within whom the Truth dwells, obtain the True Name; they speak only the Truth.

140.g: ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਦਾ; ਹੋਰਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
140.e: They walk on the Lord's Path, and inspire others to walk on the Lord's Path as well.

140.g: ਜੇ ਅਗੈ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ. ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੈ; ਛਪੜਿ ਨਾਤੈ. ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
140.e: Bathing in a pool of holy water, they are washed clean of filth. But, by bathing in a stagnant pond, they are contaminated with even more filth.

140.g: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
140.e: The True Guru is the Perfect Pool of Holy Water. Night and day, He meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

140.g: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟਾ. ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ; ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
140.e: He is saved, along with his family; bestowing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, He saves the whole world.

140.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ; ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ. ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
140.e: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to one who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it as well. ||2||

140.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਅਜੀਤ ਮੰਡੇ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
140.e: The Kshatriya kings were mashed and destroyed. In the Great war the unconquerable were conquered.

140.g: ਖੰਡਿਯੋ ਸੁ ਉਤ੍ਰ ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਦੇਸ ॥
ਦਛਨ ਪੂਰਬ ਜੀਤੇ ਨਰੇਸ ॥੧੪॥੧੩੯॥
140.e: The Khorasan country in the North was destroyed, The kings of the South and East were conquered.14.139.

140.g: ਖਗ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
ਬਜਿਯੋ ਨਿਸਾਨ ਇਹ ਜੰਬੂਦੀਪ ॥
140.e: The kings of all the regions were defeated with the might of sword. In this Jambu Dvipa the trumpet (of Yudhishtra sounded.

140.g: ਇਕ ਠਉਰ ਕੀਏ ਸਬ ਦੇਸ ਰਾਉ ॥
ਮਖ ਰਾਜਸੂਅ ਕੋ ਕੀਓ ਚਾਉ ॥੧੫॥੧੪੦॥
140.e: He gathered together the kings of various countries at one place. He expressed his wish for th performance of Rajsu sacrifice.15.140.

140.g: ਸਬ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਪਠੇ ਸੁ ਪਤ੍ਰ ॥
ਜਿਤ ਜਿਤ ਗੁਨਾਢ ਕੀਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ॥
140.e: He sent letters to all countries. All the qualified Brahmins were gathered together.

140.g: ਮਖ ਰਾਜਸੂਅ ਕੋ ਕੀਯੋ ਅਰੰਭ ॥
ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਹੁਤ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਜਿਤੇ ਅਸੰਭ ॥੧੬॥੧੪੧॥
140.e: The performance of Rajsu sacrifice was started. Many of the conquered kings were called.16.141.

140.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
140.e: ROOAAL STANZA

140.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਰਿਤਜ; ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
140.e: Million of ritual-conscious Brahmins were called.

140.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਨਾਇ ਬਿੰਜਨ; ਭੋਗੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਇ ॥
140.e: Million of different foods were prepared which were enjoyed with relish.

140.g: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਗ੍ਰਕਾ ਕਹੂੰ; ਲਾਗ ਹੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਇ ॥
140.e: Many chief Sovereigns were busy in collecting required materials.

140.g: ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਲਗੇ ਸਭ; ਧਰਮ ਕੋ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਇ ॥੧॥੧੪੨॥
140.e: Thus, the Rajsu sacrifice began to be performed with religious zeal.1.142.

140.g: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਕੋ; ਦਿਜ ਏਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਭਾਰ ॥
140.e: The orders were given for giving one load of gold to each Brahmin.

140.g: ਏਕ ਸਉ ਗਜ ਏਕ ਸਉ ਰਥਿ; ਦੁਇ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਤੁਖਾਰ ॥
140.e: One hundred elephants, one hundred chariots and two thousand horses

140.g: ਸਹੰਸ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਸਿੰਗੀ; ਮਹਿਖ ਦਾਨ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
140.e: And also four thousand cow with gilded horns and innumerable buffalos in charity

140.g: ਏਕ ਏਕਹਿ ਦੀਜੀਐ; ਸੁਨ, ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੪੩॥
140.e: Listen O Chief of the Kings, give these gifts to each Brahmin.2.143.

140.g: ਸੁਵਰਨ ਦਾਨ ਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਰੁਕਮ ਦਾਨ; ਸੁ ਤਾਬ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
140.e: Innumerable articles like gold, silver and copper were given in charity.

140.g: ਅੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਦੀਜਤ; ਦੇਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
140.e: Innumerable alms of grain were given to many gathered poor people.

140.g: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ ਪਟੰਬ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ; ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ ਦਿਜੰਤ ॥
140.e: Other items given in charity were the common clothes, silken clothes and weapons.

140.g: ਭੂਪ ਭਿਛਕ ਹੁਇ ਗਏ ਸਬ; ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥੩॥੧੪੪॥
140.e: The beggars from many countries became well-off.3.144.

140.g: ਚਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਸ ਬਨਾਹਿ ਕੁੰਡਕ; ਸਹਸ੍ਰ ਲਾਇ ਪਰਨਾਰ ॥
140.e: The fire-altar extended upto four kos and had one thousand drains.

140.g: ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਹੋਮ ਕਰੈ ਲਗੈ; ਦਿਜ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
140.e: One thousand Brahmins, considered incarnations of Ved Vyas, began the performance of sacrifice.

140.g: ਹਸਤ ਸੁੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ; ਪਰਤ ਧਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
140.e: The continuous current of clarified butter of the size of elephant’s trunk fell in the pit.

140.g: ਹੋਤ ਭਸਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ; ਲਪਟ ਝਪਟ ਕਰਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੪੫॥
140.e: Many materials were reduced to ashes by the dreadful flame.4.145.

140.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਸਭ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋ ਲੈ ਬਾਰ ॥
140.e: The earth and water of all the pilgrim-stations was broutht.

140.g: ਕਾਸਟਕਾ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਕੀ ਜਿਉਨਾਰ ॥
140.e: Also the fuel-wood and food-materials from all countries

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤਨ ਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ; ਹੋਮੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
140.e: Various kids of tasteful foods were burnt in the alftar.

140.g: ਦੇਖ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਜੰਬਰ; ਰੀਝ ਹੀ ਨਰ ਨਾਹ ॥੫॥੧੪੬॥
140.e: Seeing which the superb Brahmins were astonished and the kings pleased.5.146.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਜੰਨ; ਹੋਮੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਆਨ ॥
140.e: Many and various types of foods were burnt in the altar.

140.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਚਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਬਿਪ ਬ︀ਯਾਸ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
140.e: On all the four sides the learned Brahmins were reciting the four Vedas, like Vyas.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੂਪਤ; ਦੇਤ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
140.e: Many kings were giving innumerable types of gifts in charity.

140.g: ਭੂਮ ਭੂਰ ਉਠੀ ਜਯਤ ਧੁਨ; ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥੬॥੧੪੭॥
140.e: Here, there and everywhere on the earth infinite strain of victory was sounded.6.147.

140.g: ਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਮਵਾਸ ਆਸਨ; ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਛਿਨਾਇ ॥
140.e: Counquering the rebel kings and seizing the unaccountable wealth and precious things

140.g: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਦਿਜਾਨਨ; ਜਗ ਮੈ ਕੁਰ ਰਾਇ ॥
140.e: (Yusdhishtra) the king of Kuru country brought that wealth and distributed among the Brahmins.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਧੂਪ; ਸੁ ਧੂਪੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਆਨ ॥
140.e: Many types of fragrant materials were ignited there.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਉਠੀ ਜਯ ਧੁਨਿ; ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥੭॥੧੪੮॥
140.e: Here, there and everywhere in all directions many types of the strains of victory were sounded.7.148.

140.g: ਜਰਾਸੰਧਹ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਿ; ਕੈਰਵਾ ਹਥਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
140.e: After slaying Jarasandh and then conquering the Kauravas,

140.g: ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਕੀਓ ਬਡੋ ਮਖਿ; ਕਿਸਨ ਕੇ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
140.e: Yudhishtra performed the great Rajsu sacrifice in consultation with Krishna.

140.g: ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਸੁ ਕੈ ਕਿਤੇ ਦਿਨ; ਜੀਤ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
140.e: Conquering innumerable enemies, for many days, he performed the Rajsu sacrifice.

140.g: ਬਾਜਮੇਧ ਅਰੰਭ ਕੀਨੋ ਬੇਦ ਬ︀ਯਾਸ ਮਤੰਤ ॥੮॥੧੪੯॥
140.e: Then, with the advice of Ved Vyas, he began the performance of horse-sacrifice.8.149.

140.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਜਗ ਸਮਾਪਤਿਹ ॥
140.e: Here ends the First Sacrifice.

141.g: ਅਥ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਛਤ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
141.e: Here begins the Description of the Rule of the King Parikshat :

141.g: ਰੁਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
141.e: ROOAAL STANZA

141.g: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਪਰੀਛਤਹਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.e: One day the King Parikshat consulted his ministers

141.g: ਗਜਾਮੇਧ ਸੁ ਜਗ ਕੋ; ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਸਵਧਾਨ ॥
141.e: As to how the elephant sacrifice be performed methodically?

141.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਨ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
141.e: The friends and the ministers who spoke gave the idea

141.g: ਸੇਤ ਦੰਤ ਮੰਗਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਹੁ; ਜੁਗਤ ਸੌ ਅਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
141.e: That abandoning all other thoughts, the elephant of white teeth be sent for.1.157.

141.g: ਜਗ ਮੰਡਲ ਕੋ ਰਚਿਯੋ ਤਹਿ; ਕੋਟ ਅਸਟ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
141.e: The sacrificial altar was constructed within eight kos

141.g: ਅਸਟ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਰਿਤੁਜੁ; ਅਸਟ ਲਛ ਦਿਜਾਨ ॥
141.e: Eight thousand ritual-performing and eight lakh other Brahmins

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਬਨਾਇ ਕੈ ਤਹਾ; ਅਸਟ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਰ ॥
141.e: Eight thousand drain of various types were prepared.

141.g: ਹਸਤ ਸੁੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ; ਹੋਮੀਐ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੫੮॥
141.e: Through which the continuous current of the clarified butter of the size of the elephant-trunk flowed.2.158.

141.g: ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ; ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
141.e: Various types of kings from various countries were called.

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤਨ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ; ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
141.e: They were given many gifts of various types with honour,

141.g: ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਪਟੰਬਰਾਦਿਕ; ਬਾਜ ਅਉ ਗਜਰਾਜ ॥
141.e: Including diamonds, silken clothers etc., horses and big elephants.

141.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਸਬੈ ਦੀਏ; ਬਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਕੌ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਜ ॥੩॥੧੫੯॥
141.e: The great Sovereign gave all the things highly decorated to the kings.3.159.

141.g: ਐਸਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਕੀਓ ਤਹਾ; ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖ ਲਉ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
141.e: In this way he ruled there for many years.

141.g: ਕਰਨ ਦੇਵ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ; ਅਰ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਜ ॥
141.e: Many eminent enemies like the king Karan were conquered alongwith many of their precious belongings.

141.g: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਚੜਿਓ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਰ; ਸੈਲ ਕਾਜ ਅਖੇਟ ॥
141.e: On one day the king went on a merry-making trip and hunting.

141.g: ਦੇਖ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਭਇਓ ਤਹਾ; ਮੁਨਰਾਜ ਸਿਉ ਭਈ ਭੇਟ ॥੪॥੧੬੦॥
141.e: He saw and pursued a deer and met a great sage.4.160.

141.g: ਪੈਡ ਯਾਹਿ ਗਯੋ ਨਹੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ, ਰੇ ਰਖੀਸਰ, ਬੋਲ ॥
141.e: (He said to the sage) “O great sage! Please speak, did the deer go this way ?”

141.g: ਉਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਪਹਿ ਨ ਦੀਓ ਮੁਨਿ; ਆਖਿ ਭੀ ਇਕ ਖੋਲ ॥
141.e: The sage did not open his eye nor gave any answer to the king,

141.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕ ਸਰਪ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਕੈ; ਜਿਹ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਤਾਹ ਉਠਾਇ ॥
141.e: Seeing a dead snake, (the king) raised it with the tip of his bow

141.g: ਤਉਨ ਕੇ ਗਰ ਡਾਰ ਕੈ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜਾਤ ਭਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਇ ॥੫॥੧੬੧॥
141.e: Put it around the neck of the sage  then the Great Sovereign went away.5.161.

141.g: ਆਖ ਉਘਾਰ ਲਖੈ ਕਹਾ ਮੁਨ; ਸਰਪ ਦੇਖ ਡਰਾਨ ॥
141.e: What did the sage see on opening his eyes? He was frightened to see the snake (around his neck).

141.g: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਤ ਭਯੋ ਤਹਾ ਦਿਜ; ਰਕਤ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਚੁਚਾਨ ॥
141.e: There he became very angry and the blood oozed out form the eyes of the Brahmin.

141.g: ਜਉਨ ਮੋ ਗਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਗਿਓ; ਤਿਹ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੈ ਅਹਿਰਾਇ ॥
141.e: (He said:) “He, who hath put this snake around my neck, he will be bitten by the king of snakes

141.g: ਸਪਤ ਦਿਵਸਨ ਮੈ ਮਰੈ; ਯਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਸਦਾਇ ॥੬॥੧੬੨॥
141.e: “He will die within seven days. This curse of mine will ever be rure.”6.162.

141.g: ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਡਰਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ; ਮੰਦ੍ਰ ਏਕ ਉਸਾਰ ॥
141.e: Coming to know about the curse, the king was frightened. He got and Abode constructed.

141.g: ਮਧਿ ਗੰਗ ਰਚਿਯੋ ਧਉਲਹਰਿ; ਛੁਇ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਬਿਆਰ ॥
141.e: That palace was constructed within the Ganges, which could not even be touched by air

141.g: ਸਰਪ ਕੀ ਤਹ ਗੰਮਤਾ ਕੋ, ਕਾਟਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
141.e: How could the snake reach there and bite the king?

141.g: ਕਾਲ ਪਾਇ ਕਟ︀ਯੋ ਤਬੈ ਤਹਿ ਆਨ ਕੈ ਅਹਿਰਾਇ ॥੭॥੧੬੩॥
141.e: But within the due time, the king snakes came there and bit (the king).7.163.

141.g: ਸਾਠ ਬਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ; ਦੁਇ ਮਾਸ ਯੌ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰ ॥
141.e: (The king Parikshat) ruled for sixty years, two months and four days.

141.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਲੀ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
141.e: Then the light of the soul of the king Parikshat merged in the light of the Creator.

141.g: ਭੂਮ ਭਰਥ ਭਏ ਤਬੈ; ਜਨਮੇਜ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.e: Then the great king Janmeja become the Sustainer of the earth.

141.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਹਠੀ ਤਪੀ; ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੮॥੧੬੪॥
141.e: He was a great hero, headstrong, ascetic and adept in eighteen learinings.8.164.

141.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਛਤ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਵਤ ਭਏ ॥
141.e: The end of the Episode of King Parikshat.The Rule of King Janmeja begins :

141.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
141.e: Pauree:

141.g: ਇਕਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜਦੇ; ਇਕਿ ਕਚੈ ਦੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
141.e: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.

141.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
141.e: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within the self.

141.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਧਿਆ; ਅੰਧੇ. ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
141.e: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died in their endless wanderings.

141.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ; ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
141.e: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.

141.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਕਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
141.e: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. Unto whom should they complain?

141.g: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ. ਸਦਾ ਭਉਕਦੇ; ਇਕਨਾ ਭਰੇ ਤੁਜਾਰਾ ॥
141.e: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses of wealth.

141.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
141.e: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison and ashes.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
141.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of His Command, we are embellished and exalted. ||7||

141.g: ਨਿਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਲੈ ਧਰਾ ਪਰਿ; ਕਾਮ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਇ ॥
141.e: He walks on the earth with dancing pose, glorious in beauty like Cupid.

141.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਛਕੈ ਸਭੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ; ਰੀਝਿ ਇਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੫੦॥
141.e: On seeing him all the kings are pleased and also (Yudhishtra) the king of king.9.150.

141.g: ਬੀਣ ਬੇਣ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਬਾਜਤ; ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਸੁਰਨਾਇ ॥
141.e: Vina, Ven Mridang, Bansuri and Bheri are being played.

141.g: ਮੁਰਜ ਤੂਰ ਮੁਚੰਗ ਮੰਦਲ; ਚੰਗ ਬੰਗ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
141.e: Innumerable Muj, Toor, Murchang, Mandal, Changbeg and sarnaaee

141.g: ਢੋਲ ਢੋਲਕ ਖੰਜਕਾ ਡਫ; ਝਾਝ ਕੋਟ ਬਜੰਤ ॥
141.e: Dhol, Dholak, Khanjari, Daph and Jhaanjh are also being played.

141.g: ਜੰਗ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਟਲਕਾ; ਉਪਜੰਤ ਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੧੦॥੧੫੧॥
141.e: Big bell and small bells resound and innumerable modes of music are created.10.151.

141.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਸਬਦ ਬਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਭੇਰਿ; ਹਰੰਤ ਬਾਜ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
141.e: Kettledrums when played produce unlimited sound and innumerable horses neigh.

141.g: ਜਾਤ ਜਉਨ ਦਿਸਾਨ ਕੇ ਪਛ; ਲਾਗ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਦਾਰ ॥
141.e: Wherever the horse named Sri Barn goes, the army chiefs follow him.

141.g: ਜਉਨ ਬਾਧ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਜੂਝਤ; ਜੀਤੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਧ ॥
141.e: Whosoever chains the horse, they fight with him and conquer him.

141.g: ਆਨ ਜੌਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਚੈ ਨਹਿ; ਮਾਰੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ॥੧੧॥੧੫੨॥
141.e: He who receives them, he is saved, otherwise one who confronts, is violently killed.11.152.

141.g: ਹੈਯ ਫੇਰ ਚਾਰ ਦਿਸਾਨ ਮੈ; ਸਭ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਛਿਤਪਾਲ ॥
141.e: All the king were conquered by sending the horse in all the four directions.

141.g: ਬਾਜਮੇਧ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਸਪੂਰਨ; ਅਮਿਤ ਜਗ ਰਿਸਾਲ ॥
141.e: The horse-sacrifice was thus completed, it is very great and marvelous in the world.

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਦਾਨ; ਸੁ ਦੀਜੀਅਹਿ ਦਿਜਰਾਜ ॥
141.e: Various types of materials were given to the Brahmins in charity.

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਪਟੰਬਰਾਦਿਕ; ਬਾਜਿਯੋ ਗਜਰਾਜ ॥੧੨॥੧੫੩॥
141.e: Also many types of silken clothes, horses and great elephant.12.153.

141.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਦਾਨ ਦੀਏ ਦਿਜਾਨਨ; ਅਮਿਤ ਦਰਬ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
141.e: Many gifts and unaccountable wealth was given in charity to innumerable Brahmins.

141.g: ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਪਟੰਬਰਾਦਿ; ਸੁਵਰਨ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰ ॥
141.e: Including diamonds, common clothes, silken clothes and many loads of gold.

141.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟ ਤ੍ਰਸੇ ਸਬੈ; ਥਰਹਰਿਓ ਸੁਨਿ ਗਿਰਰਾਇ ॥
141.e: All the great enemies were horrified and even Sumeru, the king of mountain trembled on listening the details of charity.

141.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਨ ਦੈ ਦ੍ਵਿਜੈ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਾਟ ਬਾਟ ਲੁਟਾਇ ॥੧੩॥੧੫੪॥
141.e: Fearing that the Chief Sovereign may not cut him into bits and then distribute the bits.13.154.

141.g: ਫੇਰ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਮੈ ਹਯ; ਮਾਰਿਓ ਮਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
141.e: Moving it throughout the country, the horse was ultimately killed in the sacrificial place

141.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਕੈ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਤਬੈ; ਪਲ ਕੈ ਕਰੈ ਚਤੁ ਭਾਇ ॥
141.e: Then it was cut into four pieces (parts).

141.g: ਏਕ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਨ ਏਕ ਛਤ੍ਰਨ; ਏਕ ਇਸਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਦੀਨ ॥
141.e: One part was given to the Brahmins, one to Kshatriyas and one to women.

141.g: ਚਤ੍ਰ ਅੰਸ ਬਚਿਯੋ ਜੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ; ਹੋਮ ਮੈ ਵਹਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੧੪॥੧੫੫॥
141.e: The remaining fourth part was burnt in the fire-altar.14.155.

141.g: ਪੰਚ ਸੈ ਬਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ; ਸੁ ਰਾਜ ਕੈ ਇਹ ਦੀਪ ॥
141.e: After ruling this Dvipa for five hundred years.

141.g: ਅੰਤ ਜਾਇ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਸਾਤਲ; ਪੰਡ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
141.e: These sons of king Pandu ultimately fell in the himalayas (neither-world).

141.g: ਭੂਮ ਭਰਤ ਭਏ ਪਰੀਛਤ; ਪਰਮ ਰੂਪ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.e: After them Parikshat, who was most beautiful and mighty, (their grandson, the son of Abhimanya) became the king of Bharat.

141.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਰੂਪ ਉਦਾਰ ਦਾਨ; ਅਛਿਜ ਤੇਜ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੧੫॥੧੫੬॥
141.e: He was man of boundless charm, a generous donor and a treasure of invincible glory.15.156.

141.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧ ਪੋਥੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਗ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
141.e: This is the end of the Second Sacrifice in the book entitled SRI GYAN PRABODH.

141.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
141.e: Pauree:

141.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਯਤਿ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਰਹਸੀਓ ॥
141.e: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.

141.g: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰ; ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਹਸੀਓ ॥
141.e: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

141.g: ਪਕੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ; ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
141.e: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.

141.g: ਦਰਬਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ; ਰੀਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਣੇ ॥
141.e: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth, shall be emptied out in an instant.

141.g: ਤਾਜੀ ਰਥ ਤੁਖਾਰ; ਹਾਥੀ ਪਾਖਰੇ ॥
141.e: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations;

141.g: ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ; ਕਿਥੈ. ਸਿ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
141.e: the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions -

141.g: ਤੰਬੂ ਪਲੰਘ ਨਿਵਾਰ; ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਲਾਲਤੀ ॥
141.e: Oh, where are those things, which they believe to be their own?

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ; ਸਿਨਾਖਤੁ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ॥੮॥
141.e: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerful Creative Nature. ||8||
First Mehl:

141.g: ਪੰਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ. ਵਖਤ ਪੰਜਿ; ਪੰਜਾ ਪੰਜੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
141.e: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.

141.g: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਲਾਲ ਦੁਇ; ਤੀਜਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
141.e: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.

141.g: ਚਉਥੀ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ; ਪੰਜਵੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
141.e: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.

141.g: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਲਮਾ ਆਖਿ ਕੈ; ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥
141.e: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੇਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ; ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
141.e: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3||

141.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
141.e: Fourth Mehl:

141.g: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
141.e: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminate egotistical pride.

141.g: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ. ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੈ; ਤਾ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ. ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
141.e: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Only then shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord amidst the darkness of the world.

141.g: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ; ਤਜਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ. ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
141.e: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children and spouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
141.e: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word of the Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

141.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
141.e: Salok, First Mehl:

141.g: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ. ਕਹਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ; ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
141.e: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.

141.g: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਉਲਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ; ਮਸਕਲ ਮਾਨਾ. ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਸਾਵੈ ॥
141.e: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of his possessions be scraped away.

141.g: ਹੋਇ ਮੁਸਲਿਮੁ. ਦੀਨ ਮੁਹਾਣੈ; ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
141.e: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.

141.g: ਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ. ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ; ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨੇ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
141.e: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness and conceit.

141.g: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ; ਤ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
141.e: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim. ||1||

141.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
141.e: ROOAAL STANZA

141.g: ਰਾਜ ਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਜਨਮੇਜ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.e: Born in the house of a king, the great king Jammeja

141.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਹਠੀ ਤਪੀ; ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
141.e: Was a great hero, headstrong, ascetic and adept in eighteen learnings.

141.g: ਪਿਤਰ ਕੇ ਬਧ ਕੋਪ ਤੇ; ਸਬ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਲੀਨ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
141.e: Being enraged at the death of his father, he called all the Brahmins

141.g: ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਲਗੇ ਮਖ; ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਇ ॥੧॥੧੬੫॥
141.e: And engaged himself in the performance of the snake-sacrifice in the zest of his mind for Dharma.1.165.

141.g: ਏਕ ਕੋਸ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ; ਮਖ ਕੁੰਡ ਕੀਨ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
141.e: The sacrificial pit was constructed within one kos.

141.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਕਤ ਕਰਨੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਹਿ; ਹੋਮ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
141.e: After preparing the fire-altar, the Brahmins began to recite mantras methodically.

141.g: ਆਨ ਆਨ ਗਿਰੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਹਿ; ਸਰਪ ਕੋਟ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
141.e: Millions and innumerable serpents came to fall there in the fire.

141.g: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਉਠੀ ਜੈਤ ਧੁਨ; ਭੂਮ ਭੂਰ ਉਦਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੬੬॥
141.e: Here, there and everywhere resounded the strain of victory of the pious king.2.166.

141.g: ਹਸਤ ਏਕ ਦੂ ਹਸਤ ਤੀਨ; ਚਉ ਹਸਤ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
141.e: The snakes measuring one arm’s length, two arms’ length, and there, four and five arms’ length

141.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
141.e: Salok, First Mehl:

141.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੇਣਵਾ; ਸੁੰਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਘੀਉ ॥
141.e: If the rivers became cows, giving milk, and the spring water became milk and ghee;

141.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਵੈ; ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
141.e: If all the earth became sugar, to continually excite the mind;
First Mehl

141.g: ਹਕੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ. ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰ. ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
141.e: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindu eating beef.

141.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਹਾਮਾ ਤਾ ਭਰੇ; ਜਾ. ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
141.e: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.

141.g: ਗਲੀ. ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ; ਛੁਟੈ. ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
141.e: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from the practice of Truth.

141.g: ਮਾਰਣ ਪਾਹਿ ਹਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ; ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
141.e: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਈ; ਕੂੜੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
141.e: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2||

142.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
142.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

142.g: ਰਚਿਯੋ ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਬਡੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
142.e: Sovereign (Jammeja) is performing the serpent-sacrifice.

142.g: ਕਰੈ ਬਿਪ ਹੋਮੈ ਸਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜੰ ॥
142.e: The Brahmins are busy in performing Home ritual whose merit is setting everything right.

142.g: ਦਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਰਪੰ ਅਨੰਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
142.e: Innumerable types of snakes are being burnt in the pit.

142.g: ਭੁਜੈ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੰਤੰ ਜੁਗੈ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੰ ॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
142.e: Innumerable cobras, drawn by the mantras at the gate of the king. Have been burnt.1.169.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਅਸਟ ਹਸਤੰ ਸਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਇ ਨਾਰੰ ॥
142.e: Many snakes of about eight arms’ length and about seven arms’ length, with necks

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਦੁਆਦਿਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਲੌ ਪਰਮ ਭਾਰੰ ॥
142.e: Many weighty serpents of twelve arms’ length

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਕਿਤੇ ਜੋਜਨੇਕੰ ॥
142.e: Many of two thousand arms’ length and many of one Yojana length

142.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਹੋਮ ਕੁੰਡੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਅਚੇਤੰ ॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
142.e: They all fell in the fire-altar pit unconsciously.2.170.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਜੋਜਨੇ ਦੁਇ ਕਿਤੇ ਤੀਨ ਜੋਜਨ ॥
142.e: Many serpents of two Yajana length and many of three Yajanas

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਚਾਰ ਜੋਜਨ ਦਹੇ ਭੂਮ ਭੋਗਨ ॥
142.e: Many of four Yajanas length, all these serpents of the earth were burnt

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਮੁਸਟ ਅੰਗੁਸਟ ਗ੍ਰਿਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ॥
142.e: Many of the size of a fist and a thumb and the length of a span

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਡੇਢੁ ਗਿਸਟੇ ਅੰਗੁਸਟੰ ਅਰਧਾਨੰ ॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
142.e: And many of the length of one and a half span and many of the size of half a thumb were burnt.3.171.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਚਾਰ ਜੋਜਨ ਲਉ ਚਾਰ ਕੋਸੰ ॥
142.e: Many serpents from the length of four Yajanas upto four kos,

142.g: ਛੁਐ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰੈ ਅਗਨ ਹੋਮੰ ॥
142.e: Were burnt in the altar-fire, as though the fire was touching the clarified butter.

142.g: ਫਣੰ ਫਟਕੈ ਫੇਣਕਾ ਫੰਤਕਾਰੰ ॥
142.e: While burning, the snakes fluttered their hoods, frothed and hissed.

142.g: ਛੁਟੈ ਲਪਟ ਜ੍ਵਾਲਾ ਬਸੈ ਬਿਖਧਾਰੰ ॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
142.e: When they fell in the fire, the flame flared up.4.172.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਸਪਤ ਜੋਜਨ ਲੌ ਕੋਸ ਅਸਟੰ ॥
142.e: Many serpents from the length of seven upto eight Kos,

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਅਸਟ ਜੋਜਨ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਸਟੰ ॥
142.e: Many of the length of eight Yojanas and very fat

142.g: ਭਯੋ ਘੋਰ ਬਧੰ ਜਰੇ ਕੋਟ ਨਾਗੰ ॥
142.e: Millions of snakes were thus burnt and there was great killing.

142.g: ਭਜ︀ਯੋ ਤਛਕੰ ਭਛਕੰ ਜੇਮ ਕਾਗੰ ॥੫॥੧੭੩॥
142.e: Takshak, the king of snakes ran away like the crow from the falcon for fear of being eaten.5.173.

142.g: ਕੁਲੰ ਕੋਟ ਹੋਮੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਵਹਿਣ ਕੁੰਡੰ ॥
142.e: Millions of serpents of his clan were burnt in the fire-altar.

142.g: ਬਚੇ ਬਾਧ ਡਾਰੇ ਘਨੇ ਕੁੰਡ ਝੁੰਡੰ ॥
142.e: Those who were saved, were bound down and collectively thrown in the fire-pit.

142.g: ਭਜ︀ਯੋ ਨਾਗ ਰਾਜੰ ਤਕ੍ਰਯੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕੰ ॥
142.e: The king of Nagas ran away and took sheleter in the world of Indra.

142.g: ਜਰ︀ਯੋ ਬੈਦ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਭਰ︀ਯੋ ਸਕ੍ਰ ਸੋਕੰ ॥੬॥੧੭੪॥
142.e: With the power of Vedic mantras, the Abode of Indra also began to broil and with this, Indra was in great agony.6.174.

142.g: ਬਧ︀ਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਗਿਰ︀ਯੋ ਭੂਮ ਮਧੰ ॥
142.e: Bound by mantras and tantras, (Takshak) ultimately fell on the earth.

142.g: ਅੜਿਓ ਆਸਤੀਕੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਸਿਧੰ ॥
142.e: At that the great adept Brahmin Aasteek resisted the orders of the king.

142.g: ਭਿੜ੍ਰਯੋ ਭੇੜ ਭੂਪੰ ਝਿਣ੍ਰਯੋ ਝੇੜ ਝਾੜੰ ॥
142.e: He quarreled with the king and in the strife felt offended

142.g: ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਉਠ︀ਯੋ ਤਣੀ ਤੋੜ ਤਾੜੰ ॥੭॥੧੭੫॥
142.e: And rose in great anger, breaking the strings of his clothes.7.175.

142.g: ਤਜ︀ਯੋ ਸ੍ਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਭਜ︀ਯੋ ਏਕ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
142.e: He asked the king to forsake the serpent-sacrifice and meditate on the One Lord

142.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਬੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਸਾਜੰ ॥
142.e: With whose Grace all the mantras and materials of the world come to our mind.

142.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਦੂਲ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
142.e: “O the Lion-like monarch and the treasure of learning!

142.g: ਤਪੈ ਤੇਜ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧੭੬॥
142.e: “Thy Glory will shine like sun and blaze like fire.8.176.

142.g: ਮਹੀ ਮਾਹ ਰੂਪੰ ਤਪੈ ਤੇਜ ਭਾਨੰ ॥
142.e: “Thy beauty on the earth shall be moonlike and thy splendour sunlike

142.g: ਦਸੰ ਚਾਰ ਚਉਦਾਹ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
142.e: “Thou shall be treasure of fourteen learnings.

142.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਗ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
142.e: “Listen, O wielder of the bow and the monarch with knowledge of the Shastras!

142.g: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਦਿਜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੰ ॥੯॥੧੭੭॥
142.e: “Bestow on me this gifts of abandoning the serpents-sacrifice.9.177.

142.g: ਤਜਹੁ ਜੋ ਨ ਸਰਪੰ ਜਰੋ ਅਗਨ ਆਪੰ ॥
142.e: “If thou dost not abandon this gift of abandoning the serpent-sacrifice, I shall burn myself in the fire

142.g: ਕਰੋ ਦਗਧ ਤੋ ਕੌ ਦਿਵੌ ਐਸ ਸ੍ਰਾਪੰ ॥
142.e: “Or by giving such curse I shall reduce thee to ashes

142.g: ਹਣ︀ਯੋ ਪੇਟ ਮਧੰ ਛੁਰੀ ਜਮਦਾੜੰ ॥
142.e: “Or I shall pierce my belly with the sharp dagger

142.g: ਲਗੇ ਪਾਪ ਤੋ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਗਾੜੰ ॥੧੦॥੧੭੮॥
142.e: “Listen! O king! thou shalt be causing a great sin for thyself of Brahmin-killing.”10.178.
First Mehl:

142.g: ਕਿਆ ਖਾਧੈ; ਕਿਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
142.e: What good is food, and what good are clothes,

142.g: ਜਾ ਮਨਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
142.e: if the True Lord does not abide within the mind?

142.g: ਕਿਆ ਮੇਵਾ. ਕਿਆ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ; ਕਿਆ ਮੈਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
142.e: What good are fruits, what good is ghee, sweet jaggery, what good is flour, and what good is meat?

142.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਪੜੁ. ਕਿਆ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਕੀਜਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
142.e: What good are clothes, and what good is a soft bed, to enjoy pleasures and sensual delights?

142.g: ਕਿਆ ਲਸਕਰ. ਕਿਆ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ; ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
142.e: What good is an army, and what good are soldiers, servants and mansions to live in?

142.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ; ਸਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
142.e: O Nanak, without the True Name, all this paraphernalia shall disappear. ||2||

142.g: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
142.e: Pauree:

142.g: ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਗੈਬਾਨਾ; ਖਸਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ॥
142.e: The foolish demon, who does evil deeds, does not know his Lord and Master.

142.g: ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ; ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ॥
142.e: Call him a mad-man, if he does not understand himself.

142.g: ਕਲਹਿ ਬੁਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ; ਵਾਦੇ ਖਪੀਐ ॥
142.e: The strife of this world is evil; these struggles are consuming it.

142.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ; ਭਰਮੇ ਪਚੀਐ ॥
142.e: Without the Lord's Name, life is worthless. Through doubt, the people are being destroyed.

142.g: ਰਾਹ ਦੋਵੈ. ਇਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸਿਝਸੀ ॥
142.e: One who recognizes that all spiritual paths lead to the One shall be emancipated.

142.g: ਕੁਫਰ ਗੋਅ. ਕੁਫਰਾਣੈ; ਪਇਆ ਦਝਸੀ ॥
142.e: One who speaks lies shall fall into hell and burn.

142.g: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ; ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
142.e: In all the world, the most blessed and sanctified are those who remain absorbed in Truth.

142.g: ਸਿਝੈ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਵਾਨਿ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
142.e: One who eliminates selfishness and conceit is redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||9||
First Mehl:

142.g: ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਟਿਆ; ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
142.e: Look, and see how the sugar-cane is cut down. After cutting away its branches, its feet are bound together into bundles,

142.g: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
142.e: First Mehl, Salok:

142.g: ਸੋ ਜੀਵਿਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
142.e: They alone are truly alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

142.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਵਰੁ; ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
142.e: O Nanak, no one else is truly alive;

142.g: ਜੇ ਜੀਵੈ; ਪਤਿ ਲਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
142.e: those who merely live shall depart in dishonor;

142.g: ਸਭੁ ਹਰਾਮੁ; ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
142.e: everything they eat is impure.

142.g: ਰਾਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ; ਮਾਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
142.e: Intoxicated with power and thrilled with wealth,

142.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ; ਨਚੈ ਨੰਗੁ ॥
142.e: They delight in their pleasures, and dance about shamelessly.

142.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
142.e: O Nanak, they are deluded and defrauded.

142.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਪਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
142.e: Without the Lord's Name, they lose their honor and depart. ||1||

142.g: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
142.e: Pauree:

142.g: ਜਾਤੀ ਦੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ; ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੀਐ ॥
142.e: What good is social class and status? Truthfulness is measured within.

142.g: ਮਹੁਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਥਿ; ਮਰੀਐ ਚਖੀਐ ॥
142.e: Pride in one's status is like poison-holding it in your hand and eating it, you shall die.

142.g: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
142.e: The True Lord's Sovereign Rule is known throughout the ages.

142.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰਦਾਰੁ; ਦਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
142.e: One who respects the Hukam of the Lord's Command is honored and respected in the Court of the Lord.

142.g: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਰ; ਖਸਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
142.e: By the Order of our Lord and Master, we have been brought into this world.

142.g: ਤਬਲਬਾਜ ਬੀਚਾਰ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
142.e: The Drummer, the Guru, has announced the Lord's meditation, through the Word of the Shabad.

142.g: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਏ ਅਸਵਾਰ; ਇਕਨਾ ਸਾਖਤੀ ॥
142.e: Some have mounted their horses in response, and others are saddling up.

142.g: ਇਕਨੀ ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ; ਇਕਨਾ ਤਾਖਤੀ ॥੧੦॥
142.e: Some have tied up their bridles, and others have already ridden off. ||10||

142.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
142.e: Salok, First Mehl:

142.g: ਜਾ ਪਕਾ. ਤਾ ਕਟਿਆ; ਰਹੀ. ਸੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਵਾੜਿ ॥
142.e: When the crop is ripe, then it is cut down; only the stalks are left standing.

142.g: ਸਣੁ ਕੀਸਾਰਾ. ਚਿਥਿਆ; ਕਣੁ ਲਇਆ. ਤਨੁ ਝਾੜਿ ॥
142.e: The corn on the cob is put into the thresher, and the kernels are separated from the cobs.

142.g: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਚਕੀ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ; ਪੀਸਣ ਆਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥
142.e: Placing the kernels between the two mill-stones, people sit and grind the corn.

142.g: ਜੋ ਦਰਿ ਰਹੇ. ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਜਬੁ ਡਿਠੁ ॥੧॥
142.e: Those kernels which stick to the central axle are spared-Nanak has seen this wonderful vision! ||1||
First Mehl:

142.g: ਜੇ. ਦੇਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਈਐ; ਪਾਪ ਗਰਹ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
142.e: If my body were afflicted with pain, under the evil influence of unlucky stars;

142.g: ਰਤੁ ਪੀਣੇ ਰਾਜੇ. ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ; ਏਵੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
142.e: and if the blood-sucking kings were to hold power over me

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ; ਆਖਣ. ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੩॥
142.e: -even if this were my condition, I would still worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||3||
First Mehl:

142.g: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ. ਮੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗਰੁੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
142.e: If all the eighteen loads of vegetation became fruits,

142.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
142.e: and the growing grass became sweet rice; if I were able to stop the sun and the moon in their orbits and hold them perfectly steady

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ; ਆਖਣ. ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
142.e: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||2||

142.g: ਬੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਇਕੀਸ ਹਾਥ; ਪਚੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
142.e: Twenty arms’ length, twenty one arms length and twenty-five length

142.g: ਤੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਬਤੀਸ ਹਾਥ; ਛਤੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਗਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
142.e: Thirty arms’ length, thirty-two arms’ length and thirty-six arms’ length fell

142.g: ਆਨ ਆਨ ਗਿਰੈ ਤਹਾ; ਸਭ ਭਸਮ ਭੂਤ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥੧੬੭॥
142.e: And began to fall there all and reduced to ashes.3.167.

142.g: ਏਕ ਸੌ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ; ਦੋ ਸੌ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
142.e: Those measuring one hindered arms’ length and two hundred arms’ length

142.g: ਤੀਨ ਸੌ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ; ਚਤ੍ਰ ਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
142.e: Three hundred arms’ length and four hundred arms length

142.g: ਪਾਚ ਸੈ ਖਟ ਸੈ ਲਗੇ; ਤਹਿ ਬੀਚ ਆਨ ਗਿਰੰਤ ॥
142.e: Five hundred and six hundred arms’ length began to fall there within the fire-pit

142.g: ਸਹੰਸ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ ਸਭ; ਹੋਮ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੪॥੧੬੮॥
142.e: Even upto one thousand arms’ length and all innumerable ones were burnt and (thus reduced to ashes).4.168.

142.g: ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
142.e: if the mountains became gold and silver, studded with gems and jewels

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ; ਆਖਣ. ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
142.e: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||1||
First Mehl:

142.g: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਖਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਉ ॥
142.e: If fire and ice were my clothes, and the wind was my food;

142.g: ਸੁਰਗੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਹੋਵਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭੋ ਜਾਉ ॥
142.e: and even if the enticing heavenly beauties were my wives, O Nanak-all this shall pass away!

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ; ਆਖਣ. ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੪॥
142.e: Even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||4||

143.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਬਿਪ ਬੋਲੰ ਉਠਿਯੋ ਆਪ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
143.e: Hearing these words of the Brahmin, the king stood up.

143.g: ਤਜਿਯੋ ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੈਰ ਕਾਜੰ ॥
143.e: He abandoned the serpent-sacrifice and enmity for the death of his father.

143.g: ਬੁਲ︀ਯੋ ਬ︀ਯਾਸ ਪਾਸੰ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਰੰ ॥
143.e: He called Vyas near him and began consultations.

143.g: ਮਹਾ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਕਰਣ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥੧੧॥੧੭੯॥
143.e: Vyas was the great scholar of Vedas and the learning of Grammar.11.179.

143.g: ਸੁਨੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਦੁਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੰ ਕਾਸਿ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
143.e: The king had heard that she king of Kashi had two daughter

143.g: ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਰੂਪ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਮਾਜੰ ॥
143.e: Who were most beautiful and splendour of society.

143.g: ਜਿਣਿਉ ਜਾਇ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਹਣੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟੰ ॥
143.e: He wanted to go there in order to conquer them after killing the mighty tyrant.

143.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਤਾਨੇ ਲਦੇ ਭਾਰ ਉਸਟੰ ॥੧੨॥੧੮੦॥
143.e: He then left (for that city) with loaded camel.12.180.

143.g: ਚਲੀ ਸੈਨ ਸੂਕਰ ਪਰਾਚੀ ਦਿਸਾਨੰ ॥
143.e: The army moved towards the east like swift wind.

143.g: ਚੜੇ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਹਠੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
143.e: With many heroes, enduring the resolute and weapon-wielders,

143.g: ਦੁਰਿਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਰਗ ਸੁ ਬਾਰਾਣਸੀਸੰ ॥
143.e: The king of Kashi concealed himself in his ciadel,

143.g: ਘੇਰ︀ਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਫਉਜੰ ਭਜਿਓ ਏਕ ਈਸੰ ॥੧੩॥੧੮੧॥
143.e: Which was besieged by the army of Janmeja  he meditated only on Shiva.13.181.

143.g: ਮਚਿਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਸੁਧੰ ਬਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
143.e: The war began in full swing, there were many slayings with weapons

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਅਧੁ ਵਧੰ ਸਨਧੰ ਬਿਪਾਤੰ ॥
143.e: And the heroes, cut into bits, fell in the field.

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰੰ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ਰਜਾਣੰ ॥
143.e: The warriors experienced bloodbath and fell with their clothes filled with blood.

143.g: ਕਟੈ ਅਧੁ ਅਧੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਧ︀ਯਾਨੰ ॥੧੪॥੧੮੨॥
143.e: They were chopped into halves  the contemplation of Shva was interrupted.14.182.

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਖੇਤ੍ਰ ਖਤ੍ਰਾਣ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਖਤ੍ਰਾਣੰ ॥
143.e: Many Kshatriyas of reputation fell in the battlefield.

143.g: ਬਜੀ ਭੇਰ ਭੁੰਕਾਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਕਿਆ ਨਿਸਾਣੰ ॥
143.e: The dreadful sound of kettledrums and trumpets resounded.

143.g: ਕਰੇ ਪੈਜਵਾਰੰ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
143.e: The heroic warriors were shouting and making pledges, and also striking blows.

143.g: ਫਿਰੇ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਤਣੰ ਤਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੧੫॥੧੮੩॥
143.e: The trunks and heads, and bodies pierced by arrows were roaming.15.183.

143.g: ਬਿਭੇ ਦੰਤ ਵਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਛੇਦੈ ਤਨਾਨੰ ॥
143.e: The shafts were penetrating into the steel-armour

143.g: ਕਰੇ ਮਰਦਨੰ ਅਰਦਨੰ ਮਰਦਮਾਨੰ ॥
143.e: And the heroic warriors were destroying the pride of others.

143.g: ਕਟੇ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਚਉਰ ਚਾਰੰ ॥
143.e: The bodies and armour were being cut and the flywhicks were being trampled

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥੧੬॥੧੮੪॥
143.e: And with the blows of weapons, the bold warriors were falling.16.184.

143.g: ਜਿਣ੍ਰਯੋ ਕਾਸਕੀਸੰ ਹਣ︀ਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨੰ ॥
143.e: The king of Kashi was conquered and all his forces were destroyed.

143.g: ਬਰੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਤਾਹ ਕੰਪ︀ਯੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਨੈਨੰ ॥
143.e: Both his daughters were wedded by Janmeja, seeing which Shiva, the three-eyed god, trembled.

143.g: ਭਇਓ ਮੇਲ ਗੇਲੰ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
143.e: Both the kings then became friendly  the conquered kingdom was returned,

143.g: ਭਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਰੰ ਸਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜੰ ॥੧੭॥੧੮੫॥
143.e: Friendship developed between both the kings and all their works were settled appropriately.17.185.

143.g: ਮਿਲੀ ਰਾਜ ਦਾਜੰ ਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਅਨੂਪੰ ॥
143.e: The King janmeja received a unique maid-servant in his dowry,

143.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਵੰਤੀ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
143.e: Who was very learned and supremely beautiful.

143.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰੰ ਕਿਤੇ ਸਿਆਉ ਕਰਨੰ ॥
143.e: He also received diamonds, garments and horses of black ears

143.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਮਤ ਦੰਤੀ ਕਿਤੇ ਸੇਤ ਬਰਨੰ ॥੧੮॥੧੮੬॥
143.e: He also got many wanton white-coloured elephants with tusks.18.186.

143.g: ਕਰ︀ਯੋ ਬ︀ਯਾਹ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਇਓ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੰ ॥
143.e: On his marriage, the king became very happy.

143.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤ ਪੋਖੇ ਦਿਜੰ ਸਰਬ ਅੰਨੰ ॥
143.e: All the Brahmin were satisfied with the grant of all types of corn.

143.g: ਕਰੇ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤੰ ਮਹਾ ਗਜ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
143.e: The king gave in charity various of elephants.

143.g: ਭਏ ਦੋਇ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੧੯॥੧੮੭॥
143.e: From both his wives, two very beautiful sons were born.19.187.

143.g: ਲਖੀ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਦਾਸੀ ॥
143.e: (One day) the king saw the winsome maid-servant.

143.g: ਮਨੋ ਚੀਰ ਕੈ ਚਾਰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨਿਕਾਸੀ ॥
143.e: He felt as if the moonlight hath penetrated out of the moon.

143.g: ਲਹੈ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਲਤਾ ਸੀ ॥
143.e: He considered her as beautiful lightning and as creeper of learning

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਕੰਜਕੀ ਮਾਝ ਸੋਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ॥੨੦॥੧੮੮॥
143.e: Or the inner glory of the lotus hath manifested itself.20.188.

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਲਖੈ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਸੀ ॥
143.e: It seemd as if she was a garland of flowers or the moon itself

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਪਦਮਨੀ ਮੈ ਬਨੀ ਮਾਲਤੀ ਸੀ ॥
143.e: It may be the flower of Malti or it may be Padmini,

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਪੁਹਪ ਧੰਨਿਆ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਾਇਬੇਲੰ ॥
143.e: Or it may be Rati (the wife of god of love) or it may be the superb creeper of flowers.

143.g: ਤਜੈ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਚੰਪਾ ਫੁਲੇਲੰ ॥੨੧॥੧੮੯॥
143.e: The fragrance of the flowers of champa (Michelia champacca) was emanating from her limbs.21.189.

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਲੋਕ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
143.e: It seemed as if a heavenly damsel was roaming on the earth,
