143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਜਛਨੀ ਕਿਨ੍ਰਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਲੋਲੈ ॥
143.e: Or a Yaksha or Kinnar woman was busy in her frolics,

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਬੀਜੰ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਧਿ ਬਾਲੰ ॥
143.e: Or the semen of god Shiva had strayed in the form of young damsel,

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਨੰ ਨਚੈ ਕਉਲ ਨਾਲੰ ॥੨੨॥੧੯੦॥
143.e: Or the drops of water were dancing on the lotus leaf.22.190.

143.g: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
143.e: First Mehl, Salok:

143.g: ਮਛੀ ਤਾਰੂ. ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ; ਪੰਖੀ ਕਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
143.e: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?

143.g: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ; ਖੁਸਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
143.e: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?

143.g: ਕੁਤੇ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ; ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕੁਤੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
143.e: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.

143.g: ਬੋਲਾ. ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ; ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠ ॥
143.e: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?

143.g: ਅੰਧਾ. ਚਾਨਣਿ ਰਖੀਐ; ਦੀਵੇ ਬਲਹਿ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
143.e: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?

143.g: ਚਉਣੇ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਵੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
143.e: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.

143.g: ਲੋਹਾ ਮਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਢਹੈ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਸ ॥
143.e: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.

143.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੂਰਖ ਏਹਿ ਗੁਣ; ਬੋਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
143.e: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1||

143.g: ਖੁੰਢਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ; ਦੇਨਿ. ਸੁ ਮਲ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
143.e: and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.

143.g: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤਪੈ ਤੈ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
143.e: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.

143.g: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਫੋਗੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ; ਦਿਚੈ ਅਗਿ ਜਾਲਾਇ ॥
143.e: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.

143.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਠੈ ਪਤਰੀਐ; ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
143.e: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2||
First Mehl:

143.g: ਨ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵਾ; ਨਰਾ ॥
143.e: Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings,

143.g: ਨ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਧਰਾ ॥
143.e: Nor the Siddhas, nor the seekers shall remain on the earth.

143.g: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ; ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
143.e: Who else is there?

143.g: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
143.e: Pauree:

143.g: ਇਕਨਾ. ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ; ਆਸ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.e: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.

143.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ; ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.e: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!

143.g: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ; ਕਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.e: In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.

143.g: ਜਮਰਾਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.e: The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.

143.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਾਰਾਮ; ਕਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
143.e: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what they have been given.

143.g: ਬਧੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਲਾਮ; ਖਸਮ. ਨ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
143.e: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord and Master.

143.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
143.e: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.

143.g: ਕਰਸਨਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ; ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸੀ ॥੧੧॥
143.e: They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny. ||11||
First Mehl:

143.g: ਕੈਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,

143.g: ਅਗਨੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਏ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਗੋਰੀ ਸੇਤੀ; ਤੁਟੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: If a husband leaves his wife,

143.g: ਪੁਤਂ‍ੀ; ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
143.e: their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ; ਦਿਤੈ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
143.e: When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.

143.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ; ਜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
143.e: When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਕਾਲਾ ਗੰਢੁ; ਨਦੀਆ ਮੀਹ ਝੋਲ ॥
143.e: In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਗੰਢੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ; ਮਿਠੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
143.e: There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.

143.g: ਬੇਦਾ ਗੰਢੁ; ਬੋਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
143.e: When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.

143.g: ਮੁਇਆ ਗੰਢੁ; ਨੇਕੀ ਸਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
143.e: Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.

143.g: ਏਤੁ ਗੰਢਿ; ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.

143.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ; ਮੁਹਿ ਮਾਰ ॥
143.e: The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.

143.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਆਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: Nanak says this after deep reflection:

143.g: ਸਿਫਤੀ; ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
143.e: through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2||

143.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
143.e: Salok, First Mehl:

143.g: ਹਮ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ. ਦੁਨੀਆ; ਪੀਰਾ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
143.e: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buried under the ground.

143.g: ਮੇ ਰਵਦਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ; ਅਫਜੂ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
143.e: The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.

143.g: ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ. ਏਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥
143.e: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||1||

143.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
143.e: Pauree:

143.g: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.

143.g: ਇਕਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਰੇ; ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.

143.g: ਖਰੇ. ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ; ਖੋਟੇ. ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਹਰ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
143.e: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.

143.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
143.e: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-unto whom should they complain?

143.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ; ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.

143.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਖੋਟਿਅਹੁ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
143.e: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.

143.g: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
143.e: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the True Court.

143.g: ਗਣਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ; ਜੋ. ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
143.e: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator Lord Himself? ||12||

144.e: Salok, First Mehl:

144.g: ਸੀਹਾ ਬਾਜਾ ਚਰਗਾ ਕੁਹੀਆ; ਏਨਾ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਘਾਹ ॥
144.e: Tigers, hawks, falcons and eagles-the Lord could make them eat grass.

144.g: ਘਾਹੁ ਖਾਨਿ. ਤਿਨਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ; ਏਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
144.e: And those animals which eat grass-He could make them eat meat. He could make them follow this way of life.

144.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ. ਟਿਬੇ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ; ਥਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
144.e: He could raise dry land from the rivers, and turn the deserts into bottomless oceans.

144.g: ਕੀੜਾ ਥਾਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ; ਲਸਕਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
144.e: He could appoint a worm as king, and reduce an army to ashes.

144.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ. ਜੀਵਹਿ ਲੈ ਸਾਹਾ; ਜੀਵਾਲੇ. ਤਾ ਕਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥
144.e: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਹ ॥੧॥
144.e: O Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, He gives us sustenance. ||1||
It seemed as if a wreath of musical modes was presenting itself in colour and form

144.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਇਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਚੀ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
144.e: Or the Lord, king of kings, had created her as the Sovereign of beautiful women

144.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਨਾਗ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕਿਧੌ ਬਾਸਵੀ ਹੈ ॥
144.e: Or she was the daughter of a Naga or Basve, the wife of Sheshanaga
Or she was the charming replica of Sankhani, Chitrani or Padmini (9 types of women).23.191.
Her wonderful and infinite beauty glistened like a painting.
She was most elegant and most youthful.
She was most knowledgeable and adept in scientific works.

144.g: ਪੜੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸੁ ਬਿਦਿਆਦਿ ਧਰਮੰ ॥੨੪॥੧੯੨॥
144.e: She had all learning at her finger ends and was thus an adept in the discipline.24.192.
The king considered her more winsome than the light of fire.
The light of her face shone enormously than the light of fire.
The king Janmeja himself considered her like this,

144.g: ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮ ਭੋਗੰ ਦੀਏ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਜੰ ॥੨੫॥੧੯੩॥
144.e: Therefore he ardently copulated with her and gave her all the royal paraphernalia.25.193.

144.g: ਬਢਿਓ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਤਜੀ ਰਾਜ ਕੰਨਿਆ ॥
144.e: The king was greatly in love with her  he abandoned the king’s daughters (queens)

144.g: ਹੁਤੀ ਸਿਸਟ ਕੀ ਦਿਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਸਟ ਧੰਨਿਆ ॥
144.e: Who were considered eminent and fortunate in the sight of the world.

144.g: ਭਇਓ ਏਕ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
144.e: A son, a great weapon-wielder was born to him
He became adept in fourteen learnings.26.194.
The king named his first son as ASMEDH,
And named his second son as ASMEDHAN.

144.g: ਅਜੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਾਖ︀ਯੋ ਰਜੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
144.e: The maid-servant’s son was named AJAI SINGH,

144.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੰਗ ਜੋਧਾ ਮਹਾ ਜਸ ਪੂਰੰ ॥੨੭॥੧੯੫॥
144.e: Who was a great hero, a great warrior and greatly renowned.27.195.
He was a person of healthy body and great strength.
He was a great warrior in the battlefield and adept in warfare.

144.g: ਹਣੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟੰ ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
144.e: He killed prominent tyrants with his sharp-edged weapons.
He conquered many enemies like Lord Rama, the killer of Ranana.28.196.
One day the King Janmeja went hunting.

144.g: ਲਖੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਧਾਯੋ ਗਯੋ ਅਉਰ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
144.e: Seeing a deer, he pursued him and went to another country.

144.g: ਸ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਪਰਮ ਬਾਟੰ ਤਕਿਯੋ ਏਕ ਤਾਲੰ ॥
144.e: After the long and arduous journey, the king was tired  when he saw a tank,

144.g: ਤਹਾ ਦਉਰ ਕੈ ਪੀਨ ਪਾਨੰ ਉਤਾਲੰ ॥੨੯॥੧੯੭॥
144.e: He ran there quickly to drink water.29.197.

144.g: ਕਰਿਓ ਰਾਜ ਸੈਨੰ ਕਢਿਓ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਜੰ ॥
144.e: Then the king went to sleep. (the destiny) caused a horse to come out of water.
He saw the beautiful royal mare.

144.g: ਲਗ︀ਯੋ ਆਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਰਹ︀ਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਰਭੰ ॥
144.e: He copulated with her and made her pregnant.

144.g: ਭਇਓ ਸਿਯਾਮ ਕਰਣੰ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਅਦਰਬੰ ॥੩੦॥੧੯੮॥
144.e: From her an invaluable horse of black ears was born.30.198.

144.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਬਾਜ ਮੇਧੰ ਬਡੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
144.e: The king Janmeja began his great horse-sacrifice.

144.g: ਜਿਣੇ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ਸਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
144.e: He conquered all the kings and all his errands were set right.

144.g: ਗਡ੍ਰਯੋ ਜਗ ਥੰਭੰ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਹੋਮ ਕੁੰਡੰ ॥
144.e: The columns of the sacrificial place were fixed and the sacrificial altar was constructed.

144.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤ ਪੋਖੇ ਬਲੀ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਝੁੰਡੰ ॥੩੧॥੧੯੯॥
144.e: He satisfied nicely the assembly of the Brahmins giving wealth in charity.31.199.

144.g: ਦਏ ਕੋਟ ਦਾਨੰ ਪਕੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਕੰ ॥
144.e: Millins of gifts were given in charity and pure foods were served.

144.g: ਕਲੂ ਮਧਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਡੋ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਕੰ ॥
144.e: The king performed a great event of Dharma in the Kaliyuga.

144.g: ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨੇ ਆਪ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਜ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
144.e: As the queen began to scan all this,
She the most beautiful and abode of Supreme glory.32.200.

144.g: ਉਡ︀ਯੋ ਪਉਨ ਕੇ ਬੇਗ ਸਿਯੋ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਪਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
144.e: The frontal garment of the queen flew away by the gust of wind.

144.g: ਹਸੇ ਦੇਖ ਨਗਨੰ ਤ੍ਰੀਯੰ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਛਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
144.e: The Brahmins and Kshatriyas (in the assembly) seeing the nakedness of the queen laughed.

144.g: ਭਇਓ ਕੋਪ ਰਾਜਾ ਗਹੇ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
144.e: The king in great fury caught hold of all the Brahmins.

144.g: ਦਹੇ ਖੀਰ ਖੰਡੰ ਬਡੇ ਪਰਮ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੩੩॥੨੦੧॥
144.e: All the highly proud great Pundits were burnt with hot mixture of milk and sugar.33.201.

144.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਬਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਮੂੰਡੇ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ॥
144.e: Firstly all the Brahmins were bound down and their heads were shaved.

144.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਏਡੂਆ ਸੀਸ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਟਿਕਾਏ ॥
144.e: Then the pads were placed on the top of their heads.

144.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਤਪਤ ਕੈ ਖੀਰ ਕੇ ਮਧਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥
144.e: Then the boiling milk was poured (within the pads).

144.g: ਇਮੰ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥੩੪॥੨੦੨॥
144.e: And thus all the Brahmins were burnt and killed.34.202.
Salok, First Mehl:

144.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
144.e: When it pleases You, we play music and sing; when it pleases You, we bathe in water.
First Mehl:
O Nanak, that destiny which is pre-ordained and written on one's forehead
no one can erase it.
The Lord infuses strength, and He takes it away again.
You alone, O Lord, You alone. ||7||
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||2||
Pauree:

144.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ; ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
144.e: By the karma of good actions, some come to serve the Perfect Guru.
Through the Guru's Teachings, some eliminate selfishness and conceit, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Undertaking any other task, they waste their lives in vain.

144.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭ ਵਿਸੁ; ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
144.e: Without the Name, all that they wear and eat is poison.
Praising the True Word of the Shabad, they merge with the True Lord.

144.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
144.e: Without serving the True Guru, they do not obtain the home of peace; they are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.
Investing counterfeit capital, they earn only falsehood in the world.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੪॥
144.e: O Nanak, singing the Praises of the Pure, True Lord, they depart with honor. ||14||
First Mehl:
The birds have no money in their pockets.
They place their hopes on trees and water.
He alone is the Giver.
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||6||
Pauree:
True is the Hukam of Your Command. To the Gurmukh, it is known.
Through the Guru's Teachings, selfishness and conceit are eradicated, and the Truth is realized.
True is Your Court. It is proclaimed and revealed through the Word of the Shabad.
Meditating deeply on the True Word of the Shabad, I have merged into the Truth.
The self-willed manmukhs are always false; they are deluded by doubt.

144.g: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ; ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
144.e: They dwell in manure, and they do not know the taste of the Name.

144.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ; ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
144.e: Without the Name, they suffer the agonies of coming and going.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਾਰਖੁ ਆਪਿ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
144.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Appraiser, who distinguishes the counterfeit from the genuine. ||13||
First Mehl:
Neither the just, nor the generous, nor any humans at all,
Nor the seven realms beneath the earth, shall remain.
The One Lord alone exists. Who else is there?
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||3||
First Mehl:
Our sustenance is not in the hands of any person.
The hopes of all rest in the One Lord.
The One Lord alone exists-who else is there?
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||5||
First Mehl:
Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the planets,
Nor the seven continents, nor the oceans,
Nor food, nor the wind-nothing is permanent.
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||4||
First Mehl:
Some eat meat, while others eat grass.
Some have all the thirty-six varieties of delicacies,
while others live in the dirt and eat mud.
Some control the breath, and regulate their breathing.
Some live by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.
The Great Giver lives; no one dies.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ; ਨਾਹੀ. ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
144.e: O Nanak, those who do not enshrine the Lord within their minds are deluded. ||2||

145.e: First Mehl:

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ. ਸਭਿ ਵਡਿਆਂਈਆ; ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
145.e: You are so Great-all Greatness flows from You. You are So Good-Goodness radiates from You.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ; ਕੂੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
145.e: You are True-all that flows from You is True. Nothing at all is false.

145.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਚਲਣੁ; ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
145.e: Talking, seeing, speaking, walking, living and dying-all these are transitory.

145.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ. ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
145.e: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates, and in His Command, He keeps us. O Nanak, He Himself is True. ||2||

145.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
145.e: Salok, First Mehl:

145.g: ਸਬਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ; ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ॥
145.e: Those who praise the Lord in the early hours of the morning and meditate on Him single-mindedly,

145.g: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ; ਵਖਤੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮੁਏ ॥
145.e: are the perfect kings; at the right time, they die fighting.

145.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਰਾਹ; ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮਤੀ ਖਿੰਡੀਆ ॥
145.e: In the second watch, the focus of the mind is scattered in all sorts of ways.

145.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਏ ਅਸਗਾਹ; ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ. ਨ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ॥
145.e: So many fall into the bottomless pit; they are dragged under, and they cannot get out again.

145.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਬਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਬਾਚੇ ਦਿਵਾਰੰ ॥
145.e: Many Brahmins were entombed in the walls

145.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਬਾਧ ਫਾਸੀ ਦੀਏ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਭਾਰੰ ॥
145.e: Many eminent Brahmins were hanged

145.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਬਾਰਿ ਬੋਰੇ ਕਿਤੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
145.e: Many were drowned in water and many were bound in fire

145.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਅਧਿ ਚੀਰੇ ਕਿਤੇ ਬਾਧ ਫਾਰੇ ॥੩੫॥੨੦੩॥
145.e: Many were sawed into halves and many were bound and their bellies wre torn.35.203.

145.g: ਲਗਿਯੋ ਦੋਖ ਭੂਪੰ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਕੁਸਟ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
145.e: The king then suffered from the blemish of Brahmin-killing and his body was inflicted by leprosy.

145.g: ਸਭੇ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਨੇਹੀ ॥
145.e: He called all other Brahmins and treated them with love.

145.g: ਕਹੋ ਕਉਨ ਸੋ ਬੈਠਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
145.e: He asked them to sit and contemplate as to how,

145.g: ਦਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਦੋਖੰ ਮਿਟੈ ਪਾਪ ਭਾਰੰ ॥੩੬॥੨੦੪॥
145.e: The suffering of the body and the great sin can be removed.36.204.

145.g: ਬੋਲੇ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੰ ਸਬੈ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਆਏ ॥
145.e: All the invited Brahmins came to the royal court.

145.g: ਬਡੇ ਬਿਆਸ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
145.e: The eminent like Vyas and other were called.

145.g: ਦੇਖੈ ਲਾਗ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਬੋਲੇ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
145.e: After scanning the Shastras, all the Brahmins said,

145.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਮੇਧੰ ਬਢਿਓ ਭੂਪ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੩੭॥੨੦੫॥
145.e: “The ego of the king hath increased and because of this conceit, he mashed the Brahmins.37.205.

145.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਦੂਲ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
145.e: “Listen, O Supreme monarch, the treasure of learning

145.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਮੇਧੰ ਸੁ ਜਗੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ॥
145.e: “Thou didst mash the Brahmins during the sacrifice

145.g: ਭਇਓ ਅਕਸਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਕਹਿਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਉਨੈ ॥
145.e: “All this happened suddenly, no one directed thee for this

145.g: ਕਰੀ ਜਉਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਭਈ ਬਾਤ ਤਉਨੈ ॥੩੮॥੨੦੬॥
145.e: “All this hath been got done by the Providence, such happening had been recorded earlier.”38.206.

145.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਆਸ ਤੇ ਪਰਬ ਅਸਟੰ ਦਸਾਨੰ ॥
145.e: “O King! Listen from Vyas eighteen Parvas (parts) of Mahabharata

145.g: ਦਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਤੇ ਕੁਸਟ ਸਰਬੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਨੰ ॥
145.e: “Then all the ailment of leprosy will be removed from thy body.”

145.g: ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਬਿਆਸੰ ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਗ ਪਰਬੰ ॥
145.e: The eminent Brahmin Vyas was then called and the king began to listen to the Parvas (of Mahabharata).

145.g: ਪਰਿਯੋ ਭੂਪ ਪਾਇਨ ਤਜੇ ਸਰਬ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੩੯॥੨੦੭॥
145.e: The king fell at the feet of Vyas forsaking all pride.39.207.

145.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਦੂਲ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
145.e: (Vyas said J Listen, O Supreme monarch! the treasure of learning

145.g: ਹੂਓ ਭਰਥ ਕੇ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਨੰ ॥
145.e: In the linege of Bharat, there was a king named Raghu

145.g: ਭਇਓ ਤਉਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
145.e: In his line, there was the king Rama

145.g: ਦੀਜੈ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਦਾਨੰ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ਬਿਰਾਜਾ ॥੪੦॥੨੦੮॥
145.e: Who gave the gift of life to the kashatriyas from the wrath of Parasurama and also the treasures and comfortable living.40.208.

145.g: ਭਇਓ ਤਉਨ ਕੀ ਜਦ ਮੈ ਜਦੁ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
145.e: In his clan, there was a king named Yadu

145.g: ਦਸੰ ਚਾਰ ਚੌਦਹ ਸੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸਮਾਜੰ ॥
145.e: Who was erudite in all fourteen learnings

145.g: ਭਇਓ ਤਉਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਸੰਤਨੇਅੰ ॥
145.e: In his family, there was a king named Santanu

145.g: ਭਏ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੇ ਕਉਰਓ ਪਾਡਵੇਅੰ ॥੪੧॥੨੦੯॥
145.e: In his line, there were then Kaurvas and Pandavas.41.209.

145.g: ਭਏ ਤਉਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਤਰਾਸਟਰੰ ॥
145.e: In his family, there was Dhritrashtra,

145.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਜੋਧਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧਾ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
145.e: Who was a great hero in wars and a teacher of great enemies.

145.g: ਭਏ ਤਉਨ ਕੇ ਕਉਰਵੰ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
145.e: In his house there were Kauravas of vicious Karmas,

145.g: ਕੀਓ ਛਤ੍ਰਣੰ ਜੈਨ ਕੁਲ ਛੈਣ ਕਰਮੰ ॥੪੨॥੨੧੦॥
145.e: Who worked as a chisel (destroyer) for the clan of Kshatriyas.42.210.

145.g: ਕੀਓ ਭੀਖਮੇ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਮਾਜੰ ॥
145.e: They made Bhishama the General of their forces

145.g: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਜੁਧੰ ਸਮੁਹ ਪੰਡੁ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
145.e: In great fury they waged their war against the sons of Pandu.

145.g: ਤਹਾ ਗਰਜਿਯੋ ਅਰਜਨੰ ਪਰਮ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
145.e: In that war, the Supreme hereo Arjuna roared.

145.g: ਧਨੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਤਾ ਤਜੇ ਪਰਮ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੪੩॥੨੧੧॥
145.e: He was an adept in archery and shot his shafts superbly.43.211.

145.g: ਤਜੀ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਨਾ ਵਰੀ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
145.e: The great hero Arjuna shot his chain of arrows in the field (with such skill),

145.g: ਹਣਿਓ ਭੀਖਮੰ ਸਭੈ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਮੇਤੰ ॥
145.e: That he killed Bhishama and destroyed al his forces.

145.g: ਦਈ ਬਾਣ ਸਿਜਾ ਗਰੇ ਭੀਖਮੈਣੰ ॥
145.e: He gave Bhishama the bed of arrows, on which he lay down.

145.g: ਜਯੰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੁਖੰ ਪਾਡਵੇਣੰ ॥੪੪॥੨੧੨॥
145.e: The great Pandava (Arjuna) attained the victory comfortably.44.212.

145.g: ਭਏ ਦ੍ਰੋਣ ਸੈਨਾਪਤੀ ਸੈਨਪਾਲੰ ॥
145.e: The second general of Kauravas and master of their forces was Daronacharya.

145.g: ਭਇਓ ਘੋਰ ਜੁਧੰ ਤਹਾ ਤਉਨ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
145.e: There at that time a horrible war was waged.

145.g: ਹਣਿਓ ਧ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਦੋਨੰ ਤਜੇ ਦ੍ਰੋਣ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੰ ॥
145.e: Dhrishtadyumna killed Dronacharya, who breathed his last.

145.g: ਕਰਿਓ ਜੁਧ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਲੋਕੰ ਪਿਆਣੰ ॥੪੫॥੨੧੩॥
145.e: Dying in the battlefield, he went to heaven.45.213.

145.g: ਭਏ ਕਰਣ ਸੈਨਾਪਤੀ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਾਲੰ ॥
145.e: Karan became the third General of the Kaurva army,

145.g: ਮਚ︀ਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲੰ ॥
145.e: Who in great fury waged a terrible war.

145.g: ਹਣਿਓ ਤਾਹਿ ਪੰਥੰ ਸਦੰ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਪਿਓ ॥
145.e: He was killed by Partha (Arjuna) and immediately cut off his head.

145.g: ਗਿਰਿਓ ਤਉਣ ਯੁਧਿਸਟਰੰ ਰਾਜੁ ਥਪਿਓ ॥੪੬॥੨੧੪॥
145.e: After his fall (death), the rule of Yudhishtra was firmly established.46.214.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ. ਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ; ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.e: When it pleases You, we smear our bodies with ashes, and blow the horn and the conch shell.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ; ਮੁਲਾ ਸੇਖ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.e: When it pleases You, we read the Islamic Scriptures, and are acclaimed as Mullahs and Shaykhs.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ; ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.e: When it pleases You, we become kings, and enjoy all sorts of tastes and pleasures.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਵਹਿ; ਸਿਰ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.e: When it pleases You, we wield the sword, and cut off the heads of our enemies.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਜਾਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ; ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
145.e: When it pleases You, we go out to foreign lands; hearing news of home, we come back again.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.e: When it pleases You, we are attuned to the Name, and when it pleases You, we become pleasing to You.

145.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
145.e: Nanak utters this one prayer; everything else is just the practice of falsehood. ||1||

145.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
145.e: Pauree:

145.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ; ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
145.e: Serve the True Guru fearlessly, and your doubt shall be dispelled.

145.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਕਾਰ; ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
145.e: Do that work which the True Guru asks you to do.

145.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
145.e: When the True Guru becomes merciful, we meditate on the Naam.

145.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
145.e: The profit of devotional worship is excellent. It is obtained by the Gurmukh.

145.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
145.e: The self-willed manmukhs are trapped in the darkness of falsehood; they practice nothing but falsehood.

145.g: ਸਚੇ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ; ਸਚੁ ਚਵਾਂਈਐ ॥
145.e: Go to the Gate of Truth, and speak the Truth.

145.g: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ; ਸਚਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
145.e: The True Lord calls the true ones to the Mansion of His Presence.

145.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ; ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧੫॥
145.e: O Nanak, the true ones are forever true; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||15||

145.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
145.e: Pauree:

145.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੈ ਸੈਸਾਰੀਆ; ਜੋੜੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
145.e: Between the Lord's devotees and the people of the world, there can never be any true alliance.

145.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ; ਨ ਭੁਲੈ. ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
145.e: The Creator Himself is infallible. He cannot be fooled; no one can fool Him.

145.g: ਭਗਤ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ; ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
145.e: He blends His devotees with Himself; they practice Truth, and only Truth.

145.g: ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ; ਜਿਨੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
145.e: The Lord Himself leads the people of the world astray; they tell lies, and by telling lies, they eat poison.

145.g: ਚਲਣ. ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ. ਵਿਸੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
145.e: They do not recognize the ultimate reality, that we all must go; they continue to cultivate the poisons of sexual desire and anger.

145.g: ਭਗਤ ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਜਿਨੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
145.e: The devotees serve the Lord; night and day, they meditate on the Naam.

145.g: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਜਿਨੀ. ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
145.e: Becoming the slaves of the Lord's slaves, they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

145.g: ਓਨਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
145.e: In the Court of their Lord and Master, their faces are radiant; they are embellished and exalted with the True Word of the Shabad. ||16||
Third Mehl:

145.g: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ; ਪਰਗਟੁ. ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
145.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has appeared as a Light in the world.

145.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ; ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
145.e: How rare are those few Gurmukhs who swim across to the other side!

145.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
145.e: The Lord bestows His Glance of Grace;

145.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
145.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh receives the jewel. ||2||

145.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
145.e: Salok, First Mehl:

145.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ. ਰਾਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ; ਧਰਮੁ. ਪੰਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਡਰਿਆ ॥
145.e: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the knife, and the kings are butchers; righteousness has sprouted wings and flown away.

145.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਅਮਾਵਸ. ਸਚੁ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ; ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਕਹ ਚੜਿਆ ॥
145.e: In this dark night of falsehood, the moon of Truth is not visible anywhere.

145.g: ਹਉ ਭਾਲਿ; ਵਿਕੁੰਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
145.e: I have searched in vain, and I am so confused;

145.g: ਆਧੇਰੈ, ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
145.e: In this darkness, I cannot find the path.

145.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਈ ॥
145.e: In egotism, they cry out in pain.

145.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
145.e: Says Nanak, how will they be saved? ||1||

146.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
146.e: Salok, Second Mehl:

146.g: ਅਠੀ ਪਹਰੀ. ਅਠ ਖੰਡ; ਨਾਵਾ ਖੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
146.e: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer the body.

146.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ; ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
146.e: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths of these virtues.

146.g: ਕਰਮਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
146.e: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they make the Guru their spiritual teacher.

146.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰਿ ਸਬਾਹ ਕੈ; ਸੁਰਤਿਆ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
146.e: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higher consciousness.

146.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰੀਆਵਾ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ; ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ. ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
146.e: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.

146.g: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ; ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
146.e: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.

146.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਸੀਐ; ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
146.e: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.

146.g: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੀ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ਤਾਉ ॥
146.e: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.

146.g: ਸਤੀ ਪਹਰੀ. ਸਤੁ ਭਲਾ; ਬਹੀਐ ਪੜਿਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
146.e: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.

146.g: ਓਥੈ. ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ; ਕੂੜੈ ਘਟੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
146.e: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.

146.g: ਓਥੈ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ; ਖਰੇ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
146.e: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.

146.g: ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਾਦਲੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
146.e: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lord and Master. ||1||

146.g: ਤੀਜੈ. ਮੁਹੀ ਗਿਰਾਹ; ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖਾ ਦੁਇ. ਭਉਕੀਆ ॥
146.e: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.

146.g: ਖਾਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਹ; ਭੀ ਖਾਣੇ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ॥
146.e: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.

146.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਆਈ ਊਂਘ; ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ. ਪਵਾਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
146.e: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.

146.g: ਭੀ. ਉਠਿ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਵਾਦੁ; ਸੈ ਵਰੑਿਆ ਕੀ ਪਿੜ ਬਧੀ ॥
146.e: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.

146.g: ਸਭੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ; ਜੇ ਅਠੀ ਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
146.e: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God

146.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
146.e: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1||

146.g: ਭਏ ਸੈਣਪਾਲੰ ਬਲੀ ਸੂਲ ਸਲ੍ਰਯੰ ॥
146.e: Then the brave warrior Salaya became the general of Kauravas.

146.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਕੁਟਿਓ ਬਲੀ ਪੰਚ ਦਲ੍ਰਯੰ ॥
146.e: He beat the brave Pandava foces fiercely,

146.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਹਸਤ ਯੁਧਿਸਟਰੰ ਸਕਤ ਬੇਧੰ ॥
146.e: And wounded the elephant of Yudhistra with his dagger.

146.g: ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਭੂਪੰ ਬਲੀ ਭੂਪ ਬੇਧੰ ॥੪੭॥੨੧੫॥
146.e: Because of this Yudhistra fell down, but he killed the brave Salaya.47.215.

146.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
146.e: Pauree:

146.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ; ਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.

146.g: ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ; ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.

146.g: ਏਨੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰਿ; ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.

146.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ. ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ; ਸੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.

146.g: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਟਿ; ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?

146.g: ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਆਖੈ ਘਟਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.

146.g: ਲਈਅਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ; ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.

146.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ; ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੭॥
146.e: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17||
Second Mehl:

146.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ; ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
146.e: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

146.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ. ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ; ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
146.e: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

146.g: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ; ਵਾਚੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
146.e: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

146.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ; ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
146.e: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

146.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
146.e: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brow

146.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
146.e: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are saved along with them! ||2||

146.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
146.e: CHAUPAI

146.g: ਸਲ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਉਨੈ ਦਿਨ ਜੂਝਾ ॥
ਕਉਰਉ ਹਾਰ ਤਵਨ ਤੇ ਸੂਝਾ ॥
146.e: The day on which the king Salya died in fighting, the Kauravas felt their impending defeat.

146.g: ਜੂਝਤ ਸਲ ਭਇਓ ਅਸਤਾਮਾ ॥
ਕੂਟਿਓ ਕੋਟ ਕਟਕੁ ਇਕ ਜਾਮਾ ॥੧॥੨੧੬॥
146.e: When Salya died, Ashvathama become the general, he beat violently millions of forces for one watch.1.216.

146.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਦੋਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਅਤਿਰਥੀ ॥
ਪਾਡਵ ਸੈਨ ਭਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਥੀ ॥
146.e: He killed the expert charioteer Dharishtadyumna, and mashed the Pandava forces nicely.

146.g: ਪਾਡਵ ਕੇ ਪਾਚੋ ਸੁਤ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
ਦੁਆਪੁਰ ਮੈ ਬਡ ਕੀਨ ਅਖਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੧੭॥
146.e: He also killed thefive sons of Pandavas, he fought very great waars in Dvapar age.2.217.

146.g: ਕਉਰਉ ਰਾਜ ਕੀਓ ਤਬ ਜੁਧਾ ॥
ਭੀਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਾ ॥
146.e: Then Duryodhana, the king of Kauravas waged the war, against Bhim in great fury.

146.g: ਜੁਧ ਕਰਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
ਕਾਲ ਬਲੀ ਤਿਹ ਆਨ ਸੰਘਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨੧੮॥
146.e: He was never defeated while fighting, but the mighty death came and killed him.3.218.

146.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
146.e: Pauree:

146.g: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
146.e: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.

146.g: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ; ਸਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
146.e: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.

146.g: ਸਚੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰਾਂਇ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
146.e: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.

146.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਉ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
146.e: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth in His Love.

146.g: ਸਚੈ ਦੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ; ਕੂੜਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
146.e: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.

146.g: ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ; ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
146.e: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

146.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
146.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

146.g: ਤਹਾ ਭੀਮ ਕੁਰਰਾਜ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਧ ਮਚਿਓ ॥
146.e: There the fierce war of Duryodhana began with Bhim,

146.g: ਛੁਟੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਨਚਿਓ ॥
146.e: Because of which the meditation of Shiva was shattered and that great gods began to dance.

146.g: ਉਠੈ ਸਬਦ ਨਿਰਘਾਤ ਆਘਾਤ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
146.e: Because of the blows of warriors terrible sound arose

146.g: ਭਏ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਤਣੰ ਤਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੧॥੨੧੯॥
146.e: The bodies were pierced by arrows and the heads were separated from pierced by arrows and the heads were separated from the trunks.1.219.

146.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਬੀਰ ਏਕੰ ਅਨੇਕੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
146.e: Fighting in various ways, many warriors fell in the field

146.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਅਧ ਅਧੰ ਛੁਧੰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
146.e: Many had fallen in halves who had been hungry of the sharp edges of weapons.

146.g: ਕਟੇ ਕਉਰਵੰ ਦੁਰ ਸਿੰਦੂਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
146.e: The intoxicated elephants of Kauravas had been chopped in the field.

146.g: ਨਚੇ ਗਿਧ ਆਵਧ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਖੇਤੰ ॥੨॥੨੨੦॥
146.e: Seeing the brave warriors wields weapons in the field, the vultures were feeling pleased.2.220.

146.g: ਬਲੀ ਮੰਡਲਾਕਾਰ ਜੂਝੈ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ॥
146.e: The warriors were fighting in the battlefield in enclosures.

146.g: ਹਸੈ ਗਰਜ ਠੋਕੈ ਭੁਜਾ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
146.e: They laughed, roared and patted their arms, they challenged from both sides.

146.g: ਦਿਖਾਵੇ ਬਲੀ ਮੰਡਲਾਕਾਰ ਥਾਨੈ ॥
146.e: They were standing and showing feats of bravery in enclosures.

146.g: ਉਭਾਰੈ ਭੁਜਾ ਅਉ ਫਟਾਕੈ ਗਜਾਨੈ ॥੩॥੨੨੧॥
146.e: They swayed their arms and were producing terrible sounds with the blows of their maces.3.221.

146.g: ਸੁਭੇ ਸਵਰਨ ਕੇ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਧੇ ਗਜਾ ਮੈ ॥
146.e: The sheets of gold covering the maces looked splendid.

146.g: ਭਈ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਲਖੀ ਕੈ ਧੁਜਾ ਮੈ ॥
146.e: Their glory exhibited the blaze of fire at their tops.

146.g: ਭਿੜਾ ਮੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਮੰਡਲਾਕਾਰ ਬਾਹੈ ॥
146.e: The warriors moved in the field and rotated their discs.

146.g: ਅਪੋ ਆਪ ਸੈ ਨੇਕਿ ਘਾਇੰ ਸਰਾਹੈ ॥੪॥੨੨੨॥
146.e: They appreciated those on their sides who inflicted deep wounds.4.222.

146.g: ਤਹਾ ਭੀਮ ਭਾਰੀ ਭੁਜਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਹੈ ॥
146.e: There the great warrior Bhim used his weapons with his arms.

146.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਭਲੇ ਸੈਨ ਗਾਹੈ ॥
146.e: He was trampling the armies nicely.

146.g: ਉਤੈ ਕਉਰਪਾਲੰ ਧਰੈ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
146.e: On the other side Yudhishtar was bound by Kshatriya discipline,

146.g: ਕਰੈ ਚਿਤ ਪਾਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥੫॥੨੨੩॥
146.e: And was performing wonderful and holy Karmas.5.223.

146.g: ਸਭੈ ਬਾਜੁਵੰਦੰ ਛਕੈ ਭੂਪਨਾਣੰ ॥
146.e: All of them looked elegant with ornaments like armlets.

146.g: ਲਸੈ ਮੁਤਕਾ ਚਾਰ ਦੁਮਲਿਅੰ ਹਾਣੰ ॥
146.e: Their necklaces of gems glistened and their turbans looked graceful on the heads of both the warriors of the same age.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਮੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਮ ਓਜੰ ॥
146.e: Both the Chiefs were men of great strength and composure.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਮਾਨਧਾਤਾ ਮਹੀਪੰ ਕਿ ਭੋਜੰ ॥੬॥੨੨੪॥
146.e: Both were either king Mandhata or king Bhoj.6.224.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਨਾ ਬਧੈ ਅਧ ਅਧੰ ॥
146.e: Both the warriors had tightened their tearing shafts.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੰ ॥
146.e: Both the weapon-wielding warriors began to wage war in great fury.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਰਮੰ ਦੋਊ ਜਾਨ ਬਾਹੰ ॥
146.e: Both the heroes of violent actions had long arms like gods.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਹਦਿ ਹਿੰਦੂਨ ਸਾਹਾਨ ਸਾਹੰ ॥੭॥੨੨੫॥
146.e: Both were great kings with extraordinary knowledge of Hindusim.7.225.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਮ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
146.e: Both were weapon-wielders and supreme donors.

146.g: ਦੋਊ ਢਾਲ ਢੀਚਾਲ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹਿੰਦਾਨੰ ॥
146.e: Both were Indians and capable of protecting themselves with their shields.
Second Mehl:

146.g: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ; ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
146.e: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.

146.g: ਅਠੀ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ; ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
146.e: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the One Lord.

146.g: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਥਾਹ; ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
146.e: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably Beauteous Lord.

146.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ; ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
146.e: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speech is perfect.

146.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ; ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
146.e: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2||

147.e: Second Mehl:

147.g: ਆਖਣੁ. ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਜਿਆ; ਸੁਨਣਿ. ਨ ਰਜੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
147.e: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.

147.g: ਅਖੀ. ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕ ਇਕ ਵੰਨ ॥
147.e: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.

147.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ. ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਗਲੀ ਭੁਖ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
147.e: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੁਖਾ ਤਾ ਰਜੈ; ਜਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ. ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
147.e: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of the Praiseworthy Lord. ||2||

147.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
147.e: Salok, First Mehl:

147.g: ਪਹਿਰਾ ਅਗਨਿ. ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਾ; ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
147.e: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;

147.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵਾ; ਧਰਤੀ ਹਾਕ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
147.e: and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;

147.g: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤੋਲੀ; ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਈ ॥
147.e: and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;

147.g: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਧਾ. ਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਭਸੈ ਨਥਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
147.e: and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were to control and lead all;

147.g: ਏਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਕਰੀ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
147.e: and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?

147.g: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਤੇਵਡ ਦਾਤੀ; ਦੇ ਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
147.e: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His Will.

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ. ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ; ਸਚਿ; ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
147.e: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

147.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
147.e: Salok, First Mehl:

147.g: ਤੁਮੀ ਤੁਮਾ ਵਿਸੁ; ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਨਿਮੁ ਫਲੁ ॥
147.e: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit

147.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ. ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
147.e: these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not remember You

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ; ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
147.e: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are only destroying themselves. ||1||
First Mehl:

147.g: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਖੁ. ਪਤ ਪਰਵਾਲਾ; ਫੁਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
147.e: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.

147.g: ਤਿਤੁ. ਫਲ ਰਤਨ ਲਗਹਿ. ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਖਿਤ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
147.e: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
147.e: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recorded destiny is written.

147.g: ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ; ਪੂਜੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
147.e: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship of the feet of the Exalted Guru.

147.g: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕੋਪੁ; ਚਾਰੇ ਨਦੀਆ ਅਗਿ ॥
147.e: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.

147.g: ਪਵਹਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਰੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਲਗਿ ॥੨॥
147.e: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2||
First Mehl:

147.g: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ. ਕਿਰਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ; ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚ ॥
147.e: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low.

147.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
147.e: CHAUPAI

147.g: ਇਮ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ਬਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ॥
147.e: In this way for eighty-four years,

147.g: ਸਪਤ ਮਾਹ ਚਉਬੀਸ ਦਿਨਾਨੰ ॥
147.e: Seven months and twenty-four days,

147.g: ਰਾਜ ਕੀਓ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
147.e: The king Janmeja remained the ruler

147.g: ਕਾਲ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਗਾਜਾ ॥੧੯॥੨੩੭॥
147.e: Then, the trumpet of Death sounded over his head.19.237.

147.g: ਇਤਿ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਭਇਆ ॥
147.e: Thus the king Janmeja breathed his last.

147.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
147.e: Pauree:

147.g: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ; ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.

147.g: ਝੂਠਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: This world is false, but only a few understand this.

147.g: ਸਚਿ. ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ; ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.

147.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ. ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ; ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਈਐ ॥
147.e: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.

147.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ; ਮਾਰੇ ਦਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club over their heads.

147.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ; ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.

147.g: ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਲੰਮੁ; ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.

147.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ; ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੦॥
147.e: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20||

147.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
147.e: Salok, First Mehl:

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ; ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ. ਫਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
147.e: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.

147.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ. ਹਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ; ਪਕੈ. ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
147.e: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of good deeds and meditation, it ripens.

147.g: ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ ਲਹੈ; ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
147.e: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||

147.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
147.e: Pauree:

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ; ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਬੰਨਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ. ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ; ਛਾਰੁ ਰਲਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ. ਸਭ ਭੁਖ; ਜਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ; ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.

147.g: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ; ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
147.e: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

147.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਓ ਠਗਿ; ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.

147.g: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
147.e: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19||

147.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ; ਠਾਕ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
147.e: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.

147.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਵਖਾਣਿ; ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੮॥
147.e: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||18||

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਵਰਤੀ ਦੋਊ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
147.e: Both were the users of their arms and were kings with canopies.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਧਾ ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧਕਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੨੨੬॥
147.e: Both were Supreme warriors and great fighters.8.226.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡੀ ਦੋਊ ਮੰਡ ਮੰਡੰ ॥
147.e: Both were the destroyers of their enemies and also their establishers.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਜੋਧ ਜੈਤਵਾਰੁ ਜੋਧਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੰ ॥
147.e: Both were the terrible conquerors of the great heroes.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਨੀ ਦੋਊ ਬਾਹ ਸਾਹੰ ॥
147.e: Both the warriors were adept in shooting arrows and had mighty arms.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਸੂਰ ਸੈਨੰ ਦੋਊ ਸੂਰ ਮਾਹੰ ॥੯॥੨੨੭॥
147.e: Both the heroes were the sun and moon of their forces.9.227.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤੀ ਦੋਊ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
147.e: Both were the warriors universal monarchs and had knowledge of warfare.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਜੰਗ ਜੋਧੀ ਦੋਊ ਜੰਗ ਜੇਤਾ ॥
147.e: Both were the warriors of war and conquerors of war.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਤੀ ਦੋਊ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਪੰ ॥
147.e: Both were marvelously beautiful carrying beautiful bows.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਵਰਮਾ ਦੋਊ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਾਪੰ ॥੧੦॥੨੨੮॥
147.e: Both were clad in armour and were the destroyers of enemies.10.228.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡੀ ਦੋਊ ਮੰਡ ਮੰਡੰ ॥
147.e: Both were the destroyers of the enemies with their double-edged swords and were also their establishers.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਤੀ ਸੁ ਜੋਧਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੰ ॥
147.e: Both were Glory-incarnate and mighty heroes.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਮਤ ਬਾਰੁੰਨ ਬਿਕ੍ਰਮ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥
147.e: Both were intoxicate elephants and like king Vikrama.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਤਾ ਦੋਊ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਨੰ ॥੧੧॥੨੨੯॥
147.e: Both were adepts in warfare and had weapons in their hands.11.229.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਧੇ ਦੋਊ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਵਾਨੰ ॥
147.e: Both were Supreme warriors full of rage.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਤਾ ਦੋਊ ਰੂਪ ਖਾਨੰ ॥
147.e: Both were adepts in warfare and were the source of beauty.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਾਲੰ ਦੋਊ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
147.e: Both were Sustainers of Kshatriyas and followed the discipline of Kshatriyas.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਜੁਧ ਜੋਧਾ ਦੋਊ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥੧੨॥੨੩੦॥
147.e: Both were the heroes of war and men of violent actions.12.230.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਮੰਡਲਾਕਾਰ ਜੂਝੇ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ॥
147.e: Both were standing and fighting in enclosures.

147.g: ਹਥੈ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਠੋਕੈ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਾਇ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
147.e: Both struck their arms with their hands and shouted loudly.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਖਤ੍ਰਹਾਣੰ ਦੋਊ ਖਤ੍ਰ ਖੰਡੰ ॥
147.e: Both had Kshatriya discipline but both were the destroyers of Kshatriyas.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਖਗ ਪਾਣੰ ਦੋਊ ਛੇਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਡੰ ॥੧੩॥੨੩੧॥
147.e: Both had swords in their hands and both were the adornments of th battlefield.13.231.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਜੋਤੀ ਦੋਊ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
147.e: Both were Beauty-incarnate and had lofty thoughts.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਮੰਡਲਾਕਾਰ ਖੰਡਾ ਅਬਾਰੰ ॥
147.e: Both were operating their double-adged swords in their enclosures.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਖਗ ਖੂਨੀ ਦੋਊ ਖਤ੍ਰਹਾਣੰ ॥
147.e: Both had their swords smeared with blood and both worked against Kshatriya discipline.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਖਤ੍ਰਖੇਤਾ ਦੋਊ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਾਣੰ ॥੧੪॥੨੩੨॥
147.e: Both were capable of risking their life in the battlefield.14.232.

147.g: ਦੋਊ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਬ ਆਸਤ ਧਾਰੇ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
147.e: Both the heroes had their weapons in their hands.

147.g: ਰਹੇ ਬ︀ਯੋਮ ਮੈ ਭੂਪ ਗਉਨੈ ਹਕਾਰੇ ॥
147.e: It seemed as if the spirits of the dead kings moving the sky were calling them.

147.g: ਹਕਾ ਹਕ ਲਾਗੀ ਧਨੰ ਧੰਨ ਜੰਪ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
147.e: They were shouting seeing their heroism, they were praising them with the words “Well done, bravo!”

147.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਯੋ ਜਛ ਰਾਜੰ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਲੋਕ ਕੰਪ︀ਯੋ ॥੧੫॥੨੩੩॥
147.e: The king of Yakshas seeing their bravery was astonished and the earth was trembling.15.233.

147.g: ਹਨਿਓ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨੰ ਜੁਧ ਭੂਮੰ ॥
147.e: (Ultimately) the king Duryodhana was killed in the battlefield.

147.g: ਭਜੇ ਸਭੈ ਜੋਧਾ ਚਲੀ ਧਾਮ ਧੂਮੰ ॥
147.e: All the noisy warriors ran helter-skelter.

147.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਨਿਹਕੰਟਕੰ ਕਉਰਪਾਲੰ ॥
147.e: (After that) Pandavas ruled over the family of Kauravas unconcerned.

147.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਮਝਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਹਿਵਾਲੰ ॥੧੬॥੨੩੪॥
147.e: Then they went to Himalaya mountains.16.234.

147.g: ਤਹਾ ਏਕ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਧ ਮਚ︀ਯੋ ॥
147.e: At that time a war was waged with a Gandharva.

147.g: ਤਹਾ ਭੂਰਪਾਲੰ ਧੂਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਚ︀ਯੋ ॥
147.e: There that Gandharva adopted a wonderful garb.

147.g: ਤਹਾ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਕੇ ਭੀਮ ਹਸਤੀ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
147.e: Bhima threw there the elephants of the enemy upwards.

147.g: ਫਿਰੇ ਮਧਿ ਗੈਣੰ ਅਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੧੭॥੨੩੫॥
147.e: Which are still moving in the sky and have not returned as yet.17.235.

147.g: ਸੁਨੈ ਬੈਨ ਕਉ ਭੂਪ ਇਉ ਐਠ ਨਾਕੰ ॥
147.e: Hearing these words, the king Janmeja turned his nose in such a manner,

147.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਹਾਸ ਮੰਦੈ ਬੁਲ︀ਯੋ ਏਮ ਬਾਕੰ ॥
147.e: And laughed contemptuously as though the utterance about the elephants was not true.

147.g: ਰਹਿਯੋ ਨਾਕ ਮੈ ਕੁਸਟ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਵਾਨੰ ॥
147.e: With this disbelief the thirty-sixth part of leprosy remained in his nose,

147.g: ਭਈ ਤਉਨ ਹੀ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਭੂਪ ਹਾਨੰ ॥੧੮॥੨੩੬॥
147.e: And with this ailment, the king passed away.18.236.

148.e: Second Mehl:

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪ ਕਉ; ਤਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
148.e: O Nanak, if someone judges himself, only then is he known as a real judge.

148.g: ਰੋਗੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੋਵੈ ਬੁਝੈ; ਤਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
148.e: If someone understands both the disease and the medicine, only then is he a wise physician.

148.g: ਵਾਟ. ਨ ਕਰਈ ਮਾਮਲਾ; ਜਾਣੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
148.e: Do not involve yourself in idle business on the way; remember that you are only a guest here.

148.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ; ਹਾਣਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਾਣੁ ॥
148.e: Speak with those who know the Primal Lord, and renounce your evil ways.

148.g: ਲਬਿ. ਨ ਚਲਈ. ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ; ਸੋ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
148.e: That virtuous person who does not walk in the way of greed, and who abides in Truth, is accepted and famous.

148.g: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੇ ਆਗਾਸ ਕਉ; ਕਿਉ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
148.e: If an arrow is shot at the sky, how can it reach there?

148.g: ਅਗੈ. ਓਹੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਵਾਹੇਦੜੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
148.e: The sky above is unreachable-know this well, O archer! ||2||
CHAUPAI
Asumedh and Asumedhan (the sons of Janmeja),
Were great heroes and truthful (princes).
They were very brave, mighty and archers.

148.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਕੀਰਤ ਦੇਸ ਸਭ ਘਰ ਘਰ ॥੧॥੨੩੮॥
148.e: Their praises were sung in every home in the country.1.238.

148.g: ਮਹਾ ਬੀਰ ਅਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਧਨੁਖ ਧਰ ॥
148.e: They were supreme warriors and supreme archers.

148.g: ਕਾਪਤ ਤੀਨ ਲੋਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਡਰ ॥
148.e: Because of their fear, the three worlds trembled.
They were kings of indivisible glory.
They were persons of unlimited splendour and the whole world remembered them.2.239.
On the other hand, Ajai Singh was a superb hero,
Who was a great monarch and adept in fourteen learnings.
He was without any vices, he was incomparable and of unweighable minght,
Who conqured many enemies and mashed them.3.240.
He was the conqueror of many wars.
None of the weapon-wielders could escape him.
He was a great hero, possessing great qualities
And all the world venerated him.4.241.
At the time of death, the king janmeja,
Consulted his council of ministers,
As to whom should the kingship be awarded?
They looked for the mark of kingship.5.242.

148.g: ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜ ਕਵਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
148.e: Out of these three who should be given the kingship?

148.g: ਕਉਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਸੁਤ ਕਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
148.e: Which son of the king should be made the king?

148.g: ਰਜੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਨ ਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
148.e: The son of the maid-servant is not entitled to be the king

148.g: ਯਾਹਿ ਕੇ ਜੋਗ ਨ ਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਭੋਗਾ ॥੬॥੨੪੩॥
148.e: The enjoyments of kingship are not meant for him.6.243.
(The eldest son) Asumedh was made the king,
And all the people cheered him as king.
The funeral rites of Janmeja were performed.
There were great rejoicings in the house of Asumedh.7.244.
Another one brother that the king had,
Was given enormous wealth and precious articles.
He was also made one of the ministers,
And placed him at another position.8.245.
The third one, who was the son of maid-servant.
He was given the position of army-general
He was made the Bakhshi

148.g: ਸਬ ਦਲ ਕੋ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਓ ॥੯॥੨੪੬॥
148.e: And he administered all the work of the forces.9.246.
(All the brothers) were happy on getting their positions in kingdom.
The king felt great pleasure in seeing dances.
There were thirteen hundred and sixty-four Mridangs,
And millions of other musical instruments resounded in his presence.10.247.
The second brother took to heavy drinding.
He was fond of applying perfumes and seeing dances.
Both the brothers forgot to perform the royal responsibilities,

148.g: ਵਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਜਾਇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਰ ਝੂਲਾ ॥੧੧॥੨੪੮॥
148.e: And the canopy of royalty was held on the head of the third one.11.248.

148.g: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਦਿਨ ਅਸ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
148.e: After the passage of many days in the kingdom like this,
Both the brothers forgot the royal responsibilities.

148.g: ਮਦ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧ ਭਏ ਦੋਊ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
148.e: Both the brother became blind with heavy drinking,
Pauree:

148.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਾਣ; ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.e: Some speak and expound, and while speaking and lecturing, they pass away.

148.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.e: The Vedas speak and expound on the Lord, but they do not know His limits.
Not by studying, but through understanding, is the Lord's Mystery revealed.

148.g: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਭੇਖਿ; ਕਿਸੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.e: There are six pathways in the Shaastras, but how rare are those who merge in the True Lord through them.
The True Lord is Unknowable; through the Word of His Shabad, we are embellished.
One who believes in the Name of the Infinite Lord, attains the Court of the Lord.
I humbly bow to the Creator Lord; I am a minstrel singing His Praises.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੁ; ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੧॥
148.e: Nanak enshrines the Lord within his mind. He is the One, throughout the ages. ||21||
Pauree:
The soul-bride loves her Husband Lord; she is embellished with His Love.

148.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਨ ਰਹਨੀ. ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
148.e: She worships Him day and night; she cannot be restrained from doing so.
In the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, she has made her home; she is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.
She is humble, and she offers her true and sincere prayer.
She is beautiful in the Company of her Lord and Master; she walks in the Way of His Will.
With her dear friends, she offers her heart-felt prayers to her Beloved.

148.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ; ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
148.e: Cursed is that home, and shameful is that life, which is without the Name of the Lord.
But she who is adorned with the Word of His Shabad, drinks in the Amrit of His Nectar. ||22||
Salok, Second Mehl:

148.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਠੂਹਿਆ; ਨਾਗੀ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
148.e: Those who charm scorpions and handle snakes

148.g: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣੈ; ਦੇ ਕੂਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
148.e: Only brand themselves with their own hands.

148.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ. ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਅਤੀ ਹੂ ਧਕਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
148.e: By the pre-ordained Order of our Lord and Master, they are beaten badly, and struck down.

148.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਿਉ. ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੜੈ; ਡੁਬੈ. ਹਕਿ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
148.e: If the self-willed manmukhs fight with the Gurmukh, they are condemned by the Lord, the True Judge.

148.g: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ. ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮੁ; ਵੇਖੈ. ਕਰਿ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
148.e: He Himself is the Lord and Master of both worlds. He beholds all and makes the exact determination.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
148.e: O Nanak, know this well: everything is in accordance with His Will. ||1||
Salok, First Mehl:

148.g: ਮਾਰੂ. ਮੀਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ; ਅਗੀ. ਲਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਖ ॥
148.e: The desert is not satisfied by rain, and the fire is not quenched by desire.

148.g: ਰਾਜਾ. ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ; ਸਾਇਰ ਭਰੇ. ਕਿਸੁਕ ॥
148.e: The king is not satisfied with his kingdom, and the oceans are full, but still they thirst for more.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਕੇਤੀ ਪੁਛਾ ਪੁਛ ॥੧॥
148.e: O Nanak, how many times must I seek and ask for the True Name? ||1||

148.g: ਕਬ ਚੰਦਨਿ. ਕਬ ਅਕਿ ਡਾਲਿ; ਕਬ ਉਚੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
148.e: Sometimes it is perched on the sandalwood tree, and sometimes it is on the branch of the poisonous swallow-wort. Sometimes, it soars through the heavens.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲਗੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
148.e: O Nanak, our Lord and Master leads us on, according to the Hukam of His Command; such is His Way. ||2||
Second Mehl:

148.g: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ. ਤਸਿ ਜਨਮਸਿ; ਜਾਵਤੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ. ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
148.e: Life is useless, as long as one does not know the Lord God.

148.g: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
148.e: Only a few cross over the world-ocean, by Guru's Grace.

148.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
148.e: The Lord is the All-powerful Cause of causes, says Nanak after deep deliberation.

148.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
148.e: The creation is subject to the Creator, who sustains it by His Almighty Power. ||2||
Pauree:
In the Court of the Lord and Master, His minstrels dwell.
Singing the Praises of their True Lord and Master, the lotuses of their hearts have blossomed forth.
Obtaining their Perfect Lord and Master, their minds are transfixed with ecstasy.
Their enemies have been driven out and subdued, and their friends are very pleased.

148.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ; ਸਚਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
148.e: Those who serve the Truthful True Guru are shown the True Path.

149.e: Salok, First Mehl:

149.g: ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇ. ਪੀਅਹਿ ਮਲਵਾਣੀ; ਜੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlessly and eat the garbage which others have thrown away.

149.g: ਫੋਲਿ ਫਦੀਹਤਿ. ਮੁਹਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਭੜਾਸਾ; ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.

149.g: ਭੇਡਾ ਵਾਗੀ. ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇਨਿ; ਭਰੀਅਨਿ ਹਥ ਸੁਆਹੀ ॥
149.e: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-they are like sheep!

149.g: ਮਾਊ ਪੀਊ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਨਿ; ਟਬਰ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families and relatives cry out in distress.

149.g: ਓਨਾ. ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਪਤਲਿ. ਕਿਰਿਆ ਨ ਦੀਵਾ; ਮੁਏ. ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them. After their death, where will they be sent?

149.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ. ਦੇਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ. ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.

149.g: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਰਹਹਿ. ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilak mark to their foreheads.

149.g: ਝੁੰਡੀ ਪਾਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਨਿਤਿ. ਮਰਣੈ; ਦੜਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.

149.g: ਲਕੀ ਕਾਸੇ ਹਥੀ ਫੁੰਮਣ; ਅਗੋ ਪਿਛੀ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
149.e: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in their hands, they walk along in single file.

149.g: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੋਗੀ. ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੰਗਮ; ਨਾ ਓਇ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁੰਲਾ ॥
149.e: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazis or Mullahs.
CHAUPI
We have thought about this game to-day.
That we utter apparently.
One of them took the gems of the kingdom.
The second one took horses, camels and elephants.1.254.
The princes distributed all the forces.
The divided the army in three parts.
They thought, how the dice be cast and the rouse be played?
How the game and trick be played?2.255.
The game of dice was began to watch the play.
The high and low all began to watch the play
The fire of jealousy increased in their hearts,
Which is said to be the destroyer of the kings.3.256.

149.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬੀਚ ਪਰੀ ਅਸ ਖੇਲਾ ॥
149.e: The game was played thus amongst them,

149.g: ਕਟਨ ਸੁ ਹਿਤ ਭਇਉ ਮਿਟਨ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
149.e: That they reached the stage of destroying one another and it was difficult to pacify them.
In the beginning the princes put the gems and wealth to stake
Then they bet the clothes, horses and elephants, they lost all.4.257.
The wrangling increased on both the sides.

149.g: ਦੁਹ ਦਿਸ ਉਠੇ ਸੁਭਟ ਅਸ ਕਾਢਾ ॥
149.e: On both the sides, the warriors drew their swords
The sharp edges of the swords glistened,
And many corpses lay scattered there.5.258.
The vamps and demons wandered with pleasure
The vultures and ganas of Shiva manifested their pride through their gay voices.
The ghosts and goblins danced and sang.
Somewhere the Baitals raised their voice.6.259.
Somewhere the sharp edges of the swords gleamed.
The heads of warriors and trunks of elephants lay scattered on the earth.
Somewhere the intoxicated elephants were trumpeting after having fallen.
Somewhere the furious warriors in the battlefield rolled down.7.260.
Somewhere the wounded horses have fallen and are neighing.
Somewhere the terrible warriors are lying down  they have been sent.

149.g: ਕਟਿ ਗਏ ਕਹੂੰ ਕਉਚ ਅਰੁ ਚਰਮਾ ॥
149.e: Someone’s armour was cut down and someone’s was broken.
And forgot everything about kingdom.12.249.
Third Mehl:

149.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ; ਖੁਸੀਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
149.e: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyable pleasures.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ; ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
149.e: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with a blackened face. ||2||
Salok, Third Mehl:

149.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ. ਭੈ ਮਰੈ; ਭੀ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
149.e: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ; ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
149.e: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed and approved. ||1||
Pauree:
After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.
There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.
I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.
Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.
I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.

149.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ; ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.e: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.

149.g: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਲਗਿ; ਗਰਬਿ ਸਿ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.e: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They are destroyed by their own pride.
Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24||
First Mehl:

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣਾ; ਦੁਖ ਛਡਿ ਮੰਗੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
149.e: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.

149.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਇ. ਦਰਿ ਕਪੜੇ; ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨੁਖ ॥
149.e: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.

149.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਹਾਰੀਐ; ਤਿਥੈ ਚੰਗੀ ਚੁਪ ॥੨॥
149.e: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2||
Pauree:

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫॥
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25||
DOHRA

149.g: ਜਿਹ ਚਾਹੇ, ਤਾ ਕੋ ਹਨੇ; ਜੋ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੋ ਲੇਇ ॥
149.e: Whomsoever (Ajai Singh) wants he kills him, whatever he desires, he gets.

149.g: ਜਿਹ ਰਾਖੈ, ਸੋਈ ਰਹੈ; ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਹ ਦੇਇ ॥੧੩॥੨੫੦॥
149.e: Whomsoever he protects, he remains safe, and whosoever he considers protagonist, he bestows on him the desired position.13.250.
CHAUPI

149.g: ਐਸੀ ਭਾਤ ਕੀਨੋ ਇਹ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
149.e: When he began such a treatment,

149.g: ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਲੋਕ ਸਭ ਬਸ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
149.e: All the subject with this, came under his control

149.g: ਅਉ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸਾ ॥
149.e: And the chieftains and other prominent persons came under his control,

149.g: ਜੋ ਰਾਖਤ ਥੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥੨੫੧॥
149.e: Who had earlier owned allegiance to the king.1.251.
One day all the three sagacious brothers,
Began to play chess.
When the dice was thrown, (one of the two real brothers) thought in indignation,
And uttered these words, while Ajai listened.2.252.
Salok, First Mehl:

149.g: ਖਤਿਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ. ਖਤੇ ਕਰਨਿ; ਤ ਖਤਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
149.e: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fall into mistakes.

149.g: ਧੋਤੇ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਹਿ; ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
149.e: By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ; ਨਾਹਿ ਤ. ਪਾਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
149.e: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten. ||1||
Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.
Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
149.e: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord. ||23||
DOHRA

149.g: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ, ਦਾ ਕਹ ਪਰੈ; ਕਹ ਯਹ ਬਾਧੈ ਸੂਤ ॥
149.e: Let us see, what he does  how doth he throw the dice   how shalt he keep the propriety of conduct?

149.g: ਕਹਾ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਮਰੈ; ਜੋ ਰਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਪੂਤ ॥੩॥੨੫੩॥
149.e: How shalt the enemy be killed by him, who himself is the son of maid-servant?3.253.

150.g: ਦਯਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ. ਫਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ; ਫਿਟਾ ਵਤੈ ਗਲਾ ॥
150.e: Ruined by the Merciful Lord, they wander around in disgrace, and their entire troop is contaminated.

150.g: ਜੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਖੈ ॥
150.e: The Lord alone kills and restores to life; no one else can protect anyone from Him.

150.g: ਦਾਨਹੁ ਤੈ ਇਸਨਾਨਹੁ ਵੰਜੇ; ਭਸੁ ਪਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਖੁਥੈ ॥
150.e: They go without giving alms or any cleansing baths; their shaven heads become covered with dust.

150.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਉਪੰਨੇ; ਮੇਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
150.e: The jewel emerged from the water, when the mountain of gold was used to churn it.

150.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ. ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ; ਪੁਰਬੀ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
150.e: The gods established the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the festivals are celebrated and hymns are chanted.

150.g: ਨਾਇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ. ਨਾਤੈ ਪੂਜਾ; ਨਾਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ. ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
150.e: After bathing, the Muslims recite their prayers, and after bathing, the Hindus perform their worship services. The wise always take cleansing baths.

150.g: ਮੁਇਆ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
150.e: At the time of death, and at the time of birth, they are purified, when water is poured on their heads.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਸੈਤਾਨੀ; ਏਨਾ. ਗਲ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
150.e: O Nanak, the shaven-headed ones are devils. They are not pleased to hear these words.

150.g: ਵੁਠੈ ਹੋਇਐ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ; ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
150.e: When it rains, there is happiness. Water is the key to all life.

150.g: ਵੁਠੈ. ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾ; ਸਭਸੈ ਪੜਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
150.e: When it rains, the corn grows, and the sugar cane, and the cotton, which provides clothing for all.

150.g: ਵੁਠੈ. ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਹੀ; ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
150.e: When it rains, the cows always have grass to graze upon, and housewives can churn the milk into butter.

150.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਿਇ. ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਦ ਪੂਜਾ; ਪਇਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
150.e: With that ghee, sacred feasts and worship services are performed; all these efforts are blessed.

150.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ. ਨਦੀ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖੀ; ਨਾਤੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
150.e: The Guru is the ocean, and all His Teachings are the river. Bathing within it, glorious greatness is obtained.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੇ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਾ ਸਤ ਚਟੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
150.e: O Nanak, if the shaven-headed ones do not bathe, then seven handfuls of ashes are upon their heads. ||1||

150.g: ਕਟਿ ਗਏ ਗਜ ਬਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਬਰਮਾ ॥੮॥੨੬੧॥
150.e: Somewhere the armours of elephants and horses were cut down.8.261.

150.g: ਜੁਗਨ ਦੇਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਕਿਲਕਾਰੀ ॥
150.e: Somewhere the vamps were raising joyful shrieks

150.g: ਨਾਚਤ ਭੂਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
150.e: Somewhere the ghosts were dancing, while clapping their hands

150.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਬੀਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰਾ ॥
150.e: The fifty-two heroic spirits were wandering in all the four directions

150.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਮਾਰੂ ਰਾਗ ਸਿਦਉਰਾ ॥੯॥੨੬੨॥
150.e: Maru musical mode was being played.9.262.

150.g: ਰਣ ਅਸ ਕਾਲ ਜਲਧ ਜਿਮ ਗਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: The war was waged so violently as if the ocean was thundering

150.g: ਭੂਤ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਭੀਰ ਭੈ ਭਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: The gathering of ghosts and goblins ran away in great feat.

150.g: ਰਣ ਮਾਰੂ ਇਹ ਦਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਜ︀ਯੋ ॥
150.e: The Maru Raga was played from this side,

150.g: ਕਾਇਰੁ ਹੁਤੋ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਨਹਿ ਭਾਜ︀ਯੋ ॥੧੦॥੨੬੩॥
150.e: Which made even the cowards so courageous that they did not run away form the battlefield.10.263.

150.g: ਰਹਿ ਗਈ ਸੂਰਨ ਖਗ ਕੀ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
150.e: The support of the sword remained only with the warriors.

150.g: ਕਟਿ ਗਏ ਸੁੰਡ ਭਸੁੰਡ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
150.e: The trunks of many elephants were chopped off.

150.g: ਨਾਚਤ ਜੋਗਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਤਾਰਾ ॥
150.e: Somewhere the vamps and Baitals danced.

150.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਬਿਕਰਾਰਾ ॥੧੧॥੨੬੪॥
150.e: Somewhere the terrible ghosts and goblins were running here and there.11.264.

150.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਅਧ ਕਮਧ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
150.e: Many trunks cut into halves were running.

150.g: ਮੰਡਿ ਰਹੇ ਰਾਵਤ ਗਡਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
150.e: The princes were fighting and were stabilizing their positions.

150.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਰਾਗ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: The musical modes were played with such intensity,

150.g: ਕਾਇਰੁ ਹੁਤਾ ਵਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੨੬੫॥
150.e: That even the cowards did not run away from the field.12.265.

150.g: ਮੰਦਰ ਤੂਰ ਕਰੂਰ ਕਰੋਰਾ ॥
150.e: Million of drums and musical instruments sounded.

150.g: ਗਾਜ ਸਰਾਵਤ ਰਾਗ ਸੰਦੋਰਾ ॥
150.e: The elephants also joined this music with their trumpets.

150.g: ਝਮਕਸਿ ਦਾਮਨ ਜਿਮ ਕਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
150.e: The swords gleamed like lightning,

150.g: ਬਰਸਤ ਬਾਨਨ ਮੇਘ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੧੩॥੨੬੬॥
150.e: And the shafts came like rain from clouds.13.266.

150.g: ਘੂਮਹਿ ਘਾਇਲ ਲੋਹ ਚੁਚਾਤੇ ॥
150.e: The wounded warriors with dripping blood revolved,

150.g: ਖੇਲ ਬਸੰਤ ਮਨੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
150.e: As if the intoxicated persons are playing Holi.

150.g: ਗਿਰ ਗਏ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਿਰਹ ਅਰੁ ਜੁਆਨਾ ॥
150.e: Somewhere the armour and the warriors had fallen

150.g: ਗਰਜਨ ਗਿਧ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਸੁਆਨਾ ॥੧੪॥੨੬੭॥
150.e: Somewhere the vultures shrieked and the dogs barked.14.267.

150.g: ਉਨ ਦਲ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਭਾਇਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: The forces of both the brothers ran helter and skelter.

150.g: ਠਾਢ ਨ ਸਕਿਯੋ ਰੰਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: No pauper and king could stand there (before Ajai Singh).

150.g: ਤਕਿਓ ਓਡਛਾ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਚਛਨ ॥
150.e: The running kings with their forces entered the beautiful country of Orissa,

150.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਤਿਲਕ ਸੁਭ ਲਛਨ ॥੧੫॥੨੬੮॥
150.e: Whose king ‘Tilak’ was a person of good qualities.15.268.

150.g: ਮਦ ਕਰਿ ਮਤ ਭਏ ਜੇ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: The kings who get intoxicated with wine,

150.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਗਏ ਐਸ ਹੀ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: All their errands are destroyed like this.

150.g: ਛੀਨ ਛਾਨ ਛਿਤ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਯੋ ॥
150.e: (Ajai Singh) sezed the kingdom and held the canopy on his head.

150.g: ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਆਪਹੀ ਕਹਾਯੋ ॥੧੬॥੨੬੯॥
150.e: He caused himself to be called Maharaja.16.269.

150.g: ਆਗੇ ਚਲੇ ਅਸ੍ਵਮੇਧ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
150.e: The defeated Asumedh was running in front,

150.g: ਧਵਹਿ ਪਾਛੇ ਫਉਜ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
150.e: And the great army was pursuing him.

150.g: ਗੇ ਜਹਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਤਿਲਕ ਮਹਾਰਾਜਾ ॥
150.e: Asumedh went to the kingdom of Maharaja Tilak,

150.g: ਰਾਜ ਪਾਟ ਵਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਛਾਜਾ ॥੧੭॥੨੭੦॥
150.e: Who was a most appropriate king.17.270.

150.g: ਤਹਾ ਇਕ ਆਹਿ ਸਨਉਢੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨ ॥
150.e: There lived a Sanaudhi Brahmin.

150.g: ਪੰਡਤ ਬਡੇ ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਗੁਨ ਜਨ ॥
150.e: He was a very great Pundit and had many great qualities.

150.g: ਭੂਪਹਿ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਭਹੁ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
150.e: He was the preceptor of the king and all worshiped him.

150.g: ਤਿਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੮॥੨੭੧॥
150.e: None other was abored there.18.271.

150.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
150.e: Pauree:

150.g: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: I was a minstrel, out of work, when the Lord took me into His service.

150.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਕੈ ਵਾਰ; ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: To sing His Praises day and night, He gave me His Order, right from the start.

150.g: ਢਾਢੀ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ; ਖਸਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: My Lord and Master has summoned me, His minstrel, to the True Mansion of His Presence.

150.g: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਪੜਾ; ਪਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: He has dressed me in the robes of His True Praise and Glory.

150.g: ਸਚਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭੋਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
150.e: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name has become my food.

150.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖਾਧਾ ਰਜਿ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings, who eat this food and are satisfied, find peace.

150.g: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: His minstrel spreads His Glory, singing and vibrating the Word of His Shabad.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ; ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੭॥ ਸੁਧੁ
150.e: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, I have obtained His Perfection. ||27||Sudh||

150.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
150.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

150.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਾਨੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਰਚਾ ॥
150.e: Somewhere there was the recitation of Upnishads and somewhere there was discussion about the Vedas.

150.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਰਚਾ ॥
150.e: Somewhere the Brahmins were seated together and worshipping Brahman

150.g: ਤਹਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਸਨੌਢ ਤੇ ਏਕ ਲਛਨ ॥
150.e: There the Sanaudh Brahmin lived with such qualifications:

150.g: ਕਰੈ ਬਕਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਾਇ ਭਛਨ ॥੧॥੨੭੨॥
150.e: He wore the clothes of the leaves and bark of birch tree and moved around subsisting only on air.1.272.

150.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਿਯਾਮੰ ਸੁਰੰ ਸਾਥ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
150.e: Somewhere the hymns of Sam Veda were sung melodiously

150.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੁਜਰ ਬੇਦੰ ਪੜੇ ਮਾਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
150.e: Somewhere the Yajur Veda was being recited and honours were received

150.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
150.e: Pauree:

150.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ; ਸਦਾ ਕਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
150.e: It is of You, O my True and Wondrous Lord, that I sing forever.

150.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ; ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
150.e: Yours is the True Court. All others are subject to coming and going.

150.g: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ; ਸਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
150.e: Those who ask for the gift of the True Name are like You.

150.g: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ; ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
150.e: Your Command is True; we are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad.

150.g: ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ; ਤੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: Through faith and trust, we receive spiritual wisdom and meditation from You.

150.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ; ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: By Your Grace, the banner of honor is obtained. It cannot be taken away or lost.

150.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ; ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
150.e: You are the True Giver; You give continually. Your Gifts continue to increase.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
150.e: Nanak begs for that gift which is pleasing to You. ||26||
First Mehl:

150.g: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ; ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
150.e: We understand the Lord only when He Himself inspires us to understand Him.

150.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਝਾਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
150.e: He alone knows everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge.

150.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
150.e: One may talk and preach and give sermons but still yearn after Maya.

150.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ; ਸਗਲ ਕਰੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
150.e: The Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, has created the entire creation.

150.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
150.e: He Himself knows the inner nature of all.

150.g: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਅਖਿਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
150.e: O Nanak, He Himself uttered the Word.

150.g: ਲਹੈ ਭਰਾਤਿ; ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
150.e: Doubt departs from one who receives this gift. ||2||

150.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
150.e: Salok, Second Mehl:

150.g: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ; ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥
150.e: Those who have accepted the Guru's Teachings, and who have found the path, remain absorbed in the Praises of the True Lord.

150.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੀਐ; ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
150.e: What teachings can be imparted to those who have the Divine Guru Nanak as their Guru? ||1||
Second Mehl:

150.g: ਅਗੀ. ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੂਰਜ. ਕੇਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
150.e: What can the cold do to the fire? How can the night affect the sun?

150.g: ਚੰਦ. ਅਨੇਰਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ; ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
150.e: What can the darkness do to the moon? What can social status do to air and water?

150.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਚੀਜੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
150.e: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
150.e: O Nanak, he alone is known as honorable, whose honor the Lord preserves. ||2||

151.e: Gauree, First Mehl:
Let wisdom be your mother, and contentment your father.
Let Truth be your brother - these are your best relatives. ||1||

151.g: ਕਹਣਾ ਹੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
151.e: He has been described, but He cannot be described at all.

151.g: ਤਉ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
151.e: Your All-pervading creative nature cannot be estimated. ||1||Pause||
Gauree, First Mehl:

151.g: ਡਰਿ ਘਰੁ. ਘਰਿ ਡਰੁ; ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
151.e: Place the Fear of God within the home of your heart; with this Fear of God in your heart, all other fears shall be frightened away.

151.g: ਸੋ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਡਰਿ. ਡਰੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
151.e: What sort of fear is that, which frightens other fears?
Without You, I have other place of rest at all.

151.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
151.e: Whatever happens is all according to Your Will. ||1||
Be afraid, if you have any fear, other than the Fear of God.

151.g: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਡਰਣਾ; ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
151.e: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||

151.g: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
151.e: The soul does not die; it does not drown, and it does not swim across.

151.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
151.e: The One who created everything does everything.
By the Hukam of His Command we come, and by the Hukam of His Command we go.
Before and after, His Command is pervading. ||2||
Cruelty, attachment, desire and egotism

151.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ; ਨੈ ਸਾਨੁ ॥
151.e: there is great hunger in these, like the raging torrent of a wild stream.
Let the Fear of God be your food, drink and support.
Without doing this, the fools simply die. ||3||

151.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਈ; ਕੋਇ ਕੋਇ ॥
151.e: If anyone really has anyone else - how rare is that person!

151.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ; ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
151.e: All are Yours - You are the Lord of all.

151.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ; ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
151.e: All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.
O Nanak, it is so difficult to describe and contemplate Him. ||4||2||

151.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
151.e: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay & Dho-Padhay:

151.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
151.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
The Fear of God is overpowering, and so very heavy,
while the intellect is lightweight, as is the speech one speaks.
So place the Fear of God upon your head, and bear that weight;
by the Grace of the Merciful Lord, contemplate the Guru. ||1||

151.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
151.e: Without the Fear of God, no one crosses over the world-ocean.

151.g: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
151.e: This Fear of God adorns the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

151.g: ਭੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ; ਭੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
151.e: The fire of fear within the body is burnt away by the Fear of God.
Through this Fear of God, we are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.
Without the Fear of God, all that is fashioned is false.
Useless is the mold, and useless are the hammer-strokes on the mold. ||2||
The desire for the worldly drama arises in the intellect,
but even with thousands of clever mental tricks, the heat of the Fear of God does not come into play.
O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed manmukh is just wind.
His words are worthless and empty, like the wind. ||3||1||

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਿਗੰ ਬਾਚੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਰਥ ਬੇਦੰ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the Rig Veda was being read and somewhere the Atharva Veda

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਿਛਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਸਨ ਭੇਦੰ ॥੨॥੨੭੩॥
151.e: Somewhere there was the discourse about Brahm Sutras and somewhere there was discussion about the mysteries of Vishnu.2.273.

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਸਟ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥੈ ਕਥਾਣੰ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the discourse about the ten incarnations was being delivered.
There were persons adept in fourteen learinings.
There were three very learned Brahmins,
Who were unattached with the world and had faith only in One Lord.3.274.
Somewhere Koksar and somewhere Dharam-Niti was being read

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ︀ਯਾਇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੜੈ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the Nyaya Shastra and somewhere Kshatriya-Dharma was being studies

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਪੜੈ ਬ︀ਯੋਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
151.e: Somewhere Theology and somewhere astronomy was being studied

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਠਿ ਪਠਿਐ ਪਿੜਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨੭੫॥
151.e: Somewhere the Eulogy of war-goddess was being sung with devotion.4.275.
Somewhere the Prakrit language and somewhere the Naga language was being studied
Somewhere Sahaskriti and somewhere Sanskrit (or astrology) was being discussed

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਮੈ ਗੀਤ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere songs were sung from Sangeet Shastra
Somewhere the differences in the learnings of Yakshas and gandhavas were being elucidated.5.276.
Somewhere Nyaya Shastra, somewhere Mimansa Shasta and somewhere Tarak Shastra (logic) were studied

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੜੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the manyras of fire-shafts and Brahm-astras were recited
Somewhere Yoga Shastra and somewhere Samkhya Shastra was read
The cycle of the treasure of fourteen learnings was studied.6.277.
Somewhere Maha Bhashaya of Patanjalli and somewhere the Komudi of Panini was studied
Somewhere Siddhant Komudi, somewhere Chandrika and somewhere Sarsut were read
Somewhere other grammatical works including that of Vaisheshika were discussed
Somewhere Kasika commentaries on Panini Grammar Prakriya were being churned.7.278.
Somewhere someone studied the book Manorama

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਗਾਇ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਮੈ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਚੇ ॥
151.e: Somewhere someone sang in musical mode and danced

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere someone ruminated on the learning of all weapons

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਾਚੈ ਸੋਕ ਟਾਰੈ ॥੮॥੨੭੯॥
