151.e: Somewhere someone was removing anxiety by studying the science of warfare. 8.279.

151.g: ਕਹੂ ਗਦਾ ਕੋ ਜੁਧ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere someone exhibited the war-fighting of maces

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਖੜਗ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਜੁਝੈ ਮਾਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere someone received the award in sword-fighting
Somewhere mature scholars held discourses on rhetorics
Somewhere the art of swimming and Syntax were discussed.9.280.

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੈਠ ਕੇ ਗਾਰੜੀ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਬਾਚੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere Garuda Purna was being studied

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਾਭਵੀ ਰਾਸ ਭਾਖਾ ਸੁ ਰਾਚੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the eulogies of Shiva were being composed in Prakrit
Somewhere Greek, Arabic and language of heroic spirits was being learnt
Somewhere Persian and new art of warfare were being studied.10.281.

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਘਾਉ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਤੈਗੋ ॥
151.e: Somewhere someone was elucidating the treatment of weapon-wounds

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਪਾਤਕਾ ਪੈ ਚਲੈਗੋ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the targets were being shot at with arms

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਚਰਮ ਕੀ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the skilful use of the shield was being described

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਦਰਬ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੧॥੨੮੨॥
151.e: Somewhere someone was delivering discourse on Vedanta and receiving monetary award.11.282.

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਦ ਭੇਦੰ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the art of dancing and the mystery of sound was being described
Somewhere discourses were being held on Puranas and Semitic texts

151.g: ਸਭੈ ਅਛਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸਭੈ ਦੇਸ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
151.e: Somewhere alphabets and languages of various countries,Were being taugh
Somewhere the significance was being attached to the worship practiced in various countries.12.283.
Somewhere the lioness was causing her milk to be sucked by the calves

151.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਿੰਘ ਲੈ ਸੰਗ ਗਊਆ ਚਰਾਵੈ ॥
151.e: Somewhere the lion was grazing a herd of cows,
At that place the snake was creeping without ire
Somewhere the learned Pundit was praising the enemy in his discourse.13.284.

151.g: ਤਥਾ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਤਥਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
151.e: The enemy and the friend and the enemy are alike

151.g: ਜਥਾ ਏਕ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਥਾ ਪਰਮ ਛਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
151.e: An ordinary Kshatriya and a universal are alike.

152.e: The king said:
“If thou art thy own well-wisher,

152.g: ਵੈ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਧ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਅਬਹੀ ॥
152.e: “Bind both of them and give them immediately to me
“I shall make all of them the food of fire,
“And worship thee as my father.”3.293.

152.g: ਜੋ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਵੈ ਭਾਜ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
152.e: “If they have not run and concealed themselves in thy house,
“Then thou obeyest me today
“I shall prepare very tasteful food for thee,

152.g: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਵੈ ਤੀਨੋ ਮਿਲ ਖਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨੯੪॥
152.e: “Which they, thou and me, all shall eat together.”4.294.

152.g: ਦਿਜ ਸੁਨ ਬਾਤ ਚਲੇ ਸਭ ਧਾਮਾ ॥
152.e: Hearing these words of the king, all the Brahmins went to their homes,
And asked their brothers, sons and elders:
“If they are bound and given, then we lose our Dharma,
“If we eat their food, then we pollute our Karmas.”5.295.
“This son of the maid-servant is a mighty warriors,
“Who hath conquered and mashed the Kshatriya forces.
“He hath acquired his kingdom with his own might,
Modesty, humility and intuitive understanding are my mother-in-law and father-in-law;
I have made good deeds my spouse. ||2||
Union with the Holy is my wedding date, and separation from the world is my marriage.
Says Nanak, Truth is the child born of this Union. ||3||3||
CHAUPAI
The king (Ajai Singh) sent his messengers (to king Tilak) and (Sanaudhi Brahmin).
Who satisfied all the incoming Brahmin.
(These messengers saidJ “Asumedh and Asumedhan,
“Have run and hid themselves in thy home.1.287.

152.g: ਕੈ ਦਿਜ ਬਾਧ ਦੇਹੁ ਦੁਐ ਮੋਹੂ ॥
152.e: “O Brahmin, either bind and deliver them to us
“O thou shalt be considered like them

152.g: ਕਰਿਓ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੇਉ ਨ ਦਾਨਾ ॥
152.e: “Thou shalt neither be worshipped nor any gift be given to thee

152.g: ਤੋ ਕੋ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਵੋ ਦਿਜ ਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੨੮੮॥
152.e: “Thou shalt then be given various types of sufferings.2.288.
“Why hast thou hugged these two dead ones to thy bosom?
“Give them back to us  Why art thou hesitating?

152.g: ਜਉ ਦੁਐ ਏ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੂ ॥
152.e: “If thou dost not return both of them to me,

152.g: ਤਉ ਹਮ ਸਿਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਤੋਹੂ ॥੩॥੨੮੯॥
152.e: “Then we shall not be thy disciples.”3.289.
Then the Sanaudhi Brahmin got up early in the morning and took bath.
He worshipped in various ways the gods and manes.
Then he put the frontal marks of sandal and saffron on his forehead.

152.g: ਚਲ ਕਰ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਮੈ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੨੯੦॥
152.e: After that he walked upto his court.4.290.
Gauree, First Mehl:
The union of air, water and fire
the body is the play-thing of the fickle and unsteady intellect.
It has nine doors, and then there is the Tenth Gate.
Reflect upon this and understand it, O wise one. ||1||
The Lord is the One who speaks, teaches and listens.

152.g: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
152.e: One who contemplates his own self is truly wise. ||1||Pause||
The body is dust; the wind speaks through it.

152.g: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਮੂਆ ਹੈ. ਕਉਣੁ ॥
152.e: Understand, O wise one, who has died.
Awareness, conflict and ego have died,
but the One who sees does not die. ||2||
For the sake of it, you journey to sacred shrines and holy rivers;
but this priceless jewel is within your own heart.
The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read endlessly; they stir up arguments and controversies,
but they do not know the secret deep within. ||3||

152.g: ਹਉ ਨ ਮੂਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
152.e: I have not died - that evil nature within me has died.

152.g: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ; ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
152.e: The One who is pervading everywhere does not die.
Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,
and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4||

152.g: ਤਹਾ ਗਯੋ ਅਜੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਸੂਰਾ ਸੁਕ੍ਰੁਧੰ ॥
152.e: In that place of (of Sanaudhi Brahmin) went the warrior Ajai Singh in great rage,
Who wanted to kill Asumedh in a fierce war.14.285.

152.g: ਰਜੀਆ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਦਿਖਿਯੋ ਡਰੇ ਦੋਇ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੰ ॥
152.e: Both the brothers were frightened on seeing the son of the maid-servant.

152.g: ਗਹੀ ਸਰਣ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੰ ਬੁਲਿਯੋ ਏਵ ਬਾਤੰ ॥
152.e: They took shelter of the Brahmin and said:

152.g: ਗੁਵਾ ਹੇਮ ਸਰਬੰ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
152.e: “Save our life, thou shalt receive the gift of cows and gold from the lord
“O Guru, we are in thy shelter, we are in thy shelter, we are in thy sgelter.”15.286.
The Brahmin said:

152.g: ਹਮਰੀ ਵੈ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਦੁਐ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
152.e: “Neither have I seen both of them,
“Nor have they taken shelter.
“Whosoever has given thee news about them, he hath told a lie,
“O Emperor, the king of kings.1.291.
“O Emperor, the king of kings,
“O the hero of all the universe and Master of the earth
“While sitting here, I am giving blessings to thee,
“Thou , O monarch, art the Lord of the kings.”2.292.
Gauree, First Mehl, Dakhanee:
I am forever a sacrifice to the one who listens and hears,
Who understands and believes in the Name.
When the Lord Himself leads us astray, there is no other place of rest for us to find.
You impart understanding, and You unite us in Your Union. ||1||
I obtain the Naam, which shall go along with me in the end.

152.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਬਾਧੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
152.e: Without the Name, all are held in the grip of Death. ||1||Pause||
My farming and my trading are by the Support of the Name.
The seeds of sin and virtue are bound together.
Sexual desire and anger are the wounds of the soul.
The evil-minded ones forget the Naam, and then depart. ||2||
True are the Teachings of the True Guru.
The body and mind are cooled and soothed, by the touchstone of Truth.
This is the true mark of wisdom: that one remains detached, like the water-lily, or the lotus upon the water.
Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, one becomes sweet, like the juice of the sugar cane. ||3||
By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the castle of the body has ten gates.
The five passions dwell there, together with the Divine Light of the Infinite.
The Lord Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are adorned and rejuvenated. ||4||5||
Gauree, First Mehl:
How can we know where we came from?
Where did we originate, and where will we go and merge?
How are we bound, and how do we obtain liberation?
How do we merge with intuitive ease into the Eternal, Imperishable Lord? ||1||
With the Naam in the heart and the Ambrosial Naam on our lips,
through the Name of the Lord, we rise above desire, like the Lord. ||1||Pause||
With intuitive ease we come, and with intuitive ease we depart.

152.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
152.e: From the mind we originate, and into the mind we are absorbed.
As Gurmukh, we are liberated, and are not bound.
Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated through the Name of the Lord. ||2||
At night, lots of birds settle on the tree.
Some are happy, and some are sad. Caught in the desires of the mind, they perish.
And when the life-night comes to its end, then they look to the sky.
They fly away in all ten directions, according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

153.g: ਇਨ ਕੋ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰਨ ਤੇ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੬॥੨੯੬॥
153.e: “And hath ousted them from his bundaries.”6.296.
Gauree, First Mehl:
Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.
Remaining alive in this death brings joy deep within.
Overcoming egotistical pride, the Tenth Gate is found. ||1||
Death is pre-ordained - no one who comes can remain here.

153.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਿ; ਰਹਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
153.e: So chant and meditate on the Lord, and remain in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Meeting the True Guru, duality is dispelled.

153.g: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ; ਮਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
153.e: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.
One who remains dead while yet alive obtains the greatest happiness hereafter. ||2||
Meeting the True Guru, one becomes truthful, chaste and pure.
Climbing up the steps of the Guru's Path, one becomes the highest of the high.

153.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੩॥
153.e: When the Lord grants His Mercy, the fear of death is conquered. ||3||
Uniting in Guru's Union, we are absorbed in His Loving Embrace.
Granting His Grace, He reveals the Mansion of His Presence, within the home of the self.
O Nanak, conquering egotism, we are absorbed into the Lord. ||4||9||
Those who are committed to the Naam, see the world as merely a temporary pasture.
Sexual desire and anger are broken, like a jar of poison.
Without the merchandise of the Name, the house of the body and the store of the mind are empty.
Meeting the Guru, the hard and heavy doors are opened. ||4||
One meets the Holy Saint only through perfect destiny.
The Lord's perfect people rejoice in the Truth.

153.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇ; ਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
153.e: Surrendering their minds and bodies, they find the Lord with intuitive ease.
Nanak falls at their feet. ||5||6||
Gauree, First Mehl:
The conscious mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya.
The conscious mind is awake only to falsehood, corruption and attachment.
It gathers in the assets of sin and greed.
So swim across the river of life, O my mind, with the Sacred Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

153.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ; ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
153.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Great! Great is my True Lord! I seek Your All-powerful Support.

153.g: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ; ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
153.e: I am a sinner - You alone are pure. ||1||Pause||
Fire and water join together, and the breath roars in its fury!
The tongue and the sex organs each seek to taste.
The eyes which look upon corruption do not know the Love and the Fear of God.
Conquering self-conceit, one obtains the Name. ||2||

153.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
153.e: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, shall never again have to die.
Without such a death, how can one attain perfection?
The mind is engrossed in deception, treachery and duality.
Whatever the Immortal Lord does, comes to pass. ||3||
So get aboard that boat when your turn comes.
Those who fail to embark upon that boat shall be beaten in the Court of the Lord.
Blessed is that Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, where the Praises of the True Lord are sung.
O Nanak, the One Creator Lord is pervading hearth and home. ||4||7||
Gauree, First Mehl:
The inverted heart-lotus has been turned upright, through reflective meditation on God.
From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
The Lord Himself is pervading the three worlds. ||1||

153.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
153.e: O my mind, do not give in to doubt.

153.g: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
153.e: When the mind surrenders to the Name, it drinks in the essence of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
So win the game of life; let your mind surrender and accept death.

153.g: ਆਪਿ ਮੂਆ; ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
153.e: When the self dies, the individual mind comes to know the Supreme Mind.

153.g: ਨਜਰਿ ਭਈ; ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
153.e: As the inner vision is awakened, one comes to know one's own home, deep within the self. ||2||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is austerity, chastity and cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
What good are ostentatious displays?
The All-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

153.g: ਆਨ ਮਨਉ; ਤਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਉ ॥
153.e: If I had faith in someone else, then I would go to that one's house.
But where should I go, to beg? There is no other place for me.
O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||4||8||
TOTAK STANZA

153.g: ਇਮ ਬਾਤ ਜਬੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਤੇ ਸੁਨਿਯੰ ॥
153.e: When they heard the king saying in this manner,

153.g: ਗ੍ਰਹ ਬੈਠ ਸਬੈ ਦਿਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਯੰ ॥
153.e: All the Brahmins sat in their houses and decided,

153.g: ਅਜ ਸੈਨ ਅਜੈ ਭਟ ਦਾਸ ਸੁਤੰ ॥
153.e: That this son of maid-servant is unconquerable hero and his army is unconquerable.
He is very stern and a man of vicious intellect and actions.7.297.

153.g: ਮਿਲ ਖਾਇ ਤਉ ਖੋਵੈ ਜਨਮ ਜਗੰ ॥
153.e: If we eat in his company, then we lose our birth in the world

153.g: ਨਹਿ ਖਾਤ ਤੁ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਕਾਲ ਮਗੰ ॥
153.e: If we do not eat, then we will have to go in the jaws of death.

153.g: ਮਿਲ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ, ਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਉਨ ਮਤੰ ॥
153.e: After assembling we should take such decision,

153.g: ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤ ਰਹੇ ਜਗ ਆਜ ਪਤੰ ॥੮॥੨੯੮॥
153.e: With which we keep up our honour in the world.8.298.
After taking decision, they said to the king : “O king of great intellect, listen,
“Thou art fearless and unconquerable monarch on the whole earth
“Thou art unfathomable, bottomless and master of innumerable forces
“Thou art invincible, unassailable and Soverrign of Supreme might.9.299.

153.g: ਇਹ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਏਕ ਨਰੰ ॥
153.e: “There is not even one Kshatriya in this place.
“O great and superb monarch, listen to his truth.”

153.g: ਕਹਿਕੈ ਦਿਜ ਸਉ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਤ ਭਏ ॥
153.e: Uttering these words, the Brahmins got up and went away
But the spies gave the news (of the presence of his brothers there).10.300.

153.g: ਤਹਾ ਸਿੰਘ ਅਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸ ਬਢੀ ॥
153.e: Then the anger increased in the mind of Ajai Singh.
In great rage, he ordered his forces of four types to move forward.

153.g: ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ਪਰੀ ਜਹ ਖਤ੍ਰ ਬਰੰ ॥
153.e: The army reached there where both the superb Kshatriyas were stationed.

153.g: ਬਹੁ ਕੂਦਿ ਪਰੇ ਦਿਜ ਸਾਮ ਘਰੰ ॥੧੧॥੩੦੧॥
153.e: They jumped from the roof of the house into the abode of Sanaudhi Brahmin to take shelter.11.301.
The assembly of Brahmins met and reflected on the issue.

153.g: ਸਬ ਹੀ ਦਿਜ ਮੰਡਲ ਗੋਦ ਲੀਯੋ ॥
153.e: The whole assembly affectionately kept the two in their midst.

153.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਸੁ ਬੈਠਿ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੈ ॥
153.e: They ruminated over the issue as to what measures be taken?

153.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸਾਥ ਰਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਏਊ ਮਰੈ ॥੧੨॥੩੦੨॥
153.e: So that they may not offend the king and also save the two refugees.12.302.

153.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਭੈ ॥
153.e: When they said these words, then all of them desired:
“Break the secred threads immediately.”

153.g: ਜੋਊ ਮਾਨਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਸੋਈ ਲੇਤ ਭਏ ॥
153.e: Those who accepted it, they became without the thread.

153.g: ਤੇਊ ਬੈਸ ਹੁਇ ਬਾਣਜ ਕਰਤ ਭਏ ॥੧੩॥੩੦੩॥
153.e: They became Vaishyas and took trade as their occupation.13.303.

153.g: ਜਿਹ ਤੋਰ ਜਨੇਊ ਨ ਕੀਨ ਹਠੰ ॥
153.e: Those who did not dare to break the thread doggedly

153.g: ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਉਨ ਭੋਜੁ ਕੀਓ ਇਕਠੰ ॥
153.e: The two refugee kings dined together with them.
Them the spies went and told (the king Ajai Singh),

153.g: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਉਨ ਮੈ ਇਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧੪॥੩੦੪॥
153.e: There is one difference between the former and the latter.14.304.

153.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਉਠਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸਰਬ ਦਿਜੰ ॥
153.e: Then the king (Ajai Singh) addressed all his Brahmins:
“If there is no Kshatriya amongst them, then give your daughters in marriage to them.”

153.g: ਮਰਿਗੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਬਾਤ ਮਨੋ ਸਬ ਹੀ ॥
153.e: Hearing these words none replied as though they were dead.

153.g: ਉਠਿ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਤ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥੧੫॥੩੦੫॥
153.e: Then they got up and went away to their homes.15.305.
Then all gathered to take a decision.

153.g: ਸਭ ਸੋਕ ਕੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੀਚ ਡੁਬੇ ॥
153.e: All of them seemed to have been drowned in the ocean of sorrow.

153.g: ਵਹਿ ਬਾਧ ਬਹਿਠ ਅਤਿ ਤੇਊ ਹਠੰ ॥
153.e: He (Ajai Singh) wants to bind his brothers and the Brahmins were full of persistence,

153.g: ਹਮ ਏ ਦੋਊ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਚਲੈ ਇਕਠੰ ॥੧੬॥੩੦੬॥
153.e: We shall all side together with the brothers.’16.306.

153.g: ਹਠ ਕੀਨ ਦਿਜੈ ਤਿਨ ਲੀਨ ਸੁਤਾ ॥
153.e: The Sanaudh Brahmin persisted in not returning the refugee brothers, then the king Ajai Singh married his daughter.

153.g: ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਛਬਿ ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ॥
153.e: She was very beautiful, winsome and glorious.

153.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯੋ ਪੇਟ ਸਨੌਢ ਤੇ ਪੂਤ ਭਏ ॥
153.e: The sons born of that Sanaudh woman,
Were called Sanaudh.17.307.

153.g: ਸੁਤ ਅਉਰਨ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਠਾ ਜੁ ਅਹੈ ॥
153.e: The sons of other kshatryas, who lived at that place,
They became Kshatriyas of many junior ccastes.

154.e: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

154.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਬਾਜੀ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
154.e: With your nectar-like body, you live in comfort, but this world is just a passing drama.

154.g: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
154.e: You practice greed, avarice and great falsehood, and you carry such a heavy burden.

154.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ. ਮੈ ਰੁਲਦੀ ਦੇਖੀ; ਜਿਉ ਧਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
154.e: O body, I have seen you blowing away like dust on the earth. ||1||
Listen - listen to my advice!

154.g: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ. ਰਹਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.e: Only the good deeds which you have done shall remain with you, O my soul. This opportunity shall not come again! ||1||Pause||
Gauree, First Mehl:
Those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar.
Other fears are forgotten, and they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Why should we fear, when fear is dispelled by the Fear of God?

154.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, I recognize God. ||1||Pause||

154.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ; ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
154.e: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's essence are blessed and acclaimed,
And intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||2||
Those whom the Lord puts to sleep, evening and morning
- those self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged by Death, here and hereafter. ||3||
Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, day and night, are perfect.
O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11||
Gauree, First Mehl:
Past actions cannot be erased.
What do we know of what will happen hereafter?
Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.
There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||

154.g: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਮ; ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
154.e: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.

154.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ; ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.e: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||
You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!
The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.
One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.
The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||
You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.
As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.

154.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
154.e: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.
Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||

154.g: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
154.e: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.
Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.
All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.
Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10||
Gauree, First Mehl:
One who loves the three qualities is subject to birth and death.
The four Vedas speak only of the visible forms.
They describe and explain the three states of mind,
but the fourth state, union with the Lord, is known only through the True Guru. ||1||
Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one swims across.

154.g: ਬਾਹੁੜਿ; ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.e: Then, one is not born again, and is not subject to death. ||1||Pause||
Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;
the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Pandits speak of them as well.

154.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਅਰਥੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
154.e: But without the Guru, they do not understand their true significance.
The treasure of liberation is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||2||

154.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
154.e: Those, within whose hearts the Lord dwells,
become Gurmukh; they receive the blessings of devotional worship.
Through devotional worship of the Lord, liberation and bliss are obtained.
Through the Guru's Teachings, supreme ecstasy is obtained. ||3||
One who meets the Guru, beholds Him, and inspires others to behold Him as well.
In the midst of hope, the Guru teaches us to live above hope and desire.
He is the Master of the meek, the Giver of peace to all.
Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||
The King Jag: TOMAR STANZA BY THY GRACE
For eighty-two years, eight months and two days,
Ruled very prosperously the king of kings (Ajai Singh).1.312.
Listen, the king of great kingdom, who was treasure of fourteen learnings
Who recited the mantra of twelve letters and was the Supreme Sovereign on the earth.2.313.
Then the great king Jag took birth, who was very beautiful and affectionate
Who was highly lustrous than the sun, His great effulgence was indestructible.3.314.
He called all the great Brahmins. In order to perform the animal sacrifice,
He called very leaned Brahmins, who called themselves very beautiful like Cupid.4.315.
Many Brahmin beautiful like Cuaid were especially invited by the king.
Innumerable animals of the world, were caught and burnt in altar-pit thoughtlessly.5.316.
Ten times on one animal, the Vedic mantra was recited thoughtlessly.
The animal was burnt in the altar-pit, for which much wealth was received from the king.6.317.
By performing animal-sacrifice, the kingdom prospered in many ways.
For eighty-eight years and two months, the monarch ruled the kingdom.7.318.
Then the terrible sword of death, whose flame hath burnt the world
Broke the unbreakable king, whose rule was entirely glorious.8.319.

154.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਤੁ ਭਏ ॥
154.e: Those Brahmins who ate together with the king.
They were called Rajputs.18.308.

154.g: ਤਿਨ ਜੀਤ ਬਿਜੈ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਉ ਚੜ︀ਯੋ ॥
154.e: After conquering them, the king (Ajai Singh) moved to gain further conquests.
His glory and magnificence increased enormously.

154.g: ਜੋਊ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਕ ਦਏ ॥
154.e: Those who surrendered before him and married their daughters to him,
They were also called Rajputs.19.309.

154.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਕ ਦਏ ਨਹਿ ਰਾਰਿ ਬਢੀ ॥
154.e: Those who did not marry their daughters, the wrangle increased with them.

154.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਇਨ ਲੈ ਜੜ ਮੂਲ ਕਢੀ ॥
154.e: He (the king) completely uprooted them.

154.g: ਦਲ ਤੇ ਬਲ ਤੇ ਧਨ ਟੂਟਿ ਗਏ ॥
154.e: The armies, might and wealth were finished.
And they adopted the occupation of traders.20.310.

154.g: ਜੋਊ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਹਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਲਰੇ ॥
154.e: Those who did not surrender and fought violently,
Their bodies were bound and reduced to ashes in big fires.
They were burnt in the fire-altar-pit uninformed.
Thus there was a very great sacrifice of Kshatriyas.21.311.

154.g: ਇਤਿ ਅਜੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਕਾ ਰਾਜ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
154.e: Here ends the complete Description of the Rule of Ajai Singh.

155.g: ੴ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫਤੇ ॥
155.e: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.
By the Tenth King (Guru).
VISNU’S TWENTY-FOUR INCARNATIONS.
CHAUPAI
Now I describe the wonderful performance of twenty-four incarnations.

155.g: ਜਿੱਹ ਬਿਧ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲਖਾ ਅਖਾਰਾ ॥
155.e: In the way I visualized the same
O saints  listen to it attentively.
The poet Shyam is narrating it according or his own under-standing.1.
CHAUPAI
Whenever numerous tyrants take birth,
Then the Lord manifests himself in physical form
The KAL (Destroyer Lord) scans the play of all,
And ultimately destroys all.2.
CHAUPAI
The KAL (Destroyer Lord) causes the expansion of all
The same Temporal Lord ultimately destroys all
He manifests Himself in innumerable forms,
And Himself merges all within Hmself.3.
CHAUPAI

155.g: ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
155.e: In this creation is included the world and the ten incarnations
Within them pervades our Lord
Besides ten, other fourteen incarnations are also reckoned

155.g: ਕਹੋ ਜੁ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਏ ਅਖਾਰੂ ॥੪॥
155.e: And I describe the performance of all them.4.
CHAUPAI
The KAL (Temporal Lord) conceals his name,
And imposes the villainy over the head of others

155.g: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾ. ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ; ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
155.e: I say to you, O my body: listen to my advice!

155.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚਿੰਦਾ. ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ; ਝੂਠੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ॥
155.e: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.

155.g: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ; ਕਰਹਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
155.e: You gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal and commit evil deeds.

155.g: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ. ਤੂੰ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਹੀਏਹਿ; ਛੁਟੜਿ ਹੋਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
155.e: But when the swan departs, you shall remain behind, like an abandoned woman. ||2||

155.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
155.e: O body, you are living in a dream! What good deeds have you done?

155.g: ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ. ਮੈ ਜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਆ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
155.e: When I stole something by deception, then my mind was pleased.

155.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ. ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ; ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
155.e: I have no honor in this world, and I shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. My life has been lost, wasted in vain! ||3||

155.g: ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਹੋਈ, ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ. ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
155.e: I am totally miserable! O Baba Nanak, no one cares for me at all! ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਤਾਜੀ ਤੁਰਕੀ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ; ਕਪੜ ਕੇਰੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
155.e: Turkish horses, gold, silver and loads of gorgeous clothes

155.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਚਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
155.e: - none of these shall go with you, O Nanak. They are lost and left behind, you fool!

155.g: ਕੂਜਾ ਮੇਵਾ. ਮੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
155.e: I have tasted all the sugar candy and sweets, but Your Name alone is Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||

155.g: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਨੀਵ. ਦਿਵਾਲ ਉਸਾਰੀ; ਭਸਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
155.e: Digging deep foundations, the walls are constructed, but in the end, the buildings return to heaps of dust.

155.g: ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਚਿ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ; ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
155.e: People gather and hoard their possessions, and give nothing to anyone else - the poor fools think that everything is theirs.

155.g: ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੋਇਨ ਮਾੜੀ; ਸੰਪੈ. ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੫॥
155.e: Riches do not remain with anyone - not even the golden palaces of Sri Lanka. ||5||
Listen, you foolish and ignorant mind
- only His Will prevails. ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ; ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
155.e: My Banker is the Great Lord and Master. I am only His petty merchant.

155.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ; ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
155.e: This soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to life. ||6||1||13||
ROOAAL STANZA BY THE GRACE

155.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਪਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਨ; ਜਗ ਕੀਨ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
155.e: The Brahmins began the performance of the sacrifice by the recitation of auspicious mantras

155.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਅਉਰ ਉਪਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਕੈ; ਬੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਮੁਖ ਚਾਰ ॥
155.e: Brahma, Indra and other gods were also invited.

155.g: ਕਉਨ ਭਾਤਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਅਬ; ਜਗ ਕੋ ਆਰੰਭ ॥
155.e: “In what way, the sacrifice be began now?” the king asked again,

155.g: ਆਜ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਚਾਰੀਐ; ਸੁਨਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ, ਅਸੰਭ ॥੧॥੩੩੪॥
155.e: “O friends, give me to-day, thy advice in this impossible errand.”1.334.

155.g: ਮਾਸ ਕੇ ਪਲ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੈ; ਪੜਿ ਬੇਦ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
155.e: The friend advised that the flesh chopped into bits alongwith the recitation of mantras,

155.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਭੀਤਰ ਹੋਮੀਐ; ਸੁਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ, ਅਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
155.e: Be burnt in the sacrificial fire  the king was asked to listen and act without any other thoughts

155.g: ਛੇਦਿ ਚਿਛੁਰ ਬਿੜਾਰਾਸੁਰ; ਧੂਲਿ ਕਰਣਿ ਖਪਾਇ ॥
155.e: The goddess had killed the demons named Chithar and Biraal and destroyed Dhoolkaran

155.g: ਮਾਰ ਦਾਨਵ ਕਉ ਕਰਿਓ ਮਖ; ਦੈਤ ਮੇਧ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੩੫॥
155.e: After killing the demons she performed the demon-sacrifice.2.335.

155.g: ਤੈਸ ਹੀ ਮਖ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਸੁਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ, ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ॥
155.e: “Listen, O most Glorious Sovereign, thou shouldst perform the sacrifice in that way

155.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ; ਬਲਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਖੰਡ ॥
155.e: “O mighty and perfect Lord, therefore conquer all the demons of the country

155.g: ਤੈਸ ਹੀ ਮਖ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
155.e: “Just as the goddess having killed the demons, held the canopy over the head of Indra,

155.g: ਜੈਸ ਸੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਤਿਵ ਸੰਤ ਹੋਹੁ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੩॥੩੩੬॥
155.e: “And made all the gods happy, similarly Thou mayst help the saints.”3.336.
Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

155.g: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਖਿੰਥਾਤਾ ॥
155.e: Let your ear-rings be those ear-rings which pierce deep within your heart. Let your body be your patched coat.

155.g: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਡੰਡਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
155.e: Let the five passions be disciples under your control, O begging Yogi, and make this mind your walking stick. ||1||
Thus you shall find the Way of Yoga.

155.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ; ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ. ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
155.e: There is only the One Word of the Shabad; everything else shall pass away. Let this be the fruits and roots of your mind's diet. ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁੰਡਾਇਐ. ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੰਗਾਤਾ ॥
155.e: Some try to find the Guru by shaving their heads at the Ganges, but I have made the Guru my Ganges.

155.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਏਕੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਅੰਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
155.e: The Saving Grace of the three worlds is the One Lord and Master, but those in darkness do not remember Him. ||2||

155.g: ਕਰਿ ਪਟੰਬੁ. ਗਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿ; ਸੰਸਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
155.e: Practicing hypocrisy and attaching your mind to worldly objects, your doubt shall never depart.
Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

155.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਪੰਚ. ਹਮ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ; ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਉ. ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
155.e: There are five of them, but I am all alone. How can I protect my hearth and home, O my mind?

155.g: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
155.e: They are beating and plundering me over and over again; unto whom can I complain? ||1||
Chant the Name of the Supreme Lord, O my mind.

155.g: ਆਗੈ; ਜਮ ਦਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
155.e: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will have to face the awesome and cruel army of Death. ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਉਸਾਰਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੁਆਰਾ; ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਸਾ ਧਨਾ ॥
155.e: God has erected the temple of the body; He has placed the nine doors, and the soul-bride sits within.

155.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਅਵਰਿ ਲੁਟੇਨਿ. ਸੁ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
155.e: She enjoys the sweet play again and again, while the five demons are plundering her. ||2||

155.g: ਢਾਹਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ; ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪਕੜੀ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ॥
155.e: In this way, the temple is being demolished; the body is being plundered, and the soul-bride, left all alone, is captured.

155.g: ਜਮ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਪੜਿਆ; ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ. ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
155.e: Death strikes her down with his rod, the shackles are placed around her neck, and now the five have left. ||3||

155.g: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲੋੜੈ. ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੁੜੇਨਿ, ਸੁ ਖਾਧਾਤਾ ॥
155.e: The wife yearns for gold and silver, and her friends, the senses, yearn for good food.

155.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ; ਜਾਸੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
155.e: O Nanak, she commits sins for their sake; she shall go, bound and gagged, to the City of Death. ||4||2||14||

155.g: ਇਤਿ ਪੰਚਮੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
155.e: Here ends the Description of the Benign Rule of the Fifth King.
TOMAR STANZA BY THY GRACE
Then Muni became the king of the earth
The Lion-King of this world.
By conquering the unbreakable enemies,
He ruled gloriously over the earth.1.320.
He killed many enemies,
And did not leave even one of them alive.
He then ruled uninterrupted.
He sized other lands and held the canopy over his head.2.321.
He was person of superb and perfect beauty
An impetuous warrior-king
Glory-incarnate and devoid-king
The Sovereign of undivided and imperishable kingdom.3.322.
Conquering many kings,
And shooting many arrows,
Killing innumerable enemies,
He established immeasurable kingdom on the earth.4.323.
Ruling the prosperous kingdom for a long time,
The king of kings said thus
“Prepare and altar for sacrifice,
“And call the Brahmins quickly.”5.324.
Many Brahmins were then invited.
None of them was left at his home.
The consulation with ministers and Brahmins began.
The sagacious friend and ministers began to recite mantras.6.325.
Then the king of king said,
“There is incentive in my mind for a sacrifice
“What type of sacrificial altar be prepared?
“O my friends, tell me quickly.”7.326.
Then the friends consulted one another.
They told the king like this:
O generous monarch, listen,
“Thou art very sagacious in all the fourteen worlds.8.327.
“Listen, O king, in Satyuga,
“The goddess Chandi had performed the sacrifice
“By killing the enemy, the demon Mahishasura,
“She had pleased Shiva greatly”9.328.
After killing Mahishasura in the battlefield,
The canopy was held over the head of Indra.
She had pleased all the vamps,
And effaced the pride of the demons.10.329.
After conquering Mahishasura in the battlefield.
She had made the Brahmins and gods fearless
She called the god Indra,
And seizing the earth from Mahishasura, she held the canopy over his head.11.330.
She called the four-headed Brahma,
With her heart’s desire, she (the mother of the world),
Began the performance of the sacrifice
She had indivisible and powerful glory.12.331.
Then the four-headed Brahma spoke,
“Listen, O Chandi, I bow in obeisance to thee,
“Just as thou hast asked me,
“In the same way, I advise thee.”13.322.
The innumerable beings and creatures of the world,
The goddess herself called them to come,
And within her enemies she cut them in an instant.
With her loud voice she recited the Vedic mantras and performed the sacrifice.14.333.

156.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
156.e: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

156.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਕੈ; ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
156.e: The nights are wasted sleeping, and the days are wasted eating.

156.g: ਹੀਰੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ; ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
156.e: Human life is such a precious jewel, but it is being lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||

156.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
156.e: You do not know the Name of the Lord.

156.g: ਮੂੜੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.e: You fool - you shall regret and repent in the end! ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ. ਧਰਣੀ ਧਰੇ; ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
156.e: You bury your temporary wealth in the ground, but how can you love that which is temporary?

156.g: ਅਨਤ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਨ. ਜੋ ਗਏ; ਸੇ ਆਏ ਅਨਤ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
156.e: Those who have departed, after craving for temporary wealth, have returned home without this temporary wealth. ||2||

156.g: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
156.e: If people could gather it in by their own efforts, then everyone would be so lucky.

156.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
156.e: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

156.g: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ. ਮਨ ਏਕੈ; ਜੇ ਕਰਿ. ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
156.e: O mind, there is only the One medicine, mantra and healing herb - center your consciousness firmly on the One Lord.

156.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ. ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ; ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
156.e: Take to the Lord, the Destroyer of the sins and karma of past incarnations. ||1||

156.g: ਮਨ; ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.e: The One Lord and Master is pleasing to my mind.

156.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ, ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.e: In Your three qualities, the world is engrossed; the Unknowable cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ; ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.e: Maya is so sweet to the body, like sugar or molasses. We all carry loads of it.

156.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ. ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਸਿ ਮੂਸਾ. ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
156.e: In the dark of the night, nothing can be seen. The mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life, O Siblings of Destiny! ||2||

156.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.e: As the self-willed manmukhs act, they suffer in pain. The Gurmukh obtains honor and greatness.

156.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ. ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ; ਕਿਰਤੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
156.e: Whatever He does, that alone happens; past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

156.g: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ. ਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਊਣੇ; ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.e: Those who are imbued with, and committed to the Lord's Love, are filled to overflowing; they never lack anything.

156.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ. ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ. ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
156.e: If Nanak could be the dust of their feet, then he, the ignorant one, might also obtain some. ||4||4||16||

156.g: ਆਪਨ ਰਹਤ ਨਿਰਾਲਮ ਜਗ ਤੇ ॥
156.e: He Himself remains detached from the world,

156.g: ਜਾਨ ਲਏ ਜਾਨਾ ਮੈ ਤਬਤੇ ॥੫॥
156.e: I know this fact from the very beginning (ancient times).5.

156.g: ਚਉਪਈ ॥
156.e: CHAUPAI

156.g: ਆਪ ਰਚੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਲ ਘਾਏ ॥
156.e: He creates Himself and destroys Himself

156.g: ਅਵਰਨ ਕੈ ਦੈ ਮੂੰਡ ਹਤਾਏ ॥
156.e: But He imposes the responsibility on the head of others

156.g: ਆਪ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਹਾ ਨ ਪਾ︁ਯਾ ॥
156.e: He Himself remains detached and Beyond Everything

156.g: ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਕਹਾ︁ਯਾ ॥੬॥
156.e: Therefore, He is called ‘Infinite’.6.

156.g: ਚਉਪਈ ॥
156.e: CHAUPAI

156.g: ਜੋ ਚਉਬੀਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
156.e: Those who are called twenty-four incarnations

156.g: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ, ਤਨਕ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
156.e: O Lord! they even could not realise thee in a small measure

156.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜਗ ਭਰਮੇ ਭਵਰਾ︁ਯੰ ॥
156.e: They became kings of the world and got deluded

156.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਕਹਾ︁ਯੰ ॥੭॥
156.e: Therefore they were called by innumerable names.7.

156.g: ਚਉਪਈ ॥
156.e: CHAUPAI

156.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਛਲਤ, ਨ ਆਪ ਛਲਾ︁ਯਾ ॥
156.e: O Lord! Thou hast been deluding others, but could not be deluded by others

156.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ, ਛਲੀਆ ਆਪ ਕਹਾਯਾ ॥
156.e: Therefore Thou art called ‘Crafty’

156.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਦੁਖੀ ਨਿਰਖ ਅਕੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
156.e: Thou becomest agitated on seeing the saints in agony,

156.g: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਹਲਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
156.e: Therefore Thou art also called ‘the fiend of the humble’.8.

156.g: ਚਉਪਈ ॥
156.e: CHAUPAI

156.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਰਤ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੌ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
156.e: At time Thou destroyest the universe

156.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਲ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਡਾਲਾ ॥
156.e: Therefore the world hath named you KAL (the Destroyer Lord)

156.g: ਸਮੈ ਸੰਤ ਪਰ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
156.e: Thou hast been helping all the saints

156.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਖ︁ਯਾ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਾਈ ॥੯॥
156.e: Therefore the saints have reckoned Thy incarnations.9.

156.g: ਚਉਪਈ ॥
156.e: CHAUPAI

156.g: ਨਿਰਖ ਦੀਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਤ ਦਿਆਰਾ ॥
156.e: Seeing Thy mercifulness towards the lowly

156.g: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਹਮ ਤਬੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
156.e: Thy name ‘Deen Bandhu’ (the helper of the lowly) hath been thought out

156.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਰਸੁ ਢਰਈ ॥
156.e: Thou art Compassionate towards the saints

156.g: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਗ ਤਬੈ ਉਚਰਈ ॥੧੦॥
156.e: Therefore the world calls Thee ‘Karuna-nidhi’ (the Tresure of mercy).10.

156.g: ਚਉਪਈ ॥
156.e: CHAUPAI

156.g: ਸੰਕਟ ਹਰਤ ਸਾਧਵਨ ਸਦਾ ॥
156.e: Thou ever removest the distress of the saints

156.g: ਸੰਕਟ ਹਰਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਭ︁ਯੋ ਤਦਾ ॥
156.e: Therefore Thou art named ‘Sankat-haran’, the remover of the distresses

156.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
156.e: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

156.g: ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ. ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ; ਕਿਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ. ਹਮ ਆਏ ॥
156.e: Who is our mother, and who is our father? Where did we come from?

156.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਿਪਜੇ; ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
156.e: We are formed from the fire of the womb within, and the bubble of water of the sperm. For what purpose are we created? ||1||

156.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
156.e: O my Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

156.g: ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ; ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.e: My own demerits cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ. ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ; ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
156.e: I took the form of so many plants and trees, and so many animals.

156.g: ਕੇਤੇ. ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ; ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ ॥੨॥
156.e: Many times I entered the families of snakes and flying birds. ||2||

156.g: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ. ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਭੰਨੈ; ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ. ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
156.e: I broke into the shops of the city and well-guarded palaces; stealing from them, I snuck home again.

156.g: ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ. ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ; ਤੁਝ ਤੇ. ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
156.e: I looked in front of me, and I looked behind me, but where could I hide from You? ||3||

156.g: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ. ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ; ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
156.e: I saw the banks of sacred rivers, the nine continents, the shops and bazaars of the cities.

156.g: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ. ਤੋਲਣਿ ਲਾਗਾ; ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
156.e: Taking the scale, the merchant begins to weigh his actions within his own heart. ||4||

156.g: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿਆ; ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
156.e: As the seas and the oceans are overflowing with water, so vast are my own sins.

156.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ. ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਹਰ ਉਪਾਵਹੁ; ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਥਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
156.e: Please, shower me with Your Mercy, and take pity upon me. I am a sinking stone - please carry me across! ||5||

156.g: ਜੀਅੜਾ. ਅਗਨਿ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਤਪੈ; ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
156.e: My soul is burning like fire, and the knife is cutting deep.

156.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
156.e: Prays Nanak, recognizing the Lord's Command, I am at peace, day and night. ||6||5||17||

156.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ. ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ; ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
156.e: If you focus your consciousness on the Feet of the One Lord, what reason would you have to chase after greed? ||3||

156.g: ਜਪਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ; ਰਚਸਿ ਮਨਾ ॥
156.e: Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, and saturate your mind with Him.

156.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਕਪਟੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.e: Why, O Yogi, do you make so many false and deceptive claims? ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੀ. ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਣੀਤਾ ॥
156.e: The body is wild, and the mind is foolish. Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, your life is passing away.

156.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਨਾਗੀ ਦਾਝੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ. ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
156.e: Prays Nanak, when the naked body is cremated, then you will come to regret and repent. ||4||3||15||

157.g: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ; ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
157.e: According to the karma of past actions, one's destiny unfolds, even though everyone wants to be so lucky. ||3||

157.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
157.e: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He alone takes care of it.

157.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
157.e: The Hukam of our Lord and Master's Command cannot be known; He Himself blesses us with greatness. ||4||1||18||
Thou hast been destroying the sufferings of the saints
Therefore Thou art called ‘Dukh-dahan’ (the destroyer of sufferings.11.
CHAUPAI
Thou art Infinite and none could know Thy limits
Therefore thou art called ‘Breant’ (the Boundless Lord)

157.g: ਜਗ ਮੋ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਨ ਕੇ ਧਰਤਾ ॥
157.e: Thou createst the forms of all in the world
Therefore thou art called Creator.12.
CHAUPAI
None hath been able to comprehend Thee,
Therefore thou hast been called ‘Alakh’ (Incompre-hensible)

157.g: ਜੋਨ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਆ︁ਯਾ ॥
157.e: Thou dost not take birth in the world
Therefore all called Thee ‘Ajon’ (Unborn).13.
CHAUPAI
Brahma and others have got tired in knowing Thy end
Who are the helpless gods Vishnu and Shiva?
The sun and moon also meditate on Thee
Therefore Thou art known as the Creator.14.
CHAUPAI
Thou art ever guiseless, and shall be guiseless
Therefore the world calls Thee ‘Abhekhi’ (Guiseless)
None knows Thy Invisible form
Therefore Thou art described as ‘Alekh’ (Incompre-hensible).15.
CHAUPAI
Thy beauty is unique and Thy forms are Innumerable
Thou art distinctly separate from all guise and not committed to any faith or idea
Thou art the Universal Donor and Thou Thyself dost not beg

157.g: ਜਾਨ ਲ︁ਯੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਮ ਤਬ ਤੇ ॥੧੬॥
157.e: Therefore I have known Thee as the Creator.16.
CHAUPAI
Thou art not influenced by any omen or auspicious time

157.g: ਹੈ ਯਹ ਕਥਾ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਮਾਲਮ ॥
157.e: This fact is known to all the world
None of the Yantras, Mantras and Tantras please Thee
And none could realise Thee by adopting different guises.17.
CHAUPAI
All the world is engaged in its own interests
And none comprehends the Transcendental Brahman
For Thy realization many go to the cremation ground and graveyards
But the Lord is not there in both of them.18.
CHAUPAI

157.g: ਏ ਦੋਊ ਮੋਹ ਬਾਦ ਮੋ ਪਚੇ ॥
157.e: Both of them (the Hindus and Muslims) are destroying themselves in attachments and in vain discussions and disputes
But O Lord! Thou art distinctly separate from both of them

157.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਯੋ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਉਰ ਕਾ ॥
157.e: He, with whose realization, the illusion of the mind is removed
Before that Lord, none is a Hindu of a Muslim.19.
CHAUPAI
One of them wears a Tasbi (the rosary of Muslims) and the other one wears Mala (the rosary of a Hindu)
One of them recites the Quran and the other one reads Puranas
The adherents of both the religions are foolishly dying in opposing each other,

157.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੂੜਾ ॥੨੦॥
157.e: And none of them is dyed in the love of the Lord.20.
CHAUPAI

157.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੇ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
157.e: Those who are imbued in the love of the Lord,

157.g: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਲੋਕ ਲਾਜ ਤਜਿ ਨਾਚੇ ॥
157.e: They forsake their shyness and dance in ecstasy
Those who have recognized that Primal Purusha,

157.g: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਵ ਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਨਾ ॥੨੧॥
157.e: The duality is destroyed form their hearts.21.
CHAUPAI

157.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਾਵ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
157.e: Those who are absorbed in duality,

157.g: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਮੀਤ ਮਿਲਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਚੇ ॥
157.e: They are far away from the union of the Lord. Their supreme friend
They who have recognized the Supreme Purusha even a little,
They have Comprehended Him as the Supreme Essence.22.
CHAUPAI
All the Yogis and Sannyasis
All the ascetics and monks with shaven heads and Muslims
Gauree Poorbee Deepkee, First Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

157.g: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ; ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
157.e: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted

157.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ; ਸਿਵਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
157.e: - in that house, sing the Songs of Praise, and meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||1||

157.g: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
157.e: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

157.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
157.e: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

157.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ; ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
157.e: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

157.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ. ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
157.e: Your gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

157.g: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
157.e: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come - let's gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

157.g: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ; ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
157.e: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

157.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ; ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
157.e: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

157.g: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੦॥
157.e: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||20||
Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

157.g: ਹਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਬਸਾ; ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਉ ॥
157.e: What if I were to become a deer, and live in the forest, picking and eating fruits and roots

157.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
157.e: - by Guru's Grace, I am a sacrifice to my Master. Again and again, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice. ||1||
I am the shop-keeper of the Lord.

157.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ; ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
157.e: Your Name is my merchandise and trade. ||1||Pause||

157.g: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਬਿ ਬਸਾ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
157.e: If I were to become a cuckoo, living in a mango tree, I would still contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

157.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
157.e: I would still meet my Lord and Master, with intuitive ease; the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of His Form, is incomparably beautiful. ||2||

157.g: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਸਾ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
157.e: If I were to become a fish, living in the water, I would still remember the Lord, who watches over all beings and creatures.

157.g: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ. ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉ ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
157.e: My Husband Lord dwells on this shore, and on the shore beyond; I would still meet Him, and hug Him close in my embrace. ||3||

157.g: ਨਾਗਨਿ ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
157.e: If I were to become a snake, living in the ground, the Shabad would still dwell in my mind, and my fears would be dispelled.

157.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
157.e: O Nanak, they are forever the happy soul-brides, whose light merges into His Light. ||4||2||19||
Raag Gauree Gwaarayree: Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meeting the Guru, we meet the Lord.
He Himself unites us in His Union.

157.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
157.e: My God knows all His Own Ways.
By the Hukam of His Command, He unites those who recognize the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

157.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਇ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
157.e: By the Fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled.

157.g: ਭੈ ਰਾਚੈ; ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
157.e: Imbued with His Fear, we are absorbed in the Love of the True One. ||1||Pause||

157.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਹਰਿ. ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
157.e: Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally dwells within the mind.

157.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਰਾ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
157.e: My God is Great and Almighty; His value cannot be estimated.
Through the Shabad, I praise Him; He has no end or limitations.
My God is the Forgiver. I pray that He may forgive me. ||2||

157.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
157.e: Meeting the Guru, all wisdom and understanding are obtained.

158.e: They are all plundering the world in different guises
The real saints whose prop is the Name of the Lord, they hide themselved.23.
CHAUPAI
The people of he world, exhibit here in order to fill their bellies,
Because without heresy, they do not gain money

158.g: ਜਿਨ ਨਰ ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਹੱ ਧਿਆ︁ਯੋ ॥
158.e: The person, who hath meditated only on the Supreme Purusha,

158.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਰ ਡਿੰਭ ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਦਿਖਾ︁ਯੋ ॥੨੪॥
158.e: He hath never exhibited an act of heresy to anyone.24.

158.g: ਡਿੰਭ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
158.e: One’s interest remain unfulfilled without heresy
And none bows down his head before anyone without interest

158.g: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਪੇਟ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
158.e: If the belly been not attached with anyone,
Then there would have not been any king or pauper in this world.25.
Those who have recognized only God as the Lord of all,

158.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਰ ਡਿੰਭ ਨ ਕਿਸੂ ਦਿਖਾ︁ਯੋ ॥
158.e: They have never exhibited any heresy to anyone

158.g: ਸੀਸ ਦੀਯੋ ਉਨ ਸਿਰਰ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
158.e: Such a person gets his head chopped off but never his creed
And such person considers his body equivalent only to a particle of dust.26.
One is called a Yogi on perforating his ears
And goes to the forest, performing many deceitful acts

158.g: ਏਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਤੱਤੁ ਨ ਲ︁ਯੋ ॥
158.e: But the person who hath not absorbed the essence of the Name in his heart,

158.g: ਬਨ ਕੋ ਭ︁ਯੋ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੋ ਭ︁ਯੋ ॥੨੭॥
158.e: He neither belongs to the forest nor his home.27.
Upto what extent this poor can describe?
Because one person cannot know the mystery of the Infinite Lord
Undoubtedly, if one may have millions of tongues,

158.g: ਗੁਣ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਤ੍ਵ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥੨੮॥
158.e: Even then the ocean of Thy Attributes cannot be fathomed.28.

158.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਕਾਲ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੋ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
158.e: First of all the Lord as KAL is the primal farther of the whole universe
And from him emanated the Powerful Lustre
The same Lord was considered as Bhavani,
Who created the whole world.29.
First of all, He uttered ‘Oankar’:

158.g: ਸੋ ਧੁਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਜਗਤ ਮੋ ਰਹਾ ॥
158.e: And the sound of “Onkar’ Pervanded the whole world,
There was expansion of the whole world,
From the union of Purusha and Prakriti.30.

158.g: ਜਗਤ ਭ︁ਯੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਜਨੀਯਤ ॥
158.e: The world was created and from that time, everyone knows it as world
Four divisions of creation became manifest and as such they were described
I have no power to give their description,
And tell their names separately.31.
That Lord created both the powerful and the weak
They were shown distinctly as high and low
The powerful KAL, adopting the physical form,
Manifested Himself in numerous forms.32.
According as the Lord adopted different forms,
In the same manner, he became renowned as different incarnations
But whatever is the Supreme form of the Lord
Ultimately all merged in Him.33.
Consider all the beings in the world,

158.g: ਏਕ ਜੋਤ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੋ ॥
158.e: Ad the illumination of the same Light,
The Lord, Who is known as KAL

158.g: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਲੀਨ ਜਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਹ੍ਵੈੁਬੋ ॥੩੪॥
158.e: All the world will merge in Him.34.
Whatever appears inconceivable to us,
The mind gives it the name of Maya
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

158.g: ਸੁ ਥਾਉ ਸਚੁ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
158.e: True is that place, where the mind becomes pure.
True is the one who abides in Truth.
The True Bani of the Word is known throughout the four ages.
The True One Himself is everything. ||1||
Through the karma of good actions, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

158.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
158.e: Sing the Glories of the Lord, sitting in that place. ||1||Pause||
Burn this tongue, which loves duality,

158.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਨ ਚਾਖੈ; ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਇ ॥
158.e: which does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and which utters insipid words.

158.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
158.e: Without understanding, the body and mind become tasteless and insipid.
Without the Name, the miserable ones depart crying out in pain. ||2||

158.g: ਰਸਨਾ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
158.e: One whose tongue naturally and intuitively tastes the Lord's sublime essence,
By Guru's Grace, is absorbed in the True Lord.
Imbued with Truth, one contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad,
and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, from the immaculate stream within. ||3||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is collected in the vessel of the mind.
Nothing is collected if the vessel is upside-down.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Naam abides within the mind.

158.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੩॥
158.e: O Nanak, True is that vessel of the mind, which thirsts for the Shabad. ||4||3||23||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

158.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
158.e: Those who obtain spiritual wisdom from the Guru are very rare.
Those who obtain this understanding from the Guru become acceptable.
Through the Guru, we intuitively contemplate the True One.
Through the Guru, the Gate of Liberation is found. ||1||
Through perfect good destiny, we come to meet the Guru.
The true ones are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
Meeting the Guru, the fire of desire is quenched.

158.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
158.e: Through the Guru, peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind.

158.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
158.e: Through the Guru, we become pure, holy and true.
Through the Guru, we are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
Without the Guru, everyone wanders in doubt.
Without the Name, they suffer in terrible pain.
Those who meditate on the Naam become Gurmukh.
True honor is obtained through the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||3||

158.g: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
158.e: Why speak of any other? He alone is the Giver.
When He grants His Grace, union with the Shabad is obtained.
Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
O Nanak, becoming true, I am absorbed in the True One. ||4||2||22||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

158.g: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ; ਮਨਿ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
158.e: Some sing on and on, but their minds do not find happiness.
In egotism, they sing, but it is wasted uselessly.
Those who love the Naam, sing the song.
They contemplate the True Bani of the Word, and the Shabad. ||1||
They sing on and on, if it pleases the True Guru.

158.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
158.e: Their minds and bodies are embellished and adorned, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Some sing, and some perform devotional worship.
Without heart-felt love, the Naam is not obtained.
True devotional worship consists of love for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

158.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਸਦਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
158.e: The devotee keeps his Beloved clasped tightly to his heart. ||2||
The mind becomes pure, when the True Lord dwells within.
When one dwells in Truth, all actions become true.
The ultimate action is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||3||
Through the Guru, true service is performed.
How rare is that Gurmukh who recognizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Giver, the Great Giver, lives forever.
Nanak enshrines love for the Name of the Lord. ||4||1||21||

159.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
The entire world has gone insane in egotism.
In the love of duality, it wanders deluded by doubt.

159.g: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ; ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
159.e: The mind is distracted by great anxiety; no one recognizes one's own self.
Occupied with their own affairs, their nights and days are passing away. ||1||
Meditate on the Lord in your hearts, O my Siblings of Destiny.

159.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
159.e: The Gurmukh's tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukhs recognize the Lord in their own hearts;
they serve the Lord, the Life of the World. They are famous throughout the four ages.
They subdue egotism, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
God, the Architect of Destiny, showers His Mercy upon them. ||2||

159.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
159.e: True are those who merge into the Word of the Guru's Shabad;
they restrain their wandering mind and keep it steady.

159.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
159.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the nine treasures. It is obtained from the Guru.

159.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
159.e: By the Lord's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||3||

159.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਤਿਆ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
159.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the body becomes peaceful and tranquil.

159.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਪੀਰ ॥
159.e: He dwells deep within - the pain of death does not touch Him.
He Himself is our Lord and Master; He is His Own Advisor.

159.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੬॥
159.e: O Nanak, serve the Lord forever; He is the treasure of glorious virtue. ||4||6||26||
Only one lord pervades all

159.g: ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਰ ਥਾਪਾ ॥੩੫॥
159.e: But appears to everyone as distinctly separate accofding to his discernment.35.

159.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਮ ਰਹਿ︁ਯੋ ਅਲੇਖਾ ॥
159.e: That inconceivable Lord pervades all
And all the beings beg from him according to their writ
He, who hath comprehended the Lord as One,
Only he hath realized the Supreme Essence.36.
That One Lord hath a hath a Unique Beauty and Form
And he Himself is somewhere a king and somewhere a pauper
He hath involved all through various means

159.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜੁਦੋ, ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੩੭॥
159.e: But he Himself is separate from all and none could know His mystey.37.
He hath created all in separate forms
And He Himself destroys all

159.g: ਆਪ ਕਿਸੂ ਕੋ ਦੋਸ ਨ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
159.e: He doth not take any blame on His own Head
And fixes the responsibility of vicious acts on others.38.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

159.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
159.e: Why forget Him, unto whom the soul and the breath of life belong?

159.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
159.e: Why forget Him, who is all-pervading?
Serving Him, one is honored and accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

159.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
159.e: I am a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.

159.g: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ; ਤਦਿ ਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
159.e: If I were to forget You, at that very instant, I would die. ||1||Pause||

159.g: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ; ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
159.e: Those whom You Yourself have led astray, forget You.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
When someone kills and subdues his own mind, his wandering nature is also subdued.
Without such a death, how can one find the Lord?
Only a few know the medicine to kill the mind.

159.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
159.e: One whose mind dies in the Word of the Shabad, understands Him. ||1||
He grants greatness to those whom He forgives.

159.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
159.e: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh practices doing good deeds;

159.g: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
159.e: thus he comes to understand this mind.
The mind is like an elephant, drunk with wine.
The Guru is the rod which controls it, and shows it the way. ||2||
The mind is uncontrollable; how rare are those who subdue it.
Those who move the immovable become pure.
The Gurmukhs embellish and beautify this mind.
They eradicate egotism and corruption from within. ||3||
Those who, by pre-ordained destiny, are united in the Lord's Union,
are never separated from Him again; they are absorbed in the Shabad.
He Himself knows His Own Almighty Power.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||25||
Now begins the description of the first Machh Incarnation
CHAUPAI
Once there was born a demon named Shankhasura

159.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੈ ਜਗ ਕੋ ਦੁਖ ਦ︁ਯੋ ॥
159.e: Who, in many ways, distressed the world
Then the Lord manifested Himself as Machh (Fish) incarnation,
Who repeated His Own name Himself.39.
At first he Lord manifested Himself as small fish,
And shook the ocean violenty
Then He enlarged his body,
Seeing which Shankhasura got greatly enraged.40.
The fools perform devotional worship by showing off;

159.g: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਟਪਹਿ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
159.e: they dance and dance and jump all around, but they only suffer in terrible pain.
By dancing and jumping, devotional worship is not performed.

159.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
159.e: But one who dies in the Word of the Shabad, obtains devotional worship. ||3||
The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He inspires them to perform devotional worship.
True devotional worship consists of eliminating selfishness and conceit from within.

159.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
159.e: My True God knows all ways and means.
O Nanak, He forgives those who recognize the Naam. ||4||4||24||

160.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

160.g: ਤਬੈ ਕੋਪ ਗਰਜਿਯੋ ਬਲੀ ਸੰਖ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
ਧਰੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਜੇ ਲੋਹ ਚੀਰੰ ॥
160.e: Then in great anger, the mighty Shankhasura thundered and wore his armour bedecking himself with weapons and arms

160.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਤੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਸਿੰਧ ਮੱਧੰ ॥
ਤ੍ਰਸ︀︁ਯੋ ਅਸਟ ਨੈਣੰ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਜਾਪੁ ਸੁਧੰ ॥੪੧॥
160.e: He threw the fore Vedas in the ocean, which frightened the eitht-eyed Brahma and caused him to remember the Lord.41.

160.g: ਧਰੇ ਲੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੰ ॥
160.e: Then the Lord, the well-wisher of both (the Vedas as well as Brahma) ws filled with kindness and highly enraged, He wore His steel-armour.

160.g: ਮਹਾਂ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਾਤੰ ਕਰੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
ਟਰੇ ਦੇਵ ਸਰਬੰ ਗਿਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਾਤੰ ॥੪੨॥
160.e: The bows of weapons were struck alongwith arms causing destruction. All the gods in groups moved away from their seats and the seven worlds trembled because of this horrible war.42.

161.g: ਸੰਖਾਸੁਰ ਮਾਰੇ, ਬੇਦ ਉਧਾਰੇ; ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਜਸੁ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
161.e: The Lord received great approbation of killing the demon Shankhasura, redeeming the Vedas and destroying the enemies.

161.g: ਦੇਵੇਸੁ ਬੁਲਾ︁ਯੋ, ਰਾਜ ਬਿਠਾ︁ਯੋ; ਛਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾ︁ਯੋ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਨੋ ॥
161.e: He called Indra, the king of gods and blessed him with royalty and its comforts.

161.g: ਕੋਟੰ ਬਜੇ ਬਾਜੇ, ਅਮੁਰੇਸੁਰ ਗਾਜੇ; ਸੁਭ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਸੋਕ ਹਰੇ ॥
161.e: Millions of musical instruments began to resound, the gods began to play th tune of bliss and the sorrows of every house were destroyed.

161.g: ਦੈ ਕੋਟਕ ਦਛਨਾ, ਕ੍ਰੋਰ ਪ੍ਰਦਛਨਾ; ਆਨਿ ਸੁ ਮੱਛ ਕੇ ਪਾਇ ਪਰੇ ॥੫੪॥
161.e: All the gods bowed in respect at the feet of Fish incarnation presenting various types of gifts and making millions of circumambulations.54.

161.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਮੱਛ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥ ਸੰਖਾਸੁਰ ਬਧਹ ॥
161.e: End of the description of the first Machh (fish) Incarnation and Killing of Shankhasura in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Gauree, Third Mehl, Gwaarayree:
True is the Lord King, True is His Royal Command.
Those whose minds are attuned to the True,
Carefree Lord enter the True Mansion of His Presence, and merge in the True Name. ||1||
Listen, O my mind: contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

161.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ; ਭਵਜਲੁ. ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
161.e: Chant the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
In doubt he comes, and in doubt he goes.
This world is born out of the love of duality.
The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord; he continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

161.g: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਕਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
161.e: Does he himself go astray, or does God lead him astray?
This soul is enjoined to the service of someone else.

161.g: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
161.e: It earns only terrible pain, and this life is lost in vain. ||3||
Granting His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

161.g: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤੇ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
161.e: Remembering the One Name, doubt is cast out from within.

161.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ; ਨਾਉ. ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੩੧॥
161.e: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the nine treasures of the Name are obtained. ||4||11||31||

162.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
162.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

162.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
162.e: Through great good fortune and high destiny, one meets the True Guru.

162.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
162.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is constantly within the heart, and one enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
162.e: O mortal, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

162.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ; ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.e: Be victorious in the game of life, and earn the profit of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

162.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
162.e: Spiritual wisdom and meditation come to those unto whom the Word of the Guru's Shabad is sweet.

162.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
162.e: By Guru's Grace, a few have tasted, and seen it. ||2||

162.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ; ਬਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਚਾਰ ॥
162.e: They may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions,

162.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
162.e: but without the Name, the egotistical ones are cursed and doomed. ||3||

162.g: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ; ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ॥
162.e: They are bound and gagged, and hung by Maya's noose;

162.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੩੪॥
162.e: O servant Nanak, they shall be released only by Guru's Grace. ||4||14||34||

162.g: ਮਧੁ ਪਾਨ ਕਢ︁ਯੋ ਘਟ ਮਦਿਯ ਮਤੰ ॥
162.e: The bow and of purely white colour came out, and those intoxicated ones brought out from the ocean a pitcher of honey.

162.g: ਗਜ ਬਾਜ ਸੁਧਾ ਲਛਮੀ ਨਿਕਸੀ ॥
ਘਨ ਮੋ ਮਨੋ ਬਿੰਦੁਲਤਾ ਬਿਗਸੀ ॥੩॥
162.e: The elephant, horse, nectar and Lakshmi came out and looked splendid like the flash of lightning from the clouds.3.

162.g: ਕਲਪਾਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਮਾਹੁਰ ਅਉ ਰੰਭਾ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਮੋਹ ਰਹੈ ਲਖ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਭਾ ॥
162.e: After Kalapdrum (Elysian, wish-fulfilling tree) and poison, the heavenly damsel Rambha came out, seeing whom, the people of Indrs’s court allured.

162.g: ਮਨ ਕੌਸਤਭ ਚੰਦ ਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਸੁਭੰ ॥
ਜਿਹੱ ਭੱਜਤ ਦੈਤ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਜੁਧੰ ॥੪॥
162.e: The Kaustubh jewel and the moon also came out, which are remembered by the demons in the battlefield.4.

162.g: ਨਿਕਸੀ ਗਵਰਾਜ ਸੁ ਧੇਨ ਭਲੀ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਛੀਨ ਲ︁ਯੋ ਸਹ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਲੀ ॥
162.e: Kamadhenu (the wish-fulfilling cow) also came out which was seized by the mighty Sahasrajun.

162.g: ਗਨ ਰਤਨ, ਗਨਉ ਉਪ ਰਤਨ ਅਬੈ ॥
ਤੁਮ ਸੰਤ, ਸੁਨੋ, ਚਿਤ ਲਾਇ ਸਬੈ ॥੫॥
162.e: After reckoning the jewels, now I mention the minor jewels, O saints  listen to me attentively.5.

162.g: ਗਨ ਜੋਕ ਹਰੀਤਕੀ ਓਰ ਮਧੰ ॥
ਜਨ ਪੰਚ ਸੁ ਨਾਮ︁ਯ ਸੰਖ ਸੁਭੰ ॥
162.e: These minor jewels are leech, myrobalan, honey, conch ( panchjanay), ruta, hemp, discus and mace

162.g: ਸਸ ਬੇਲ ਬਿਜਿਯਾ ਅਰ ਚੱਕ੍ਰ ਗਦਾ ॥
ਜੁਵਰਾਜ ਬਿਰਾਜਤ ਪਾਨ ਸਦਾ ॥੬॥
162.e: The later two look impressive in the hands of princes always.6.

162.g: ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਨੰਦਗ ਖੱਗ ਭਣੰ ॥
ਜਿਨ ਖੰਡਿ ਕਰੇ ਗਨ ਦਈਤ ਰਣੰ ॥
162.e: The bow and arrow, the bull Nandi and the dagger (which had destroyed the demons) came out of the ocean.

162.g: ਸਿਵ ਸੂਲ ਬੜਵਾਨਲ ਕਪਲ ਮੁਨੰ ॥
ਤ ਧਨੰਤਰ ਚਉਦਸਵੋ ਰਤਨੰ ॥੭॥
162.e: The trident of Shiva, Barvanal (the fire), Kapil Muni and Dhanwantri came out as the fourteenth jewel.7.

162.g: ਗਨ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਰਤਨ ਔ ਧਾਤ ਗਨੋ ॥
ਕਹਿ ਧਾਤ ਸਬੈ ਉਪਧਾਤ ਭਨੋ ॥
162.e: After counting the greater and minor jewels, now I count the metals and afterwards I shall count the lesser metals.

162.g: ਸਬ ਨਾਮ ਜਥਾ ਮਤ ਸ︁ਯਾਮ ਧਰੋ ॥
162.e: All these names have been reckoned by the poet Shyam according to his own understanding

162.g: ਘਟ ਜਾਨ ਕਵੀ ਜਿਨ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੋ ॥੮॥
162.e: Considering them in small number, poets requested not to slander me.8.

162.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੋ ਗਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਿਕਾ ਸ੍ਵਰਨੰ ॥
ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
162.e: Third Mehl, Gauree Bairaagan:

162.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਊਪਰਿਮੇਘੁਲਾ. ਬਰਸਤੁ ਹੈ; ਕਿਆ; ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ. ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
162.e: The clouds pour their rain down upon the earth, but isn't there water within the earth as well?

162.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ. ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗਾ. ਵਰਸਤ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
162.e: Water is contained within the earth; without feet, the clouds run around and let down their rain. ||1||

162.g: ਬਾਬਾ; ਤੂੰ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਹੀ ॥
162.e: O Baba, get rid of your doubts like this.

162.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ, ਸੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ; ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.e: As you act, so shall you become, and so you shall go and mingle. ||1||Pause||

162.g: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਕਿਆ ਓਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
162.e: As woman or man, what can anyone do?

162.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ. ਸਦਾ ਹਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ; ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
162.e: The many and various forms are always Yours, O Lord; they shall merge again into You. ||2||

162.g: ਇਤਨੇ ਜਨਮ. ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇ; ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
162.e: In countless incarnations, I went astray. Now that I have found You, I shall no longer wander.

162.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ. ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
162.e: It is His work; those who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad come to know it well. ||3||

162.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਤੂੰਹੈ ਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ; ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਹੀ ॥
162.e: The Shabad is Yours; You are Yourself. Where is there any doubt?

162.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ. ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਪੁਨਰਪਿ. ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੩੫॥
162.e: O Nanak, one whose essence is merged with the Lord's essence does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again. ||4||1||15||35||

162.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
162.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

162.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ. ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਬਾਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
162.e: The whole world is under the power of Death, bound by the love of duality.

162.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
162.e: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego; they receive their just rewards. ||1||

162.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
162.e: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ; ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.e: As Gurmukh, you shall be awarded the treasure of the Naam. In the Court of the Lord, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

162.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ; ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
162.e: Through 8.4 million incarnations, people wander lost; in stubborn-mindedness, they come and go.

162.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨਿਓ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
162.e: They do not realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad; they are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
162.e: The Gurmukh understands his own self. The Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

162.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
162.e: Imbued with devotion to the Lord's Name, night and day, he merges in peace. ||3||

162.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
162.e: When one's mind dies in the Shabad, one radiates faith and confidence, shedding egotism and corruption.

162.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੬॥
162.e: O servant Nanak, through the karma of good actions, the treasure of devotional worship and the Name of the Lord are attained. ||4||2||16||36||

162.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੩੩॥
162.e: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are detached, in the perfect balance of Nirvaanaa. ||4||13||33||

162.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
162.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

162.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
162.e: The Lord, Har, Har, has ordained that the soul is to stay in her parents' home for only a few short days.

162.g: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
162.e: Glorious is that soul-bride, who as Gurmukh, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

162.g: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ. ਗੁਣ ਸੰਮਲੈ; ਸਾਹੁਰੈ. ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
162.e: She who cultivates virtue in her parents' home, shall obtain a home at her in-laws.

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
162.e: The Gurmukhs are intuitively absorbed into the Lord. The Lord is pleasing to their minds. ||1||

162.g: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ; ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
162.e: Our Husband Lord dwells in this world, and in the world beyond. Tell me, how can He be found?

162.g: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.e: The Immaculate Lord Himself is unseen. He unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||

163.g: ਅਥ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
163.e: Here begins the description of the incarnations named Nar and Narayan:

163.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
163.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

163.g: ਨਰੰ ਅਉਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੰ ਰੂਪ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਭਯੋ ਸਾਮੁਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਸੰਭਾਰੀ ॥
163.e: Manifesting himself as Nar and Narayan, Vishnu, managing his weapons and arms, came in front of the demon-forces.

163.g: ਭਟੰ ਐਠਿ ਫੈਂਟੇ ਭੁਜੰ ਠੋਕਿ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
163.e: The warriors tied their garments tightly and the kings beat their arms

163.g: ਬਜੇ ਸੂਲ ਸੇਲੰ ਭਏ ਆਪ ਰੂਪੰ ॥੧੫॥
163.e: It, that war, the tridents and the spears began to collide with each other.15.

163.g: ਪਰਿਯੋ ਆਪ ਮੋ ਲੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਧਰਿਯੋ ਐਸ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆਵਤਾਰੰ ॥
163.e: In great anger. The blows of the steel-arms began to rain and at this juncture Vishnu manifested his third incarnation.

163.g: ਨਰੰ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੰ ਦੁਐ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
ਦਿਪੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਉਦਰ ਜੁ ਧਾਰੇ ਅਨੂਪੰ ॥੧੬॥
163.e: Nar and Narayan both had similar forms and their effulgence assumed unparalleled Lustre.16.

163.g: ਉਠੈ ਟੂਕ ਕੋਪੰ ਗੁਰਜੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
ਜੁਟੇ ਜੰਗ ਕੋ ਜੰਗ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਝਾਰੇ ॥
163.e: Wearing their helmets the warriors are striking their blows with maces and the mighty heroes are engrossed in the war.

163.g: ਉਡੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੂਰੰ ਛੁਹੀ ਐਨ ਗੈਨੰ ॥
ਡਿਗੇ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਦੈਤ ਕੰਪਿਯੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਨੈਨੰ ॥੧੭॥
163.e: The dust hath both the gods and demons, having gone astray, were falling and even the three-eyed god Shiva trembled.17.

163.e: The brave fighters, being chopped into bits, began to fall and it appeared that the wrestlers are lying intoxicated after drinking hemp.18.

163.g: ਦਿਸਾ ਮਉ ਨ ਆਈ ਅਨੀ ਦੈਤ ਰਾਜੰ ॥

163.e: More forces of demons came from another direction, seeing which the gods, leaving all their paraphernalia, ran away.

163.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਸੰਜ ਪੁੰਜ ਸਿਰੰ ਬਾਹੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
ਸੁਭੈ ਬਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਚੇਤਿ ਪੁਹਪੰ ਕਰੀਰੰ ॥੧੯॥
163.e: The limbs began to fall in great numbers and the arrows looked auspicious in the manner of the flowers of capparis in the month of the Chaitra.19.

163.g: ਉਪਧਾਤ ਕਥਨੰ ॥

ਚਤੁਰਥ ਤਿਹ ਸਿੰਬਲਖਾਰ ਭਣੰ ॥
163.e: Now I describe the minor metals  they are : antimony, cinnabar, yellow orpiment, bombax,

ਭਨਿ ਅਸਟਮ ਲੋਣ ਰਸੰ ਲਵਣੰ ॥੧੦॥
163.e: Potash, conchshell, mica, artemesia and calomel.10.

163.g: ਚਤੁਰਥ ਭਨ ਧਾਤ ਸਿਤੰ ਰੁਕਮੰ ॥
163.e: First of tall I reckon iron, lead and gold alongwith the fourth white metal silver

ਕਥਿ ਅਸਟਮ ਜਿਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਧਾਤ ਧਰੰ ॥੯॥
163.e: Then mentioning copper, tin and brass, I consider the eighth metal as zinc, which is found within the earth.9.

163.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
163.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

163.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
163.e: From the True Guru, I obtained spiritual wisdom; I contemplate the Lord's essence.

163.g: ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
163.e: My polluted intellect was enlightened by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

163.g: ਸਿਵਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਈਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
163.e: The distinction between Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter - has been destroyed, and the darkness has been dispelled.

163.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
163.e: The Lord's Name is loved by those, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny was written. ||1||

163.g: ਹਰਿ. ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ, ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
163.e: How can the Lord be obtained, O Saints? Seeing Him, my life is sustained.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਤੀ; ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
163.e: Without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. Unite me with the Guru, so that I may drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

163.g: ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ. ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
163.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and I listen to them daily; the Lord, Har, Har, has emancipated me.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
163.e: I have obtained the Lord's essence from the Guru; my mind and body are drenched with it.

163.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ. ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
163.e: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the True Being, who has blessed me with devotional worship of the Lord.

163.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ. ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੨॥
163.e: From the Guru, I have obtained the Lord; I have made Him my Guru. ||2||

163.g: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ; ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
163.e: The Sovereign Lord is the Giver of virtue. I am worthless and without virtue.

163.g: ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਡੂਬਦੇ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
163.e: The sinners sink like stones; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord carries us across.

163.g: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
163.e: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord; I am worthless and without virtue.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ; ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
163.e: I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save me, as You have saved the idiots and fools. ||3||

163.g: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
163.e: Eternal celestial bliss comes through the Guru's Teachings, by meditating continually on the Lord, Har, Har.

163.g: ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
163.e: I have obtained the Lord God as my Best Friend, within the home of my own self. I sing the Songs of Joy.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ॥
163.e: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God, that I may meditate on Your Name, Har, Har.

163.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ; ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੩੮॥
163.e: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those who have found the True Guru. ||4||4||18||38||

163.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
163.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

163.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
163.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

163.e: the Yogi cries out, "Gorakh, Gorakh".

163.g: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
163.e: But I am just a fool - I just chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

163.g: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ; ਕਿਆ ਗਤਿ. ਰਾਮ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
163.e: I do not know what my condition shall be, Lord.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ. ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
163.e: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Name of the Lord. You shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

163.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
163.e: CHAUPAI

163.e: As the major and minor jewels, the major and minor metals came out

163.e: They were taken away by Vishnu and distributed the remaining things amongst all.12.

163.e: And taking the trident, the cow named Pinak and Poison in his hands, gave them to Shva.13.

163.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
163.e: DOHRA

163.e: These metals, minor metals have been described by me according to my own understanding.

163.e: He, who desires to have them, can get them.11.

163.e: God Himself bestows wisdom; meditate on the Name of the Lord.

163.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
163.e: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, who places the Ambrosial Nectar in the mouth.

163.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
163.e: When egotism and duality are eradicated, one intuitively merges in peace.

163.g: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
163.e: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself links us to His Name. ||2||

163.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਅਗਿਆਨ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
163.e: The self-willed manmukhs, in their arrogant pride, do not find God; they are so ignorant and foolish!

163.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ. ਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
163.e: They do not serve the True Guru, and in the end, they regret and repent, over and over again.
