163.e: They are cast into the womb to be reincarnated, and within the womb, they rot.

163.e: As it pleases my Creator Lord, the self-willed manmukhs wander around lost. ||3||

163.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ; ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
163.e: My Lord God inscribed the full pre-ordained destiny upon the forehead.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
163.e: When one meets the Great and Courageous Guru, one meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

163.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
163.e: The Lord's Name is my mother and father; the Lord is my relative and brother.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੩੭॥
163.e: O Lord, Har, Har, please forgive me and unite me with Yourself. Servant Nanak is a lowly worm. ||4||3||17||37||

163.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
163.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

The mother loves to see her son eat.
The fish loves to bathe in the water.
The True Guru loves to place food in the mouth of His GurSikh. ||1||

164.g: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
164.e: If only I could meet those humble servants of the Lord, O my Beloved.

164.g: ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
164.e: Meeting with them, my sorrows depart. ||1||Pause||

164.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਛਰੇ; ਗਊ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
164.e: As the cow shows her love to her strayed calf when she finds it,

164.g: ਕਾਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
164.e: and as the bride shows her love for her husband when he returns home,

164.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
164.e: so does the Lord's humble servant love to sing the Praises of the Lord. ||2||
The rainbird loves the rainwater, falling in torrents;
the king loves to see his wealth on display.
The humble servant of the Lord loves to meditate on the Formless Lord. ||3||

164.g: ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
164.e: The mortal man loves to accumulate wealth and property.
The GurSikh loves to meet and embrace the Guru.

164.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੧॥
164.e: Servant Nanak loves to kiss the feet of the Holy. ||4||3||41||

164.g: ਬਟੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਰਬੰ ਗਈ ਛੂਟ ਰਾਰੰ ॥
ਧਰਿਯੋ ਐਸ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਪੰਚਮ ਵਤਾਰੰ ॥੮॥
164.e: All the jewels were distributed and the dispute ended  in this way, the fifth incarnation of the Vishnu became apparent.8.

164.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਮਹਾਮੋਹਨੀ ਪੰਚਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੫॥
164.e: End of the description of the fifth incarnation MAHA MOHNI in BACHITTAR NATAK.5.
Now begins the description of the Boar Incarnation:
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

164.g: ਗਏ ਠਾਮ ਠਾਮੰ ਸਬੈ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
164.e: In this way, the god Vishnu distributed the honey and ambrosia  and all gods and demons went away to their places.

164.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਸੁ ਆਪੰ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥

164.e: Again the enmity grew between both of them and the war was waged  in which the gods fled and could not withstand the demons.1.
Hiranayaksha and Hiranayakashipu, both the demon brothers,

164.g: ਸਬੈ ਲੋਗ ਕੈ ਜੀਤ ਲੀਨੇ ਗਹੀਰੰ ॥
164.e: Conquered the tresures of the worlds
The Sannyaasee smears his body with ashes;
renouncing other men's women, he practices celibacy.
I am just a fool, Lord; I place my hopes in You! ||2||
The Kh'shaatriya acts bravely, and is recognized as a warrior.
The Shoodra and the Vaisha work and slave for others;
I am just a fool - I am saved by the Lord's Name. ||3||

164.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
164.e: The entire Universe is Yours; You Yourself permeate and pervade it.
O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with glorious greatness.
I am blind - I have taken the Lord as my Support. ||4||1||39||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:
The beggar loves to receive charity from the wealthy landlord.
The hungry person loves to eat food.
The GurSikh loves to find satisfaction by meeting the Guru. ||1||

164.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
164.e: O Lord, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I place my hopes in You, Lord.

164.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
164.e: Shower me with Your Mercy, and fulfill my longing. ||1||Pause||
The song-bird loves the sun shining in her face.
Meeting her Beloved, all her pains are left behind.
The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||2||
The calf loves to suck its mother's milk;
its heart blossoms forth upon seeing its mother.
The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||3||

164.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
164.e: All other loves and emotional attachment to Maya are false.
They shall pass away, like false and transitory decorations.

164.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੨॥
164.e: Servant Nanak is fulfilled, through the Love of the True Guru. ||4||4||42||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

164.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ; ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥
164.e: The Speech of the Lord is the most sublime speech, free of any attributes.

164.g: ਭਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ; ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
164.e: Vibrate on it, meditate on it, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

164.g: ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
164.e: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, listening to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||1||
O Lord of the Universe, unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

164.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ; ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
164.e: My tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord, singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

164.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
164.e: Those humble beings who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

164.g: ਤਿਨ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ; ਰਾਮਾ ॥
164.e: please make me the slave of their slaves, Lord.
Serving Your slaves is the ultimate good deed. ||2||

164.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
164.e: One who chants the Speech of the Lord

164.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
164.e: that humble servant is pleasing to my conscious mind.
Those who are blessed with great good fortune obtain the dust of the feet of the humble. ||3||

164.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
164.e: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny

164.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
164.e: Are in love with the humble Saints.
Those humble beings, O Nanak, are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||40||
Now begins the description of Maha Mohini Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
Vishnu transformed himself into form of Maha Mohini

164.g: ਰਹੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੈ ਦਿਤਿ ਆਦਿਤਿਯਾ ਕੁਮਾਰੰ ॥
164.e: Seeing which both and the demons were allured.

164.g: ਛਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜੋਗੰ ਰਹੇ ਰੀਝ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
164.e: All of them wanted to please her and thought of sharing her love

164.g: ਤਜੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਦੀਯੋ ਛੋਰ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੧॥
164.e: And all abandoned their weapons and also their prride.1.

164.g: ਫੰਧੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਫਾਧੰ ਭਯੋ ਕੋਪ ਹੀਣੰ ॥
164.e: All of them, having been entrapped in her noose of love, forsook their anger,

164.g: ਲਗੈ ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨੰ ਧਯੋ ਪਾਨਿ ਪੀਣੰ ॥
164.e: And rushed towards her in order to relish the wantonness of her eyes and the sweetness of her words

164.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਝੂੰਮਿ ਭੂਮੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੰ ॥
164.e: All of them, while swinging, fell on the earth as though they were lifeless

164.g: ਸਭੈ ਚੇਤ ਹੀਣੰ ਲਗੇ ਜਾਨ ਬਾਣੰ ॥੨॥
164.e: All become without consciousness as though they were hit by the arrows.2.

164.g: ਛੁਟੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਭੈ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬੰ ॥
164.e: Seeing all of the without consciousness, the weapons and arms were discharged by the gods

164.g: ਭਯੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜੋਗੰ ਲਗੇ ਨੈਨ ਐਸੇ ॥
164.e: The demons began to die and felt that they were considered worthy of love for Mohini.
They appeared like the lion entrapped in a snare.3.

164.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਰਤਨ ਬਾਟੇ ਤੁਮਊ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਾਨੋ ॥
ਕਥਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਤੇ ਬਾਤ ਥੋਰੀ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
164.e: You know the story of thee distribution of the jewels

164.g: ਸਬੈ ਪਾਤਿ ਪਾਤੰ ਬਹਿਠੈ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
164.e: Therefore for fear of the increase in narration, I relate it only in brief

164.g: ਕਟੰ ਪੇਚ ਛੋਰੇ ਤਜੇ ਤੇਗ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੪॥
164.e: All the warriors, loosening the waist-garments and forsaking the sword, sat in a line.4.

165.g: ਜਲੰ ਬਾ ਥਲੇਯੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
165.e: They ruled over all the places in water and on land

165.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੨॥
165.e: And seeing their own great physical strength, their pride knew no bounds.2.

165.g: ਚਹੈ ਜੁਧ ਮੋ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਆਨਿ ਕੋਊ ॥
165.e: They wanted that some brave warriors may come forward to fight with them

165.g: ਬਲੀ ਹੋਏ ਵਾ ਸੋ ਭਿਰੇ ਆਨਿ ਸੋਊ ॥
165.e: But only he could march against them, who could be greatly stronger than them.

165.g: ਚੜਿਯੋ ਮੇਰ ਸ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਗੰ ਗੁਸਟ ਸੰਗੰ ॥
165.e: They climbed to the top of the Sumeru mountain and with the blows of their maces,

165.g: ਹਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਭੂਮੰ ਕੀਏ ਸਰਬ ਭੰਗੰ ॥੩॥
165.e: They took away the Vedas and the earth forcibly and caused the destruction of all natural principles.3.

165.g: ਧਸੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੇਦੰ ਰਹੀ ਹੁਐ ਪਤਾਰੰ ॥
165.e: They earth went deep into the nether-world

165.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਤਉ ਦਾੜ ਗਾੜਾਵਤਾਰੰ ॥
165.e: Then Vishnu manifested himself in the form of a Boar of terrible and cruel teeth.

165.g: ਧਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਨੀਰ ਮਧੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਊਚ ਨਾਦੰ ॥
165.e: He penetrated into water and raised a thunderous shout,

165.g: ਰਹੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੂਰੰ ਧੁਨੰ ਨਿਰਬਖਾਦੰ ॥੪॥
165.e: Which spread equally throughout the universe.4.

165.g: ਬਜੇ ਡਾਕ ਡਉਰੂ ਦੋਊ ਬੀਰ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
165.e: Hearing this terrible shout and the resounding of the trumpets, both the brave demons awakened

165.g: ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਦਿ ਬੰਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਭੀਰ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
165.e: Listening to their thundering voice, the cowards ran away

165.g: ਝਮੀ ਤੇਗ ਤੇਜੰ ਸਰੋਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰ ॥
165.e: The war began and the clattering of the glistening swords and the sound of the furious blows was heard

165.g: ਖਿਵੀ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਾਦੋ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥੫॥
165.e: The luster of the swords looked like the flash of lightning in the month of Bhadon.5.

165.g: ਮੁਖੰ ਮੁਛ ਬੰਕੀ ਬਕੈ ਸੂਰ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
ਤੜੰਕਾਰ ਤੇਗੰ ਸੜੰਕਾਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥
165.e: The warriors of winsome whiskers are shouting and the sounds of the blows of the swords and arrows are being heard

165.g: ਧਮਕਾਰ ਸਾਗੰ ਖੜਕਾਰ ਖਗੰ ॥
ਟੁਟੇ ਟੂਕ ਟੋਪੰ ਉਠੇ ਨਾਲ ਅਗੰ ॥੬॥
165.e: With the knocking and falling and the sparks are coming out from them.6.

165.g: ਉਠੇ ਨਦ ਨਾਦੰ ਢਮਕਾਰ ਢੋਲੰ ॥
ਢਲੰਕਾਰ ਢਾਲੰ ਮੁਖੰ ਮਾਰ ਬੋਲੰ ॥
165.e: With the resounding of trumpets and knocking sound on the shields, the utterance of “kill kill” coming from the mouth is being heard

165.g: ਖਹੇ ਖਗ ਖੂਨੀ ਖੁਲੇ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
ਨਚੇ ਕੰਧਿ ਹੀਣੰ ਕਮਧੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਚੇਤੰ ॥੭॥
165.e: The bloody daggers of the warriors have come out in the battlefield and the headless trunks are dancing in an unconscious state.7.

165.g: ਭਰੇ ਜੋਗਣੀ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਚਉਸਠ ਚਾਰੀ ॥
ਨਚੀ ਖੋਲਿ ਸੀਸੰ ਬਕੀ ਬਿਕਰਾਰੀ ॥
165.e: The sixty-four female evil spirit (Yoginis) have filled their bowls with blood

165.g: ਹਸੈ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲੰ ॥
ਬਜੇ ਡਾਕ ਡਉਰੂ ਕਰੂਰੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ॥੮॥
165.e: And loosening their matted hair, they are raising their terrible sound, the most awful ghosts and fiends are laughing and the shrieking sound of the hideous vampires is being heard.8.

165.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰਤ ਮੁਸਟੰ ਕਰੈ ਪਾਵ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਸਿੰਘ ਸਿੰਘੰ ਡਹੇ ਗਜ ਮਾਤੰ ॥
165.e: The warriors are giving the blows of their fists and feet in this way as if the thundering lions have furiously attacked one another

165.g: ਛੁਟੀ ਈਸ ਤਾੜੀ ਡਗਿਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
165.e: Hearing the terrible sound of the war, the attention of gods Shiva and Brahma hath distracted

165.g: ਭਜ︀ਯੋ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਕਾਪ ਭਾਨੰ ਮਧ︀ਯਾਨੰ ॥੯॥
165.e: The moon also trembled and the noonday sun also fled in fear.9.

165.g: ਜਲੇ ਬਾ ਥਲੇਯੰ ਥਲੰ ਤਥ ਨੀਰੰ ॥
ਕਿਧੋ ਸੰਧਿਯੰ ਬਾਣ ਰਘੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
165.e: There was water everywhere upward and downward and in this atmosphere Vishnu took aim of his arrows on his targets

165.g: ਕਰੈ ਦੈਤ ਆਘਾਤ ਮੁਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਚੋਟ ਬਾਹੈ ਘਰਿਯਾਰੀ ਘਰਿਯਾਰੰ ॥੧੦॥
165.e: The demons were collectively giving terrible blows of their fists in the way, like a crocodile aiming his blows on another crocodile.10.

165.g: ਬਜੇ ਡੰਗ ਬੰਕੇ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੂਰੰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਗਜ ਜੁਟੇ ਦੰਤਾਰੇ ਦੰਤਾਰੇ ॥
165.e: The trumpets resounded and the mighty and terrible warriors fought with each other in this way, as if the elephants with long tusks are fighting with each other.

165.g: ਢਮੰਕਾਰ ਢੋਲੰ ਰਣੰਕੇ ਨਫੀਰੰ ॥
ਸੜਕਾਰ ਸਾਗੰ ਤੜਕਾਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੧੧॥
165.e: The sound of the drums and horns was being heard and there was also the clattering of the daggers and the crackling of the arrows.11.

165.g: ਦਿਨੰ ਅਸਟ ਜੁਧੰ ਭਯੋ ਅਸਟ ਰੈਣੰ ॥
ਡਗੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਰਬੰ ਉਠਿਯੋ ਕਾਪ ਗੈਣੰ ॥
165.e: The war was waged for eight days and eight nights, in which the earth and the sky trembled.

165.g: ਰਣੰ ਰੰਗ ਰਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਰੰਗ ਭੂਮੰ ॥
ਹਣ︀ਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਝੂਮੰ ॥੧੨॥
165.e: All the warriors appeared absorbed in warfare in the battle-field, and Vishnu caused the death and fall of the enemy.12.

165.g: ਧਰੇ ਦਾੜ ਅਗ੍ਰੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਤਬੰ ॥
ਹਠੀ ਦੁਸਟਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਭਜੇ ਦੈਤ ਸਬੰ ॥
165.e: Then he placed all the four Vedas on the protruding part of his teeth and caused the death and fall of the persistent inimical demons

165.g: ਦਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਆਗਿਆ ਧੁਨੰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀਯੰ ॥
ਸਬੈ ਸੰਤਨੰ ਤਾਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਯੰ ॥੧੩॥
165.e: Vishnu commanded Brahma and he created the Dhanur-veda for the happiness of all the saints.13.

165.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਖਸਟਮੰ ਬਿਸਨ ਐਸਾਵਤਾਰੰ ॥
165.e: In this way, the sixth partial incarnation of the Visnu manifested himself,

165.g: ਸਬੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਜਿਤੈ ਕੀਯੋ ਬੇਦ ਉਧਾਰੰ ॥
165.e: Who destroyed the enemies and protected the Vedas

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

165.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਬਣੀ ॥
165.e: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding;

165.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ, ਹਰਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
165.e: meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Lord Master.

165.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਘਣੀ ॥੧॥
165.e: So many are emancipated along with those who meditate on the Lord. ||1||

165.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ; ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ. ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
165.e: O GurSikhs, chant the Name of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤ; ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
165.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, all sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

165.g: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਤਬ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
165.e: When one meets the Guru, then the mind becomes centered.

165.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਪੰਚ ਰਹੇ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
165.e: The five passions, running wild, are brought to rest by meditating on the Lord.

165.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਗਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
165.e: Night and day, within the body-village, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||2||

165.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ; ਜਿਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
165.e: Those who apply the dust of the Feet of the True Guru to their faces,

165.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੂੜ ਤਿਆਗੇ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
165.e: renounce falsehood and enshrine love for the Lord.

165.g: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
165.e: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

165.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
165.e: Service to the Guru is pleasing to the Lord Himself.

165.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
165.e: Even Krishna and Balbhadar meditated on the Lord, falling at the Guru's Feet.

165.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੩॥
165.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself saves the Gurmukhs. ||4||5||43||

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

165.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ. ਗਰਭੁ ਪਾਲਤੀ; ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
165.e: The mother nourishes the fetus in the womb, hoping for a son,

165.g: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਦੇਇ; ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
165.e: who will grow and earn and give her money to enjoy herself.

165.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ, ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਦਾ; ਦੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਥਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
165.e: In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Lord, who extends His Helping Hand to us. ||1||

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਡੰਡਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Yogi, who wields the staff of authority.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
165.e: The Lord Himself practices tapa - intense self-disciplined meditation;

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ. ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ; ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
165.e: He is deeply absorbed in His primal trance. ||1||

165.g: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ; ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
165.e: Such is my Lord, who is all-pervading everywhere.

165.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ; ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
165.e: He dwells near at hand - the Lord is not far away. ||1||Pause||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ; ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Word of the Shabad. He Himself is the awareness, attuned to its music.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ; ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
165.e: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself blossoms forth.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇ; ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
165.e: The Lord Himself chants, and the Lord Himself inspires others to chant. ||2||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਧਾਰਾ ॥
165.e: He Himself is the rainbird, and the Ambrosial Nectar raining down.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
165.e: The Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ; ਆਪੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Doer; He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੇੜੀ; ਤੁਲਹਾ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Boat, the Raft and the Boatman.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
165.e: The Lord Himself, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੪॥
165.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself carries us across to the other side. ||4||6||44||

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

165.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ; ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਹਿ. ਤੈਸੀ ਹਮ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
165.e: O Master, You are my Banker. I receive only that capital which You give me.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ; ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
165.e: I would purchase the Lord's Name with love, if You Yourself, in Your Mercy, would sell it to me. ||1||

165.g: ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ, ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
165.e: I am the merchant, the peddler of the Lord.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ; ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
165.e: I trade in the merchandise and capital of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

165.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
165.e: I have earned the profit, the wealth of devotional worship of the Lord. I have become pleasing to the Mind of the Lord, the True Banker.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ. ਹਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ; ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ. ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
165.e: I chant and meditate on the Lord, loading the merchandise of the Lord's Name. The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even approach me. ||2||

165.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ; ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
165.e: Those traders who trade in other merchandise, are caught up in the endless waves of the pain of Maya.

165.g: ਓਇ ਜੇਹੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ; ਫਲੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
165.e: According to the business in which the Lord has placed them, so are the rewards they obtain. ||3||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ. ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
165.e: People trade in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, when the God shows His Mercy and bestows it.

165.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੪੫॥
165.e: Servant Nanak serves the Lord, the Banker; he shall never again be called to render his account. ||4||1||7||45||

166.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
166.e: TOTAK STANZA

166.g: ਇਕਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਗਯੋ ਚਟਸਾਰਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ॥
ਥਟਿਯੋ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜੰ ਜਿਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
166.e: There was the victory of Dharma (righteousness) and the gods collectively were Victorious,

166.g: ਉਤਾਰਿਯੋ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤ ਸੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੧੪॥
166.e: And they caused to remove the pride of all in a right way.14.

166.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬੈਰਾਹ ਖਸਟਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬॥
166.e: End of the description of the sixth BOAR INCARNATION in BACHITTAR NATAK.6.

166.g: ਅਥ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
166.e: Now begins the description of Narsingh Incarnation:

166.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
166.e: Let Shri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.

166.g: ਪਾਧਰੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
166.e: PADHRI STANZA

166.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕੀਯੋ ਦਿਵਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ ॥
ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਸੁਭ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਜ ॥
166.e: In this way, Indra, the king of gods ruled and filled the granaries of materials through all modes

166.g: ਜਬ ਦੇਵਤਾਨ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਗਰੂਰ ॥
ਬਲਵੰਤ ਦੈਤ ਉਠੇ ਕਰੂਰ ॥੧॥
166.e: When the pride of the gods grew enormously, then in order toshelve their pride, the hard-hearted mighty demons rose again.1.

166.g: ਲਿਨੋ ਛਿਨਾਇ ਦਿਵਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ ॥
ਬਾਜਿਤ੍ਰ ਨੇਕ ਉਠੇ ਸੁ ਬਾਜਿ ॥
166.e: The kingdom of Indra was seized and this proclamation was made on all sides with the accompaniment of many musical instruments,

166.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
ਜਲੰ ਬਾ ਥਲੇਅੰ ਹਿਰਿਨਾਛ ਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
166.e: That Hiranayakashipu is the emperor at all the places.2.

166.g: ਇਕ ਦ︀ਯੋਸ ਗਯੋ ਨਿਜ ਨਾਰਿ ਤੀਰ ॥
ਸਜਿ ਸੁਧ ਸਾਜ ਨਿਜ ਅੰਗਿ ਬੀਰ ॥
166.e: One day, this mighty ruler, bedecking himself, went to his wife,

166.g: ਕਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਮੋ ਭਯੋ ਨਿਰੁਕਤ ॥
ਤਬ ਭਯੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਕੋ ਬੀਰਜ ਮੁਕਤ ॥੩॥
166.e: And absorbed himself with her so intensely that at the time of his intercourse, his semen was discharged.3.

166.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਭਗਤ ਲੀਨੋ ਵਤਾਰ ॥
ਸਬ ਕਰਨਿ ਕਾਜ ਸੰਤਨ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
166.e: From that semen Prahlad was born in order to help nad protect the saints.

166.g: ਚਟਸਾਰ ਪੜਨਿ ਸਉਪ︀ਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
ਪਟੀਯਹਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੈ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੪॥
166.e: When the king sent him to school for education, he asked his teacher to write the Name of Lord-God on his tablet.4.

166.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
166.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

166.g: ਨਿਤ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ. ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੇ; ਭਰਮੈ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
166.e: Continuously, day and night, they are gripped by greed and deluded by doubt.

166.g: ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਵੇਗਾਰੀਆ; ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ॥
166.e: The slaves labor in slavery, carrying the loads upon their heads.

166.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ. ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ. ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
166.e: That humble being who serves the Guru is put to work by the Lord in His Home. ||1||

166.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ. ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ; ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
166.e: O my Lord, please break these bonds of Maya, and put me to work in Your Home.

166.g: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
166.e: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

166.g: ਨਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰੇ; ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ. ਅਰਥਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
166.e: Mortal men work for kings, all for the sake of wealth and Maya.

166.g: ਕੈ ਬੰਧੈ. ਕੈ ਡਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ; ਕੈ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
166.e: But the king either imprisons them, or fines them, or else dies himself.

166.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ. ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
166.e: Blessed, rewarding and fruitful is the service of the True Guru; through it, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I have found peace. ||2||

166.g: ਨਿਤ ਸਉਦਾ ਸੂਦੁ ਕੀਚੈ. ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
166.e: Everyday, people carry on their business, with all sorts of devices to earn interest, for the sake of Maya.

166.g: ਜਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਦੇਇ. ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੇ; ਤੋਟੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
166.e: If they earn a profit, they are pleased, but their hearts are broken by losses.

166.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ. ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੇ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
166.e: One who is worthy, becomes a partner with the Guru, and finds a lasting peace forever. ||3||

166.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ. ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
166.e: O my Lord, I am so foolish; save me, O my Lord God!

166.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ; ਤੁਝਹਿ ਵਡਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
166.e: Your servant's praise is Your Own Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

166.g: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
166.e: Those whose minds are pleased by the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, are joyful in the palaces of their own homes.

166.g: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗਹਿ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
166.e: Their mouths savor all the sweet delicacies when they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

166.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲੀ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
166.e: The Lord's humble servants are the saviors of their families; they save their families for twenty-one generations - they save the entire world! ||2||

166.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ. ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
166.e: Whatever has been done, has been done by the Lord; it is the Glorious Greatness of the Lord.

166.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ. ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
166.e: O Lord, in Your creatures, You are pervading; You inspire them to worship You.

166.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
166.e: The Lord leads us to the treasure of devotional worship; He Himself bestows it. ||3||

166.g: ਲਾਲਾ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ; ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
166.e: I am a slave, purchased in Your market; what clever tricks do I have?

166.g: ਜੇ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਹਾਲੇ. ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ; ਘਾਸੀ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
166.e: If the Lord were to set me upon a throne, I would still be His slave. If I were a grass-cutter, I would still chant the Lord's Name.

166.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥੪੬॥
166.e: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; contemplate the Glorious Greatness of the Lord||4||2||8||46||

166.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
166.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

166.g: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਕਰੇ; ਲੋਚੈ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ॥
166.e: The farmers love to work their farms;

166.g: ਹਲੁ ਜੋਤੈ. ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਧੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
166.e: they plow and work the fields, so that their sons and daughters may eat.

166.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ; ਹਰਿ. ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
166.e: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and in the end, the Lord shall save them. ||1||

166.g: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ; ਕੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
166.e: I am foolish - save me, O my Lord!

166.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਮ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
166.e: O Lord, enjoin me to work and serve the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

166.g: ਲੈ ਤੁਰੇ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ; ਸਉਦਾਗਰੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
166.e: The traders buy horses, planning to trade them.

166.g: ਧਨੁ ਖਟੈ. ਆਸਾ ਕਰੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
166.e: They hope to earn wealth; their attachment to Maya increases.

166.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
166.e: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; chanting the Lord's Name, they find peace. ||2||

166.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ. ਹਟਵਾਣੀਆ; ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
166.e: The shop-keepers collect poison, sitting in their shops, carrying on their business.

166.g: ਮੋਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਝੂਠ ਕਾ; ਝੂਠੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
166.e: Their love is false, their displays are false, and they are engrossed in falsehood.

166.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
166.e: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; they take the Lord's Name as their supplies. ||3||

166.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ; ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਫਾਸ ॥
166.e: This emotional attachment to Maya and family, and the love of duality, is a noose around the neck.

166.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਰੈ; ਜੋ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
166.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, the humble servants are carried across; they become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

166.g: ਜਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥੪੭॥
166.e: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam; the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||4||3||9||47||

167.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਚੌਕ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਸੁਭਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਤੰ ॥
167.e: One day the king went to the school and seeing his son, he was startled.

167.g: ਜੋ ਪੜਿਯੋ ਦਿਜ ਤੇ ਸੁਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਰੜੋ ॥
ਨਿਰਭੈ ਸਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪੜੋ ॥੫॥
167.e: When the king asked, the child told whatever he had learnt and fearlessly began to read the Name of Lord-God.5.

167.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਰਿਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਅਸੁਰੰ ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ, ਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ, ਭਜੋ ਦੁਸਰੰ ॥
167.e: On hearing the Name of Lord-God, the demon became furious and said, “Who else is there except me on whom you are meditating?”

167.g: ਜੀਯ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਰੋ ਸਿਸੁ ਯਾਹਿ ਹਨੋ ॥
ਜੜ ਕਿਉ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੋ ॥੬॥
167.e: He decided to kill this student and said, “O fool  why are you repeating the name of Lord-God?”6.

167.g: ਜਲ ਅਉਰ ਥਲੰ ਇਕ ਬੀਰ ਮਨੰ ॥
ਇਹ ਕਾਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਨੰ ॥
167.e: “Only Hiranayakashipu is considered the mithty-one in water and on land , then why are you repeating the name of Lord-God”?

167.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਬਾਧਤ ਥੰਮ ਭਏ ॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਦਾਨਵ ਬੈਨ ਧਏ ॥੭॥
167.e: Then, as commanded by the king, the demons tied him with the column.7.

167.g: ਗਹਿ ਮੂੜ ਚਲੇ ਸਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਨ ਕੋ ॥
ਨਿਕਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਬ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਉਬਾਰਨ ਕੋ ॥
167.e: When those foolish persons advanced to kill this student, the Lord manifested Himself at the same time in order to protect His disciple.

167.g: ਚਕਚਉਧ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬੈ ॥
ਨਿਕਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਹਰਿ ਫਾਰਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਜਬੈ ॥੮॥
167.e: Al those who saw the Lord at that time were astonished, the Lord had manifested Himself by tearing off the doors.8

167.g: ਲਖਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਿਵਾਰ ਸਬੈ ਥਹਰੇ ॥
ਅਵਿਲੋਕਿ ਚਰਾਚਰ ਹੂੰਹਿ ਹਿਰੇ ॥
167.e: Seeing Him, all the gods and demons trembled and all the animate and inanimate objects became fearful in their bearts

167.g: ਗਰਜੇ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਨਰਾਤ ਕਰੰ ॥
ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਰਤ ਕੀਏ ਮੁਖ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਭਰੰ ॥੯॥
167.e: The Lord in the form of Narsingh (man-lion), with red eyes and the mouth filled with blood, thundered dreadfully.9.

167.g: ਲਖਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਭਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ॥
ਗਰਜਿਯੋ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਰਣੰ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
167.e: Seeing this and hearing the thunder of Narsingh all the demons fled

167.g: ਇਕ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਠਾਢਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਰਣ ਮੈ ॥
ਗਹਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਗਦਾ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਮਨ ਮੈ ॥੧੦॥
167.e: Only the Emperor, fearlessly holding his mace in his hand, stood firmly in that battlefield.10.

167.g: ਲਰਜੇ ਸਬ ਸੂਰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ਗਰਜੇ ॥
ਸਮੁਹਾਤ ਭਏ ਭਟ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੇ ॥
167.e: When the Emperor roared loudly, then all the brave warriors trembled and all those warriors came forward in groups before that lion.

167.g: ਜੁ ਗਏ ਸਮੁਹੇ ਛਿਤ ਤੈ ਪਟਕੇ ॥
ਰਣਿ ਭੈ ਰਣਧੀਰ ਬਟਾ ਨਟ ਕੇ ॥੧੧॥
167.e: All those who went in front of Narsingh, He caught hold of all those warriors like a juggler and knocked them down of the ground.11.

167.g: ਬਬਕੇ ਰਣਧੀਰ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ਘਣੇ ॥
ਰਹਿਗੇ ਮਨੋ ਕਿੰਸਕ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਸਣੇ ॥
167.e: The warriors shouted loudly at one another and saturated with blood began to fall.

167.g: ਉਮਗੇ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰਨ ਤੇ ਰਿਪੁ ਯੌ ॥
ਬਰਸਾਤਿ ਬਹਾਰਨ ਅਭ੍ਰਨ ਜਿਯੋ ॥੧੨॥
167.e: The enemies advanced from all the four sides with such intensity like the clouds in the rainy season.12.

167.g: ਬਰਖੈ ਸਰ ਸੁਧ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤਿਯੰ ॥
ਉਮਡੇ ਬਰਬੀਰ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸਿਯੰ ॥
167.e: Advancing from all the ten directions, the warriors began to shower the arrows and stones

167.g: ਚਮਕੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਸੁ ਬਾਣ ਜੁਧੰ ॥
ਫਹਰੰਤ ਧੁਜਾ ਜਨੁ ਬੀਰ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੰ ॥੧੩॥
167.e: The swords and arrows glistened in the war-field and the brave fighters began to flutter their flags.13.

167.g: ਹਹਰੰਤ ਹਠੀ ਬਰਖੰਤ ਸਰੰ ॥
167.e: The persistent warriors with loud shouts are showering a volley of arrows in this way,

167.g: ਜਨੁ ਸਾਵਨ ਮੇਘ ਬੁਠਿਯੋ ਦੁਸਰੰ ॥
167.e: As if it is the second cloudburst in the mont of Swan

167.g: ਫਰਹੰਤ ਧੁਜਾ ਹਹਰੰਤ ਹਯੰ ॥
167.e: The flags are fluttering and the horses are neighing

167.g: ਉਪਜਿਯੋ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨਵ ਰਾਇ ਭਯੰ ॥੧੪॥
167.e: And seeing all this scene, the heart of the demon-king was filled with fear.14.

167.g: ਹਿਹਨਾਤ ਹਯੰ ਗਰਜੰਤ ਗਜੰ ॥
167.e: The horses are neighing and the elephants are roaring

167.g: ਭਟ ਬਾਹ ਕਟੀ ਜਨੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧੁਜੰ ॥
167.e: The chopped long arms of the warriors look like the flag of Indra

167.g: ਤਰਫੰਤ ਭਟੰ ਗਰਜੰ ਗਜੰ ॥
167.e: The warriors are writhing and the elephants are roaring in such a way,

167.g: ਸੁਨ ਕੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਵਣ ਮੇਘ ਲਜੰ ॥੧੫॥
167.e: That the clouds of the month of Sawan are feeling shy.15.

167.g: ਬਿਚਲ੍ਰਯੋ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈਕੁ ਫਿਰਿਯੋ ਪੁਨਿ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
167.e: As soon as the horse of Hiranayakashipu turned a little, he himself deviated and retraced two steps

167.g: ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਛ ਲਗੇ ਅਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਤ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
167.e: But still he was infuriated in the manner of the snake who gets infuriated when its tail is crushed by a foot

167.g: ਰਣਰੰਗ ਸਮੈ ਮੁਖ ਯੋ ਚਮਕ︀ਯੋ ॥
167.e: His face was shining in the battlefield,

167.g: ਲਖਿ ਸੂਰ ਸਰੋਰਹੁ ਸੋ ਦਮਕ੍ਰਯੋ ॥੧੬॥
167.e: Like the blossoming of the lotus on seeing the sun.16.

167.g: ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਤੁਰੰਗਨ ਐਸ ਭਯੋ ॥
ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
167.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

167.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਤ; ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ. ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
167.e: Within my conscious mind is the constant longing for the Lord. How can I behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Lord?

167.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਤਾ; ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
167.e: One who loves the Lord knows this; the Lord is very dear to my conscious mind.

167.g: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਿਆ. ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
167.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has re-united me with my Creator Lord; I was separated from Him for such a long time! ||1||

167.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ. ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ; ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
167.e: O my Lord, I am a sinner; I have come to Your Sanctuary, and fallen at Your Door, Lord.

167.g: ਮਤੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ. ਹਮ ਮੇਲੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ; ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
167.e: My intellect is worthless; I am filthy and polluted. Please shower me with Your Mercy sometime. ||1||Pause||

167.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹੈ; ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ, ਹਰਿ. ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
167.e: My demerits are so many and numerous. I have sinned so many times, over and over again. O Lord, they cannot be counted.

167.g: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
167.e: You, Lord, are the Merciful Treasure of Virtue. When it pleases You, Lord, You forgive me.

167.g: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ. ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤੀ; ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੀਓ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
167.e: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. He has bestowed the Teachings of the Lord's Name, which saves me. ||2||

167.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ; ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹ. ਤਬ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
167.e: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O my True Guru? When the Guru speaks, I am transfixed with wonder.

167.g: ਹਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ. ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ; ਜੈਸੇ ਹਮ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
167.e: Can anyone else save a sinner like me? The True Guru has protected and saved me.

167.g: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਤਾ. ਤੂੰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਤਾ; ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੰਧਪੁ. ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
167.e: O Guru, You are my father. O Guru, You are my mother. O Guru, You are my relative, companion and friend. ||3||

167.g: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ; ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ. ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
167.e: My condition, O my True Guru - that condition, O Lord, is known only to You.

167.g: ਹਮ ਰੁਲਤੇ ਫਿਰਤੇ. ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛਤਾ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ. ਕੀਰੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
167.e: I was rolling around in the dirt, and no one cared for me at all. In the Company of the Guru, the True Guru, I, the worm, have been raised up and exalted.

167.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਨ ਕੇਰਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਚੂਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥੪੯॥
167.e: Blessed, blessed is the Guru of servant Nanak; meeting Him, all my sorrows and troubles have come to an end. ||4||5||11||49||

167.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
167.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

167.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਹਿ. ਜੀਉ ਲੁਭਤੁ ਹੈ; ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
167.e: The soul of the man is lured by gold and women; emotional attachment to Maya is so sweet to him.

167.g: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਘੋੜੇ ਖੁਸੀ; ਮਨੁ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
167.e: The mind has become attached to the pleasures of houses, palaces, horses and other enjoyments.

167.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
167.e: The Lord God does not even enter his thoughts; how can he be saved, O my Lord King? ||1||

167.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ; ਇਹ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
167.e: O my Lord, these are my lowly actions, O my Lord.

167.g: ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਬਖਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
167.e: O Lord, Har, Har, Treasure of Virtue, Merciful Lord: please bless me with Your Grace and forgive me for all my mistakes. ||1||Pause||

167.g: ਕਿਛੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਹੀ, ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਿਛੁ ਢੰਗੁ. ਨ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
167.e: I have no beauty, no social status, no manners.

167.g: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ. ਬੋਲਹ, ਗੁਣ ਬਿਹੂਨ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਨ. ਤੇਰਾ ॥
167.e: With what face am I to speak? I have no virtue at all; I have not chanted Your Name.

167.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ. ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਬਰੇ; ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
167.e: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. This is the generous blessing of the True Guru. ||2||

167.g: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ. ਮੁਖੁ ਨਕੁ ਦੀਆ; ਵਰਤਣ ਕਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
167.e: He gave all beings souls, bodies, mouths, noses and water to drink.

167.g: ਅੰਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ. ਕਪੜੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਦੀਆ; ਰਸ ਅਨਿ ਭੋਗਾਣੀ ॥
167.e: He gave them corn to eat, clothes to wear, and other pleasures to enjoy.

167.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ. ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਪਸੂ. ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
167.e: But they do not remember the One who gave them all this. The animals think that they made themselves! ||3||

167.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
167.e: You made them all; You are all-pervading. You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

167.g: ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ. ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹ; ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
167.e: What can these wretched creatures do? This whole drama is Yours, O Lord and Master.

167.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਮ ਗੁਲਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨॥੫੦॥
167.e: Servant Nanak was purchased in the slave-market. He is the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||4||6||12||50||

167.g: ਜਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ. ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਹੈ; ਤਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ. ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
167.e: The more one feels hunger for other tastes and pleasures, the more this hunger persists.

167.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਵੇਚੇ ਸਿਰੁ. ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ॥
167.e: Those unto whom the Lord Himself shows mercy, sell their head to the Guru.

167.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੮॥
167.e: Servant Nanak is satisfied by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. He shall never feel hungry again. ||4||4||10||48||

168.e: CHAUPAI
DODHAK STANZA

168.g: ਬਾਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਸੁ ਬਾਣ ਭਟ ਗਣ ॥
ਅੰਤਿ ਗਿਰੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਣਿ ॥
168.e: After striking their swords and arrows, the brave fighters ultimately fell down during that great war.
The wounded warriors are swinging like the blossomed spring at the end of the month of Phagun.23.
Somewhere the chopped arms of the warriors appear like the trunks of the elephants
The brave fighters appear beautiful like the flowers blooming in the garden.24.
The enemies were dyed with blood like many types of blooming flowers.
After having been wounded with swords the brave soldiers were roaming like the manifestation of anger itself.25.
The horses are moving in so much intoxication and creating noise that the attention of Shiva was dissolved, And it seemed that the universe had been displaced

168.g: ਸਰ ਸੇਲ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤ ਐਸ ਬਹੇ ॥
ਨਭ ਅਉਰ ਧਰਾ ਦੋਊ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧੭॥
168.e: The arrows, daggers and stones were flying and filling both the earth and the sky.17.
The Ganas and Gandharvas, seeing both, were pleased and the gods showered flowers.

168.g: ਮਿਲ ਗੇ ਭਟ ਆਪ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੋਊ ਯੋ ॥

168.e: Two warriors were fighting with each other like the children competing with one another in their play during the night.18.
TOMAR STANZA
Millions of horses are neighing and the warriors are showering arrows
The bows have slipped and fallen from the hands and in this way the terrible and unique war is being waged.21.
Many types of warriors and innumerable horsemen are fighting with one another
They are striking their swords without any suspicion and in this way, a unique war is going on.22.
BELI BINDRAM STANZA
The warriors are thundering in the war and seeing them both the gods and demons are feeling shy
The brave fighters, who have been wounded, are roaming and it appears that the smoke is flying upwards.19.
The brave fighters of many types are fighting bravely with one another.
The lances and arrows are being hurled and the horses of the warriors are advancing hesitantly.20.
Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

168.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
168.e: Meeting Him, the mind is filled with bliss. He is called the True Guru.

168.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ. ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ; ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
168.e: Double-mindedness departs, and the supreme status of the Lord is obtained. ||1||

168.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
168.e: How can I meet my Beloved True Guru?

168.g: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ; ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ. ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
168.e: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him. How will I meet my Perfect Guru? ||1||Pause||

168.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ; ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
168.e: Granting His Grace, the Lord has led me to meet my Perfect True Guru.

168.g: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀਆ; ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
168.e: The desire of His humble servant has been fulfilled. I have received the dust of the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

168.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ. ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਣੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
168.e: Those who meet the True Guru implant devotional worship to the Lord, and listen to this devotional worship of the Lord.

168.g: ਤੋਟਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
168.e: They never suffer any loss; they continually earn the profit of the Lord. ||3||

168.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
168.e: One whose heart blossoms forth, is not in love with duality.

168.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਧਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪॥੫੨॥
168.e: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, one is saved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||8||14||52||
Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

168.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਜਣਿ ਪਾਲਤੀ; ਰਾਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
168.e: Just as the mother, having given birth to a son, feeds him and keeps him in her vision

168.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੋਚਾਰਿ ॥
168.e: - indoors and outdoors, she puts food in his mouth; each and every moment, she caresses him.

168.g: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਖਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
168.e: In just the same way, the True Guru protects His GurSikhs, who love their Beloved Lord. ||1||

168.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ. ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹੈ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
168.e: O my Lord, we are just the ignorant children of our Lord God.

168.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ. ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਧਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ. ਕੀਏ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
168.e: Hail, hail, to the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Teacher who has made me wise through the Lord's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

168.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਗਗਨਿ ਫਿਰੰਤੀ ਊਡਤੀ; ਕਪਰੇ ਬਾਗੇ ਵਾਲੀ ॥
168.e: The white flamingo circles through the sky,

168.g: ਓਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤੁ. ਪੀਛੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਬਚਰੇ; ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
168.e: but she keeps her young ones in her mind; she has left them behind, but she constantly remembers them in her heart.

168.g: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ. ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰਖੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
168.e: In just the same way, the True Guru loves His Sikhs. The Lord cherishes His GurSikhs, and keeps them clasped to His Heart. ||2||

168.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਤੀ. ਤੀਸ ਬਤੀਸ ਹੈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਸਨਾ. ਮਾਸ ਰਤੁ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
168.e: Just as the tongue, made of flesh and blood, is protected within the scissors of the thirty-two teeth

168.g: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ. ਮਾਸ ਕਾਤੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ. ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
168.e: who thinks that the power lies in the flesh or the scissors? Everything is in the Power of the Lord.

168.g: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ, ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੈਜ. ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
168.e: In just the same way, when someone slanders the Saint, the Lord preserves the honor of His servant. ||3||

168.g: ਭਾਈ. ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ, ਕਿਸੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
168.e: O Siblings of Destiny, let none think that they have any power. All act as the Lord causes them to act.

168.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ, ਸਿਰਤਿ ਸਾਪੁ; ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਕੋਈ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ, ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
168.e: Old age, death, fever, poisons and snakes - everything is in the Hands of the Lord. Nothing can touch anyone without the Lord's Order.

168.g: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ. ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ. ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥੫੧॥
168.e: Within your conscious mind, O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, who shall deliver you in the end. ||4||7||13||51||
TOTAK STANZA
Many enemies fell down fighting and Narsingh, the incarnation of Vishnu also received many wounds.
The chopped bits of the warriors were flowing in the stream of blood like the bubbles of foam.26.

168.g: ਸੁਆਮਿ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ॥
168.e: The fighting soldiers, having been cut into bits, fell down, but none of them put to disrepute the dignity of their master.
Showing the blows of the swords and arrows, the warriors fled away ultimately in great fear.27.
Fourth Mehl, Gauree Poorbee:

168.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ॥
168.e: The Merciful Lord God showered me with His Mercy; with mind and body and mouth, I chant the Lord's Name.

168.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
168.e: As Gurmukh, I have been dyed in the deep and lasting color of the Lord's Love. The robe of my body is drenched with His Love. ||1||

168.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ; ਹਉ ਗੋਲੀ ॥
168.e: I am the maid-servant of my Lord God.

168.g: ਜਬ ਹਮ. ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਲ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
168.e: When my mind surrendered to the Lord, He made all the world my slave. ||1||Pause||

168.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ. ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ; ਖੋਜਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੀ ॥
168.e: Consider this well, O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny - search your own hearts, seek and find Him there.

168.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ, ਹਰਿ ਕੋਲੀ ॥੨॥
168.e: The Beauty and the Light of the Lord, Har, Har, is present in all. In all places, the Lord dwells near by, close at hand. ||2||

169.g: ਤ︀ਯਾਗਿ ਚਲੈ ਰਣ ਕੋ ਸਬ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
ਲਾਜ ਬਿਸਰ ਗਈ ਭਏ ਅਧੀਰਾ ॥
169.e: All the warriors, abandoning their shyness and getting impatient left the battlefield and ran away.

169.g: ਹਿਰਿਨਾਛਸ ਤਬ ਆਪੁ ਰਿਸਾਨਾ ॥
ਬਾਧਿ ਚਲ︀ਯੋ ਰਣ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਨਾ ॥੨੮॥
169.e: Seeing this, Hirnayakashipu himself in great ire, moved forward for waging war.28.

169.g: ਭਰਿਯੋ ਰੋਸ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮੁਹੇ ਰਣਿ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
169.e: Seeing the Emperor coming towards him, Narsingh also got infuriated.

169.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਰੋਸ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸੇਵਕਹਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਰਿਸਾਨਾ ॥੨੯॥
169.e: He did not care for his wounds, because he was in extreme agony of seeing the suffering on his devotees.29.

169.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
169.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

169.g: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ; ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਾਨੇ ॥
169.e: You are Merciful, the Destroyer of all pain. Please give me Your Ear and listen to my prayer.

169.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ. ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
169.e: Please unite me with the True Guru, my breath of life; through Him, O my Lord and Master, You are known. ||1||

169.g: ਰਾਮ; ਹਮ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
169.e: O Lord, I acknowledge the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.

169.g: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ. ਅਸੁਧ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
169.e: I am foolish and ignorant, and my intellect is impure. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I come to know You. ||1||Pause||

169.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ. ਹਮ ਦੇਖੇ; ਸਭ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਫੀਕ ਫੀਕਾਨੇ ॥
169.e: All the pleasures and enjoyments which I have seen - I have found them all to be bland and insipid.

169.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
169.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

169.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
169.e: Life of the World, Infinite Lord and Master, Master of the Universe, All-powerful Architect of Destiny.

169.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ. ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
169.e: Whichever way You turn me, O my Lord and Master, that is the way I shall go. ||1||

169.g: ਰਾਮ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
169.e: O Lord, my mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

169.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
169.e: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
169.e: The Lord, Har, Har, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the panacea, the medicine for the world. The Lord, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, bring peace and tranquility.

169.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
169.e: Those who partake of the Lord's sublime essence, through the Guru's Teachings - their sins and sufferings are all eliminated. ||2||

169.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ. ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਤੇ. ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
169.e: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads, bathe in the pool of contentment of the Guru.

169.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਗਈ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ; ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
169.e: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, from those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Name. ||3||

169.g: ਰਾਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ. ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਤੁਮ ਜੇਵਡ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
169.e: O Lord, You Yourself are Your Own Master, O God. There is no other Giver as Great as You.

169.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੫੪॥
169.e: Servant Nanak lives by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; by the Lord's Mercy, he chants the Lord's Name. ||4||2||16||54||

169.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
169.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

169.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
169.e: Show Mercy to me, O Life of the World, O Great Giver, so that my mind may merge with the Lord.

169.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ. ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਚੇ ॥੧॥
169.e: The True Guru has bestowed His most pure and sacred Teachings. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, my mind is transfixed and enraptured. ||1||

169.g: ਰਾਮ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ; ਬੇਧਿ ਲੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
169.e: O Lord, my mind and body have been pierced through by the True Lord.

169.g: ਜਿਹ ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ, ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ, ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
169.e: The whole world is caught and held in the mouth of Death. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

169.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ; ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਰ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
169.e: Those who are not in love with the Lord are foolish and false - they are faithless cynics.

169.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ; ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਪਾਚੇ ॥੨॥
169.e: They suffer the most extreme agonies of birth and death; they die over and over again, and they rot away in manure. ||2||

169.g: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਚੇ ॥
169.e: You are the Merciful Cherisher of those who seek Your Sanctuary. I beg of You: please grant me Your gift, Lord.

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ. ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕੀਜੈ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
169.e: Make me the slave of the Lord's slaves, so that my mind might dance in Your Love. ||3||

169.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ॥
169.e: He Himself is the Great Banker; God is our Lord and Master. I am His petty merchant.

169.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਸਿ, ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੫੫॥
169.e: My mind, body and soul are all Your capital assets. You, O God, are the True Banker of servant Nanak. ||4||3||17||55||

169.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
169.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

169.g: ਕੰਪਾਈ ਸਟਾ ਸਿੰਘ ਗਰਜ︀ਯੋ ਕ੍ਰੂਰੰ ॥
ਉਡ︀ਯੋ ਹੇਰਿ ਬੀਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਨੂਰੰ ॥
169.e: Giving a jeck to his neck, Narsingh raised a terrible thunder and listening to his thunder, the faces of the heroes turned pale.

169.g: ਉਠ︀ਯੋ ਨਾਦ ਬੰਕੇ ਛੁਹੀ ਗੈਣਿ ਰਜੰ ॥
ਹਸੇ ਦੇਵ ਸਰਬੰ ਭਏ ਦੈਤ ਲਜੰ ॥੩੦॥
169.e: Because of that dreadful sound, the earth trembled and its dust touched the sky. All the gods began to smile and the heads of the demons bowed down with shame.30.

169.g: ਮਚ︀ਯੰ ਦੁੰਦ ਜੁਧੰ ਮਚੇ ਦੁਇ ਜੁਆਣੰ ॥
ਤੜੰਕਾਰ ਤੇਗੰ ਕੜਕੇ ਕਮਾਣੰ ॥
169.e: The dreadful war of both the heroic fighters got ablazed, and the clattering sound of the sword and the cracking sound of the bows was heard.

169.g: ਭਿਰਿਯੋ ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਦਾਨਵੰ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੰ ॥
ਹੜੰ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਚਲੇ ਮਧੰ ਮੁਲਤਾਣੰ ॥੩੧॥
169.e: The demon-king fought in great fury and there was a flood of blood in the battlefield.31.

169.g: ਕੜਕਾਰ ਤੇਗੰ ਤੜਕਾਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥
ਭਏ ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕੰ ਰਣੰ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ॥
169.e: With the clattering of swords and the crackling noise of the arrows, the mighty and the enduring heroes were chopped into bits

169.g: ਬਜੇ ਸੰਖ ਭੂਰੰ ਸੁ ਢੋਲੰ ਢਮੰਕੇ ॥
ਰੜੰ ਕੰਕ ਬੰਕੇ ਡਹੈ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਕੇ ॥੩੨॥
169.e: The conches, clarionets and drums resounded and the wanton soldiers, riding on the sharp horses stood firmly in the battlefield.32.

169.g: ਭਜੇ ਬਾਜਿ ਗਾਜੀ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
ਰਹੇ ਠਾਢਿ ਭੂਪਾਲ ਆਗੇ ਨ ਏਕੰ ॥
169.e: Many a warrior riding on the horses and elephants fled away and none of the chiefs could stand against Narsingh.

169.g: ਫਿਰਿਯੋ ਸਿੰਘ ਸੂਰੰ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੂਰੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ, ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੈ; ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੋਲੀ ॥
169.e: The Lord, Har, Har, dwells close by, all over the world. He is Infinite, All-powerful and Immeasurable.

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਓ, ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਓ. ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
169.e: The Perfect Guru has revealed the Lord, Har, Har, to me. I have sold my head to the Guru. ||3||

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ, ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ; ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੋਲੀ ॥
169.e: O Dear Lord, inside and outside, I am in the protection of Your Sanctuary; You are the Greatest of the Great, All-powerful Lord.

169.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਵੇਚੋਲੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੫੩॥
169.e: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, meeting the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary. ||4||1||15||53||

170.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਗਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
170.e: I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by meeting the True Guru. It is sweet, like the juice of the sugarcane. ||2||

170.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
170.e: Those who have not met the Guru, the True Guru, are foolish and insane - they are faithless cynics.

170.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਨ. ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਏ; ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ. ਮੋਹਿ ਪਚਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
170.e: Those who were pre-ordained to have no good karma at all - gazing into the lamp of emotional attachment, they are burnt, like moths in a flame. ||3||

170.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਨੇ ॥
170.e: Those whom You, in Your Mercy, have met, Lord, are committed to Your Service.

170.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ; ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੬॥
170.e: Servant Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. He is famous, and through the Guru's Teachings, He merges in the Name. ||4||4||18||56||

170.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
170.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

170.g: ਹਲਾ ਚਾਲ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਰ ਬੀਰ ਢੂਕੇ ॥
ਮਚਿਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਜਿਯੋ ਕਰਨ ਸੰਗੰ ਘੜੂਕੇ ॥
170.e: After challenging each other, both the heroes began to fight again, and a dreadful war ensued between them for gaining victory over the other.

170.g: ਨਖੰ ਪਾਤ ਦੋਊ ਕਰੇ ਦੈਤ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਗਜ ਜੁਟੇ ਬਨੰ ਮਸਤਿ ਮਾਤੰ ॥੩੮॥
170.e: Both of them were giving destructive blows to one another with their nails and appeared like two intoxicated elephants fighting each other in the forest.38.

170.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਨਰਸਿੰਘੰ ਧਰਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
ਪੁਰਾਨੋ ਪਲਾਸੀ ਮਨੋ ਬਾਇ ਡਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
170.e: Narsingh again threw Hiranayakashipu on the earth just as the old Palas tree (Butea frondosa) falls down on the earth with a gust of wind.

170.g: ਹਨ︀ਯੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਸਟੰ ਭਈ ਪੁਹਪ ਬਰਖੰ ॥
ਕੀਏ ਦੇਵਤਿਯੋ ਆਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਤ ਕਰਖੰ ॥੩੯॥
170.e: Seeing that tyrants hath died, sang many types of songs of victory.39.

170.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
170.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

170.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ; ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
170.e: My breath of life is in Your Power, God; my soul and body are totally Yours.

170.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
170.e: Be merciful to me, and show me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. There is such a great longing within my mind and body! ||1||

170.g: ਰਾਮ. ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ; ਮਿਲਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
170.e: O my Lord, there is such a great longing within my mind and body to meet the Lord.

170.g: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ. ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
170.e: When the Guru, the Merciful Guru, showed just a little mercy to me, my Lord God came and met me. ||1||Pause||

170.g: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ. ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
170.e: Whatever is in my conscious mind, O Lord and Master - that condition of mine is known only to You, Lord.

170.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ; ਨਿਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
170.e: Night and day, I chant Your Name, and I find peace. I live by placing my hopes in You, Lord. ||2||

170.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ. ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
170.e: The Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, has shown me the Way; my Lord God came and met me.

170.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਸਭ ਆਸ ਪੁਜੀ. ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
170.e: Night and day, I am filled with bliss; by great good fortune, all of the hopes of His humble servant have been fulfilled. ||3||

170.g: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਕਰਤੇ; ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
170.e: O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe, everything is under Your control.

170.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੦॥੫੮॥
170.e: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please, preserve the honor of Your humble servant. ||4||6||20||58||

170.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
170.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

170.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ. ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ. ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ; ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਹਾਢੇ ॥
170.e: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions.

170.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
170.e: CHAUPAI

170.g: ਮੁਸਟ ਜੁਧ ਜੁਟੇ ਭਟ ਦੋਊ ॥
ਤੀਸਰ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਪੇਖੀਅਤ ਕੋਊ ॥
170.e: The war with fists of both the warriors began and none other except those two could be seen in the battlefield.

170.g: ਭਏ ਦੁਹੁਨ ਕੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨੈਣਾ ॥
ਦੇਖਤ ਦੇਵ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਗੈਣਾ ॥੩੫॥
170.e: The eyes of both had become red and all the groups of gods were seeing this performance form the sky.35.

170.g: ਅਸਟ ਦਿਵਸ ਅਸਟੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਜੁਧਾ ॥
ਕੀਨੋ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਭਟਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਾ ॥
170.e: For eight days and eight nights both these brave heroes, furiously, waged the dreadful war.

170.g: ਬਹੁਰੋ ਅਸੁਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੁ ਮੁਰਝਾਨਾ ॥
ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਭੂਮਿ ਜਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥੩੬॥
170.e: After this, the demon-king felt weakness and fell down on the earth like an old tree.36.

170.g: ਸੀਚਿ ਬਾਰਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਗਾਯੋ ॥
ਜਗੋ ਮੂਰਛਨਾ ਪੁਨਿ ਜੀਯ ਆਯੋ ॥
170.e: Narsingh sprinkled ambrosia and woke him up from the unconscious state and he become alert after coming out of the state of unconsciousness.

170.g: ਬਹੁਰੋ ਭਿਰੇ ਸੂਰ ਦੋਈ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਾ ॥
ਮੰਡਿਯੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਆਪ ਮਹਿ ਜੁਧਾ ॥੩੭॥
170.e: Both the heroes began to fight again furiously and a dreadful war began again.37.

170.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
170.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕਹੁ ਕਿਥੈ. ਹਰਿ ਪਹੁ ਨਸੀਐ ॥
170.e: O my mind, God is always with you; He is your Lord and Master. Tell me, where could you run to get away from the Lord?

170.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥
170.e: The True Lord God Himself grants forgiveness; we are emancipated only when the Lord Himself emancipates us. ||1||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ. ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
170.e: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har - chant it in your mind.

170.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ. ਭਜਿ ਪਉ. ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ. ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
170.e: Quickly now, run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my mind; following the Guru, the True Guru, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ. ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ. ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੀਐ ॥
170.e: O my mind, serve God, the Giver of all peace; serving Him, you shall come to dwell in your own home deep within.

170.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘਸੀਐ ॥੨॥
170.e: As Gurmukh, go and enter your own home; anoint yourself with the sandalwood oil of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ, ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ; ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ. ਮਨਿ ਹਸੀਐ ॥
170.e: O my mind, the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are exalted and sublime. Earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and let your mind be happy.

170.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ; ਤਾ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
170.e: If the Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy, bestows it, then we partake of the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ. ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ; ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ. ਜਮਿ ਘੁਟੀਐ ॥
170.e: O my mind, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and attached to duality, those faithless cynics are strangled by the Messenger of Death.

170.g: ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਚੋਰ. ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਮਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ॥੪॥
170.e: Such faithless cynics, who have forgotten the Naam, are thieves. O my mind, do not even go near them. ||4||

170.e: By killing them, all the tyrants were put to shame,

170.e: And that Imperceptible Lord-God merged again in His Own Self.

170.e: The poet, according to his own understanding, after reflection, hath uttered the above-mentioned saying,

170.e: That in this way, Vishnu manifested himself in his seventh incarnation.42.

170.e: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpfrul.

171.e: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.

171.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ; ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
171.e: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||

171.e: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.

171.e: “The manner in which only a spark of fire, falling down, grows immensely in stature

Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

171.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.e: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

171.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
171.e: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

171.g: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ; ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.e: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

171.g: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ; ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
171.e: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

171.g: ਸਾਕਤ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.e: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

171.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ. ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
171.e: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

171.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ; ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.e: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

171.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
171.e: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

171.g: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.e: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

171.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
171.e: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||
NARAAJ STANZA
He transformed himself ad a dwarf and after some reflection, he moved towards the court of the king Bali, where, on reaching, he stood firmly.4.
This Brahmin recited all the four Vedas, which the king listened to attentively.
The king Bali then called th Brahmin and got him seated respectfully on a seat of sandalwood.5.
The king quaffed the water, with which the feet of the Brahmin had been washed and offered charities.
Then he circumambulated around the Brahmin several times, after that the king offered millions of charities, but the Brahmin did not touch anything with his hand.6.
The Brahmin said that all those things were of no use to him and all the ostentations offered by the king were false.
He then asked him to give only two and a half steps of the earth  and accept the special eulogy.7.
Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

171.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ. ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
171.e: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.

171.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ; ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
171.e: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||

171.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

171.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ. ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
171.e: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||

171.g: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
171.e: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

171.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ; ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
171.e: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.

171.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ. ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ; ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
171.e: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

171.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
171.e: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.

171.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ; ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
171.e: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||

171.g: ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
171.e: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.

171.g: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥

ਫੁਨਿ ਇਹ ਸਮੋ ਸਭੋ ਛਲ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਭਿਛਕ ਐ ਹੈ ॥੧੩॥
172.e: “Because I shall not be able to get such a God-like beggar again.”13.

172.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਇਹੈ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥
ਮਨ ਮੋ ਧਰੀ ਨ ਕਿਸੂ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
172.e: The King decided this general notion in his mind, but perceptibly he did not divulge it to anyone.

172.g: ਭ੍ਰਿਤ ਤੇ ਮਾਗ ਕਮੰਡਲ ਏਸਾ ॥
ਲਗ︀ਯੋ ਦਾਨ ਤਿਹ ਦੇਨ ਨਰੇਸਾ ॥੧੪॥
172.e: He asked the medicant to give his pot, in order to enact such a base deed.14.

172.g: ਸੁਕ੍ਰ ਬਾਤ ਮਨ ਮੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀ ॥
ਭੇਦ ਨ ਲਹਤ ਭੂਪ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
172.e: Shukracharya understood the notion of the mind of the King, but the ignorant King could not comprehend it.

172.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਮਕਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਾਰ ਸਰੂਪਾ ॥
ਪੈਠਿਯੋ ਮਧ ਕਮੰਡਲ ਭੂਪਾ ॥੧੫॥
172.e: Shukracharya transformed himself into a small fish and seated himself in the mendicant’s pot.15.

172.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਰ ਪਾਨਿ ਸੁਰਾਹੀ ਲਈ ॥
ਦਾਨ ਸਮੈ ਦਿਜਬਰ ਕੀ ਭਈ ॥
172.e: The King took the mendicant’s pot in his hand and the time forgiving alms to the Brahmin arrived.

172.g: ਦਾਨ ਹੇਤ ਜਬ ਹਾਥ ਚਲਾਯੋ ॥
ਨਿਕਸ ਨੀਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਆਯੋ ॥੧੬॥
172.e: When the King in order to give alms took some water in his hand, no water came out of the pot.16.

172.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
172.e: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.

172.g: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ; ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ. ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
172.e: Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachings have dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||

172.g: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ. ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ. ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
172.e: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focused on the Lord.

172.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ; ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ. ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
172.e: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened; within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||

172.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ; ਤਿਨ. ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
172.e: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.

172.g: ਉਨ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ, ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ; ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
172.e: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||

172.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
172.e: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.

172.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ. ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
172.e: Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62||

172.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
172.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

172.g: ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ. ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
172.e: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, my selfishness and conceit have been abolished.

172.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
172.e: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

172.g: ਰਾਮ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
172.e: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

172.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
172.e: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way to find Him.

172.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
172.e: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||

172.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
172.e: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Him within my heart.

172.g: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
172.e: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru. ||3||

172.g: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ; ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
172.e: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.

172.g: ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
172.e: Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63||

172.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
172.e: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

172.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
172.e: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

172.g: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ. ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ. ਰਾਮਾ ॥
172.e: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.

172.g: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
172.e: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation.

172.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
172.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

172.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ. ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
172.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru's Teachings, the mind sings.

172.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
172.e: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||

172.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
172.e: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

172.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਮਨੁ. ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
172.e: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.

172.g: ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
172.e: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||

172.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ; ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
172.e: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

172.g: ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
172.e: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with the Lord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||

172.g: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ. ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
172.e: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.

172.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
172.e: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||26||64||

173.e: The water that oozed out from the eye of Shukracharya, the King took it in his hand.
Shukracharya did not allow the water to leak and in this way, tried to protect his master from destruction.19.
Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

173.g: ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ. ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ. ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: From within my mind, from within my mind, O my Lord of the Universe, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord, from within my mind.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: The Lord's Love is with me, but it cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru has led me to see the unseen.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ. ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: He has revealed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Lord of the Universe; all poverty and pain have departed.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
173.e: I have obtained the supreme status of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; by great good fortune, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||1||

173.g: ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ. ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠੜਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: With his eyes, O my Beloved, with his eyes, O my Lord of the Universe - has anyone ever seen the Lord God with his eyes?

173.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: My mind and body are sad and depressed, O my Lord of the Universe; without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is withering away.
DOHRA

173.g: ਜਹ ਸਾਧਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਪਰੈ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
173.e: Wherever the saints are in distress, the Non-temporal Lord comes there for help.

173.g: ਦੁਆਰਪਾਲ ਹੁਐ ਦਰਿ ਬਸੇ; ਭਗਤ ਹੇਤ ਹਰਿਰਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
173.e: The Lord, coming under the control of His devotee, became his gate-keeper.26.
Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

173.g: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ; ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰੀਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: Come, O sisters - let's make virtue our charms.

173.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ; ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: Let's join the Saints, and enjoy the pleasure of the Lord's Love.

173.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burns steadily in my mind.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ; ਢੁਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
173.e: The Lord, being pleased and moved by pity, has led me to meet Him. ||1||

173.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: My mind and body are filled with love for my Darling Lord.

173.g: ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਚੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: The True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, has united me with my Friend.

173.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਸੰਤਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: I offer my mind to the Guru, who has led me to meet my God.
I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||

173.g: ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ. ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਮਨਿ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: Dwell, O my Beloved, dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, show mercy to me and come to dwell within my mind.

173.g: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ. ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; I am transfixed with ecstasy, gazing upon the Perfect Guru.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day, their minds are blissful and happy.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਨਿਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ. ਮਨਿ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
173.e: By great good fortune, the Lord is found, O my Lord of the Universe; earning profit continually, the mind laughs with joy. ||3||

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: The Lord Himself creates, and the Lord Himself beholds; the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.

173.g: ਇਕਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਖਸ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਇਕਨਾ. ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: Some partake of the bounty of the Lord's favor, which never runs out, while others receive only a handful.

173.g: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ. ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ; ਇਕਨਾ. ਭਿਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: Some sit upon thrones as kings, and enjoy constant pleasures, while others must beg for charity.

173.g: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
173.e: The Word of the Shabad is pervading in everyone, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||4||2||28||66||
Now begins the description of Parashuram Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
CHAUPAI
Then a long period of time elapsed and the Kshatriyas conquered all the earth.

173.g: ਬਾਸਵ ਬਲਿ ਕਹੂੰ ਲੈਨ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੧॥
173.e: They considered themselves as the most high and their strength became unlimited.1.

173.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਸਵ ਪੈ ਗਏ ॥
173.e: Realising this all the gods were worried and went to Indra and said:
“All the demons have transformed themselves as Kshatriyas, O King! Now tell us your view about it.”2.
By great good fortune, you shall meet with the Lord. ||1||

173.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: I have met the Guru, the Yogi, the Primal Being; I am delighted with His Love.

173.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: The Guru is imbued with the Love of the Lord; He dwells forever in Nirvaanaa.
By great good fortune, I met the most accomplished and all-knowing Lord.

173.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥੨॥
173.e: My mind and body are drenched in the Love of the Lord. ||2||
Come, O Saints - let's meet together and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

173.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: In the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, let's earn the lasting profit of the Naam.

173.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: Let's serve the Saints, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.
By one's karma and pre-ordained destiny, they are met. ||3||

173.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: In the month of Saawan, the clouds of Ambrosial Nectar hang over the world.

173.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰੁ. ਕੁਹੁਕਿਅੜਾ; ਸਬਦੁ. ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
173.e: The peacock of the mind chirps, and receives the Word of the Shabad, in its mouth;

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.e: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord rains down, and the Sovereign Lord King is met.
Servant Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||1||27||65||
CHAUPAI
In this way, Vishnu, manifesting himself as the eighth incarnation, gratified all the saints.

173.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੰਤ, ਚਿਤ ਲਾਇ ਸੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨੭॥
173.e: Now I describe the ninth incarnation, which may please be listened to and understood correctly by all the saints..27.

173.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਸਟਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਲਿ ਛਲਨ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੮॥
173.e: End of the description of VAMAN, the eighth incarnation of Vishnu and the deception of the king BALI in BACHITTAR NATAK.8.
CHAUPAI
When the water (from the eye) oozed out on the hand of the King, he gave it as alms, notionally, on the hand of the Brahmin.
After this the dwarf expanded his body, which became so huge that it touched the heavens after penetrating through this world.20.
Seeing this, al the people were wonder-struck and visualizing such a huge form of Vishnu, the demons became unconscious.
The feet of Vishnu touched the nether-worlds and the head touched the heavens  all were non-plussed on seeing this.21.
With one step, he measured the nether-world and with the second step he measured the heavens.

173.g: ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਗਿਰੀ ਗੰਗ ਕੀ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
173.e: In this way, Vishnu touched the whole universe and the current of Ganges began to flow down from the whole universe.22.

173.g: ਮਨ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਬਚਨ ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੁਐ ਰਹਾ ॥
173.e: In this way, the king was also astonished and remained puzzled in mind, word and deeds.

173.g: ਸੁ ਕੁਛ ਭਯੋ ਜੋਊ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿ ਉਚਾਰਾ ॥

173.e: Whatever Shukracharya had said, the same had happened and he himself had seen all this with his own eyes on that day.23.

173.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
173.e: For the remaining half a step, the king Bali got measured his own body and earned approbation.

173.g: ਜਬ ਲਉ ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਕੋ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
ਤਬ ਲਉ ਚਲੀ ਕਥਾ ਜਗਿ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨੪॥
173.e: As long as there is water in the Ganges and Yamuna, till that time the story of his time the story of this enduring king will be narrated.24.
Vishnu was then pleased and manifesting himself said
“O king  I shall be a watchmen and servant at your gate myself

173.g: ਜਬ ਲਗ ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਕੋ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨੫॥
173.e: And as long as there will be water in the Ganges and Yamuna, the story of your charity will be narrate.25.

174.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
174.e: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

174.g: ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ. ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: Playful is my Lord of the Universe; playful is my Beloved. My Lord God is wondrous and playful.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ. ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ. ਗੋਪੀ ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is the milkmaids who seek Him.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the Ravisher and the Enjoyer.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਭੁਲਈ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
174.e: The Lord is All-knowing - He cannot be fooled, O my Lord of the Universe. He is the True Guru, the Yogi. ||1||

174.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੈ. ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways!

174.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ. ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: Some enjoy enjoyments, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander around naked, the poorest of the poor.

174.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who beg for them.

174.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
174.e: His devotees have the Support of the Naam, O my Lord of the Universe; they beg for the sublime sermon of the Lord. ||2||

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੋਚ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfills the desires of the minds of His devotees.

174.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: He Himself is permeating and pervading the waters and the lands, O my Lord of the Universe; He is All-pervading - He is not far away.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: The Lord Himself is within the self, and outside as well, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is fully pervading everywhere.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
174.e: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is diffused everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe. The Lord Himself beholds all; His Immanent Presence is pervading everywhere. ||3||

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: O Lord, the music of the praanic wind is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; as the Lord Himself plays this music, so does it vibrate and resound.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: O Lord, the treasure of the Naam is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord God is revealed.
