174.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: He Himself leads us to enter His Sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord preserves the honor of His devotees.

174.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: Meeting the Saints, O my Lord of the Universe, I have found my Lord God, my Companion, my Best Friend.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਮੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ. ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
174.e: The Lord, the Life of the World, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. The night of my life now passes in peace. ||2||

174.g: ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ; ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: O Saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Best Friend; my mind and body are hungry for Him.

174.g: ਹਉ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved; deep within, I feel the pain of separation from the Lord.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: The Sovereign Lord King is my Beloved, my Best Friend. Through the Guru, I have met Him, and my mind has been rejuvenated.

174.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
174.e: The hopes of my mind and body have been fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe; meeting the Lord, my mind vibrates with joy. ||3||

174.g: ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ. ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ. ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved; I am forever a sacrifice to You.

174.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ. ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord; O my Lord of the Universe, please preserve my assets.

174.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ. ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.e: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through His guidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੭॥
174.e: I have obtained the Lord's Name, by Your Mercy, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||29||67||

174.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
174.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

174.g: ਜਯੋ ਜਾਮਦਗਨੰ ਦਿਜੰ ਆਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
ਭਯੋ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਤੇ ਕਵਾਚੀ ਕੁਠਾਰੀ ॥
174.e: Hail, hail to the incarnation-like sage Yamadagni, through whose wife Renuka was born the wearer of armour and carrier of axe (that is Parashurama)

174.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਛਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਪਾਤ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
ਹਨ︀ਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਜਉਨੈ ਸਹੰਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਪੰ ॥੫॥
174.e: He manifested himself as death for the Kshatriyas and destroyed the king named Sahasrabadhu.5.

174.g: ਕਹਾ ਗੰਮ ਏਤੀ, ਕਥਾ ਸਰਬ ਭਾਖਉ ॥
ਕਥਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਤੇ ਥੋਰੀਐ ਬਾਤ ਰਾਖਉ ॥
174.e: I have not the requisite wisdom to describe the whole story, therefore fearing lest it may not become voluminous, I say it very briefly:

174.g: ਭਰੇ ਗਰਬ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਨਰੇਸੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਤਿਨੈ ਨਾਸ ਕੋ ਪਾਣਿ ਧਾਰਿਯੋ ਕੁਠਾਰੰ ॥੬॥
174.e: The Kshatriya king had been intoxicated with pride and in order to destroy them, Parashurama held up the axe in his hand.6.

174.g: ਹੁਤੀ ਨੰਦਨੀ ਸਿੰਧ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
ਤਿਸੈ ਮਾਗ ਹਾਰਿਯੋ ਸਹੰਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
174.e: Nandini, the wish-fulfilling cow like the daughter of Yamadagni and the Kshatriya Sahasrabahu had got tired in begging it from the sage.

174.g: ਲੀਯੋ ਛੀਨ ਗਾਯੰ ਹਤਿਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਤਾਤੰ ॥
ਤਿਸੀ ਬੈਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਬੈ ਭੂਪ ਪਾਤੰ ॥੭॥
174.e: Ultimately, he snatched away the cow and killed Yamadagni and in order to wreak his vengeance, Parashurama destroyed all the Kshatriya kings.7.

174.g: ਗਈ ਬਾਲ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਲੀਯੋ ਸੋਧ ਤਾ ਕੋ ॥
ਹਨਿਯੋ ਤਾਤ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾ ਕੋ ॥
174.e: Form the very childhood Parashurama had been quite inquisitive in his mind about the identity of the killer of his father

174.g: ਸਹੰਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਪੰ ਸੁਣਿਯੋ ਸ੍ਰਉਣ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
ਗਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਤਉਨ ਠਾਮੰ ॥੮॥
174.e: And when he came to know that it was the king Sahasrabahu, he moved towards his place with his arms and weapons.8.

174.g: ਕਹੋ ਰਾਜ, ਮੇਰੋ ਹਨਿਯੋ ਤਾਤ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
174.e: Parashurama said to the king, “O king  how hast thou killed my father?

174.g: ਅਬੈ ਜੁਧ ਜੀਤੋ ਹਨੋ ਤੋਹਿ ਤੈਸੇ ॥
174.e: Now I want to wage war with you in order to kill you”

174.g: ਕਹਾ ਮੂੜ, ਬੈਠੋ ਸੁ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਸੰਭਾਰੋ ॥
ਚਲੋ ਭਾਜ ਨਾ ਤੋ ਸਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਡਾਰੋ ॥੯॥
174.e: He also said, “O fool, hold your weapons, otherwise forsaking them, run away from this place.”9.

174.g: ਸੁਣੇ ਬੋਲ ਬੰਕੇ ਭਰਿਯੋ ਭੂਪ ਕੋਪੰ ॥
ਉਠਿਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਦੂਲ ਲੈ ਪਾਣਿ ਧੋਪੰ ॥
174.e: Hearing these ironical words, the king was filled with fury and holding his weapons in his hands, got up like a lion.

174.g: ਹਠਿਯੋ ਖੇਤਿ ਖੂਨੀ ਦਿਜੰ ਖੇਤ੍ਰ ਹਾਯੋ ॥
ਚਹੇ ਆਜ ਹੀ ਜੁਧ ਮੋ ਸੋ ਮਚਾਯੋ ॥੧੦॥
174.e: He came to the arena of battle with determination, knowing that the Brahmin Parashurama was desirous of fighting with him on the same day.10.

174.g: ਧਏ ਸੂਰ ਸਰਬੰ ਸੁਨੇ ਬੈਨ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
ਚੜਿਯੋ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਜੁਧੰ ਸ੍ਰਜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਜੰ ॥
174.e: Hearing the furious words of the king, his warriors in great ire, decorating themselves (with their weapon) marched forward

174.g: ਗਦਾ ਸੈਹਥੀ ਸੂਲ ਸੇਲੰ ਸੰਭਾਰੀ ॥
ਚਲੇ ਜੁਧ ਕਾਜੰ ਬਡੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
174.e: Holding firmly their tridents, lances, maces etc., the great canopied kings moved forward for waging war.11.

174.g: ਰਸਾਵਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
174.e: RASAAVAL STANZA

174.g: ਭਏ ਏਕ ਠਉਰੇ ॥
ਸਬ ਦੇਵਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
ਛੀਰਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਕਹੁ ਚਲੇ ਸੁਧਾਰਾ ॥
174.e: All the gods together reflected on this issued and went towards the milk-ocean.

174.g: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਰੀ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
ਇਮ ਆਗਿਆ ਤਹ ਤੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
174.e: There they eulogized KAL, the destroyer Lord and received the following message.3.

174.g: ਦਿਜ ਜਮਦਗਨਿ ਜਗਤ ਮੋ ਸੋਹਤ ॥
ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਤ ਅਘਨ ਓਘਨ ਹਤ ॥
174.e: The Destroyer Lord said, “ A sage named Yamadagni abides on the earth, who always gets up to destroy the sins by his virtuous deeds.

174.g: ਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਧਰੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
ਹਨਹੁ ਸਕ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
174.e: “O Vishnu, manifested yourself in his house and destroy the enemies of India.”4.

174.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
174.e: NARAAJ STANZA

174.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਪਾਣ ਧਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
ਚਲੇ ਬਲੀ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
174.e: Holding their swords in their hands, the mighty warriors marched forward with loud shouts

174.g: ਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਭਾਖਹੀ ॥
ਸਰੋਘ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਚਾਖਹੀ ॥੧੨॥
174.e: They uttered “kill, kill” and their arrows were drinking blood.12.

174.g: ਸੰਜੋਇ ਸੈਹਥੀਨ ਲੈ ॥
ਚੜੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ਰੋਸ ਕੈ ॥
174.e: Wearing their armour and holding their daggers, the warriors in great ire moved forward.

174.g: ਚਟਾਕ ਚਾਬਕੰ ਉਠੇ ॥
ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਬੁਠੈ ॥੧੩॥
174.e: The blows of whips horses produced knocking sounds and thousands of arrows flew out (from the bows).13.

175.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
175.e: By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of the Universe; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved. ||4||4||30||68||
Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

175.g: ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ; ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
175.e: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||

175.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.

175.g: ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ; ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.

175.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ; ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
175.e: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

175.g: ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.

175.g: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, my Beloved.
O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||

175.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.

175.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;

175.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ; ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
175.e: the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69||
All the warriors ran and gathered at one place.
And the besieged Parashurama, just as the clouds besiege the sun.14.
With the crackling of bows a queer sound was produced,
And the army swarmed like the dark clouds.15.
With the clattering of the daggers, a queer sound was produced,
The elephants began to roar in groups and bedecked with armour, the warriors seemed impressive.16.
Gathering from all the four sides, the groups of elephants began a fight.
The volleys of arrows were shot and the heads of the kings were shattered. 17.
The frightful sound emanated and all the kings got infuriated.
Parashurama was besieged by the army like Shiva encircled by the forces of Cupid.18.
All being absorbed and dyed with the dye of war, feared the glory of others.
So much dust arose by (the movement of the) army that the sky was filled with dust.19.
The drums resounded violently and the mighty warriors began to roar.
The warriors were fighting each other like the freely roaming lions.20.
With the shouts of “kill, kill”, the warriors were uttering dreadful words.
The chopped limbs of the warriors are falling and it appeared that there is fire on all the four sides.21.
The weapons began to fall from the hands and the warriors began to run away empty-handed.
The horses were neighing and were running hither and thither with swiftness.22.
The warriors are wounding the enemy by showering their arrows  they were also patting their arms.
The warriors by planting their daggers, increasing their inimical intentions, are waging a terrible war. 23
Many wounds are being inflicted and the wounded warriors appear to be playing Holi
Showering their arrows, all are desirous of the victory.24.
The warriors are roaming and falling like the swinging, after the breaking of their weapons and becoming trees armless, the warriors sped away.25.
Fifth Mehl, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

175.g: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
175.e: How can happiness be found, O my Siblings of Destiny?

175.g: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
175.e: How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ||1||Pause||

175.g: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
175.e: There is no happiness in owning one's own home, in all of Maya,
or in lofty mansions casting beautiful shadows.
In fraud and greed, this human life is being wasted. ||1||
Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ. ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.

175.g: ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.

175.g: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.
I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||

175.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.

175.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ; ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.
I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

175.g: ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ; ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: Show me the way to the Lord, Dear Saints; I am searching all over for Him.

175.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The Kind and Compassionate True Guru has shown me the Way, and I have found the Lord.
Through the Name of the Lord, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

175.g: ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: I am consumed with the pain of separation from the Love of the Lord.

175.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The Guru has fulfilled my desire, and I have received the Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.e: The Lord has become merciful, and now I meditate on the Name of the Lord.
Servant Nanak has obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||6||20||18||32||70||

176.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

176.g: ਕਿਉ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਐ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
176.e: Why do you doubt? What do you doubt?

176.g: ਜਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
176.e: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky.
The Gurmukhs are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||
One who is protected by the Merciful Lord

176.g: ਤਿਸੁ; ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
176.e: - no one else can rival him. ||1||Pause||
The Infinite One is pervading among all.

176.g: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਉ; ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
176.e: So sleep in peace, and don't worry.

176.g: ਓਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਜੋ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
176.e: He knows everything which happens. ||2||
The self-willed manmukhs are dying in the thirst of duality.

176.g: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਹਿ; ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
176.e: They wander lost through countless incarnations; this is their pre-ordained destiny.
As they plant, so shall they harvest. ||3||
Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind has blossomed forth.
And now everywhere I look, God is revealed to me.

176.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
176.e: Servant Nanak's hopes have been fulfilled by the Lord. ||4||2||71||
All the enemies who came in front of him, Parashurama killed them all. Ultimately all of them ran away and their pride was shattered.26.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
In the field of karma, plant the seed of the Naam.
Your works shall be brought to fruition.
You shall obtain these fruits, and the fear of death shall be dispelled.

176.g: ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
176.e: Sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

176.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
176.e: Keep the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, enshrined in your heart,
and your affairs shall be quickly resolved. ||1||Pause||
Be always attentive to your God;
thus you shall be honored in His Court.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
In so many incarnations, you were a worm and an insect;
in so many incarnations, you were an elephant, a fish and a deer.
In so many incarnations, you were a bird and a snake.
In so many incarnations, you were yoked as an ox and a horse. ||1||
Meet the Lord of the Universe - now is the time to meet Him.
After so very long, this human body was fashioned for you. ||1||Pause||
In so many incarnations, you were rocks and mountains;
in so many incarnations, you were aborted in the womb;
in so many incarnations, you developed branches and leaves;
you wandered through 8.4 million incarnations. ||2||
Through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you obtained this human life.

176.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
176.e: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
Abandon pride, falsehood and arrogance.
Remain dead while yet alive, and you shall be welcomed in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

176.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
176.e: Whatever has been, and whatever shall be, comes from You, Lord.
No one else can do anything at all.
We are united with You, when You unite us with Yourself.

176.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
176.e: Says Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||72||
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

176.g: ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਆਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
ਲਏ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨਾ ਕੀਏ ਆਪ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
176.e: Wearing his important weapons, the king himself, taking the mighty warriors with him, marched forward to wage the war.

176.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਛੋਰੇ ਭਯੋ ਜੁਧੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥
ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਕਾਲ ਮਾਨੋ ਸਭੈ ਰਸਮਿ ਭਾਨੰ ॥੨੭॥
176.e: Forsaking his innumerable weapons, he waged a terrible war. The king himself seemed like the rising sun at dawn.27.

176.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਠੋਕਿ ਭੂਪੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਐਸੇ ॥

176.e: Patting his arms, the king firmly waged the war, like the war waged by Vrittasura with Indra

176.g: ਸਬੈ ਕਾਟ ਰਾਮੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਬਾਹਿ ਹੀਨੰ ॥
ਹਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨਾ ਭਯੋ ਗਰਬ ਛੀਨੰ ॥੨੮॥
176.e: Parashurama made him armless by chopping away all his arms, and shattered his pride by destroying all his army.28.

176.g: ਕਟੀ ਸੁੰਡ ਸੀ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਾਹੰ ਬਿਸਾਲੰ ॥
176.e: Parashurama held up his dreadful axe in his hand and chopped the arm of king like the trunk of the elephant.

176.g: ਭਏ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗੰ ਕਰੰ ਕਾਲ ਹੀਣੰ ॥
ਗਯੋ ਗਰਬ ਸਰਬੰ ਭਈ ਸੈਣ ਛੀਣੰ ॥੨੯॥
176.e: In this way becoming limbless, the whole army of the king was destroyed and his ego was shattered.29.

176.g: ਬਚੇ ਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਜ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
176.e: Ultimatley, becoming unconscious the king fell down in the battlefield, and all his warriors, who remained alive, fled away to their own countries.

176.g: ਲਈ ਛੀਨ ਛਉਨੀ ਕਰੈ ਛਤ੍ਰਿ ਘਾਤੰ ॥

176.e: Parashurama seized his capital and destroyed the Kshatriyas and for a long time, the people worshipped him.30.
He is pleased at the sight of his elephants and horses
and his armies assembled, his servants and his soldiers.
But the noose of egotism is tightening around his neck. ||2||
His rule may extend in all ten directions;
he may revel in pleasures, and enjoy many women
- but he is just a beggar, who in his dream, is a king. ||3||

176.g: ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
176.e: The True Guru has shown me that there is only one pleasure.

176.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
176.e: Whatever the Lord does, is pleasing to the Lord's devotee.
Servant Nanak has abolished his ego, and he is absorbed in the Lord. ||4||

176.g: ਇਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
176.e: This is the way to find happiness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

176.g: ਇਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
176.e: This is the way to find the Lord, our Help and Support. ||1||Second Pause||
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

176.g: ਲਈ ਛੀਨ ਛਉਨੀ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
ਹਰੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਦਿਜੰ ਜੀਤਿ ਜੂਪੰ ॥
176.e: After seizing the capital, Parashurama made a Brahmin the king, but again the Kshatriyas, conquering all the Brahmins, snatched their city.

177.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
He makes jewels out of the dust,

177.g: ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
177.e: and He managed to preserve you in the womb.
He has given you fame and greatness;

177.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
177.e: meditate on that God, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||
O Lord, I seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
177.e: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
He transformed me, the fool, into a fine speaker,
and He made the unconscious become conscious;
by His Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures.

177.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਮਨ ਤੇ. ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
177.e: May I never forget that God from my mind. ||2||
He has given a home to the homeless;
He has given honor to the dishonored.
He has fulfilled all desires;
remember Him in meditation, day and night, with every breath and every morsel of food. ||3||
By His Grace, the bonds of Maya are cut away.
By Guru's Grace, the bitter poison has become Ambrosial Nectar.

177.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
177.e: Says Nanak, I cannot do anything;
I praise the Lord, the Protector. ||4||6||75||
DOHRA

177.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
177.e: In this way, the Brahma incarnation manifested for purifying he subjects

177.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਬੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕਹ ਡਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
177.e: And all the beings began to perform the righteous actions, forsaking the sinful action.6.
CHAUPAI

177.g: ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਮੋ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਅਖਾਰਾ ॥

177.e: In this way, Vishnu manifested for the ninth time in order to enact the wonderful play.
Now I describe the tenth incarnation, who is the support of the life-breath of the saints.35.

177.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਨਵਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਪਰਸਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੯॥
177.e: End of the description of the ninth incarnation PARASHURAMA in BACHITTAR NATAK.9.
Give up all your clever tricks and devices,
and hold tight to the Feet of the Saints. ||2||

177.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
177.e: The One, who holds all creatures in His Hands,

177.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
177.e: is never separated from them; He is with them all.

177.g: ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ; ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
177.e: Abandon your clever devices, and grasp hold of His Support.
In an instant, you shall be saved. ||3||

177.g: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
177.e: Know that He is always near at hand.

177.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
177.e: Accept the Order of God as True.
Through the Guru's Teachings, eradicate selfishness and conceit.

177.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
177.e: O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||4||73||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

177.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
177.e: In His Sanctuary, there is no fear or sorrow.

177.g: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
177.e: Without Him, nothing at all can be done.
I have renounced clever tricks, power and intellectual corruption.
God is the Protector of His servant. ||1||

177.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
177.e: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.

177.g: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
177.e: Within your home, and beyond it, He is always with you. ||1||Pause||

177.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
177.e: Keep His Support in your mind.
Now begins the description of Brahma Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
CHAUPAI
Now I describe that ancient story as to how the knowledgeable Brahma was bron.
The four-headed Brahma was born as the destroyer of sins and the creator of all the universe.1.

177.g: ਜਬ ਜਬ ਬੇਦ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਹੀ ॥

177.e: Whenever the knowledge of Vedas is destroyed, Brahma is then manifested.

177.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਪੁ ਧਰਾ ॥

177.e: For this purpose Vishnu manifested himself ad Brahma and he was known as “Chaturanan” (four-faced) in the world.2.

177.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਬਿਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਪੁ ਧਰਾ ॥
ਤਬ ਸਬ ਬੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰ ਜਗਿ ਕਰਾ ॥
177.e: When Vishnu manifested himself as Brahma, he propagated the doctrines of the Vedas in the world.
He composed Shastras, Smritis and gave a life-discipline to the beings of the world.3.

177.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਹੁਤੇ ਅਘਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਹਰਤਾ ॥
177.e: Those people who were there to perform sinful action, after getting the knowledge. From the Vedas, they became the remover of sins.
The sinful actions were explained and all the beings became absorbed in the actions of Dharma ( righteousness).4.
In this way, the Brahma incarnation manifested, who is the remover of all sins.
All the subjects began to tread the path of Dharma and abandoned the sinful actions.5.
CHAUPAI
The tenth incarnation of Vishnu is Brahma, who established the righteous actions in the world.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
The Guru's Word is eternal and everlasting.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
177.e: The Guru's Word cuts away the noose of Death.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
177.e: The Guru's Word is always with the soul.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

177.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਸੁ. ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
177.e: Whatever the Guru gives, is useful to the mind.

177.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
177.e: Whatever the Saint does - accept that as True. ||1||Pause||
The Guru's Word is infallible and unchanging.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are dispelled.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
177.e: The Guru's Word never goes away;

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
177.e: through the Guru's Word, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
177.e: The Guru's Word accompanies the soul.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
177.e: The Guru's Word is the Master of the masterless.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
177.e: The Guru's Word saves one from falling into hell.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savors the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
The Guru's Word is revealed in the world.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, no one suffers defeat.
O Nanak, the True Guru is always kind and compassionate,
Unto those whom the Lord Himself has blessed with His Mercy. ||4||5||74||

177.g: ਚਲਿਯੋ ਰੋਸ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ਕੁਠਾਰੰ ॥੩੧॥
177.e: The Brahmin, in great agony called Parashurama, who, holding his axe, moved with great fury.31.

177.g: ਸੁਨ︀ਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ਹਠੀ ਰਾਮ ਆਏ ॥
ਸਭੰ ਜੁਧੁ ਕੋ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
177.e: When all the kings heard that taking a vow of killing Kshatriyas, the persistent Parashurama had arrived, then all of them prepared for war, taking all their weapons.

177.g: ਚੜੇ ਚਉਪ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਕੀਏ ਜੁਧ ਐਸੇ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਸੋ ਰਾਵਣੰ ਲੰਕ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੩੨॥
177.e: In great ire, all of them came to wage the war like Rana and Ravana in Sri Lanka.32.

177.g: ਲਗੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਲਖੇ ਰਾਮ ਅੰਗੰ ॥
ਗਹੇ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣੰ ਕੀਏ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੰਗੰ ॥
177.e: When Parashurama saw that he was being attacked with arms and weapons, then he took the arrows in hand and killed his enemies

177.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਹੀਣ ਏਕੰ ਸਿਰੰ ਹੀਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥
ਸਬੈ ਮਾਰ ਡਾਰੇ ਗਏ ਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ॥੩੩॥
177.e: Many warriors became armless and many became headless. All those warriors who went in front of Parashurama, he killed all of the,.33.

177.g: ਹਣੇ ਐਸ ਹੀ ਭੂਪ ਸਰਬੰ ਸੁਧਾਰੰ ॥
177.e: He caused the earth to become without Kshatriyas for twenty-one times and in this way, he destroyed all the kings and their base

177.g: ਕਥਾ ਸਰਬ ਜਉ ਛੋਰ ਤੇ ਲੈ ਸੁਨਾਉ ॥
ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਕੇ ਬਾਢਬੇ ਤੇ ਡਰਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
177.e: And if I describe the complete story from one end to the other, then I fear that the book will become very voluminous.34.

178.e: TOTAK STANZA

178.g: ਜਿਹ ਤੇਜ ਤਪੈ ਰਵਿ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥
178.e: In Trupura State lived a three-eyed demons, whose glory was equal to the glory of the Sun, which spread over the three worlds.
After receiving the boon, that demons become so powerful that he conquered all the fourteen regions of the universe.9.

178.g: ਜੋਊ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਣ ਹਣੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥
ਸੋਊ ਨਾਸ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਹ ਦੈਤ ਦੁਰੰ ॥
178.e: (That demon had this boon) that anyone who had the power to kill him with one arrow, he only could kill that terrible demon.

178.g: ਅਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਯੋ, ਕਬਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਨੈ ॥
ਇਕ ਬਾਣ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪੁਰ ਤੀਨ ਹਨੈ ॥੧੦॥
178.e: The poet now wants to describe that mighty warrior who could kill that three-eyed demon with one arrow.10.
PADHAARI STANZA

178.g: ਤਬ ਪਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਤਿ ॥
178.e: When the earth is pressed by the load of sins, then she cannot have peace in her heart.
Then she goes and shouts loudly in the milk-ocean and the Rudra incarnation of Vishnu is manifested.7.
After manifestation, Rudra destroys the demons and crushing them, he protects the saints.

178.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਕਲ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟ ਨਾਸ ॥

178.e: In this way, destroying all the tyrants, he then abides in the heart of his devotees.8.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
Those who have died have been forgotten.

178.g: ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ; ਸੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
178.e: Those who survive have fastened their belts.
They are busily occupied in their affairs;

178.g: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣ; ਦਿੜੀ ਉਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
178.e: they cling twice as hard to Maya. ||1||

178.g: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ; ਕਛੁ. ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
178.e: No one thinks of the time of death;
people grasp to hold that which shall pass away. ||1||Pause||
The fools - their bodies are bound down by desires.
They are mired in sexual desire, anger and attachment;
the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands over their heads.
Believing it to be sweet, the fools eat poison. ||2||
They say, "I shall tie up my enemy, and I shall cut him down.
Who dares to set foot upon my land?
I am learned, I am clever and wise."
The ignorant ones do not recognize their Creator. ||3||
The Lord Himself knows His Own state and condition.

178.g: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ; ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
178.e: What can anyone say? How can anyone describe Him?

178.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
178.e: Whatever He attaches us to - to that we are attached.
Everyone begs for their own good. ||4||
Everything is Yours; You are the Creator Lord.
You have no end or limitation.
Please give this gift to Your servant,
that Nanak might never forget the Naam. ||5||9||78||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
By all sorts of efforts, people do not find salvation.
Through clever tricks, the weight is only piled on more and more.
Serving the Lord with a pure heart,
you shall be received with honor at God's Court. ||1||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
Listening to the Lord's sermon, my pollution has been washed away.
I have become totally pure, and I now walk in peace.
By great good fortune, I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
I have fallen in love with the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

178.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
178.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His servant has been carried across.

178.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
178.e: The Guru has lifted me up and carried me across the ocean of fire. ||1||Pause||
Singing the Kirtan of His Praises, my mind has become peaceful;
the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away.
I have seen all the treasures within my own mind;
why should I now go out searching for them? ||2||
When God Himself becomes merciful,
the work of His servant becomes perfect.
He has cut away my bonds, and made me His slave.
Remember, remember, remember Him in meditation; He is the treasure of excellence. ||3||
He alone is in the mind; He alone is everywhere.
The Perfect Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled all doubts.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak has found peace. ||4||8||77||
Now begins the description of Rudra Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
TOTAK STANZA

178.g: ਸਬ ਹੀ ਜਨ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਲਗੇ ॥
ਤਜਿ ਜੋਗ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਗੇ ॥
178.e: All the people absorbed themselves in the works of Dharma, but the time came when the discipline of Yoga and Bhakti (devotion) was abandoned

178.g: ਜਬ ਧਰਮ ਚਲੇ ਤਬ ਜੀਉ ਬਢੇ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਕੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗਢੇ ॥੧॥
178.e: When the path of Dharma is adopted, all the souls get pleased and practising equality, they visualize One Brahman within all.1.
This earth was pressed under the lord of sufferings of the people of the world and it was impossible to describe its anguish and agony

178.g: ਧਰ ਰੂਪ ਗਊ ਦਧ ਸਿੰਧ ਗਈ ॥

178.e: Then the earth transformed itself into a cow and weeping bitterly, she reached the milk-ocean before the Non-temporal Lord.2.

178.g: ਹਸਿ ਕਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
ਦੁਖ ਸ੍ਰਉਨਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਯੋ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
178.e: When the Lord heard with His own ears the sufferings of the earth, then the Destroyer Lord was pleased and laughed

178.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਸੁਪਨੇ ॥੩॥
178.e: He called Vishnu in His presence and said to him in this way.3.

178.g: ਸੁ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤੁਮ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਧਰੋ ॥
ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਕੋ ਚਲਿ ਨਾਸ ਕਰੋ ॥
178.e: The destroyer Lord asked Vishnu to manifest himself as Rudra in order to destroy the beings of the world

178.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਧਰਿਯੋ ॥
ਜਗ ਜੰਤ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕੇ ਜੋਗ ਕਰਿਯੋ ॥੪॥
178.e: Then Vishnu manifested himself as Rudra and destroying the beings of the world, he established Yoga.4.

178.g: ਕਹਿ ਹੋਂ ਸਿਵ ਜੈਸਕ ਜੁਧ ਕੀਏ ॥
ਸੁਖ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋ ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
178.e: I shall describe now as to how Shiva waged wars and gave comfort to the saints
I shall also tell how he wedded Parbati after conquering her in the Swayyamvara (self-selection of a husband from amongst the suitors).5.

178.g: ਜਿਮ ਅੰਧਕ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਰਿਯੋ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਮਨੋਜ ਕੋ ਮਾਨ ਹਰਿਯੋ ॥
178.e: How Shiva waged a war against Andgakasura? How is effaced the pride of Cupid?

178.g: ਦਲ ਦੈਤ ਦਲੇ ਕਰ ਕੋਪ ਜਿਮੰ ॥

178.e: Getting furious, how he mashed the gathering of demons? I shall describe all these anecdotes.6.

178.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
178.e: Taste the ambrosial essence, the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Of what use are other efforts?
Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself protects our honor. ||2||
What is the human? What power does he have?
All the tumult of Maya is false.
Our Lord and Master is the One who acts, and causes others to act.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||
Of all comforts, this is the true comfort.
Keep the Guru's Teachings in your mind.

178.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
178.e: Those who bear love for the Name of the Lord
- says Nanak, they are blessed, and very fortunate. ||4||7||76||

178.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥

178.e: It hath been said in Shastras and Smrities that there is no difference between Brahma and Vishnu.7.

178.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦਸਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੦॥
178.e: End of the description of the tenth incarnation BRAHMA in BACHITTAR NATAK.10.

179.g: ਸਿਵ ਧਾਇ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਰਨ ਕੋ ॥
ਜਗ ਕੇ ਸਬ ਜੀਵ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਕੋ ॥
179.e: For the protection of the beings of the world and the killing of that demon, the god Shiva moved forward.

179.g: ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪਿ ਤਜਿਯੋ ਸਿਤ ਸੁਧ ਸਰੰ ॥
ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਹੀ ਨਾਸ ਕੀਯੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥੧੧॥
179.e: In great fury, shot one arrow and only with arrow, he destroyed that demon of Tripura, named Tripura.11.
Seeing this performance all the saints were pleased and gods showered flowers form heaven.

179.g: ਧੁਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਰਹੀ ਜਯ ਸਦ ਹੂਅੰ ॥

179.e: The sound of “hail, hail” resound, there was consternation on Himalaya mountain and the earth tembled.12.

179.g: ਦਿਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਬੀਤ ਗਏ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥

179.e: After a long time, another demons named Andhakasura came on the scene

179.g: ਤਬ ਬੈਲਿ ਚੜਿਯੋ ਗਹਿ ਸੂਲ ਸਿਵੰ ॥
ਸੁਰ ਚਉਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਕਿਵੰ ॥੧੩॥
179.e: Mounting his bull and holding his trident, Shiva moved forward (to chastise him). Seeing his terrible form, the gods were also startled.13.
Shiva marched forward alongwith Ganas, Gandharavas, Yakshas and Nagas and Durga also granted boon to him.
The gods began to see that Shiva would kill Andhakasura in the same way as he had killed the demon Tripura.14.

179.g: ਉਹ ਓਰਿ ਚੜੇ ਦਲ ਲੈ ਦੁਜਨੰ ॥
ਇਹ ਓਰ ਰਿਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਗਹਿ ਸੂਲ ਸਿਵੰ ॥
179.e: Form the other side that demons of vicious intellect started. From this side in great fury and holding the trident in his hand, Shiva moved.
Intoxicated with war-tactics, the mighty warriors presented the scene like the blazing flames of fire in the forst.15.

179.g: ਦਨੁ ਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਰਚੇ ॥
ਗਹਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਬੈ ਰਸ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਮਚੇ ॥
179.e: Both the demons and gods became absorbed in the war and bedecking themselves with weapons all the warriors enjoyed the relish of anger.

179.g: ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਲੈ ਘਨ ਸੈ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੧੬॥
179.e: The warriors of both the sides enjoyed the shooting of arrows and the arrows are being showered like the raining of clouds on the doomsday.16.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

179.g: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖੀ ॥
179.e: I have gazed upon the many forms of Maya, in so many ways.
With pen and paper, I have written clever things.
I have seen what it is to be a chief, a king, and an emperor,
but they do not satisfy the mind. ||1||

179.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
179.e: Show me that peace, O Saints,
which will quench my thirst and satisfy my mind. ||1||Pause||
You may have horses as fast as the wind, elephants to ride on,
sandalwood oil, and beautiful women in bed,
actors in dramas, singing in theaters

179.g: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
179.e: - but even with them, the mind does not find contentment. ||2||
You may have a throne at the royal court, with beautiful decorations and soft carpets,
all sorts of luscious fruits and beautiful gardens,
the excitement of the chase and princely pleasures
- but still, the mind is not made happy by such illusory diversions. ||3||
In their kindness, the Saints have told me of the True One,
and so I have obtained all comforts and joy.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
Says Nanak, through great good fortune, I have found this. ||4||

179.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
179.e: One who obtains the wealth of the Lord becomes happy.

179.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੮੧॥
179.e: By God's Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat. ||1||Second Pause||12||81||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

179.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਿ; ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
179.e: Even with vast sums of wealth, the mind is not satisfied.
Gazing upon countless beauties, the man is not satisfied.
He is so involved with his wife and sons - he believes that they belong to him.
That wealth shall pass away, and those relatives shall be reduced to ashes. ||1||
Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, they are crying out in pain.

179.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
179.e: Their bodies are cursed, and their wealth is cursed - they are imbued with Maya. ||1||Pause||

179.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ; ਦੀਜਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
179.e: The servant carries the bags of money on his head,

179.g: ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
179.e: but it goes to his master's house, and he receives only pain.
The man sits as a king in his dreams,
but when he opens his eyes, he sees that it was all in vain. ||2||
The watchman oversees the field of another,

179.g: ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਰਾਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
179.e: but the field belongs to his master, while he must get up and depart.
He works so hard, and suffers for that field,

179.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪੜੈ ॥੩॥
179.e: but still, nothing comes into his hands. ||3||

179.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜੁ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
179.e: The dream is His, and the kingdom is His;

179.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਨੀ; ਤਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
179.e: He who has given the wealth of Maya, has infused the desire for it.
He Himself annihilates, and He Himself restores.
Nanak offers this prayer to God. ||4||11||80||

179.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ ॥
179.e: O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the Lord's Name.

179.g: ਤੁਝੈ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾਤਾ ਝੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
179.e: The hot winds shall never even touch you. ||1||Pause||
Like a boat in the ocean of fear;
like a lamp which illumines the darkness;
like fire which takes away the pain of cold
- just so, chanting the Name, the mind becomes peaceful. ||2||

179.g: ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ; ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
179.e: The thirst of your mind shall be quenched,
and all hopes shall be fulfilled.
Your consciousness shall not waver.
Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam as Gurmukh, O my friend. ||3||
He alone receives the panacea, the medicine of the Naam,
unto whom the Lord, in His Grace, bestows it.

179.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥
179.e: One whose heart is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har
- O Nanak, his pains and sorrows are eliminated. ||4||10||79||

180.e: RUAAMAL STANZA

180.g: ਘਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਭਜੇ ਸੁਰਾਰਦਨ; ਕੋਪੁ ਓਪ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥
ਅੰਧਿ ਕੰਧਿ ਫਿਰਿਯੋ ਤਬੈ; ਜਯ ਦੁੰਦਭੀਨ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
180.e: The demons being wounded and becoming weak began to run away and at that time, Andhakasura, resounding his drums turned and moved towards the battlefield.

180.g: ਸੂਲ ਸੈਹਥਿ ਪਰਿਘ ਪਟਸਿ; ਬਾਣ ਓਘ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ॥
180.e: The blows were struck with tridents, swords, arrows and other weapons and arms and the warriors swung and fell

180.g: ਪੇਲਿ ਪੇਲਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰਨ; ਖੇਲ ਜਾਨੁ ਧਮਾਰ ॥੧੭॥
180.e: It seemed that there was a programme of dance and amorous pastime.17.

180.g: ਸੇਲ ਰੇਲ ਭਈ ਤਹਾ; ਅਰੁ ਤੇਗ ਤੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ॥
ਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਫਵਜਨ; ਬਾਹਿ ਬਾਹਿ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ॥
180.e: With the blows of swords and arrows, there was consternation in the battlefield and striking their weapons, the warriors were stirring up the armies.

180.g: ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਪਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ; ਸਰਬੰਗ ਸ੍ਰੋਨਤ ਪੂਰ ॥
180.e: Somewhere the limbless fighters and somewhere the complete bodies are immersed in blood

180.g: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਬਰੀ ਅਨੇਕਨ; ਹੇਰਿ ਹੇਰਿ ਸੁ ਹੂਰ ॥੧੮॥
180.e: The warriors who had attained martyrdom, are wedding the heavenly damsels, after making search for them.18.

180.g: ਚਉਰ ਚੀਰ ਰਥੀ ਰਥੋਤਮ; ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਕੀ ਸਰਤਾ ਉਠੀ; ਸੁ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
180.e: The garments, chariots, the chariot-riders and many horses are lying hither and thither and a dreadful stream of blood is flowing in the battlefield.

180.g: ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਕਟੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਜ; ਰਾਜ ਤਾਜ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
180.e: Somewhere the bedecked horses and elephants are lying chopped and

180.g: ਉਸਟਿ ਪੁਸਟਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ; ਰਿਪੁ ਬਾਚੀਯੰ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੧੯॥
180.e: Somewhere there are heaps of warriors lying down  not a single enemy hath remained alive.19.

180.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਤਹਾ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
ਗਾਜ ਗਾਜ ਹਨੇ ਸਦਾ; ਸਿਵ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
180.e: The kings have abandoned their bedecked horses and elephants and gone away and the god Shiva, shouting very loudly, hath destroyed the mighty warriors.

180.g: ਭਾਜ ਭਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਹਠੀ; ਹਥਿਆਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣ ਕਮਾਣ ਛਾਡਿ; ਸੁ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੨੦॥
180.e: The brave fighters have also abandoned their weapons and gone away, after leaving behind their bows and arrows and steel-armors.20.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
By Your Grace, we find the Way.
By God's Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By God's Grace, we are released from our bondage.
By Your Grace, egotism is eradicated. ||1||
As You assign me, so I take to Your service.

180.g: ਹਮ ਤੇ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
180.e: By myself, I cannot do anything at all, O Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||
If it pleases You, then I sing the Word of Your Bani.
If it pleases You, then I speak the Truth.
If it pleases You, then the True Guru showers His Mercy upon me.
All peace comes by Your Kindness, God. ||2||

180.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
180.e: Whatever pleases You is a pure action of karma.

180.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
180.e: Whatever pleases You is the true faith of Dharma.

180.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
180.e: The treasure of all excellence is with You.
Your servant prays to You, O Lord and Master. ||3||

180.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
180.e: The mind and body become immaculate through the Lord's Love.
All peace is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
My mind remains attuned to Your Name;
Nanak affirms this as his greatest pleasure. ||4||14||83||
The mortal claims this body as his own.
Again and again, he clings to it.
He is entangled with his children, his wife and household affairs.

180.g: ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
180.e: He cannot be the slave of the Lord. ||1||

180.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
180.e: What is that way, by which the Lord's Praises might be sung?

180.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
180.e: What is that intellect, by which this person might swim across, O mother? ||1||Pause||
That which is for his own good, he thinks is evil.
If someone tells him the truth, he looks upon that as poison.
He cannot tell victory from defeat.
This is the way of life in the world of the faithless cynic. ||2||
The demented fool drinks in the deadly poison,
while he believes the Ambrosial Naam to be bitter.
He does not even approach the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
he wanders lost through 8.4 million incarnations. ||3||
The birds are caught in the net of Maya;

180.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ; ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
180.e: immersed in the pleasures of love, they frolic in so many ways.
Says Nanak, the Perfect Guru has cut away the noose from those,
Unto whom the Lord has shown His Mercy. ||4||13||82||
All the warriors who go in front of him, Rudra destroys them all, those who will advance, will also be destroyed by Shiva.21.
The blind (headless) trunks are rising in the battlefield and casting special showers of arrows.
Innumerable warriors, shooting arrows from their bows are exhibiting proof of their bravery.22.
RASAAVAL STANZA
Bedecked with the steel-armour, the warriors are thundering on all the four sides.
The wanton mighty heroes are irresistible.23.
The horrible sound of musical instruments is being heard and the bedecked warriors are being seen.
The bows are crackling like the thundering of the clouds.24.
The gods, holding their bows, are also moving,
And all the brave fighters, being pleased, are showering their arrows.25.
Holding their bows in their hands, excessively glorious and proud warriors have marched forward,
And with the clattering of their weapons, the bodies of the enemies are being chopped into two parts.26.
Seeing the fury of Rudra, the weak demons are running away.
Bedecked with their armour, they mighty warriors are thundering.27.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
The mind is the temple, and the body is the fence built around it.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
You may taste the other flavors,
but your thirst shall not depart, even for an instant.

180.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕਾ; ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
180.e: But when you taste the sweet flavor the the Lord's sublime essence
- upon tasting it, you shall be wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||
O dear beloved tongue, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

180.g: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
180.e: Imbued with this sublime essence, you shall be satisfied. ||1||Pause||

180.g: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਵੇ; ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
180.e: O tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

180.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
180.e: Each and every moment, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
Do not listen to any other, and do not go anywhere else.
By great good fortune, you shall find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||
Twenty-four hours a day, O tongue, dwell upon God,
The Unfathomable, Supreme Lord and Master.
Here and hereafter, you shall be happy forever.
Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O tongue, you shall become priceless. ||3||
All the vegetation will blossom forth for you, flowering in fruition;

180.g: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡੇ ॥
180.e: imbued with this sublime essence, you shall never leave it again.

180.g: ਆਨ ਨ ਰਸ ਕਸ; ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
180.e: No other sweet and tasty flavors can compare to it.

180.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੪॥
180.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has become my Support. ||4||15||84||

181.e: CHAUPAI
At that time, the mighty Andhakasura, alongwith the army of demons sped towards the fornt.
He discharged many arrows on Nandi, which penetrated through his limbs.33.

181.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਬਾਣ ਲਗੇ ਬਾਹਣ ਤਨਿ ॥
ਰੋਸ ਜਗਿਯੋ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਵ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ॥
181.e: When the god Shiva saw the infliction of the arrows on his vehicle, then he became violently furious.
With great ire, he discharge his poisonous arrows, which spread over the earth and sky in an instant.34.
When Rudra shot his arrows, the army of demons sped away.
Then Andhakasura came in front of Shiva, a dreadful war ensured.35.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
TOTAK STANZA

181.g: ਘਟਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਿਪੁ ਚੇਤ ਭਯੋ ॥
ਧਨੁ ਬਾਣ ਬਲੀ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਾਣਿ ਲਯੋ ॥
181.e: After one ghari (about 24 mintues), the enemy (Andhakasura) regained his senses and that mighty warrior again took bow and arrows in his hands.

181.g: ਸਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਲੀ ਘਨ ਜਿਯੋ ਬਰਖ੍ਰਯੋ ॥੩੮॥
181.e: The bow was pulled in his hands in great anger and a volley of arrows was showered like rain.38.
In great ire, that mighty warrior began to discharge and shower his distinctively powerful arrows, which struck on one side came out from the other side.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ; ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
181.e: You are my Companion; You are my Best Friend.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀਤੁ ॥
181.e: You are my Beloved; I am in love with You.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ; ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
181.e: You are my honor; You are my decoration.

181.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਨਿਮਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
181.e: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||1||

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
181.e: You are my Intimate Beloved, You are my breath of life.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
181.e: You are my Lord and Master; You are my Leader. ||1||Pause||

181.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
181.e: As You keep me, so do I survive.

181.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ; ਸੋਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
181.e: Whatever You say, that is what I do.
Wherever I look, there I see You dwelling.
O my Fearless Lord, with my tongue, I chant Your Name. ||2||

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ; ਤੂੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
181.e: You are my nine treasures, You are my storehouse.
I am imbued with Your Love; You are the Support of my mind.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੀਆ ॥
181.e: You are my Glory; I am blended with You.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ; ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
181.e: You are my Shelter; You are my Anchoring Support. ||3||
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
I have obtained Your secret from the Guru.
Through the True Guru, the One and only Lord was implanted within me;

181.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੭॥
181.e: servant Nanak has taken to the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||18||87||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Gwaarayree:
Night and day, they remain in the Love of the One.

181.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
181.e: They know that God is always with them.
They make the Name of their Lord and Master their way of life;
they are satisfied and fulfilled with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

181.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
181.e: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, their minds and bodies are rejuvenated,

181.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ; ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
181.e: entering the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of the soul.
They see only the One, and obey His Order.
There is only one trade, and one occupation.
They know no other than the Formless Lord. ||2||
They are free of both pleasure and pain.
They remain unattached, joined to the Lord's Way.

181.g: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
181.e: They are seen among all, and yet they are distinct from all.
They focus their meditation on the Supreme Lord God. ||3||
How can I describe the Glories of the Saints?

181.g: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
181.e: Their knowledge is unfathomable; their limits cannot be known.
O Supreme Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon me.
Bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||17||86||
ARIL

181.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਾਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਵਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ਕੋਪ ਕਰਿ ॥
ਲਗੇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਗਾਤ; ਗਏ ਓਹ ਘਾਨਿ ਕਰ ॥
181.e: The demons, highly infuriated, discharged twenty arrows on Shiva, which struck the body of Shiva and wounded it.

181.g: ਗਹਿ ਪਿਨਾਕ ਕਹ ਪਾਣਿ; ਪਿਨਾਕੀ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
ਹੋ ਤੁਮੁਲ ਜੁਧੁ ਦੁਹੂੰਅਨ; ਰਣ ਮਧਿ ਮਚਾਇਓ ॥੩੬॥
181.e: Shiva also ran forward, holding his bow in his hand and a fearful war began between them.36.

181.g: ਤਾੜਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਹ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਪਿਨਾਕੀ ਕੋਪੁ ਹੁਐ ॥
ਹਣੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਹੁ ਬਾਣ; ਨਿਖੰਗ ਤੇ ਕਾਢ ਦੁਐ ॥
181.e: Then Shiva took out tow arrow from his quiver, and aiming them at the tyrant, he discharged them in great anger.

181.g: ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਭੂਮਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸਿਰਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
181.e: The arrows struck the head of the enemy and he fell down on the earth

181.g: ਹੋ ਜਨਕੁ ਗਾਜ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ; ਬੁਰਜ ਕਹੁ ਮਾਰਿਯੋ ॥੩੭॥
181.e: He fell like a column falling flat on the ground having been hit by lightning.37.
Holding the Shakti (his power) in his hands the supremely glorious Shiva,
Thundering dreadfully, is absorbed in war, and is looking impressive.28.
The blood is oozing out of the wounds and all the fighters are fighting with enthusiasm.
The vampires are pleased and the horses etc, are rolling in dust.29.
Rudra, in great fury, hath destroyed the demons,
And hath chopped their bodies into bits and killed the army.30.
Shiva, the holder of the trident, is in extreme anger and he hath destroyed the demons.
The arrows are being showered like the raining clouds.31.
When Rudra thundered in the battlefield, then all the demons ran away.
All of them abandoned their weapons and the pride of all was shattered.32.
The infinite substance is within it.
Within it, the great merchant is said to dwell.

181.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਬਾਪਾਰੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਊਹਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
181.e: Who is the trader who deals there? ||1||
How rare is that trader who deals in the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He takes the Ambrosial Nectar as his food. ||1||Pause||
He dedicates his mind and body to serving the Lord.

181.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
181.e: How can we please the Lord?
I fall at His Feet, and I renounce all sense of 'mine and yours'.

181.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ; ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
181.e: Who can settle this bargain? ||2||

181.g: ਮਹਲੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ; ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
181.e: How can I attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence?

181.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
181.e: How can I get Him to call me inside?

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
181.e: You are the Great Merchant; You have millions of traders.
Who is the benefactor? Who can take me to Him? ||3||
Seeking and searching, I have found my own home, deep within my own being.
The True Lord has shown me the priceless jewel.
When the Great Merchant shows His Mercy, He blends us into Himself.
Says Nanak, place your faith in the Guru. ||4||16||85||

182.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
The eyes are asleep in corruption, gazing upon the beauty of another.
The ears are asleep, listening to slanderous stories.
The tongue is asleep, in its desire for sweet flavors.
The mind is asleep, fascinated by Maya. ||1||

182.g: ਇਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ; ਕੋਈ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
182.e: Those who remain awake in this house are very rare;

182.g: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਵਸਤੁ; ਓਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
182.e: by doing so, they receive the whole thing. ||1||Pause||
All of my companions are intoxicated with their sensory pleasures;

182.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
182.e: they do not know how to guard their own home.
The five thieves have plundered them;
the thugs descend upon the unguarded village. ||2||

182.g: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
182.e: Our mothers and fathers cannot save us from them;

182.g: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
182.e: friends and brothers cannot protect us from them
they cannot be restrained by wealth or cleverness.
Only through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, can those villains be brought under control. ||3||
Have Mercy upon me, O Lord, Sustainer of the world.
The dust of the feet of the Saints is all the treasure I need.
In the Company of the True Guru, one's investment remains intact.
Nanak is awake to the Love of the Supreme Lord. ||4||
He alone is awake, unto whom God shows His Mercy.

182.g: ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ; ਸਾਬਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੦॥੮੯॥
182.e: This investment, wealth and property shall remain intact. ||1||Second Pause||20||89||
CHAUPAI
In this way, this demon grew in strength excessively and he also looted the treasure of Kuber.
He caught Brahma and caused him to weep, and conquering Indra, He seized his canopy and swung over his head.4.
After conquering the gods, he caused them to fall at his feet and forced Vishnu and Shiva to abide only within their own cities.l
He gathered all the fourteen jewels in his own house and fixed the polaces on nine planets at his will.5.
DOHRA

182.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਬਸਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਪੁਰੀ; ਅਸੁਰ ਸਕਲ ਅਸੁਰਾਰ ॥
182.e: The demon-king, conquering all, caused them to live in his own territory.

182.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੀ ਮਹੇਸ ਕੀ; ਗਿਰਿ ਕੈਲਾਸ ਮਧਾਰ ॥੬॥
182.e: The gods went to Kailash mountain and worshipped him.6.
It torments us with the expression of pleasure and pain.
It torments us through incarnations in heaven and hell.
It is seen to afflict the rich, the poor and the glorious.
The source of this illness which torments us is greed. ||1||
Maya torments us in so many ways.

182.g: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
182.e: But the Saints live under Your Protection, God. ||1||Pause||
It torments us through intoxication with intellectual pride.
It torments us through the love of children and spouse.
It torments us through elephants, horses and beautiful clothes.
It torments us through the intoxication of wine and the beauty of youth. ||2||
It torments landlords, paupers and lovers of pleasure.
It torments us through the sweet sounds of music and parties.
It torments us through beautiful beds, palaces and decorations.
It torments us through the darkness of the five evil passions. ||3||
It torments those who act, entangled in ego.
It torments us through household affairs, and it torments us in renunciation.
It torments us through character, lifestyle and social status.

182.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥
182.e: It torments us through everything, except for those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||

182.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ; ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
182.e: The Sovereign Lord King has cut away the bonds of His Saints.
How can Maya torment them?

182.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਈ ॥
182.e: Says Nanak, Maya does not draw near those
Who have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||19||88||

182.g: ਤਬ ਕੋਪ ਕਰੰ ਸਿਵ ਸੂਲ ਲੀਯੋ ॥
ਅਰਿ ਕੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੁਖੰਡ ਕੀਯੋ ॥੩੯॥
182.e: Then greatly infuriated, Shiva took the trident in his hand, and cut the head of the enemy into two parts.39.

182.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਪਿਨਾਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਹਿ ਅੰਧਕ ਬਧਹਿ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੋਸਤਤਿ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੦॥
182.e: End of the description of the killing of the demon ANDHAK and the Eulogy of SHIVA in BACHITTAR NATAK.
CHAUPAI
They performed various types of mediation, worship and service day and service day and night for a long time.
Now everything depended on the support of Shiva.7.

182.g: ਕਾਪਤ ਭਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਰਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ॥
182.e: All the enemies on water and land trembled, seeing the innumerable forces of Shiva, the lord of ghosts.

182.g: ਦਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਦੁਹਿਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ॥੮॥
182.e: Out of all the kings, the king Daksha was most respected, who had ten thousand daughters in his home.8.
Once that king held a swayyamvara at his place and permitted his ten thousand daughters.

182.g: ਜੋ ਬਰੁ ਰੁਚੇ ਬਰਹੁ ਅਬ ਸੋਈ ॥

182.e: To wed according to their interest forsaking all thought of high and low in society.9.

182.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਿਸੈ ਰੁਚਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਬਰਾ ॥

182.e: Each one of them wed whomsoever she liked, but all such anecdotes cannot be described
It all of them are narrated in detail, then there will always be the fear of increasing the volume.10.
Now begins the description of the killing of Parbati:
Let Sri Bhagauti ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
TOTAK STANZA

182.g: ਸੁਰ ਰਾਜ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਿ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
ਅਰਿ ਅੰਧਕ ਨਾਸ ਸੁਨਿਯੋ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
182.e: When Indra heard about the destruction of Andhakasura he was very much pleased.

182.g: ਇਮ ਕੈ ਦਿਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਬੀਤ ਗਏ ॥

182.e: In this way, may days elapsed and Shiva also went to Indra’s place.1.
Then Rudra manifested himself in a dreadful form  seeing Shiva, Indra discharged his wapons.

182.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਵ ਕੋਪ ਅਖੰਡ ਕੀਯੋ ॥

182.e: Then Shiva was highly infuriated and blazed like a live charcoal.2.

182.g: ਤਿਹ ਤੇਜ ਜਰੇ ਜਗ ਜੀਵ ਸਬੈ ॥
ਤਿਹ ਡਾਰ ਦਯੋ ਮਧਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਤਬੈ ॥
182.e: With that blaze, all the beings of the world began to burn. Then Shiva in order to pacify his anger threw his weapon and anger into the sea

182.g: ਸੋਊ ਡਾਰ ਦਯੋ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਮਹਿ ਨ ਗਯੋ ॥

182.e: But it could not be drowned and manifested itself in the from of the demon Jalandhar.3.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
Kings and emperors are under His Power.

182.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
182.e: The whole world is under His Power.

182.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
182.e: Everything is done by His doing;
other than Him, there is nothing at all. ||1||
Offer your prayers to your True Guru;
He will resolve your affairs. ||1||Pause||

182.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
182.e: The Darbaar of His Court is the most exalted of all.

182.g: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
182.e: His Name is the Support of all His devotees.
The Perfect Master is pervading everywhere.

182.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਨੀ ॥੨॥
182.e: His Glory is manifest in each and every heart. ||2||
Remembering Him in meditation, the home of sorrow is abolished.

182.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਜਮੁ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
182.e: Remembering Him in meditation, the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.
Remembering Him in meditation, the dry branches become green again.

183.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
By the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, the fire of desire is quenched.
Meeting the True Guru, egotism is subdued.
In the Company of the True Guru, the mind does not waver.
The Gurmukh speaks the Ambrosial Word of Gurbani. ||1||

183.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
183.e: He sees the True One pervading the whole world; he is imbued with the True One.

183.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
183.e: I have become cool and tranquil, knowing God, through the Guru. ||1||Pause||
By the Grace of the Saints, one chants the Lord's Name.
By the Grace of the Saints, one sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
By the Grace of the Saints, all pains are erased.
By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from bondage. ||2||

183.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮਿਟੇ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ॥
183.e: By the kind Mercy of the Saints, emotional attachment and doubt are removed.
Taking a bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy - this is true Dharmic faith.
By the kindness of the Holy, the Lord of the Universe becomes merciful.
The life of my soul is with the Holy. ||3||
Meditating on the Merciful Lord, the Treasure of Mercy,
I have obtained a seat in the Saadh Sangat.

183.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
183.e: I am worthless, but God has been kind to me.
In the Saadh Sangat, Nanak has taken to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||22||91||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord God.
The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Shedding my ego, I have become free of hate.
Twenty-four hours a day, I worship the Guru's Feet. ||1||
Now, my evil sense of alienation is eliminated,

183.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
183.e: since I have heard the Praises of the Lord with my ears. ||1||Pause||
The Savior Lord is the treasure of intuitive peace, poise and bliss.
He shall save me in the end.
My pains, sufferings, fears and doubts have been erased.
He has mercifully saved me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
He Himself beholds, speaks and hears all.

183.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
183.e: O my mind, meditate on the One who is always with you.
By the Grace of the Saints, the Light has dawned.
The One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is perfectly pervading everywhere. ||3||
Pure are those who speak, and sanctified are those who hear and sing,
Forever and ever, the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

183.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
183.e: Says Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Mercy,

183.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੨॥
183.e: all one's efforts are fulfilled. ||4||23||92||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
He breaks our bonds, and inspires us to chant the Lord's Name.
With the mind centered in meditation on the True Lord,
Anguish is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace.
Such is the True Guru, the Great Giver. ||1||
He alone is the Giver of peace, who inspires us to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

183.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
183.e: By His Grace, He leads us to merge with Him. ||1||Pause||

183.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
183.e: He unites with Himself those unto whom He has shown His Mercy.
All treasures are received from the Guru.
Renouncing selfishness and conceit, coming and going come to an end.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Supreme Lord God is recognized. ||2||
God has become merciful to His humble servant.
Four daughters were given to the sage Kashyap, and many of the daughters married the god Chandrama (moon).
Many of them went to foreign countries, but Guri (Parvait) named and married Shiva.11.

183.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਬ︀ਯਾਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਨੀ ॥

183.e: When, after wedding, Parvati reached the home of Shiva (Rudra), the many types of narratives became prevalent.
The king called all his daughters and all of them came to their father’s home alongwith their husband.12.
All the kings within and outside the country, began to reach at the house of their father-in-law.
Considering the queer dressing habits of Rudra, no one could think of him.13.
The king Daksha did not invite Gauri  then Gauri heard about it from the mouth of Narad, she got extremely angry in her mind.

183.g: ਬਿਨ ਬੋਲੇ ਪਿਤ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗਈ ॥

183.e: She went to her father’s house without telling anybody, and her body and mind were emotionally blazing.14.

183.g: ਜਗ ਕੁੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀ ਉਛਰ ਕਰਿ ॥

183.e: Being extremely infuriated, she plunged into the sacrificial pit, and because of her dignified demeanour, the fire cooled down.

183.g: ਤਾ ਤਨ ਕੀਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਸਾ ॥੧੫॥
183.e: But Sati (Parvati) lighted her Yoga-fire and with that fire, her body was destroyed.15.
Narad, on the other side, came to Shiva and said, “Why art thou sitting here, having been intoxicated with hemp (and there Guari hath burnt herself alive)?”

183.g: ਗਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਤਹ ਕੋ ਉਠ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧੬॥
183.e: Hearing this, Shiva’s meditation was shattered and his heart was filled with rage  he held up his trident and ran towards that side.16.

183.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਭਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਥਲੈ ॥

183.e: Remembering Him in meditation, sinking stones are made to float. ||3||
I salute and applaud the Society of the Saints.

183.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
183.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Support of the breath of life of His servant.
Says Nanak, the Lord has heard my prayer;

183.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੦॥
183.e: by the Grace of the Saints, I dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||21||90||

184.e: The One Lord of the Universe is the Support of His humble servants.
They love the One Lord; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.

184.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
184.e: The Name of the Lord is all treasures for them. ||3||
They are in love with the Supreme Lord God;
their actions are pure, and their lifestyle is true.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness.
Nanak's God is Incomparable and Infinite. ||4||24||93||
When Shiva reached the place where Sati had burnt herself, he caught his trident also very firmly.
With blows of various types, he destroyed the merit of the whole Yajna (sacrifice).17.

184.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਤੇ ਕਰ ਦੁਇ ਦੁਇ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
184.e: He destroyed many kings and chopped their bodies into bits.

184.g: ਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਮਾਰ ਠਉਰ ਹੀ ਡਾਰਾ ॥੧੮॥
184.e: On whomsoever the blow of the trident struck, he died there and then.18.

184.g: ਜਗ ਕੁੰਡ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਭਯੋ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥

184.e: When Shiva looked into the sacrificial pit and saw he burnt body of Gauri, he began to pluck his matted hair.
At that time, Virbhandra manifested himself there and after his manifestation, he began to destroy the kings.19.

184.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਪਠੈ ਦਏ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ॥
184.e: He chopped several kings into part and sent several of them to the abode of Yama.
Just as with the flooding of the stream, the banks are eroded further, likewise many terrible warriors began to fall on the earth.20.
At that time, Shiva regained his senses and fell on the enemy with his bow in his hand.

184.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਬਾਣ ਤਨ ਮਾਰਾ ॥

184.e: Whomsoever Shiva struck his arrow by pulling his bow, he breathed his last there and then.21.
The tabors began to resound and in all the ten directions, the ghosts and fiends began to roar.

184.g: ਝਿਮ ਝਿਮ ਕਰਤ ਅਸਿਨ ਕੀ ਧਾਰਾ ॥

184.e: The swords glittered and their blows were showered and the headless trunks began to dance on all the four sides.22.
The trumpets and drums resounded and their sound was heard  the warriors fought bravely in the war.

184.g: ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਮਰੇ ਅਪਰ ਰਿਸ ਬਢੇ ॥

184.e: They collided with one another, being filled with great anger, and they were never seen again, riding on their horses.23.
On whomsoever, there was the blow of the trident, held in the fist of Shiva, he was killed there and then,
Virbhadra foutht such a fierce fight, that in great confusion, the ghosts and fiends were awakened.24.
DOHRA

184.g: ਤੀਰ ਤਬਰ ਬਰਛੀ ਬਿਛੂਅ; ਬਰਸੇ ਬਿਸਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
184.e: The arrows, daggers, lances and other types of weapons were showered,

184.g: ਸਬ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੂਝਤ ਭਏ; ਸਾਬਤ ਬਚਾ ਨ ਏਕ ॥੨੫॥
184.e: And all the warriors fell as martyras and none remained alive.25.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

184.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
184.e: Our way of life is in His Hands;
remember Him, the Master of the masterless.

184.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ; ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
184.e: When God comes to mind, all pains depart.

184.g: ਭੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
184.e: All fears are dispelled through the Name of the Lord. ||1||

184.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ; ਭਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਾ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
184.e: Why do you fear any other than the Lord?

184.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ; ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
184.e: Forgetting the Lord, why do you pretend to be at peace? ||1||Pause||
He established the many worlds and skies.
The soul is illumined with His Light;

184.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
184.e: no one can revoke His Blessing.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on God, and become fearless. ||2||
Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on God's Name.
In it are the many sacred shrines of pilgrimage and cleansing baths.
Seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God.

184.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੰਕ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
184.e: Millions of mistakes shall be erased in an instant. ||3||
The Perfect King is self-sufficient.
God's servant has true faith in Him.
Giving him His Hand, the Perfect Guru protects him.
O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God is All-powerful. ||4||26||95||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
By Guru's Grace, my mind is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Asleep for so many incarnations, it is now awakened.
I chant the Ambrosial Bani, the Glorious Praises of God.
The Pure Teachings of the Perfect Guru have been revealed to me. ||1||
Meditating in remembrance on God, I have found total peace.

184.g: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
184.e: Within my home, and outside as well, there is peace and poise all around. ||1||Pause||
I have recognized the One who created me.
Showing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.
Taking me by the arm, He has made me His Own.

184.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ; ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
184.e: I continually chant and meditate on the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||
Mantras, tantras, all-curing medicines and acts of atonement,
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

184.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
184.e: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord, swim across.
Those who have the blessing of good karma, meet with the Lord.

184.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ; ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
184.e: Pain, disease and fear do not affect them at all.
They meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within their hearts. ||1||
Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord.

184.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
184.e: From the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained. ||1||Pause||
The Merciful Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.
He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Eternal and Infinite.
Meditate on Him, O my mind, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru. ||2||
Serving Him, all treasures are obtained.
Worshipping God, honor is obtained.

184.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
184.e: Working for Him is never in vain;

184.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
184.e: forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
Show Mercy to me, O God, O Searcher of hearts.
The Unseen Lord and Master is the Treasure of Peace.
All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary;
Nanak is blessed to receive the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||25||94||
CHAUPAI

184.g: ਬਾਇ ਹਨੇ ਗਿਰਿ ਗੇ ਜਨੁ ਝੰਡਾ ॥
184.e: The kings, chopped into bits, were lying the cluster of trees fallen down by the blow of wind.
When Rudra, holding his trident wrought the destruction, then the scence of that place looked very queer.26.
Then the kings, forgetting the Yajna, began to run away to their countries.

184.g: ਜਬ ਰਣ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਹੁਐ ਧਾਏ ॥

184.e: When Rudra pursued them as fury-incarnate, then none of the running kings could survive.27.

184.g: ਤਬ ਸਬ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਜ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥

184.e: Then all the kings, becoming alert, were highly activated and the musical instruments resounded from all the sides.

184.g: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਭਰਾ ਛਿਨਕ ਮਹਿ ਧਾਮਾ ॥੨੮॥
184.e: Then the war become more intense and the house of Yama began to be filled with the dead.28.

185.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
185.e: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
That which belongs to another - he claims as his own.

185.g: ਜੋ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਨ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
185.e: That which he must abandon - to that, his mind is attracted. ||1||
Tell me, how can he meet the Lord of the World?

185.g: ਜੋ ਬਿਬਰਜਤ; ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.e: That which is forbidden - with that, he is in love. ||1||Pause||

185.g: ਝੂਠੁ ਬਾਤ; ਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
185.e: That which is false - he deems as true.

185.g: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵਨੁ; ਮਨਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
185.e: That which is true - his mind is not attached to that at all. ||2||
He takes the crooked path of the unrighteous way;
leaving the straight and narrow path, he weaves his way backwards. ||3||

185.g: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ; ਖਸਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
185.e: God is the Lord and Master of both worlds.

185.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੮॥
185.e: He, whom the Lord unites with Himself, O Nanak, is liberated. ||4||29||98||
NARAAJ STANZA
Many warriors are running forward and with their blows are wounding the enemies.
Many warriors, being wounded, are roaming and showering arrows.35.
Bedecked with several arms, the warriors are marching forward and thundering
And striking their blows fearlessly, are shouting “kill, kill”.36.
Preparing themselves like the thundering dark clouds, the brave fighters are marching forward.
Bedecked with weapons, they are looking so beautiful that the daughters of the gods are getting allured by them.37.
They are very selective in wedding the warriors and all the heroes are moving about and looking impressive in the battlefield like Indra, the king of gods.
All those kings, who are frightened, they have been abandoned by the daughters of the gods.38.
NARAAJ STANZA
The warriors riding on the horses, coming down, began to roam, holding their weapons
The arrows were discharged and the bows crackled.31.
The sword began to fall and the dust rose from the earth upwards.
On one side, the sharp arrows are being discharged and on the other side people are repeating request for water.32.
The vultures are swooping down and the warriors equal in strength are fighting.
Durga is laughing and the glittering swords are being struck.33.
BRIDH NARAAJ STANZA

185.g: ਸੁ ਮਾਰੁ ਮਾਰ ਸੂਰਮਾ; ਪੁਕਾਰ ਮਾਰ ਕੇ ਚਲੇ ॥
ਅਨੰਤ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਗਣੋ; ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬੀਰਹਾ ਦਲੇ ॥
185.e: The brave fighters marched forward with their shouts of “kill, kill”. And form this side, the ganas of Rudra destroyed innumerable warriors.

185.g: ਘਮੰਡ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਵਣੀ; ਅਘੋਰ ਜਿਉ ਘਟਾ ਉਠੀ ॥
ਅਨੰਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਾਣ ਧਾਰ; ਸੁਧ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਕੈ ਬੁਠੀ ॥੩੪॥
185.e: The furious arrows are being showered like the drops form the visible rising dark thundering clouds in the month of Sawan.34.
BRIDH NARAAJ STANZA

185.g: ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਜ ਕੈ; ਪਰੇ ਹੁਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ॥
ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ; ਬਨਾਇ ਸੈਣ ਏਕਠੀ ॥
185.e: The warriors thundering dreadfully and bedecked with arms and weapons fell (on the enemy) and seeing the anger of Rudra, they gathered all the forces.

185.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਵਣੀ; ਦੁਰੰਤ ਜਿਯੋ ਉਠੀ ਘਟਾ ॥
ਸੁ ਸੋਭ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਨਚੈ; ਸੁ ਛੀਨਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਛਟਾ ॥੩੯॥
185.e: They gathered quickly like the rising and thundering clouds of Sawan and gathering the glory of heaven in themselves, began to dance, being highly intoxicated.39.

185.g: ਕੰਪਾਇ ਖਗ ਪਾਣ ਮੋ; ਤ੍ਰਪਾਇ ਤਾਜੀਯਨ ਤਹਾ ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
185.e: are all in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the soul and the breath of life.
I have obtained the true wealth of the Lord's Love.
I have crossed over the treacherous world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||
Sit in peace, O Saints, with the family of friends.

185.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਓ; ਜਾ ਕਾ. ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
185.e: Earn the wealth of the Lord, which is beyond estimation.
He alone obtains it, unto whom the Guru has bestowed it.
O Nanak, no one shall go away empty-handed. ||4||27||96||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, they come together through destiny.
As long as the Lord commands, they enjoy their pleasures. ||1||
By burning oneself, the Beloved Lord is not obtained.

185.g: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ; ਸਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.e: Only by the actions of destiny does she rise up and burn herself, as a 'satee'. ||1||Pause||
Imitating what she sees, with her stubborn mind-set, she goes into the fire.

185.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ. ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
185.e: She does not obtain the Company of her Beloved Lord, and she wanders through countless incarnations. ||2||
With pure conduct and self-restraint, she surrenders to her Husband Lord's Will;

185.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਕਉ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
185.e: that woman shall not suffer pain at the hands of the Messenger of Death. ||3||

185.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
185.e: Says Nanak, she who looks upon the Transcendent Lord as her Husband,
is the blessed 'satee'; she is received with honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||30||99||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
The hands are sanctified instantly,
and the entanglements of Maya are dispelled.
Repeat constantly with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
and you shall find peace, O my friends, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
With pen and ink, write upon your paper

185.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.e: the Name of the Lord, the Ambrosial Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||Pause||
By this act, your sins shall be washed away.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.

185.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ; ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
185.e: The couriers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall not touch you.
The intoxication of Maya shall not entice you at all. ||2||
You shall be redeemed, and through you, the whole world shall be saved,
if you chant the Name of the One and Only Lord.
Practice this yourself, and teach others;
instill the Lord's Name in your heart. ||3||
That person, who has this treasure upon his forehead
that person meditates on God.

185.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
185.e: Twenty-four hours a day, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

185.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੭॥
185.e: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||4||28||97||
The kings returned with several kinds of arrows and weapons for waging the war.
They began to strike blows speedily like the strokes on the gong.29.
The mighty warriors began to fall as bits and the nine regions of the world trembled.
Forsaking their swords, the kings began to fall down and there was dreadful scene in the battlefield.30.
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
I am prosperous and fortunate, for I have received the True Name.

185.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural, intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

186.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

186.g: ਭਯੋ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਪੰ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਸੂਲ ਪਾਣੰ ॥

186.e: In great ire, Rudra held his trident in his hand and vacating the saddles of many horses, he killed many warriors.

186.g: ਉਤੇ ਏਕ ਦਛੰ ਇਤੈ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਏਕੰ ॥

186.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

186.g: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਤੇ; ਜਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
186.e: I was scared, scared to death, when I thought that He was far away.
But my fear was removed, when I saw that He is pervading everywhere. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

186.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
186.e: He shall not abandon me; He shall surely carry me across. ||1||Pause||

186.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ; ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਬ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
186.e: Pain, disease and sorrow come when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

186.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
186.e: Eternal bliss comes when one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
Do not say that anyone is good or bad.
Renounce your arrogant pride, and grasp the Feet of the Lord. ||3||
Says Nanak, remember the GurMantra;
you shall find peace at the True Court. ||4||32||101||

186.g: ਜੁਆਨ ਆਨ ਕੇ ਪਰੇ; ਸੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਠਾਢਿਬੋ ਜਹਾ ॥
186.e: Holding their swords in their hands and galloping their horses, the mighty youthful warriors stopped there, where Rudra was standing.

186.g: ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਸੈਹਥੀ; ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ਆਨ ਕੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
ਧਕੇਲਿ ਰੇਲਿ ਲੈ ਚਲੈ; ਪਛੇਲ ਪਾਵ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥੪੦॥
186.e: The brave fighters began to inflict blows with many types of arrows and weapons and forcibly moved forward, without retracing their steps.40.

186.g: ਸੜਕ ਸੂਲ ਸੈਹਥੀ; ਤੜਕ ਤੇਗ ਤੀਰਯੰ ॥
ਬਬਕ ਬਾਘ ਜਿਯੋ ਬਲੀ; ਭਭਕ ਘਾਇ ਬੀਰਯੰ ॥
186.e: The clattering of daggers and sword is being heard  the warriors are wounding one another, roaring like lions.

186.g: ਅਘਾਇ ਘਾਇ ਕੇ ਗਿਰੇ; ਪਛੇਲ ਪਾਵ ਨ ਟਰੇ ॥
ਸੁ ਬੀਨ ਬੀਨ ਅਛਰੈ; ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਹੁਐ ਬਰੇ ॥੪੧॥
186.e: On getting wounded the warriors are falling down, but are not retracing their steps.41.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

186.g: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਕਾ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
186.e: The Lord of Unfathomable Form has His Place in the mind.
By Guru's Grace, a rare few come to understand this. ||1||
The Ambrosial Pools of the celestial sermon

186.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲੈ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
186.e: - those who find them, drink them in. ||1||Pause||
